凌晨.en: He came home in the early morning.
We set off at three in the morning.

凌晨.zh: 凌晨的时候街上几乎没人。
凌晨.en: In the early morning, there are almost no people on the streets.
He gets up to run every early morning.

凌晨.zh: 昨天晚上我工作到凌晨两点。
凌晨.en: Last night I worked until two in the morning.

害.en: These words made her cry for a long time.

害.zh: 这场暴雨害得我们没法出门。
害.en: This heavy rain prevented us from going out.

淘汰.en: He was eliminated by the company.

淘汰.zh: 这次比赛会淘汰一半的选手。
淘汰.en: This competition will eliminate half of the contestants.

淘汰.zh: 因为技术落后，产品很快就被淘汰了。
淘汰.en: Because the technology was outdated, the product was quickly eliminated.

淘汰.zh: 我们得想办法避免被淘汰。
淘汰.en: We need to find a way to avoid being eliminated.

淘汰.zh: 学校每年都淘汰不合格的学生，这公平吗？
淘汰.en: The school eliminates unqualified students every year, is that fair?

立.zh: 他立下了一个很大的目标。
立.en: He set a very big goal.

立.zh: 既然决定了，我们就立马上路吧。
立.en: Since we've decided, let's set off immediately.

立.zh: 这个牌子立在路边很显眼。
立.en: This sign stands by the road and is very conspicuous.

立.zh: 公司刚立了新规矩，大家都要遵守。
立.en: The company just established new rules; everyone must follow.

料.zh: 你料不到会发生这种事。
料.en: You couldn't expect this to happen.

料.zh: 做这道菜需要哪些调料？
料.en: What seasonings are needed for this dish?

料.zh: 我早就料到他会迟到，果然不出所料。
料.en: I already expected he'd be late, sure enough.

料.zh: 这些塑料制品很容易回收。
料.en: These plastic products are easy to recycle.

料.zh: 别小看他，他可是个有料的家伙。
料.en: Don't underestimate him, he's a guy with substance.

公众.en: The public has strong opinions about this.

公众.zh: 这件事引起了公众的广泛关注。
公众.en: This incident has drawn widespread public attention.

公众.zh: 虽然公司道歉了，但公众并不买账。
公众.en: Although the company apologized, the public didn't buy it.

公众.zh: 政府需要倾听公众的声音。
公众.en: The government needs to listen to the public's voice.

公众.zh: 他作为公众人物，言行要谨慎。
公众.en: As a public figure, he must be cautious in words and deeds.

释放.zh: 运动可以帮助释放压力。
经过谈判，人质终于被安全释放。
释放.en: After negotiations, the hostages were finally released safely.

释放.zh: 这个行为会释放出有害气体。
释放.en: This action will release harmful gases.

释放.zh: 他释放出了内心的愤怒。
释放.en: He released the anger inside him.

心脏.en: His heart is beating very fast.

心脏.zh: 医生说他心脏有点问题。
心脏.en: The doctor said there's something wrong with his heart.

心脏.zh: 虽然很害怕，但他的心脏依然很强壮。
心脏.en: Although scared, his heart is still strong.

心脏.zh: 这里是城市的心脏地带。
心脏.en: This is the heart of the city.

心脏.zh: 她收到礼物时，心脏几乎停止了。
心脏.en: When she received the gift, her heart almost stopped.

嗨.zh: 他嗨起来的时候谁都拦不住。
嗨.en: When he gets excited, no one can stop him.

嗨.zh: 先别嗨，我们还有工作要完成。
嗨.en: Don't get carried away yet, we still have work to finish.

嗨.zh: 昨天聚会大家玩得很嗨。
嗨.en: Yesterday at the party everyone had a blast.

斗争.zh: 为了自由，他们进行了长期的斗争。
斗争.en: For freedom, they waged a long struggle.

斗争.zh: 虽然困难重重，但斗争从未停止。
斗争.en: Although difficulties abound, the struggle never stopped.

斗争.zh: 内部斗争让公司损失很大。
斗争.en: Internal strife caused great losses to the company.
He is having an intense internal struggle.

给予.zh: 公司会给予优秀员工丰厚奖励。
给予.en: The company will give generous rewards to outstanding employees.

给予.zh: 如果你给予足够支持，他一定能完成。
给予.en: If you give enough support, he can definitely finish.

给予.zh: 父母给予了我无私的爱。
给予.en: My parents gave me selfless love.

给予.zh: 这个政策给予农民很多好处。
给予.en: This policy gives farmers many benefits.

指挥.zh: 他站在台上指挥整个合唱团。
指挥.en: He stood on stage conducting the entire choir.

指挥.zh: 因为情况紧急，他临时担任了指挥。
指挥.en: Because of the emergency, he temporarily acted as commander.

指挥.zh: 交通警察在路口指挥车辆。
指挥.en: The traffic police are directing vehicles at the intersection.

指挥.zh: 老板指挥我们做这做那，真烦。
指挥.en: The boss orders us around, so annoying.

突破.en: He ran and broke the record.

突破.zh: 虽然很难，但我们还是突破了。
突破.en: Although it was hard, we still broke through.

突破.zh: 技术突破让我们看到了希望。
如果你不努力，很难有突破。
突破.en: If you don't work hard, it's hard to have a breakthrough.

露.en: She accidentally revealed her true colors.

露.zh: 因为他太紧张，所以露了破绽。
露.en: Because he was too nervous, he showed a flaw.
Today the weather is good, there is a lot of dew.

为此.en: He is very sad about this.

为此.zh: 我们为此已经准备了很久。
为此.en: We have already prepared for this for a long time.

为此.zh: 因为时间紧，为此我们加班了。
为此.en: Because time is tight, we worked overtime for this.

为此.zh: 他为此付出了很多代价。
为此.en: He paid a lot for this.

环.zh: 为了保护环境，我们种了很多树。
环.en: To protect the environment, we planted many trees.

环.zh: 如果这个环断了，项链就坏了。
环.en: If this ring breaks, the necklace will break.

环.zh: 她戴了一个银环当耳环。
环.en: She wears a silver ring as an earring.

回头.zh: 回头我再给你打个电话。
回头.en: Later I'll give you a call.

回头.zh: 如果你走错了，回头还来得及。
回头.en: If you go the wrong way, it's still not too late to turn back.

回头.zh: 她回头的时候，看到了老朋友。
回头.en: When she turned around, she saw an old friend.

法官.en: The judge has already announced the verdict.

法官.zh: 法官在法庭上问了很多问题。
法官.en: The judge asked many questions in court.

法官.zh: 因为证据不足，法官判他无罪。
法官.en: Due to insufficient evidence, the judge found him not guilty.

法官.zh: 法官要求双方提供更多的资料。
法官.en: The judge asked both parties to provide more materials.

嘿.zh: 嘿，你猜我今天遇到了谁？
嘿.en: Hey, guess who I met today?

嘿.zh: 嘿，这件事你得好好想一想。
嘿.en: Hey, you need to think carefully about this.

股票.zh: 我朋友投资股票赚了很多钱。
股票.en: My friend invested in stocks and made a lot of money.

股票.zh: 因为股票大跌，他亏了不少钱。
股票.en: Because stocks plummeted, he lost quite a bit of money.

股票.zh: 你最好别把所有钱都投进股票。
股票.en: You'd better not put all your money into stocks.

脑袋.zh: 昨天撞到了脑袋，肿了一个包。
脑袋.en: Yesterday I hit my head, and a bump swelled.

脑袋.zh: 如果你用脑袋好好想想，就能找到答案。
脑袋.en: If you think carefully with your head, you can find the answer.

脑袋.zh: 他的脑袋里装满了奇怪的想法。
脑袋.en: His head is full of strange ideas.

血液.en: Need to draw blood for test.

血液.zh: 医生说我的血液指标很正常。
血液.en: The doctor said my blood indicators are normal.

血液.zh: 因为失血过多，他的血液供应不足。
血液.en: Because of excessive blood loss, his blood supply is insufficient.

血液.zh: 献血可以促进血液新陈代谢。
血液.en: Blood donation can promote blood metabolism.

主管.zh: 我需要跟主管确认一下这个方案。
主管.en: I need to confirm this plan with the supervisor.

主管.zh: 因为主管不在，所以事情都耽误了。
主管.en: Because the supervisor was away, everything got delayed.

主管.zh: 新来的主管对我们要求特别高。
主管.en: The new supervisor has very high demands on us.

主管.zh: 那个主管很负责，大家都喜欢他。
主管.en: That supervisor is very responsible, everyone likes him.

动力.zh: 工作给了我很大的动力。
动力.en: Work gives me a lot of motivation.
Having no money is my motivation to make money.

动力.zh: 为了家人，我必须努力，这就是我的动力。
动力.en: For my family, I have to work hard, that's my motivation.

动力.zh: 学习的动力来自好奇心。
动力.en: The motivation to learn comes from curiosity.

动力.zh: 他把兴趣当作工作的动力。
动力.en: He takes his interest as the driving force for work.

形.en: The shape of this letter is very special.
He keeps his figure very well.
The shape of the cloud is like a flower.

形.zh: 虽然形状不同，但它们的形都很美。
形.en: Although the shapes are different, their forms are all beautiful.

形.zh: 你注意一下这个字的形怎么写。
形.en: Pay attention to how this character's form is written.

祝福.en: Sending you my most sincere blessings.

祝福.zh: 生日那天我收到了很多祝福。
祝福.en: I received many blessings on my birthday.

祝福.zh: 祝福你新年快乐，万事如意。
祝福.en: Wishing you a happy new year and all the best.

祝福.zh: 我代表全家送上美好的祝福。
祝福.en: On behalf of the whole family, I send our best wishes.

祝福.zh: 虽然不能到场，但我还是送上了祝福。
祝福.en: Although I couldn't be there, I still sent my blessings.

公主.zh: 每个女孩都梦想成为公主。
公主.en: Every girl dreams of becoming a princess.

公主.zh: 故事里的公主非常美丽。
公主.en: The princess in the story is very beautiful.

公主.zh: 那个小公主今天穿了一条粉裙子。
公主.en: That little princess wore a pink dress today.

公主.zh: 她是家里的公主，大家都宠她。
公主.en: She is the princess of the family, everyone dotes on her.

公主.zh: 迪士尼的公主电影我全看过。
公主.en: I've seen all the Disney princess movies.

松.en: This pine tree grows very tall.

松.zh: 鞋带太松了，重新系一下。
松.en: The shoelaces are too loose, tie them again.

松.zh: 周末不用早起，可以松一口气。
松.en: No need to get up early on weekends, you can relax.

松.zh: 他把绳子松了松，让箱子更好搬。
松.en: He loosened the rope a bit to make the box easier to move.

松.zh: 山上有很多松树，空气特别好。
松.en: There are many pine trees on the mountain, the air is especially good.

埋.en: Bury the seeds in the soil.
He buried himself in the blanket.

埋.zh: 事故后，他们埋了那些垃圾。
埋.en: After the accident, they buried that garbage.

埋.zh: 小狗喜欢在院子里埋骨头。
埋.en: The puppy likes to bury bones in the yard.

埋.zh: 因为太伤心，她把过去都埋在心里。
埋.en: Because she was too sad, she buried the past in her heart.

率.zh: 这个城市的失业率很低。
率.en: The unemployment rate in this city is very low.

率.zh: 你手机的电量利用率高吗？
率.en: Is your phone's battery usage rate high?

率.zh: 为了提高效率，他改了方法。
率.en: To improve efficiency, he changed his method.

率.zh: 成功率这么低，我们要不要试试？
率.en: The success rate is so low, should we give it a try?

率.zh: 利率下降了，大家可以考虑贷款。
率.en: Interest rates have dropped, everyone can consider taking a loan.

能量.zh: 巧克力能快速补充能量。
正能量的人总是很受欢迎。
能量.en: People with positive energy are always very popular.

能量.zh: 他浑身充满了能量，好像不会累。
能量.en: He is full of energy, as if he never gets tired.

能量.zh: 运动后需要及时补充能量和水分。
能量.en: After exercise, you need to replenish energy and water in time.

野.zh: 去野外露营要注意安全。
野.en: When camping in the wild, you need to pay attention to safety.

野.zh: 这个野菜很好吃，可以清炒。
野.en: This wild vegetable is delicious, you can stir-fry it simply.

野.zh: 那只野猫经常来我家门口。
野.en: That stray cat often comes to my doorstep.

野.zh: 他喜欢野餐，不喜欢在餐厅吃。
野.en: He likes picnics, doesn't like eating in restaurants.

野.zh: 虽然野花很美，但不要随便采摘。
野.en: Although wildflowers are beautiful, don't pick them casually.

清理.zh: 周末我要清理家里的旧东西。
清理.en: I want to clean out old things at home this weekend.

清理.zh: 他用了两个小时才把厨房清理干净。
清理.en: It took him two hours to clean the kitchen thoroughly.

清理.zh: 清理完房间后，我们一起去吃饭吧。
清理.en: After cleaning the room, let's go eat together.

清理.zh: 公司请了保洁阿姨来清理办公室。
清理.en: The company hired a cleaning lady to clean the office.

激情.en: He is very passionate about his work.

激情.zh: 这支球队踢得很有激情。
激情.en: This team plays with a lot of passion.

激情.zh: 虽然年纪大了，他对生活依然充满激情。
激情.en: Although he is old, he is still full of passion for life.

激情.zh: 演讲时他充满激情，感染了所有人。
激情.en: He spoke with passion and moved everyone.

激情.zh: 爱情需要激情，也需要耐心。
激情.en: Love needs passion as well as patience.

从未.en: I have never seen him before.

从未.zh: 虽然我们认识很久，但我从未告诉过她这个秘密。
从未.en: Although we've known each other for a long time, I've never told her this secret.

从未.zh: 他从未做过饭，今天居然学会了。
从未.en: He has never cooked before, but today he actually learned how.

从未.zh: 我对这件事从未后悔过。
从未.en: I have never regretted this matter.

谈判.en: The two sides are in negotiations.

谈判.zh: 这个价格还可以再谈判。
谈判.en: This price can still be negotiated.

谈判.zh: 谈判持续了三个小时，最后还是没有结果。
谈判.en: The negotiations lasted three hours, but in the end there was still no result.

谈判.zh: 他是一位经验丰富的谈判专家。
谈判.en: He is an experienced negotiation expert.

谈判.zh: 如果谈判失败，我们可能要换供应商。
谈判.en: If the negotiation fails, we may have to change suppliers.

成交.zh: 双方在价格上达成共识，顺利成交。
成交.en: The two sides reached a consensus on price and closed the deal smoothly.

成交.zh: 因为对方不同意我们的条件，成交很困难。
成交.en: Because the other party didn't agree to our terms, it was difficult to close the deal.

成交.zh: 昨天我们和客户成交了一笔大订单。
成交.en: Yesterday we closed a big order with a client.

成交.zh: 成交后，请尽快安排发货。
成交.en: After the deal is closed, please arrange shipment as soon as possible.

业.en: He started a business, and now he's very busy.
This industry is hard to do now.

业.zh: 为了守住这份业，他付出了很多。
业.en: He has sacrificed a lot to keep this business alive.
His family's business has been passed down for generations.

业.zh: 虽然业不大，但利润很高。
业.en: Although the business is not big, the profit is high.

造型.zh: 造型师给她设计了一个新造型。
造型.en: The stylist designed a new look for her.

造型.zh: 为了拍照，她特意做了个新造型。
造型.en: She got a new look specially for the photoshoot.

造型.zh: 这部电影的造型很独特，让人印象深刻。
造型.en: The styling of this movie is very unique and impressive.

造型.zh: 他不喜欢太夸张的造型，喜欢简单的。
造型.en: He doesn't like overly exaggerated styles; he prefers simple ones.

餐.en: The food at this restaurant is delicious.

餐.zh: 每天三餐都要按时吃，对胃好。
餐.en: Eat three meals a day on time, it's good for your stomach.

餐.zh: 他点了一份套餐，有汤有菜。
餐.en: He ordered a set meal with soup and dishes.

餐.zh: 晚餐后，我们一起去散步。
餐.en: After dinner, we went for a walk together.

补.en: Your clothes are torn; patch them up.

补.zh: 他最近在补钙，因为缺钙。
补.en: He has been supplementing calcium recently because he is deficient.

补.zh: 周末我打算补一补功课，准备考试。
补.en: I plan to catch up on my homework this weekend to prepare for exams.

补.zh: 医生建议他多补点维生素C。
补.en: The doctor advised him to take more vitamin C supplements.

补.zh: 吃了这个药，可以补气血。
补.en: Taking this medicine can replenish qi and blood.

装备.en: Check the equipment well before climbing mountains.

装备.zh: 他花了很多钱买摄影装备。
装备.en: He spent a lot of money on photography gear.

装备.zh: 因为装备不够，我们无法进行这次探险。
装备.en: Because of insufficient equipment, we couldn't go on this expedition.

装备.zh: 消防员的装备必须定期更换。
装备.en: Firefighters' equipment must be replaced regularly.

圣诞节.en: How do you plan to spend Christmas?

圣诞节.zh: 我们圣诞节一起去吃火锅吧。
圣诞节.en: Let's go eat hotpot together for Christmas.

圣诞节.zh: 虽然圣诞节不是中国的传统节日，但很多年轻人都会庆祝。
圣诞节.en: Although Christmas is not a traditional Chinese holiday, many young people still celebrate it.

圣诞节.zh: 圣诞节那天街上到处都是彩灯和圣诞树。
圣诞节.en: On Christmas Day, the streets are full of colorful lights and Christmas trees.

圣诞节.zh: 她圣诞节收到了很多礼物，开心极了。
圣诞节.en: She received a lot of gifts at Christmas and was extremely happy.

障碍.en: There's no obstacle in this matter.
The language barrier gives me a headache.

障碍.zh: 虽然遇到了不少障碍，但我们还是完成了任务。
障碍.en: Although we encountered many obstacles, we still completed the task.

障碍.zh: 路上的障碍已经被清除了。
障碍.en: The obstacles on the road have been cleared.

障碍.zh: 他克服了心理障碍，终于敢在大家面前说话了。
障碍.en: He overcame his psychological barrier and finally dared to speak in front of everyone.

自杀.zh: 他最近情绪很低落，甚至有自杀的念头。
自杀.en: He's been very depressed lately, even having suicidal thoughts.

自杀.zh: 如果有朋友想自杀，一定要及时帮助他。
自杀.en: If a friend is thinking about suicide, you must help him in time.

自杀.zh: 新闻里说那个明星因为抑郁症自杀了。
自杀.en: The news said that celebrity committed suicide due to depression.

自杀.zh: 虽然生活很难，但不要选择自杀这条路。
自杀.en: Even though life is hard, don't choose the path of suicide.

危机.zh: 虽然公司遇到了危机，但老板很冷静。
危机.en: Although the company faced a crisis, the boss remained calm.

危机.zh: 危机时刻，大家要团结一致。
危机.en: In times of crisis, everyone must unite.

危机.zh: 他总能化解危机，大家都信任他。
危机.en: He can always resolve crises, so everyone trusts him.

公民.zh: 每个公民都有纳税的义务。
公民.en: Every citizen has the duty to pay taxes.

公民.zh: 作为公民，我们应该遵守法律。
公民.en: As citizens, we should obey the law.

公民.zh: 公民的权利和义务是平等的。
公民.en: Citizens' rights and obligations are equal.

公民.zh: 无论你是什么国籍的公民，都要尊重当地文化。
公民.en: No matter which country's citizen you are, you must respect the local culture.

当初.en: I shouldn't have listened to you in the first place.

当初.zh: 当初我们是一起创业的。
当初.en: We started the business together back then.

当初.zh: 如果当初多努力一点，现在就不会后悔了。
当初.en: If I had worked harder back then, I wouldn't regret it now.

当初.zh: 你还记得当初的梦想吗？
当初.en: Do you still remember your original dream?

当初.zh: 当初的选择改变了我的一生。
当初.en: The choice I made back then changed my whole life.

线索.en: The police found an important clue.

线索.zh: 根据线索，凶手就在这栋楼里。
线索.en: According to the clues, the murderer is in this building.

线索.zh: 他提供的线索帮了大忙。
线索.en: The clues he provided were a big help.

线索.zh: 虽然线索很少，但侦探还是破案了。
线索.en: Although there were few clues, the detective still solved the case.

引.en: He led me into the room.

引.zh: 这句话引来了很多笑声。
引.en: This remark drew a lot of laughter.

引.zh: 别引他生气，他脾气不好。
引.en: Don't make him angry; he has a bad temper.
She led the child across the street.

引.zh: 他几句话就引出了真相。
引.en: With just a few words, he brought out the truth.

金属.zh: 这个玩具是金属的，很重。
金属.en: This toy is metal, so it's very heavy.

金属.zh: 回收金属对环保有好处。
金属.en: Recycling metal is good for the environment.

金属.zh: 虽然塑料很轻，但金属更耐用。
金属.en: Although plastic is light, metal is more durable.

闪.en: The car light flashed once and then went out.
She dodged and avoided that car.

闪.zh: 虽然光线很暗，但屏幕闪了一下。
闪.en: Although the light was dim, the screen flashed once.

石油.en: Oil prices have gone up again.
The Middle East is rich in petroleum.

石油.zh: 虽然石油很重要，但我们也要开发新能源。
石油.en: Although oil is very important, we also need to develop new energy.

石油.zh: 这辆车的石油快用完了。
石油.en: This car's oil is almost used up.

石油.zh: 石油泄漏对环境危害很大。
石油.en: Oil spills are very harmful to the environment.

频道.en: This channel is very good to watch.

频道.zh: 你最喜欢哪个电视频道？
频道.en: Which TV channel do you like best?

频道.zh: 我换了好几个频道，都没找到想看的节目。
频道.en: I switched several channels but didn't find any show I wanted to watch.

频道.zh: 这个频道正在直播足球比赛。
频道.en: This channel is broadcasting a football match live.

频道.zh: 因为信号不好，所以那个频道全是雪花。
频道.en: Because the signal is bad, that channel is all snow.

散.en: Let's go out for a walk.

散.zh: 因为天气好，我决定出去散散心。
散.en: Because the weather is nice, I decided to go out and relax.

散.zh: 这种药是散装的，需要自己分。
散.en: This medicine is loose-packed, you need to divide it yourself.

散.zh: 虽然他不想散，但会议还是结束了。
散.en: Although he didn't want to adjourn, the meeting still ended.

警告.zh: 老师警告我们不要在学校打架。
警告.en: The teacher warned us not to fight at school.
A typhoon warning has been issued.

警告.zh: 因为他不听警告，所以出了事故。
警告.en: Because he didn't listen to the warning, an accident happened.

基因.zh: 科学家正在研究人类基因的秘密。
基因.en: Scientists are studying the secrets of human genes.

基因.zh: 双胞胎的基因非常相似。
虽然基因很重要，但后天环境也会影响。
基因.en: Although genes are important, the acquired environment also affects.

晕.en: Long-distance bus rides easily cause dizziness.

晕.zh: 因为没吃早饭，她在操场晕倒了。
晕.en: Because she didn't eat breakfast, she fainted on the playground.

晕.zh: 这个图案转来转去，看得我眼晕。
晕.en: This pattern spins around, making my eyes dizzy.

晕.zh: 你晕车的话，可以吃药预防。
晕.en: If you get carsick, you can take medicine to prevent it.

就算.en: Even if it rains, still go.

就算.zh: 就算你赢了，也不能骄傲。
就算.en: Even if you win, you can't be proud.

就算.zh: 就算工作再忙，也要注意身体。
就算.en: Even if work is very busy, you still need to take care of your health.

就算.zh: 就算他不同意，我也要试试。
就算.en: Even if he disagrees, I still want to try.

就算.zh: 就算失败了，至少我们努力过。
就算.en: Even if we fail, at least we tried.

革命.en: The Industrial Revolution changed the world.

革命.zh: 这个技术革命让生活方便了很多。
革命.en: This technological revolution made life much more convenient.

革命.zh: 他一生都在为革命奋斗。
革命.en: He fought for the revolution all his life.

革命.zh: 虽然革命很艰难，但最终成功了。
革命.en: Although the revolution was very difficult, it finally succeeded.

孤独.zh: 虽然朋友很多，但有时候还是感到孤独。
孤独.en: Although I have many friends, sometimes I still feel lonely.

孤独.zh: 这只小狗看起来很孤独。
孤独.en: This little dog looks very lonely.

孤独.zh: 孤独并不可怕，要学会享受。
孤独.en: Loneliness is not scary, you need to learn to enjoy it.

针.en: He sewed clothes with a needle.

针.zh: 医生给我打了一针疫苗。
针.en: The doctor gave me a vaccine shot.
This needle is too thin, can't see clearly.

针.zh: 因为怕打针，他小时候总是哭。
针.en: Because he was afraid of injections, he always cried as a child.

官员.zh: 那个官员今天来视察了。
官员.en: That official came for an inspection today.

官员.zh: 官员们正在开会讨论新的政策。
官员.en: The officials are having a meeting to discuss the new policy.

官员.zh: 虽然他是个官员，但生活很朴素。
官员.en: Although he is an official, he lives a very simple life.

官员.zh: 这位官员在任期间做了很多好事。
官员.en: This official did a lot of good things during his tenure.

官员.zh: 老百姓希望官员能真正为他们解决问题。
官员.en: Ordinary people hope that officials can truly solve problems for them.

暴力.zh: 这部电影里暴力镜头太多了。
暴力.en: There are too many violent scenes in this movie.

暴力.zh: 暴力不能解决问题，只会让事情更糟。
暴力.en: Violence cannot solve problems; it only makes things worse.

暴力.zh: 他因为家庭暴力被抓了。
暴力.en: He was arrested for domestic violence.

暴力.zh: 学校应该教育孩子远离暴力。
暴力.en: Schools should teach children to stay away from violence.

神奇.en: This magic trick is so amazing!

神奇.zh: 大自然有很多神奇的现象。
他有一种神奇的能力，能预测天气。
神奇.en: He has a magical ability to predict the weather.

神奇.zh: 这次旅行看到了很多神奇的地方。
神奇.en: This trip saw many magical places.

神奇.zh: 虽然听起来很神奇，但这是真的。
神奇.en: Although it sounds incredible, it's true.

尴尬.en: The atmosphere was very awkward at that time.

尴尬.zh: 他说错话，大家都觉得尴尬。
尴尬.en: He said the wrong thing, and everyone felt awkward.

尴尬.zh: 在电梯里遇到前男友，太尴尬了。
尴尬.en: Meeting my ex-boyfriend in the elevator was so awkward.

尴尬.zh: 我不想让场面变得尴尬，就赶紧转移话题。
尴尬.en: I didn't want the situation to become awkward, so I quickly changed the subject.

尴尬.zh: 她不小心把咖啡洒在客人身上，尴尬得脸都红了。
尴尬.en: She accidentally spilled coffee on a guest, and her face turned red with embarrassment.

脑子.en: You have a really smart brain!

脑子.zh: 他脑子进水了，竟然做出这种事。
脑子.en: He's out of his mind to do something like this.

脑子.zh: 最近事情太多，我脑子都转不动了。
脑子.en: There's been too much going on lately, my brain can't keep up.
Use your brain more; don't always ask others.

脑子.zh: 虽然年纪大了，但他脑子还很清楚。
脑子.en: Even though he's old, his mind is still very clear.

代价.zh: 他为了赚钱付出了健康的代价。
代价.en: He paid the price of his health for making money.

代价.zh: 这个决定代价太大了，我们承担不起。
代价.en: This decision comes at too high a cost; we can't afford it.

代价.zh: 战争让无数家庭付出了沉重的代价。
代价.en: War has cost countless families a heavy price.

代价.zh: 如果你不努力，将来会付出更大的代价。
代价.en: If you don't work hard, you'll pay a bigger price in the future.

婴儿.zh: 她刚生了一个可爱的婴儿。
婴儿.en: She just gave birth to a cute baby.

婴儿.zh: 婴儿的皮肤特别嫩，要小心护理。
婴儿.en: A baby's skin is very delicate, so you need to take good care of it.

婴儿.zh: 这个婴儿哭了一晚上，把大家都吵醒了。
婴儿.en: This baby cried all night and woke everyone up.

婴儿.zh: 虽然婴儿不会说话，但他们能感受到大人的情绪。
婴儿.en: Although babies can't speak, they can sense adults' emotions.

瞧.en: Look, there's a rainbow over there.
Look at how smug he is!

瞧.zh: 你瞧我这记性，又忘了带钥匙。
瞧.en: Look at my memory; I forgot to bring the keys again.
Quick, look, that cat can dance!

瞧.zh: 你瞧，我没说错吧，果然下雨了。
瞧.en: See, I wasn't wrong; it really rained.

主持人.zh: 这个主持人反应很快，很会控场。
主持人.en: This host is quick-witted and good at controlling the stage.

主持人.zh: 她是一名电视台主持人，主持过很多节目。
主持人.en: She is a TV host who has hosted many shows.

主持人.zh: 主持人问了一个很难的问题，嘉宾都愣住了。
主持人.en: The host asked a very difficult question, and the guest was stunned.

主持人.zh: 虽然他是新主持人，但表现得非常专业。
主持人.en: Although he is a new host, he performed very professionally.

团结.zh: 只有团结起来，我们才能克服困难。
团结.en: Only by uniting can we overcome difficulties.

团结.zh: 这个团队非常团结，工作效率很高。
团结.en: This team is very united and works with high efficiency.

团结.zh: 虽然他们来自不同国家，但为了共同目标很团结。
团结.en: Although they come from different countries, they are very united for a common goal.

涉及.zh: 这个问题涉及法律，我们得小心。
涉及.en: This issue involves the law, we need to be careful.

涉及.zh: 他的发言涉及公司机密，所以被叫停了。
涉及.en: His speech involved company secrets, so it was stopped.

涉及.zh: 这个项目涉及资金和技术，需要领导批准。
涉及.en: This project involves funds and technology, and needs leadership approval.

踩.zh: 他踩到我的脚了，赶紧道歉。
踩.en: He stepped on my foot and quickly apologized.

踩.zh: 走路小心点，别踩到水坑。
踩.en: Walk carefully, don't step into puddles.

踩.zh: 昨天有人在楼梯上踩空了，摔了一跤。
踩.en: Yesterday someone missed a step on the stairs and fell.

发动.zh: 他们发动了全体员工参加这次活动。
发动.en: They mobilized all employees to join this event.

发动.zh: 战争突然发动了，大家都吓了一跳。
发动.en: The war suddenly started, everyone was shocked.

发动.zh: 公司想发动一次市场调查，看看客户需求。
发动.en: The company wants to launch a market survey to see customer needs.

策略.zh: 我们需要想一个新的营销策略来提高销量。
策略.en: We need to think of a new marketing strategy to increase sales.

策略.zh: 他的策略是先稳住客户，再慢慢谈价格。
策略.en: His strategy is to stabilize the client first, then slowly discuss the price.
There's a problem with the strategy.

策略.zh: 比赛时，教练改变了防守策略，结果赢了。
策略.en: During the game, the coach changed the defensive strategy and ended up winning.

陷入.en: He fell into a difficult situation.

陷入.zh: 这个国家陷入了经济危机，人民很痛苦。
陷入.en: This country fell into an economic crisis, the people are suffering.

陷入.zh: 我们陷入了交通堵塞，迟到了一个小时。
陷入.en: We got stuck in a traffic jam, arrived an hour late.
Don't get into this kind of discussion.

陷入.zh: 她陷入了回忆，完全没听到我在叫她。
陷入.en: She fell into memories, completely didn't hear me calling her.

档.zh: 这个文件放在哪个档里了？我找不到了。
档.en: Which file is this document in? I can't find it.

档.zh: 他换了一个高档位的镜头，拍照效果更好。
档.en: He changed to a high-grade lens, the photo effect is better.

档.zh: 开车的时候记得根据路况换档，不然容易熄火。
档.en: When driving, remember to shift gears according to road conditions, otherwise it's easy to stall.

肯.en: Are you willing to go to the hospital with me?

肯.zh: 只要她肯努力，一定能成功。
肯.en: As long as she is willing to work hard, she will surely succeed.
The boss is unwilling to give a raise.

肯.zh: 我问他好几次了，他都不肯告诉我真相。
肯.en: I asked him several times, but he wouldn't tell me the truth.

回报.zh: 他帮助了我，我一定要回报他。
回报.en: He helped me, I must repay him.

回报.zh: 这份工作的回报不高，但很有意义。
回报.en: This job's reward isn't high, but it's meaningful.
Giving back to society is good.

回报.zh: 你的付出总有一天会有回报，别着急。
回报.en: Your efforts will eventually be rewarded, don't worry.

愤怒.zh: 听到这个消息，她愤怒得说不出话来。
愤怒.en: Hearing this news, she was so angry she couldn't speak.

愤怒.zh: 别那么愤怒，冷静下来再说。
愤怒.en: Don't be so angry, calm down and then talk.

愤怒.zh: 客户因为服务太差而愤怒地投诉了。
愤怒.en: The customer angrily complained because of the poor service.

评估.zh: 公司每年都会对员工进行一次绩效评估。
评估.en: The company conducts a performance evaluation for employees every year.

评估.zh: 我们需要评估这个项目的可行性才能决定。
评估.en: We need to assess the feasibility of this project before deciding.

评估.zh: 他找专家评估了那幅画的价值，发现是赝品。
评估.en: He had experts evaluate the value of that painting and found it was a fake.

原本.zh: 他原本打算明天走，但临时有事。
原本.en: He originally planned to leave tomorrow, but something came up.

原本.zh: 这个计划原本是好的，可惜没执行好。
原本.en: This plan was originally good, unfortunately it wasn't executed well.
I originally thought it was very simple.

原本.zh: 我们原本住在北京，后来搬到了上海。
原本.en: We originally lived in Beijing, later moved to Shanghai.

宫.en: The Forbidden City is very famous.

宫.zh: 我们昨天去了故宫，看到了很多宝贝。
宫.en: We went to the Forbidden City yesterday and saw many treasures.

宫.zh: 这座宫殿已经有五百年的历史了。
宫.en: This palace has a history of 500 years.

宫.zh: 小时候我总觉得皇宫里住着神仙。
宫.en: When I was a child, I always thought immortals lived in the palace.

维护.zh: 这家公司专门负责维护大楼的电梯。
维护.en: This company is responsible for maintaining the building's elevators.

维护.zh: 他一直在努力维护自己的权益。
维护.en: He has been trying hard to uphold his rights.

维护.zh: 社区志愿者每天维护公园的卫生。
维护.en: Community volunteers maintain the park's cleanliness every day.

气氛.en: The restaurant has a great atmosphere.

气氛.zh: 今天开会的气氛有点紧张，大家都不说话。
气氛.en: The meeting atmosphere today was a bit tense, everyone was quiet.

气氛.zh: 生日派对上气氛非常欢乐。
气氛.en: The birthday party had a very cheerful atmosphere.

气氛.zh: 他们用音乐和灯光制造了浪漫的气氛。
气氛.en: They created a romantic atmosphere with music and lights.

跟踪.zh: 警察一直在跟踪那个可疑的人。
跟踪.en: The police have been tracking that suspicious person.

跟踪.zh: 这个APP可以跟踪你的运动数据。
跟踪.en: This app can track your exercise data.

跟踪.zh: 他一路上都在跟踪前面那辆车。
跟踪.en: He was following the car ahead the whole way.

望.zh: 我站在山顶望远方，风景很美。
望.en: I stood on the mountaintop looking into the distance, the scenery was beautiful.
She glanced at him without saying a word.

望.zh: 每年春节大家都望着一家人团圆。
望.en: Every Spring Festival, everyone hopes for family reunion.

活力.en: Young people are full of vitality.

活力.zh: 这个城市很有活力，晚上也很热闹。
活力.en: This city is very vibrant, and it's lively at night too.

活力.zh: 老爷爷虽然年纪大了，但依然充满活力。
活力.en: Although the old man is old, he is still full of vitality.

心灵.zh: 这本书能触动人的心灵。
心灵.en: This book can touch people's souls.

心灵.zh: 多读书能让心灵更丰富。
心灵.en: Reading more can enrich the soul.
We should take care of our hearts/minds.

心灵.zh: 他用自己的经历治愈了很多受伤的心灵。
心灵.en: He used his own experience to heal many wounded hearts.

委托.en: I entrusted him to handle this matter.

委托.zh: 她委托律师去处理遗产的问题。
委托.en: She entrusted a lawyer to handle the inheritance issue.

委托.zh: 这个项目是客户委托我们做的。
委托.en: This project was commissioned to us by the client.
Please rest assured to entrust it to me.

委托.zh: 他们委托我帮忙照顾一下他们的孩子。
委托.en: They entrusted me to help take care of their child.

航空.zh: 这家航空公司的服务很好，价格也合理。
航空.en: This airline has good service and reasonable prices.

航空.zh: 航空运输比海运快得多。
航空.en: Air transport is much faster than sea transport.

航空.zh: 航空业在疫情期间受到了很大的影响。
航空.en: The aviation industry was greatly affected during the pandemic.

通道.en: There's an emergency exit over there.

通道.zh: 地铁站的通道里人很多。
通道.en: There are many people in the subway station passage.

通道.zh: 如果你迷路了，可以问工作人员通道在哪。
通道.en: If you get lost, you can ask staff where the passage is.

通道.zh: 虽然通道很长，但走过去就能看到出口了。
通道.en: Although the passage is long, you'll see the exit after walking through it.

田.en: There is a field in front of my house.
Grandpa planted rice in the field.
This field has a good harvest this year.

田.zh: 他们打算把田租给别人种菜。
田.en: They plan to rent out the field for others to grow vegetables.

田.zh: 虽然田不大，但一家人吃菜足够了。
田.en: Although the field is not big, it's enough for the family's vegetables.

才能.zh: 他的才能被老板发现了。
才能.en: His talent was discovered by the boss.

才能.zh: 这孩子从小就有音乐才能。
才能.en: This child has had musical talent since childhood.

才能.zh: 光有才能不够，还要努力才行。
才能.en: Just having talent is not enough; you also need to work hard.

才能.zh: 我觉得语言才能是可以后天培养的。
才能.en: I think language talent can be cultivated later.

文明.zh: 这个地方的文明程度很高。
文明.en: This place has a high level of civilization.

文明.zh: 因为大家都很文明，所以排队很自觉。
文明.en: Because everyone is very civilized, they queue up consciously.

文明.zh: 导游给我们讲了玛雅文明的历史。
文明.en: The tour guide told us about the history of the Maya civilization.

偶像.en: Young people like to follow idols.

偶像.zh: 虽然偶像很优秀，但也要过好自己的生活。
偶像.en: Although idols are great, you still need to live your own life well.

偶像.zh: 我把这位科学家当作我的偶像。
偶像.en: I regard this scientist as my idol.

混乱.en: The traffic chaos is a headache.

混乱.zh: 因为没人管理，这里一片混乱。
混乱.en: Because no one is in charge, it's a mess here.

混乱.zh: 考试前他脑子一片混乱。
混乱.en: Before the exam, his mind was a mess.

混乱.zh: 虽然刚开始很混乱，但后来大家配合好了。
混乱.en: Although it was chaotic at first, everyone coordinated well later.

创意.zh: 他的创意让大家都惊呆了。

实话.zh: 实话讲，我不太喜欢这个电影。
实话.en: To be honest, I don't really like this movie.

实话.zh: 你要是不说实话，这事就没法解决。
实话.en: If you don't tell the truth, this matter can't be resolved.

实话.zh: 他这个人特别直，总是有什么说什么实话。
实话.en: He's a very straightforward person, always saying whatever truth there is.

实话.zh: 虽然实话难听，但我觉得你应该知道真相。
实话.en: Although the truth is hard to hear, I think you should know it.

救命.en: Help! Someone fell into the water!

救命.zh: 这药真是救命，我吃完就好多了。
救命.en: This medicine is a lifesaver; I felt much better after taking it.

救命.zh: 遇到危险时，一定要大声喊救命。
救命.en: When in danger, you must shout for help loudly.

救命.zh: 他学会了心肺复苏，关键时刻能救命。
救命.en: He learned CPR, which can save lives in critical moments.

救命.zh: 那个医生做了个大手术，简直是救命恩人。
救命.en: That doctor performed a major surgery; he's truly a lifesaver.

无所谓.zh: 穿哪件衣服都行，反正我无所谓。
无所谓.en: Either outfit is fine, I don't really care anyway.

无所谓.zh: 他对这件事的态度很无所谓，好像跟他没关系。
无所谓.en: His attitude toward this matter is very indifferent, as if it has nothing to do with him.

无所谓.zh: 去不去都无所谓，关键是你开心就好。
无所谓.en: Going or not doesn't matter; the key is that you're happy.

无所谓.zh: 虽然大家都很紧张，他却一副无所谓的样子。
无所谓.en: Although everyone was nervous, he looked completely unconcerned.

老鼠.en: There's a mouse in the kitchen.
Mice are afraid of cats; that's common knowledge.

老鼠.zh: 昨晚老鼠把面包咬了个洞。
老鼠.en: Last night, a mouse bit a hole in the bread.

老鼠.zh: 他家养了一只猫，所以从来没见过老鼠。
老鼠.en: His family keeps a cat, so they've never seen a mouse.

老鼠.zh: 老鼠虽然很小，但能传播疾病，不能忽视。
老鼠.en: Although mice are small, they can spread diseases and should not be ignored.

移民.zh: 他们全家准备移民加拿大。
移民.en: Their whole family is preparing to immigrate to Canada.

移民.zh: 移民手续很麻烦，需要等很久。
移民.en: Immigration procedures are very troublesome and require a long wait.

移民.zh: 这里有很多移民来自不同国家。
移民.en: There are many immigrants here from different countries.

移民.zh: 他移民之后，反而更想念家乡的美食。
移民.en: After immigrating, he actually misses the food from his hometown even more.

移民.zh: 虽然移民能带来新机会，但也要面对很多挑战。
移民.en: Although immigration can bring new opportunities, it also comes with many challenges.

联合国.en: The United Nations headquarters is in New York.

联合国.zh: 联合国正在讨论气候问题。
联合国.en: The United Nations is discussing climate issues.

联合国.zh: 他曾在联合国做过翻译工作。
联合国.en: He used to work as a translator at the United Nations.

联合国.zh: 联合国通过了一项新的决议，很多国家都支持。
联合国.en: The United Nations passed a new resolution, and many countries supported it.

联合国.zh: 虽然联合国的作用很大，但有时效率不高。
联合国.en: Although the United Nations plays a big role, sometimes it is not very efficient.

情形.zh: 这种情形我以前没见过。
情形.en: I've never seen this kind of situation before.

情形.zh: 到了现场，才发现情形比想象中严重。
情形.en: When we arrived at the scene, we realized the situation was worse than imagined.

情形.zh: 如果情形继续恶化，我们必须马上采取措施。
情形.en: If the situation continues to deteriorate, we must take immediate action.

情形.zh: 虽然情形很复杂，但我们还是有办法应对。
情形.en: Although the situation is complicated, we still have ways to deal with it.

持有.zh: 他持有这家公司百分之三十的股份。
持有.en: He holds 30% of the shares in this company.

持有.zh: 只有持有会员卡才能享受折扣。
持有.en: Only those with a membership card can enjoy the discount.

持有.zh: 他长期持有这些股票，没有卖出过。
持有.en: He has held these stocks for a long time and has never sold them.

持有.zh: 虽然持有枪支是合法的，但需要办理许可证。
持有.en: Although holding a firearm is legal, you need to obtain a permit.

沿着.zh: 你沿着这条路一直走就到了。
沿着.en: Go straight along this road and you'll arrive.

沿着.zh: 他沿着海岸线骑了一个小时自行车。
沿着.en: He rode his bike along the coastline for an hour.

沿着.zh: 沿着这条小巷进去，你会看到一个咖啡馆。
沿着.en: Go along this alley, and you'll see a coffee shop.

沿着.zh: 我每天早上都沿着公园跑步，空气很好。
沿着.en: I run along the park every morning; the air is very good.

合并.zh: 这两个文件夹可以合并成一个。
合并.en: These two folders can be merged into one.

合并.zh: 学校决定把两个班级合并，因为人数太少。
合并.en: The school decided to merge the two classes because there were too few students.

合并.zh: 他们合并了所有数据，然后做了分析。
合并.en: They merged all the data and then did an analysis.

合并.zh: 合并之后，我们的团队变得更大了。
合并.en: After the merger, our team became larger.

带领.zh: 她带领团队完成了这个项目。
带领.en: She led the team to complete this project.

带领.zh: 老师带领学生们去博物馆参观。
带领.en: The teacher led the students to visit the museum.

带领.zh: 他带领大家克服了很多困难，终于成功了。
带领.en: He led everyone to overcome many difficulties and finally succeeded.

带领.zh: 这次旅行由他带领，我们都很放心。
带领.en: This trip is led by him, so we are all at ease.

探索.en: Children like to explore the unknown.

探索.zh: 科学家们正在探索火星的表面。
探索.en: Scientists are exploring the surface of Mars.

探索.zh: 我们需要探索更好的解决方案。
探索.en: We need to explore better solutions.

探索.zh: 他们深入丛林探索，发现了很多新物种。
探索.en: They explored deep into the jungle and discovered many new species.

探索.zh: 探索宇宙一直是人类的梦想。
探索.en: Exploring the universe has always been a dream of humanity.

对抗.en: We need to fight the virus.

对抗.zh: 这两支球队将在决赛中对抗。
对抗.en: These two teams will compete against each other in the finals.

对抗.zh: 他一直在和病魔对抗，从没放弃。
对抗.en: He has been fighting his illness and never gave up.

对抗.zh: 对抗压力最好的方法就是运动。
对抗.en: The best way to fight stress is exercise.

对抗.zh: 政府采取措施对抗通货膨胀。
对抗.en: The government took measures to combat inflation.

灭.en: Please put out the candle before leaving.

灭.zh: 这场大火整整烧了两天才被灭掉。
灭.en: This big fire burned for two whole days before being put out.

灭.zh: 他们用沙子把火灭了，以防蔓延。
灭.en: They put out the fire with sand to prevent it from spreading.

灭.zh: 杀虫剂可以灭掉家里所有的蟑螂。
灭.en: Insecticide can kill all the cockroaches in the house.

秩序.zh: 新规则让交通秩序好多了。
秩序.en: The new rules have made traffic order much better.

秩序.zh: 考试的时候一定要遵守考场秩序。
秩序.en: During exams, you must abide by the exam hall rules.

秩序.zh: 他们维持秩序，确保活动顺利进行。
秩序.en: They maintained order to ensure the event went smoothly.

秩序.zh: 社会秩序需要我们共同维护。
秩序.en: Social order requires our joint effort to maintain.

血管.en: The blood vessels on his hand are very visible.
High blood pressure can damage blood vessels.

血管.zh: 医生检查了他腿部的血管有没有堵塞。
血管.en: The doctor checked if the blood vessels in his leg were blocked.

血管.zh: 因为血管破裂，他需要马上手术。
血管.en: Because a blood vessel ruptured, he needs surgery immediately.

血管.zh: 运动可以促进血液循环，保护血管健康。
血管.en: Exercise can promote blood circulation and protect blood vessel health.

热线.zh: 这个热线24小时都有人接听。
热线.en: This hotline is answered 24 hours a day.

热线.zh: 如果你遇到问题，可以打我们的热线电话。
热线.en: If you encounter any problems, you can call our hotline.

热线.zh: 他打了消费者热线投诉，很快就解决了。
热线.en: He called the consumer hotline to complain, and it was quickly resolved.

热线.zh: 疫情期间，心理热线帮助了很多人。
热线.en: During the pandemic, the psychological hotline helped many people.

娃娃.en: That little baby is really cute.

娃娃.zh: 她抱着一个娃娃睡着了。
娃娃.en: She fell asleep holding a doll.

娃娃.zh: 我小时候最爱玩这个娃娃，现在还在。
娃娃.en: When I was little, I loved playing with this doll, and I still have it now.

娃娃.zh: 邻居家的娃娃刚学会走路，特别好玩。
娃娃.en: The neighbor's baby just learned to walk, it's really fun.

以往.en: I didn't eat spicy food before.

以往.zh: 他以往的成绩比现在好多了。
以往.en: His past grades were much better than now.

以往.zh: 以往我们周末常去爬山，但最近太忙了。
以往.en: We used to go hiking on weekends, but we've been too busy lately.

以往.zh: 你以往不是挺喜欢她的吗？怎么现在变了？
以往.en: Didn't you used to like her before? How come you changed now?

以往.zh: 这家店的生意跟以往比起来差了不少。
以往.en: This store's business has dropped a lot compared to before.

关联.zh: 他的病跟工作压力有很大关联。
关联.en: His illness is strongly linked to work stress.

关联.zh: 温度变化和植物生长直接关联。
关联.en: Temperature changes are directly related to plant growth.

关联.zh: 这两起事故之间有没有什么关联？
关联.en: Is there any connection between these two accidents?

关联.zh: 虽然它们看起来很像，但其实没有任何关联。
关联.en: Although they look alike, they actually have no connection at all.

金钱.zh: 他为了金钱什么都干得出来。
金钱.en: He would do anything for money.

金钱.zh: 我觉得友情比金钱更重要。
金钱.en: I think friendship is more important than money.

金钱.zh: 她把大部分金钱都花在了旅行上。
金钱.en: She spends most of her money on travel.

金钱.zh: 虽然金钱很重要，但健康才是第一位的。
金钱.en: Although money is important, health comes first.

犬.zh: 小区里禁止饲养烈性犬。
犬.en: Fierce dogs are banned in the community.

犬.zh: 警犬帮警察找到了失踪的孩子。
犬.en: The police dog helped the police find the missing child.

犬.zh: 她家那只小犬特别听话，从不乱叫。
犬.en: Her little dog is very obedient and never barks randomly.

消灭.en: All the mosquitoes have been eliminated.
We need to eliminate these pests.

消灭.zh: 这个计划能彻底消灭安全隐患。
消灭.en: This plan can completely eliminate safety hazards.

消灭.zh: 科学家正在研究如何消灭这种病毒。
消灭.en: Scientists are researching how to eliminate this virus.

消灭.zh: 虽然困难很多，但我们有信心消灭它。
消灭.en: Although there are many difficulties, we are confident we can eliminate it.

欺骗.zh: 不要用谎言来欺骗别人。
欺骗.en: Don't use lies to deceive others.

欺骗.zh: 她发现自己被朋友欺骗了，非常伤心。
欺骗.en: She found out she was deceived by her friend and was very sad.

欺骗.zh: 这种欺骗行为迟早会被人揭穿的。
欺骗.en: This kind of deceptive behavior will be exposed sooner or later.

街头.en: He makes a living performing on the streets.

街头.zh: 街头的小吃总是特别香。
街头.en: Street snacks always smell especially good.

街头.zh: 我们经常在街头看到流浪猫。
街头.en: We often see stray cats on the streets.

街头.zh: 周末的街头到处都是人，车都走不动了。
街头.en: The streets are full of people on weekends, and cars can't move.

惊人.en: This set of data is simply astonishing!

惊人.zh: 她惊人的记忆力让所有老师都佩服。
惊人.en: Her amazing memory impressed all the teachers.

惊人.zh: 虽然结果很惊人，但仔细想想也有道理。
惊人.en: Although the result is astonishing, it makes sense when you think about it.

质疑.zh: 他从不质疑老师的决定。
质疑.en: He never questions the teacher's decisions.

质疑.zh: 她的研究成果遭到了同行的质疑。
质疑.en: Her research results have been questioned by peers.

质疑.zh: 虽然有人质疑他的能力，但他用行动证明了。
质疑.en: Although some questioned his ability, he proved it with actions.

摩托车.en: He rides a motorcycle to work.

摩托车.zh: 街上停着一辆红色摩托车。
摩托车.en: There is a red motorcycle parked on the street.

摩托车.zh: 他花了两万块买了一辆二手摩托车。
摩托车.en: He spent 20,000 yuan on a used motorcycle.

摩托车.zh: 因为堵车，摩托车反而比汽车方便多了。
摩托车.en: Because of traffic jams, motorcycles are actually much more convenient than cars.

金融.en: He works at a finance company.

金融.zh: 最近金融市场波动很大。
金融.en: The financial market has been very volatile recently.

金融.zh: 我朋友学金融，毕业后去了银行。
金融.en: My friend studied finance and went to a bank after graduation.

金融.zh: 金融行业压力很大，但收入也不错。
金融.en: The finance industry is very stressful, but the income is good too.

金融.zh: 她对金融投资特别感兴趣，所以每天看新闻。
金融.en: She is very interested in financial investment, so she watches the news every day.

贸易.zh: 这家公司做国际贸易生意。
贸易.en: This company does international trade business.

贸易.zh: 贸易战对经济影响很大。
贸易.en: The trade war has a big impact on the economy.

贸易.zh: 因为贸易纠纷，很多商品涨价了。
贸易.en: Because of trade disputes, many goods have increased in price.

贸易.zh: 他们公司主要靠出口贸易赚钱。
贸易.en: Their company mainly makes money through export trade.

痕迹.en: There are footprints on the ground.
The wound has healed, but there is still a scar.

痕迹.zh: 这些痕迹说明有人来过这里。
痕迹.en: These traces show that someone has been here.

痕迹.zh: 时间久了，以前的痕迹都消失了。
痕迹.en: After a long time, the previous traces have all disappeared.

痕迹.zh: 他说话时留下的痕迹让人怀疑。
痕迹.en: The traces left in his words made people suspicious.

染.en: The white clothes got stained with ink.
In autumn, the leaves slowly turn yellow.

染.zh: 这种燃料容易染到皮肤上。
染.en: This kind of dye easily stains the skin.

清晰.zh: 电视画面不够清晰，有点模糊。
清晰.en: The TV picture is not clear enough, a bit blurry.

清晰.zh: 记忆中的画面依然清晰。
清晰.en: The scene in my memory is still clear.

清晰.zh: 虽然隔得很远，但我能清晰听到他的声音。
清晰.en: Although far away, I can clearly hear his voice.

码头.en: There are many boats at the dock.
He is waiting for the boat to dock at the pier.

码头.zh: 这个码头每天都很忙碌。
码头.en: This dock is very busy every day.

码头.zh: 我们约好在码头见面，然后一起去坐船。
码头.en: We agreed to meet at the dock and then go take the boat together.

码头.zh: 码头附近开了一家新的海鲜餐厅。
码头.en: A new seafood restaurant opened near the dock.

循环.zh: 我们应该提倡循环利用资源。
循环.en: We should promote the recycling of resources.

循环.zh: 血液在身体里不断循环。
循环.en: Blood circulates continuously in the body.

循环.zh: 经济有繁荣和萧条的循环周期。
循环.en: The economy has cycles of boom and bust.

汇报.en: I have to report on work tomorrow.
He reported the situation to his superior.

汇报.zh: 这次汇报做得很好，老板很满意。
汇报.en: This report was well done, and the boss was very satisfied.

汇报.zh: 我需要先准备一下汇报的内容。
汇报.en: I need to prepare the content of the report first.

汇报.zh: 每个月底我们都要写一份汇报总结。
汇报.en: At the end of each month, we have to write a summary report.

从没.en: I have never been to Beijing.

从没.zh: 她说她从没吃过辣的东西。
从没.en: She said she has never eaten spicy food.
Have you never seen him before?

从没.zh: 虽然学了三年，他从没说过一句外语。
从没.en: Although he studied for three years, he has never spoken a word of a foreign language.

从没.zh: 我从没想过他会做出这种事情。
从没.en: I never thought he would do such a thing.

总裁.en: The CEO is not in the office today.
He got promoted to president this year.

总裁.zh: 总裁要求我们提高效率。
总裁.en: The CEO asked us to improve efficiency.

总裁.zh: 这位总裁很年轻，但很有能力。
总裁.en: This CEO is very young but very capable.

总裁.zh: 公司年会上，总裁发表了演讲。
总裁.en: At the company's annual meeting, the president gave a speech.

鉴定.zh: 我拿那块玉去珠宝店鉴定了真假。
鉴定.en: I took that jade to the jewelry store to authenticate it.

鉴定.zh: 经过鉴定，这瓶酒是假的，所以不能喝。
鉴定.en: After appraisal, this bottle of wine is fake, so you can't drink it.

鉴定.zh: 他的精神状况需要医生鉴定。
鉴定.en: His mental condition needs a doctor's evaluation.

鉴定.zh: 这家公司鉴定产品质量很严格。
鉴定.en: This company's product quality appraisal is very strict.

协调.en: Everyone needs to coordinate the time well.

协调.zh: 项目经理负责协调各部门的工作。
协调.en: The project manager is responsible for coordinating the work of each department.

协调.zh: 虽然意见不同，但我们尽量协调出一个方案。
协调.en: Although opinions differ, we try to coordinate a plan.

协调.zh: 这套衣服的颜色很协调。
协调.en: The colors of this outfit are very harmonious.

协调.zh: 他动作协调，跳舞很好看。
协调.en: His movements are coordinated, he dances beautifully.

超越.zh: 这次成绩超越了我自己的预期。
超越.en: This result exceeded my own expectations.

超越.zh: 只要你努力，就能不断超越自己。
超越.en: As long as you work hard, you can continuously surpass yourself.

超越.zh: 这辆车超越了时速三百公里。
在比赛中，他超越了极限。
超越.en: In the competition, he surpassed his limits.

铺.zh: 工人在路上铺了一层新的沥青。
铺.en: Workers paved a new layer of asphalt on the road.
First spread the carpet, then place the furniture.

铺.zh: 他喜欢在桌上铺一块桌布。
铺.en: He likes to lay a tablecloth on the table.

铺.zh: 这家店铺了木地板，看起来很高档。
铺.en: This shop laid wooden flooring, looks very upscale.

泥.zh: 下雨后，路上都是泥，很难走。
泥.en: After the rain, the road is all mud, hard to walk.

泥.zh: 虽然摔了一身泥，但他没哭。
泥.en: Although he fell and got covered in mud, he didn't cry.

泥.zh: 这种泥可以用来做陶器。
泥.en: This kind of mud can be used to make pottery.
Don't get mud on the sofa.

正义.zh: 他为了正义，不怕得罪任何人。
正义.en: For justice, he is not afraid to offend anyone.

正义.zh: 虽然过程很难，但正义最终会到来。
正义.en: Although the process is hard, justice will eventually come.

正义.zh: 这部电影讲的是正义战胜邪恶。
正义.en: This movie is about justice defeating evil.

正义.zh: 他是一个很有正义感的人。
正义.en: He is a person with a strong sense of justice.

民众.en: The public cares a lot about this matter.

民众.zh: 政府听取民众的意见，改进了政策。
民众.en: The government listened to public opinion and improved the policy.

民众.zh: 因为民众抗议，公司撤销了决定。
民众.en: Because of public protest, the company withdrew its decision.

民众.zh: 这次活动吸引了大量民众参与。
民众.en: This event attracted a large number of public participants.

民众.zh: 民众的生活水平在不断提高。
民众.en: The living standards of the public are constantly improving.

场景.zh: 电影里的打斗场景拍得非常逼真。
场景.en: The fight scene in the movie was filmed very realistically.

场景.zh: 每当我看到这个场景，就会想起小时候。
场景.en: Whenever I see this scene, I think of my childhood.

场景.zh: 婚礼的场景布置得很浪漫。
场景.en: The wedding scene was decorated very romantically.

场景.zh: 这种场景在现实生活中很少见。
场景.en: This kind of scene is rare in real life.

青春.zh: 她把自己的青春都奉献给了教育事业。
青春.en: She dedicated all her youth to education.

青春.zh: 虽然青春短暂，但要好好珍惜。
青春.en: Although youth is short, we must cherish it well.

青春.zh: 这首歌充满了青春的回忆。
青春.en: This song is full of youthful memories.

青春.zh: 他正在度过最美好的青春时光。
青春.en: He is spending the best time of his youth.

救援.en: The rescue team arrived very quickly.

救援.zh: 地震后，救援人员连夜搜救幸存者。
救援.en: After the earthquake, rescue workers searched for survivors all night.

救援.zh: 因为道路不通，救援工作非常困难。
救援.en: Because the road was blocked, rescue work was very difficult.

救援.zh: 他们派出了直升机进行救援。
这次救援行动很成功，救出了所有人。
救援.en: This rescue operation was very successful, saving everyone.

欲望.zh: 她控制住了自己的购物欲望。
人如果没有欲望，生活就少了动力。
欲望.en: If people have no desires, life lacks motivation.

欲望.zh: 因为欲望太多，他最后失去了真正的朋友。
欲望.en: Because he had too many desires, he ended up losing true friends.

欲望.zh: 面对金钱的欲望，他选择了守住底线。
欲望.en: Faced with the desire for money, he chose to hold his ground.

败.zh: 失败是成功之母，别灰心。
败.en: Failure is the mother of success; don't lose heart.

败.zh: 他因为轻敌而败给了对手。
败.en: He lost to his opponent because of underestimating him.

败.zh: 虽然计划很完美，最后还是败在了细节上。
败.en: Although the plan was perfect, it ultimately failed on the details.

败.zh: 一场大雨让我们的野餐计划彻底败了。
败.en: A heavy rain completely ruined our picnic plan.

立场.zh: 他坚持自己的立场不动摇。
立场.en: He stuck to his position without wavering.

立场.zh: 在这个问题上，我和他的立场完全不同。
立场.en: On this issue, my stance and his are completely different.

立场.zh: 虽然大家都反对，但他还是表明了立场。
立场.en: Even though everyone opposed, he still made his position clear.

立场.zh: 作为中间人，我必须保持中立的立场来处理纠纷。
立场.en: As a mediator, I must maintain a neutral stance to handle the dispute.

火灾.en: A fire broke out last night.

火灾.zh: 火灾的原因还在调查中。
火灾.en: The cause of the fire is still under investigation.

火灾.zh: 那栋楼因为火灾，很多人都无家可归了。
火灾.en: Many people became homeless because of the fire in that building.

火灾.zh: 火灾发生时，他们迅速从安全通道撤离了。
火灾.en: When the fire broke out, they quickly evacuated through the emergency exit.

火灾.zh: 虽然火灾很可怕，但消防员们冲在最前面救人。
火灾.en: Although fires are terrifying, firefighters rush to the front to save people.

认定.en: I believe he is the murderer.

认定.zh: 警方认定这起事故属于意外。
认定.en: The police determined that this accident was an accident.

认定.zh: 经过调查，他们认定责任在对方。
认定.en: After investigation, they held the other party responsible.

认定.zh: 她认定自己的选择没错，所以坚持了下去。
认定.en: She was convinced her choice was right, so she persisted.

认定.zh: 如果你认定一件事是对的，就不要轻易放弃。
认定.en: If you are certain something is right, don't give up easily.

跌.en: Stock prices have dropped a lot.

跌.zh: 小孩在跑的时候不小心跌倒了。
跌.en: The child accidentally fell while running.

跌.zh: 这几天天气不好，气温跌到了零度以下。
跌.en: The weather has been bad these days; the temperature has dropped below zero.

跌.zh: 他从楼梯上跌下来，幸好没有受伤。
跌.en: He fell down the stairs, but luckily he wasn't injured.

会计.en: I want to be an accountant.
She works as an accountant at a company.

会计.zh: 会计每个月都要做财务报表。
会计.en: Accountants have to prepare financial statements every month.

会计.zh: 因为公司缺人，会计一个人干三个人的活。
会计.en: Because the company is short-staffed, the accountant does the work of three people.

会计.zh: 会计告诉我今年的利润比去年高了不少。
会计.en: The accountant told me that this year's profit is much higher than last year's.

妙.zh: 他说话很妙，大家都爱听。
妙.en: He speaks very cleverly; everyone likes to listen.

妙.zh: 这部电影的结局太妙了，完全没想到。
妙.en: The ending of this movie is so wonderful; I totally didn't expect it.

妙.zh: 她用一个妙招解决了这个难题。
妙.en: She used a clever trick to solve this problem.

妙.zh: 虽然看起来简单，但这里面有很妙的道理。
妙.en: Although it looks simple, there is a subtle principle in it.

狮子.en: The lion is the king of beasts.

狮子.zh: 动物园里有一只大狮子。
狮子.en: There is a big lion in the zoo.

狮子.zh: 狮子在草原上追捕猎物的时候速度很快。
狮子.en: Lions run very fast when chasing prey on the grassland.

狮子.zh: 虽然狮子很凶猛，但它们在保护幼崽时特别勇敢。
狮子.en: Although lions are fierce, they are especially brave when protecting their cubs.

狮子.zh: 他胆子很小，连看到狮子的照片都会害怕。
狮子.en: He is very timid; even seeing a picture of a lion scares him.

头脑.en: He has a very smart mind.

头脑.zh: 遇到问题要保持头脑清醒。
头脑.en: When facing problems, keep a clear head.

头脑.zh: 别冲动，用头脑好好想想再决定。
头脑.en: Don't be impulsive; use your head and think carefully before deciding.

头脑.zh: 他这个人很有头脑，做生意从来不亏。
头脑.en: He is a very shrewd person; he never loses money in business.

头脑.zh: 虽然年轻，但她的头脑比很多成年人都成熟。
头脑.en: Although young, her mind is more mature than many adults.

倒是.zh: 他平时很懒，今天倒是主动收拾房间了。
倒是.en: He is usually lazy, but today he actually took the initiative to clean the room.

倒是.zh: 我倒是不介意，就怕他生气。
倒是.en: I actually don't mind, but I'm afraid he'll get angry.
This idea is actually not bad.

倒是.zh: 虽然下雨了，但我们倒是因此在家休息了一天。
倒是.en: Although it rained, we actually got to rest at home for a day because of it.

此刻.en: I miss you very much at this moment.

此刻.zh: 此刻，所有的人都安静了下来，等待结果。
此刻.en: At this moment, everyone fell silent, waiting for the result.

此刻.zh: 我不知道此刻该说什么。
此刻.en: I don't know what to say at this moment.
Feelings are complicated at this moment.

此刻.zh: 就在此刻，他突然想起了一个重要的事情。
此刻.en: Just at this moment, he suddenly remembered something important.

足以.en: This money is enough to pay rent.

足以.zh: 你的努力足以让你通过考试，别担心。
足以.en: Your effort is enough to let you pass the exam, don't worry.

足以.zh: 这一句话足以说明问题。
足以.en: This one sentence is enough to explain the problem.
His ability is enough to be qualified.

足以.zh: 仅仅一个道歉不足以弥补他造成的伤害。
足以.en: Just an apology is not enough to make up for the harm he caused.

尺.zh: 这块布需要两尺长才够做裙子。
尺.en: This cloth needs to be two chi long to make a skirt.

尺.zh: 他身高六尺，在古时候算很高了。
尺.en: He is six chi tall, which was considered very tall in ancient times.
Just one chi short of reaching it.

尺.zh: 你用尺量一下桌子的宽度，然后告诉我数字。
尺.en: Use a ruler to measure the width of the table, then tell me the number.

通信.en: We have been keeping in correspondence.

通信.zh: 随着科技发展，通信方式变得越来越方便。
通信.en: With the development of technology, communication methods have become more and more convenient.

通信.zh: 古代人通信靠骑马送信，非常慢。
通信.en: In ancient times, people communicated by horse-riding messengers, which was very slow.

场面.zh: 婚礼的场面布置得特别浪漫，大家都赞不绝口。
场面.en: The wedding scene was decorated especially romantically, and everyone was full of praise.

场面.zh: 他没见过这种大场面，有点紧张。
场面.en: He hasn't seen such a big occasion before, so he's a bit nervous.
The scene was once very awkward.

场面.zh: 在颁奖典礼上，她掌控全场，场面非常热烈。
场面.en: At the award ceremony, she controlled the whole scene, and the atmosphere was very lively.

祖国.zh: 无论走到哪里，我都不会忘记自己的祖国。
祖国.en: No matter where I go, I will never forget my motherland.

祖国.zh: 祖国的发展让我们感到自豪。
祖国.en: The development of our motherland makes us feel proud.
These are the flowers of the motherland.

祖国.zh: 海外游子常常思念祖国的亲人和山水。
祖国.en: Overseas Chinese often miss their relatives and the landscapes of their motherland.

放手.zh: 父母要学会对孩子放手，让他们自己去闯。
放手.en: Parents need to learn to let go of their children and let them explore on their own.

放手.zh: 为了健康，他放手了所有甜食。
放手.en: For health, he gave up all sweets.

放手.zh: 在感情里，有时候放手是对彼此最好的选择。
放手.en: In a relationship, sometimes letting go is the best choice for both parties.

惩罚.zh: 考试作弊会被学校严厉惩罚。
惩罚.en: Cheating on exams will be severely punished by the school.

惩罚.zh: 适当的惩罚可以让孩子明白错误。
惩罚.en: Appropriate punishment can make children understand their mistakes.
This is not punishment, it's education.

惩罚.zh: 如果违反交通规则，司机将面临罚款的惩罚。
惩罚.en: If you violate traffic rules, the driver will face a fine as punishment.

事务.en: He handles many affairs every day.

事务.zh: 公司的事务都由经理负责安排。
事务.en: The company's affairs are all arranged by the manager.

事务.zh: 我最近私人事务比较多，没空出门。
事务.en: I have a lot of personal affairs recently, so I don't have time to go out.

事务.zh: 在开会之前，先把所有日常事务处理完。
事务.en: Before the meeting, finish all the daily affairs first.

在意.en: He cares a lot about others' opinions.

在意.zh: 你别在意，他只是开玩笑。
在意.en: Don't mind him, he's just joking.

在意.zh: 虽然大家都不在意，但我还是觉得不舒服。
在意.en: Although everyone else doesn't care, I still feel uncomfortable.

在意.zh: 她表面上说没事，其实心里很在意。
在意.en: She says it's fine on the surface, but actually she cares a lot inside.

寸.en: An inch of time is an inch of gold.
He follows me closely, not moving an inch.
Without my phone, I can't function at all.

寸.zh: 虽然只差一寸，但就是够不着。
寸.en: Although it's only an inch short, I just can't reach it.

寸.zh: 这块地寸土寸金，买下来肯定升值。
寸.en: This land is extremely valuable; buying it will definitely appreciate.

抵抗.zh: 他们拼命抵抗，但还是输了。
抵抗.en: They resisted desperately but still lost.

抵抗.zh: 虽然敌人很强，但我们一定要抵抗。
抵抗.en: Although the enemy is strong, we must resist.

抵抗.zh: 这种材料能抵抗高温和腐蚀。
抵抗.en: This material can resist high temperatures and corrosion.

动机.en: I suspect his motives are not pure.

动机.zh: 警察正在调查犯罪动机。
动机.en: The police are investigating the criminal motive.

动机.zh: 她做这件事的动机很复杂。
动机.en: Her motive for doing this is very complicated.

动机.zh: 虽然动机是好的，但方法不对。
动机.en: Although the motive is good, the method is wrong.

情节.en: The plot of this movie is very exciting.
The plot of the story is too cliché.

情节.zh: 根据情节需要，主角必须离开。
情节.en: According to the plot needs, the protagonist must leave.

情节.zh: 小说中有很多感人的情节。
情节.en: There are many touching plots in the novel.

情节.zh: 虽然情节有点复杂，但很好看。
情节.en: Although the plot is a bit complicated, it's very good.

虽.en: Though far, the scenery is beautiful.
Although he is smart, he doesn't work hard.
Although I want to go, I have no time.

预期.en: The result is not as expected.

预期.zh: 这次考试达到了预期目标。
预期.en: This exam achieved the expected goal.

预期.zh: 今年的经济增长超出预期。
预期.en: This year's economic growth exceeded expectations.

预期.zh: 虽然预期很好，但实际很差。
预期.en: Although expectations were good, the reality was bad.

吵架.en: You two stop arguing, talk nicely.

吵架.zh: 她跟邻居吵架吵得很凶。
吵架.en: She had a fierce quarrel with her neighbor.

吵架.zh: 虽然吵架了，但很快就和好了。
吵架.en: Although they argued, they quickly made up.

货车.en: A truck is parked by the roadside.
Driving a truck requires a special license.

货车.zh: 这辆货车装了太多货物。
货车.en: This truck is loaded with too much cargo.

货车.zh: 货车在高速上开得很慢。
货车.en: The truck is driving very slowly on the highway.

货车.zh: 虽然货车很旧，但还能用。
货车.en: Although the truck is very old, it still works.

出场.en: He appears in the third act.
He only played for ten minutes in the match.

出场.zh: 演员出场时观众热烈鼓掌。
出场.en: When the actor appeared, the audience applauded warmly.

出场.zh: 虽然他出场时间短，但表现很棒。
出场.en: Although his appearance time was short, his performance was great.

天才.zh: 这孩子学东西很快，大家都说他是天才。
天才.en: This child learns things very fast; everyone says he's a genius.

天才.zh: 虽然他不是天才，但靠努力也成功了。
天才.en: Although he is not a genius, he succeeded through hard work.

天才.zh: 那个数学天才在十五岁就上了大学。
天才.en: That math genius went to college at age fifteen.

天才.zh: 我们队里有个音乐天才，弹钢琴特别厉害。
天才.en: There is a musical genius in our team who plays the piano amazingly well.

一向.en: I have always been used to sleeping and waking early.

一向.zh: 她一向很准时，今天却迟到了。
一向.en: She has always been punctual, but today she was late.

一向.zh: 这家店的服务一向不错，你可以放心。
一向.en: The service in this shop has always been good; you can rest assured.

一向.zh: 他虽然一向不爱说话，但心里什么都清楚。
一向.en: Although he has always been quiet, he knows everything in his heart.

一向.zh: 爸爸一向支持我的决定，这次也不例外。
一向.en: Dad has always supported my decisions, and this time is no exception.

绝望.zh: 考试没通过，她几乎绝望了。
绝望.en: She almost despaired after failing the exam.

绝望.zh: 在那种情况下，很多人都会觉得绝望。
绝望.en: In that situation, many people would feel desperate.

绝望.zh: 即使遇到困难，也不要轻易绝望，总会有办法的。
绝望.en: Even when facing difficulties, don't easily despair; there is always a way.

绝望.zh: 看到救援队来了，绝望的人们重新燃起了希望。
绝望.en: Seeing the rescue team arrive, the desperate people rekindled their hope.

迷人.en: The scenery here is very charming.

迷人.zh: 她笑起来的样子特别迷人。
迷人.en: The way she smiles is especially charming.

迷人.zh: 这个小镇虽然不大，但有一种迷人的安静。
迷人.en: Although this small town is not big, it has a charming quietness.

迷人.zh: 他迷人的歌声让所有人都陶醉了。
电影里的女主角既聪明又迷人，观众都很喜欢她。
迷人.en: The female lead in the movie is both smart and charming; the audience all like her.

职位.zh: 他升职了，新职位是经理。
职位.en: He got promoted; his new position is manager.

职位.zh: 这个职位要求有五年以上的工作经验。
职位.en: This position requires more than five years of work experience.

职位.zh: 我对现在的职位很满意，暂时不想换工作。
职位.en: I am quite satisfied with my current position and don't want to change jobs for now.

职位.zh: 公司正在招聘一个销售职位，你有兴趣吗？
职位.en: The company is recruiting for a sales position; are you interested?

职位.zh: 虽然职位不高，但他的责任很大，管着整个项目。
职位.en: Although his position is not high, his responsibility is great—he manages the entire project.

化妆.en: She puts on makeup every day.

化妆.zh: 我不太会化妆，所以平时只涂口红。
化妆.en: I'm not good at makeup, so I usually just put on lipstick.

化妆.zh: 参加婚礼前，她花了一个小时化妆。
化妆.en: Before attending the wedding, she spent an hour putting on makeup.

化妆.zh: 化妆可以让人看起来更精神，但也要注意皮肤保养。
化妆.en: Makeup can make people look more energetic, but you also need to take care of your skin.

化妆.zh: 她化妆技术很好，每次出门都像换了个人。
化妆.en: Her makeup skills are great; every time she goes out, it looks like a different person.

节奏.en: The rhythm of this song is very fast.

节奏.zh: 现在的生活节奏越来越快了。
节奏.en: The pace of life nowadays is getting faster and faster.

节奏.zh: 跳舞的时候要跟上音乐的节奏。
节奏.en: When dancing, you need to keep up with the rhythm of the music.

节奏.zh: 他工作很有节奏，每天按时完成任务。
节奏.en: He works at a steady pace, finishing tasks on time every day.

节奏.zh: 这个城市节奏很慢，适合养老，年轻人可能不太喜欢。
节奏.en: The pace of this city is very slow, suitable for retirement, but young people may not like it.

骗子.en: He is a liar; don't believe him.

骗子.zh: 网上有很多骗子，要小心上当。
骗子.en: There are many scammers online; be careful not to be fooled.

骗子.zh: 那个骗子冒充银行工作人员，骗了不少钱。
骗子.en: That scammer pretended to be a bank employee and swindled a lot of money.

骗子.zh: 幸好我及时发现了他是骗子，不然就损失大了。
骗子.en: Luckily I found out in time that he was a fraud, otherwise I would have suffered a big loss.

骗子.zh: 骗子的话听起来很诱人，但千万别贪小便宜。
骗子.en: Scammers' words sound very tempting, but never be greedy for small gains.

外科.zh: 这家医院的外科医生很有名。
外科.en: The surgeons at this hospital are very famous.

外科.zh: 他因为阑尾炎做了外科手术。
外科手术虽然风险大，但技术已经非常先进了。
外科.en: Although surgical operations are risky, the technology is already very advanced.

外科.zh: 我弟弟想当外科医生，所以选了这个专业。
外科.en: My younger brother wants to be a surgeon, so he chose this major.

角落.en: The keys are in the corner.

角落.zh: 那个角落有一张旧桌子。
角落.en: There is an old table in that corner.

角落.zh: 他喜欢一个人坐在教室的角落看书。
角落.en: He likes to sit alone in the corner of the classroom and read.

角落.zh: 打扫的时候别忘了清理角落里的灰尘。
角落.en: When cleaning, don't forget to wipe the dust in the corners.

角落.zh: 这只小猫躲在院子的角落里，好像很害怕的样子。
角落.en: This kitten is hiding in the corner of the yard, looking very scared.

闯.zh: 他一个人闯进了那间办公室。
闯.en: He barged into that office alone.
I often got into trouble when I was a child.

闯.zh: 你闯一闯说不定能找到机会。
闯.en: If you take a chance, you might find an opportunity.

闯.zh: 他决定去大城市闯一闯，看看外面的世界。
闯.en: He decided to venture to the big city and see the world outside.

免疫.zh: 他最近免疫力下降，老生病。
免疫.en: His immunity has been low lately, and he keeps getting sick.

免疫.zh: 这种病得过一次就有免疫力了。
免疫.en: Once you've had this disease, you have immunity.

免疫.zh: 因为免疫系统出了问题，他很容易过敏。
免疫.en: Because his immune system has issues, he is prone to allergies.

免疫.zh: 虽然吃了药，但身体还是没有产生免疫反应。
免疫.en: Even after taking the medicine, his body still didn't produce an immune response.

戒指.zh: 他送了一枚金戒指给她。
戒指.en: He gave her a gold ring.

戒指.zh: 结婚戒指要戴在左手无名指上。
戒指.en: The wedding ring should be worn on the left ring finger.

戒指.zh: 这枚戒指虽然不大，但很有意义。
戒指.en: Although this ring is not big, it is very meaningful.

戒指.zh: 她把戒指摘下来放在桌子上，然后就去洗澡了。
戒指.en: She took off her ring, put it on the table, and then went to take a shower.

单纯.zh: 别把事情想得太单纯了。
单纯.en: Don't think things are too simple.

单纯.zh: 他只是单纯地想帮你，没别的意思。
单纯.en: He just purely wants to help you, nothing else.

单纯.zh: 小时候的快乐很单纯，一颗糖就够了。
单纯.en: The happiness in childhood was simple; one piece of candy was enough.

单纯.zh: 她性格单纯，从来不会骗人。
单纯.en: She has a simple personality and never lies to people.

割.en: The farmer is cutting rice in the field.

割.zh: 这块肉割掉坏的部分就能吃了。
割.en: If you cut off the bad part of this meat, it's edible.
He cut the rope with a knife.

割.zh: 伤口太深，医生只好割开皮肤清理。
割.en: The wound was too deep, so the doctor had to cut open the skin to clean it.

初步.en: This is just a preliminary plan.

初步.zh: 经过初步讨论，大家基本同意这个方案。
初步.en: After a preliminary discussion, everyone basically agreed on this plan.

初步.zh: 初步结果显示，他的病情有好转。
初步.en: Preliminary results show that his condition has improved.

初步.zh: 虽然只是初步的尝试，但效果还不错。
初步.en: Although it's just an initial attempt, the effect is pretty good.

假设.zh: 假设明天不下雨，我们就去。
假设.en: Suppose it doesn't rain tomorrow, we will go.

假设.zh: 这只是个假设，不用太当真。
假设.en: This is just a hypothesis; don't take it too seriously.

假设.zh: 假设你是老板，你会怎么做？
假设.en: Suppose you were the boss, what would you do?

假设.zh: 这个假设还需要更多的数据来验证。
假设.en: This hypothesis still needs more data to verify.

假设.zh: 假设他不同意，我们还有别的办法吗？
假设.en: Suppose he disagrees, do we have any other options?

困扰.zh: 这个问题困扰我很久了。
困扰.en: This problem has troubled me for a long time.
Don't let small things bother you.

困扰.zh: 他最近一直被失眠困扰。
困扰.en: He has been troubled by insomnia lately.

困扰.zh: 噪音太大，困扰了附近居民的生活。
困扰.en: The noise is too loud, troubling the lives of nearby residents.

困扰.zh: 工作上的压力一直困扰着她，让她睡不好觉。
困扰.en: Work pressure has been troubling her, making it hard for her to sleep.

布置.en: The teacher assigned a lot of homework.

布置.zh: 我们在客厅里布置了一些鲜花。
布置.en: We arranged some flowers in the living room.

布置.zh: 新年到了，她忙着布置房间。
布置.en: New Year is coming, and she is busy decorating the room.

布置.zh: 老板布置的任务，我明天之前要完成。
布置.en: The task assigned by the boss, I need to finish it by tomorrow.

布置.zh: 婚礼现场布置得很浪漫，大家都觉得漂亮。
布置.en: The wedding venue was decorated very romantically, and everyone thought it was beautiful.

优先.en: Priority is given to the elderly and children.
This task needs to be prioritized.

优先.zh: 面试时，有经验的人优先考虑。
优先.en: During interviews, people with experience are given priority.

优先.zh: 我们得优先解决资金问题，才能继续项目。
优先.en: We have to prioritize solving the funding issue before we can continue the project.

吊.en: Hang the clothes on the hanger.

吊.zh: 因为灯坏了，所以我先吊了一个临时灯。
吊.en: Because the light was broken, I first hung a temporary light.

吊.zh: 别吊我胃口了，快说结果吧！
吊.en: Don't keep me in suspense, just tell me the result!

吊.zh: 他用绳子把水桶吊到井里打水。
吊.en: He used a rope to lower the bucket into the well to fetch water.

手臂.zh: 我昨天打篮球，结果手臂扭伤了。
手臂.en: I played basketball yesterday and ended up spraining my arm.

手臂.zh: 她用手臂挡了一下阳光。
手臂.en: She shielded the sunlight with her arm.

手臂.zh: 虽然手臂很疼，但他还是坚持完成了比赛。
手臂.en: Although his arm hurt a lot, he still insisted on finishing the race.

携带.en: Please bring your documents with you.

携带.zh: 坐飞机时，不能携带液体超过100毫升。
携带.en: When flying, you cannot carry liquids over 100ml.

携带.zh: 他出门总是携带一把伞。
携带.en: He always carries an umbrella when going out.

携带.zh: 因为要爬山，所以大家都携带了足够的水和食物。
携带.en: Because we were going hiking, everyone brought enough water and food.

聚集.zh: 很多人聚集在门口等着看明星。
聚集.en: Many people gathered at the door waiting to see the star.

聚集.zh: 这些数据需要聚集在一起分析。
聚集.en: This data needs to be gathered together for analysis.

聚集.zh: 虽然下着雨，但粉丝们还是聚集在演唱会入口。
聚集.en: Although it was raining, the fans still gathered at the concert entrance.

指定.en: Please gather at the designated location.

指定.zh: 老师指定小王负责这次活动的策划。
指定.en: The teacher appointed Xiao Wang to be responsible for planning this event.

指定.zh: 这个座位是指定给贵宾的。
指定.en: This seat is designated for VIP guests.

指定.zh: 如果你不指定谁来接手，那就只能由我来决定了。
指定.en: If you don't specify who will take over, then I'll have to decide.
Please finish within the specified time.

部位.zh: 医生检查了他受伤的部位，说问题不大。
部位.en: The doctor examined his injured area and said it wasn't serious.

部位.zh: 汽车的哪个部位最容易出问题？
部位.en: Which part of the car is most prone to problems?

部位.zh: 虽然这个部位很小，但它的作用却很重要。
部位.en: Although this part is very small, its function is very important.

融入.en: He quickly integrated into the new environment.

融入.zh: 留学生需要时间融入当地的文化和生活。
融入.en: International students need time to integrate into the local culture and life.

融入.zh: 这些设计元素融入了传统风格。
融入.en: These design elements incorporate traditional style.

融入.zh: 虽然语言不通，但他还是努力融入大家的谈话。
融入.en: Although he didn't speak the language, he still tried to blend into everyone's conversation.

融入.zh: 她完全融入了这个团队。
融入.en: She fully integrated into the team.

激励.zh: 公司用奖金来激励员工努力工作。
激励.en: The company uses bonuses to motivate employees to work hard.

激励.zh: 这种比赛能激励大家不断进步。
激励.en: This kind of competition can motivate everyone to keep improving.

激励.zh: 因为受到朋友的激励，他才坚持跑完了全程。
激励.en: Because he was encouraged by his friend, he insisted on finishing the whole race.

坚定.zh: 无论遇到什么困难，他都不会放弃自己的坚定信念。
坚定.en: No matter what difficulties he encounters, he will not give up his firm belief.

坚定.zh: 她用坚定的语气说出了自己的决定。
坚定.en: She stated her decision in a firm tone.

坚定.zh: 虽然很多人反对，但他依然坚定地走自己的路。
坚定.en: Although many people opposed him, he still firmly walked his own path.
We need to strengthen our confidence.

粒.zh: 米饭里有一粒沙子，我差点咬到。
粒.en: There was a grain of sand in the rice; I nearly bit into it.

粒.zh: 他数着盘子里剩下的几粒花生米。
粒.en: He counted the remaining few peanuts on the plate.

粒.zh: 因为只吃了几粒米，所以他很快就饿了。
粒.en: Because he only ate a few grains of rice, he got hungry quickly.
There are two buttons on the table.

高层.en: The company's top management is having a meeting.

高层.zh: 这栋楼有三十层，高层风景很好。
高层.en: This building has 30 floors, and the view from the upper floors is great.

高层.zh: 因为高层不同意，这个项目被暂停了。
高层.en: Because the senior management disagreed, this project was suspended.

高层.zh: 我们住在高层，每天都要坐电梯。
高层.en: We live on a high floor, so we have to take the elevator every day.

高层.zh: 高层领导应该多听听员工的意见。
高层.en: Senior leaders should listen more to employees' opinions.

许可.zh: 没有许可是不能进入这个区域的。
许可.en: Without permission, you cannot enter this area.

许可.zh: 我们需要申请施工许可才能动工。
许可.en: We need to apply for a construction permit before starting work.

许可.zh: 虽然老板口头许可了，但还要走流程。
许可.en: Although the boss gave verbal permission, we still need to go through the process.

许可.zh: 他未经许可就拿走了我的电脑。
许可.en: He took my computer without permission.

灾难.zh: 这次地震是一场大灾难。
灾难.en: This earthquake was a major disaster.

灾难.zh: 灾难发生时，大家要保持冷静。
灾难.en: When a disaster occurs, everyone should stay calm.

灾难.zh: 为了避免灾难，我们要提前做好准备。
灾难.en: To avoid disaster, we need to prepare in advance.

灾难.zh: 火灾给这个家庭带来了巨大的灾难。
灾难.en: The fire brought great disaster to this family.

灾难.zh: 如果早点预警，这场灾难可能不会这么严重。
灾难.en: If there had been an early warning, this disaster might not have been so severe.

以便.zh: 请早点通知我，以便安排时间。
以便.en: Please notify me early so that I can arrange my time.

以便.zh: 多存点钱，以便将来应急。
以便.en: Save more money so that you can handle emergencies in the future.

以便.zh: 他买了新手机，以便更好地工作。
以便.en: He bought a new phone so that he could work better.

以便.zh: 我们记下他的地址，以便以后联系。
以便.en: We wrote down his address so that we can contact him later.

以便.zh: 老师把作业要求写得很清楚，以便学生理解。
以便.en: The teacher wrote the assignment requirements very clearly so that students could understand.

军人.zh: 军人的职责是保卫国家。
军人.en: The duty of military personnel is to defend the country.

军人.zh: 他退伍后，看起来还像个军人。
军人.en: After retiring from the army, he still looks like a soldier.

军人.zh: 因为他是军人，所以做事非常守纪律。
军人.en: Because he is a military man, he is very disciplined in everything he does.

军人.zh: 这些军人在灾区帮助了很多老百姓。
军人.en: These soldiers helped many ordinary people in the disaster area.

定义.en: What is the definition of this word?

定义.zh: 成功没有统一的标准定义。
定义.en: There is no universal definition of success.

定义.zh: 科学家重新定义了什么是行星。
定义.en: Scientists redefined what a planet is.

定义.zh: 在开会之前，我们先定义一下问题。
定义.en: Before the meeting, let's define the problem first.

定义.zh: 不同文化对礼貌的定义不太一样。
定义.en: Different cultures have different definitions of politeness.

图像.zh: 我们需要处理一下图像的亮度。
图像.en: We need to adjust the brightness of the image.

图像.zh: 他用电脑软件修复了旧照片的图像。
图像.en: He used computer software to restore the image of the old photo.

图像.zh: 如果图像分辨率太低，打印出来会模糊。
图像.en: If the image resolution is too low, it will be blurry when printed.

图像.zh: 她正在分析卫星传来的图像数据。
图像.en: She is analyzing the image data transmitted by the satellite.

逗.en: He really likes to tease children.

逗.zh: 这只猫很调皮，总想逗你。
逗.en: This cat is very mischievous, always trying to tease you.

逗.zh: 你说话真逗，大家都被你逗乐了。
逗.en: What you said is so funny; everyone was amused by you.

逗.zh: 她逗了半天狗，狗都不理她。
逗.en: She tried to tease the dog for a long time, but the dog ignored her.

修复.en: The computer is broken and needs repairing.

修复.zh: 他花了一个月修复了古董花瓶。
修复.en: He spent a month restoring the antique vase.

修复.zh: 软件更新后，很多漏洞都被修复了。
修复.en: After the software update, many bugs were fixed.

修复.zh: 因为损坏严重，专家说修复起来很困难。
修复.en: Because the damage is severe, experts say it will be very difficult to restore.

常规.zh: 我们按照常规流程处理。
常规.en: We handle it according to the routine procedure.

常规.zh: 今天不做常规检查，只做测试。
常规.en: Today we won't do the routine check, only the test.

常规.zh: 虽然情况特殊，但还是要遵守常规规定。
常规.en: Although the situation is special, we still have to follow the routine regulations.

常规.zh: 在常规会议上，老板宣布了新的计划。
常规.en: At the routine meeting, the boss announced a new plan.

依赖.zh: 他虽然很依赖父母，但也在慢慢学会独立。
依赖.en: Although he relies heavily on his parents, he is slowly learning to be independent.

依赖.zh: 我们不应该太依赖手机。
依赖.en: We shouldn't rely too much on phones.

依赖.zh: 如果总是依赖别人，自己很难成长。
依赖.en: If you always depend on others, it's hard to grow yourself.

依赖.zh: 这个项目完全依赖你的努力。
依赖.en: This project completely depends on your effort.

此事.en: This matter has nothing to do with me.

此事.zh: 关于此事，我们已经讨论了很多次。
此事.en: Regarding this matter, we have discussed it many times.

此事.zh: 既然此事已经决定了，就别再想了。
此事.en: Since this matter is already decided, don't think about it anymore.
What's your opinion on this matter?

此事.zh: 此事需要尽快处理，不然会出问题。
此事.en: This matter needs to be handled quickly, otherwise problems will arise.

分散.zh: 风一吹，树叶就分散开了。
分散.en: When the wind blows, the leaves scatter.

分散.zh: 如果大家分散行动，效率会更高。
分散.en: If everyone disperses to act separately, efficiency will be higher.

分散.zh: 他的精力太分散，很难做好一件事。
分散.en: His energy is too scattered, it's hard to do one thing well.

分散.zh: 我们要分散风险，不要把全部钱投进去。
分散.en: We need to spread the risk, don't put all the money in.

误.zh: 因为堵车，我误了今天的会议。
误.en: Because of traffic, I missed today's meeting.

误.zh: 如果你误了时间，就只能等下一班了。
误.en: If you miss the time, you'll have to wait for the next one.

误.zh: 这是个误会，他不是那个意思。
误.en: This is a misunderstanding; he didn't mean that.

误.zh: 他误以为我在生气，其实我只是累了。
误.en: He mistakenly thought I was angry, but I was just tired.

添.zh: 这汤太咸了，再添点水吧。
添.en: This soup is too salty, add some water.

添.zh: 如果你觉得冷，我再添一件衣服给你。
添.en: If you feel cold, I'll add another piece of clothing for you.

添.zh: 家里添了一个新成员，是只小猫。
添.en: The family added a new member, a little cat.

添.zh: 他不但不帮忙，反而添了很多乱。
添.en: Not only did he not help, but he also added a lot of chaos.

履行.zh: 公司会履行合同上的所有条款。
履行.en: The company will fulfill all the terms in the contract.

履行.zh: 既然签了字，就要履行义务。
履行.en: Since you signed, you must fulfill the obligations.

履行.zh: 他没能履行自己的职责。
履行.en: He failed to fulfill his duties.

履行.zh: 我们应该履行作为公民的责任。
履行.en: We should fulfill our responsibilities as citizens.

竞赛.zh: 下个月学校会举办数学竞赛。
竞赛.en: Next month the school will hold a math competition.

竞赛.zh: 虽然竞赛很激烈，但他还是拿了第一。
竞赛.en: Although the competition was fierce, he still got first place.

竞赛.zh: 他们参加的是知识竞赛，不是体育比赛。
竞赛.en: They participated in a knowledge competition, not a sports match.

竞赛.zh: 竞赛的结果明天公布，大家都很紧张。
竞赛.en: The results of the competition will be announced tomorrow, everyone is nervous.

被迫.zh: 因为天气不好，我们被迫取消了旅行。
被迫.en: Because of bad weather, we were forced to cancel the trip.

被迫.zh: 虽然他不想辞职，但最终还是被迫接受了。
被迫.en: Although he didn't want to quit, he was eventually forced to accept it.

被迫.zh: 她被迫在两者之间做出选择。
被迫.en: She was forced to choose between the two.

被迫.zh: 由于资金不足，公司被迫裁员。
被迫.en: Due to insufficient funds, the company was forced to lay off employees.

争夺.en: They are competing for the championship.

争夺.zh: 两家公司正在争夺这个市场份额。
争夺.en: Two companies are competing for this market share.

争夺.zh: 如果大家都不让步，争夺只会更激烈。
争夺.en: If no one gives in, the competition will only become more intense.

争夺.zh: 孩子们在争夺最后一个玩具。
争夺.en: The children are fighting over the last toy.

争夺.zh: 这场争夺持续了很久，双方都不肯放弃。
争夺.en: This contention lasted a long time; neither side was willing to give up.

扫描.zh: 你可以用手机扫描这个文件。
扫描.en: You can scan this document with your phone.

扫描.zh: 如果你扫描了条形码，就能看到价格。
扫描.en: If you scan the barcode, you can see the price.

扫描.zh: 医生给我做了一个脑部扫描。
扫描.en: The doctor did a brain scan for me.

扫描.zh: 把这张照片扫描一下，然后发到邮箱里。
扫描.en: Scan this photo, then send it to the email.

理念.zh: 他觉得公司的理念太保守了。
理念.en: He thinks the company's philosophy is too conservative.

理念.zh: 虽然理念不同，但我们还是朋友。
理念.en: Although our concepts differ, we are still friends.

理念.zh: 这个教育理念在亚洲很流行。
理念.en: This educational concept is very popular in Asia.

理念.zh: 他的生活理念就是快乐至上。
理念.en: His life philosophy is happiness first.

排名.zh: 这个大学的排名今年下降了很多。
排名.en: This university's ranking dropped a lot this year.

排名.zh: 因为成绩好，他的排名很靠前。
排名.en: Because his grades are good, his ranking is very high.

排名.zh: 排名不能代表全部能力。

排名.en: In the ranking, he is number one.

出事.zh: 听说那辆车在高速公路上出事了。
出事.en: I heard that car had an accident on the highway.

出事.zh: 如果没人帮忙，肯定要出事。
出事.en: If no one helps, there will definitely be trouble.
Don't worry, nothing will go wrong.

出事.zh: 她一出事就给我打电话了。
出事.en: As soon as she had trouble, she called me.

频率.zh: 他跑步的频率是一周三次。
频率.en: His running frequency is three times a week.

频率.zh: 虽然频率不高，但他每次都很认真。
频率.en: Although the frequency is not high, he is very serious each time.

取代.en: No one can replace his place in my heart.

住宅.en: The price of new residences has risen a lot.

住宅.en: Her family lives in a high-end residential building.

住宅.en: The government is building more public housing.

丧失.en: Staying up late for a long time can cause a person to lose judgment.

丧失.en: Although injured, he did not lose hope for life.

争论.en: In class, the students started a heated debate.

争论.zh: 不管怎么争论，最后还是要看结果。
争论.en: No matter how much they argue, in the end they still have to look at the results.

The Earth rotates around the sun.

旋转.en: He made the top spin quickly.

旋转.en: Although the wind is strong, the windmill still rotates slowly.

旋转.en: Children like to watch the carousel.

吞.en: Snakes can swallow animals bigger than their head.

气质.en: The waiters at this store all have professional demeanor.

气质.zh: 他说话的气质让人觉得很有安全感。
气质.en: His manner of speaking gives people a sense of security.

景.zh: 站在山顶上看景，心情特别放松。
景.en: Looking at the view from the mountaintop, my mood is especially relaxed.

景.zh: 虽然天气不好，但是景还是很棒。
景.en: Although the weather is bad, the view is still great.

景.zh: 我们找个地方停下来拍景吧。
景.en: Let's find a place to stop and take pictures of the view.

景.zh: 她喜欢画景，尤其是山水。
景.en: She likes painting scenes, especially mountains and rivers.

伤亡.en: The casualties in this accident are not large.

伤亡.zh: 地震造成了严重的人员伤亡和财产损失。
伤亡.en: The earthquake caused severe casualties and property losses.

伤亡.zh: 由于救援及时，伤亡人数被控制在最低。
伤亡.en: Due to timely rescue, the number of casualties was kept to a minimum.

伤亡.en: In the war, both sides had heavy casualties.

伤亡.zh: 我们需要统计这次事故的具体伤亡情况。
伤亡.en: We need to count the specific casualties of this accident.

缺陷.zh: 每个人的性格都有一些缺陷，这很正常。
缺陷.en: Everyone's personality has some flaws, that's normal.

缺陷.zh: 虽然设计有缺陷，但是功能还是不错的。
缺陷.en: Although the design has flaws, the function is still good.

缺陷.en: He cannot participate in sports competitions due to physical defects.

缺陷.en: The defect of this software has been fixed.

酒精.en: I don't drink beverages containing alcohol.

酒精.zh: 酒精消毒虽然有效，但是对皮肤有一定刺激。
酒精.en: Although alcohol disinfection is effective, it irritates the skin to some extent.

酒精.en: Because I have to drive, I can't touch any alcohol.

酒精.en: The concentration of medical alcohol is generally 75%.

酒精.zh: 他喝多了酒精，现在很难受。
酒精.en: He drank too much alcohol and now feels very uncomfortable.

查出.en: The doctor found out the cause of the illness.

查出.en: After the physical exam, it was found that his blood lipids are high.

查出.en: We haven't found out the cause of this problem yet.

查出.en: The customs discovered a batch of prohibited items.

总理.en: The Premier answered questions about the economy at the press conference.

总理.zh: 虽然总理很忙，但他还是抽出时间慰问灾民。
总理.en: Although the Premier is very busy, he still took time to console the disaster victims.

总理.zh: 新总理提出了很多改革措施。
总理.en: The new Premier proposed many reform measures.

总理.zh: 总理的讲话鼓舞了全国人民。
总理.en: The Premier's speech inspired the whole nation.

限.en: Each account is limited to purchasing two items per day.

限.en: Because the venue is limited, we have to limit the number of registrations.
The supermarket promotion is not limited by brand.

限.en: Drivers must drive within the speed limit, otherwise they will be fined.

骨头.en: The dog is chewing a bone.

骨头.zh: 他摔了一跤，结果骨头断了。
骨头.en: He fell and ended up with a broken bone.

骨头.zh: 虽然骨头汤很营养，但有些人觉得太油腻。
骨头.en: Although bone soup is nutritious, some people find it too greasy.

骨头.en: This kind of fish has few bones, suitable for children.
He is so thin that his skin wraps his bones.

上级.en: The superior notified us to have a meeting.

上级.zh: 他明天要去上级公司汇报工作。
上级.en: He is going to the parent company to report on work tomorrow.

上级.zh: 虽然上级同意了，但还是要走流程。
上级.en: Although the superior agreed, we still need to go through the process.

上级.en: The higher-level leader is coming to inspect the work.

睁.en: Open your eyes and take a look.
He opened his eyes wide and looked out the window.
