睁.en: Every day when I wake up, the first thing I do is open my eyes.
She sleeps with her eyes open.

睁.zh: 虽然很困，但我还是努力睁开眼睛。
睁.en: Although I'm very sleepy, I still tried to open my eyes.

金牌.en: She dreams of winning a gold medal.

金牌.zh: 这次比赛我们队得了三块金牌。
金牌.en: Our team won three gold medals in this competition.

金牌.zh: 奥运会上，她终于赢得了金牌。
金牌.en: At the Olympics, she finally won a gold medal.

金牌.zh: 他训练了很久，就是为了那块金牌。
金牌.en: He trained for a long time, just for that gold medal.

例外.zh: 通常我不喝酒，但今天例外。
例外.en: I usually don't drink, but today is an exception.

例外.zh: 所有学生都得参加，没有例外。
例外.en: All students must attend, no exceptions.

例外.zh: 除了他以外，其他人都是例外。
例外.en: Except for him, everyone else is an exception.

例外.zh: 通常我们不允许迟到，但特殊情况例外。
例外.en: Usually we don't allow being late, but special circumstances are an exception.

沉重.zh: 听到这个消息，他的心情很沉重。
沉重.en: Hearing this news, he felt very heavy-hearted.

沉重.zh: 他背着沉重的书包去上学。
沉重.en: He goes to school carrying a heavy backpack.

沉重.zh: 这次失败让他感到非常沉重。
沉重.en: This failure made him feel very heavy.

沉重.zh: 虽然任务很沉重，但他还是坚持完成了。
沉重.en: Although the task was very heavy, he still persisted and completed it.

仪器.zh: 科学家用精密仪器做实验。
仪器.en: Scientists use precision instruments to do experiments.

仪器.zh: 医院里有很多先进的仪器。
仪器.en: There are many advanced instruments in the hospital.

仪器.zh: 他正在操作一台复杂的仪器。
仪器.en: He is operating a complex instrument.

仪器.zh: 因为仪器出了问题，实验不得不暂停。
仪器.en: Because the instrument had a problem, the experiment had to be paused.

命名.zh: 这条街道以他的名字命名。
命名.en: This street is named after him.

命名.zh: 科学家用发现者的名字来命名这个星球。
命名.en: Scientists named the planet after the discoverer.

命名.zh: 父母给孩子命名时很用心。
命名.en: Parents put a lot of thought into naming their child.

命名.zh: 这个品牌是以创始人的姓氏命名的。
命名.en: This brand is named after the founder's surname.

赋予.zh: 音乐赋予生活更多的色彩。
赋予.en: Music adds more color to life.

赋予.zh: 这个任务赋予了他很大的责任。
赋予.en: This task gave him a lot of responsibility.

赋予.zh: 大自然赋予了我们丰富的资源，我们要珍惜。
赋予.en: Nature has given us abundant resources, and we should cherish them.

示范.zh: 他给我们示范如何操作。
示范.en: He demonstrated to us how to operate it.

示范.zh: 你先做个示范，我们跟着学。
示范.en: You do a demonstration first, and we'll follow along.

示范.zh: 教练示范了正确的跑步姿势。
示范.en: The coach demonstrated the correct running posture.

示范.zh: 为了让大家理解，他重复示范了好几次。
示范.en: In order for everyone to understand, he repeated the demonstration several times.

严厉.zh: 老师对学生的要求很严厉。
严厉.en: The teacher is very strict with the students.

严厉.zh: 他因为迟到受到了严厉的批评。
严厉.en: He received severe criticism for being late.

严厉.zh: 虽然教练很严厉，但都是为了我们好。
严厉.en: Although the coach is very strict, it's all for our own good.

严厉.zh: 这件事的后果非常严厉，大家要小心。
严厉.en: The consequences of this matter are very severe, everyone should be careful.

封闭.en: Because of the epidemic, the residential area is sealed off.

封闭.zh: 他的内心很封闭，不愿意跟人交流。
封闭.en: He is very closed off inside and unwilling to communicate with others.

封闭.zh: 这条高速公路暂时封闭，请绕行。
封闭.en: This highway is temporarily closed, please take a detour.

封闭.zh: 公司决定封闭这个部门，进行全面检查。
封闭.en: The company decided to seal off this department for a comprehensive inspection.

处罚.zh: 他因为闯红灯被处罚了。
处罚.en: He was punished for running a red light.

处罚.zh: 公司对迟到员工有明确的处罚规定。
处罚.en: The company has clear punishment rules for late employees.

处罚.zh: 如果你不按时交作业，老师会处罚你。
处罚.en: If you don't hand in your homework on time, the teacher will punish you.

处罚.zh: 这次违规的处罚很重，他可能要罚款。
处罚.en: The punishment for this violation is severe; he might have to pay a fine.

处罚.zh: 虽然只是小错，但老板还是给了严厉的处罚。
处罚.en: Although it was a small mistake, the boss still gave a harsh punishment.

血压.en: Do you usually measure your blood pressure?

血压.zh: 医生说我血压有点高，要注意饮食。
血压.en: The doctor said my blood pressure is a bit high, I need to watch my diet.

血压.zh: 他最近工作压力大，血压也上升了。
血压.en: He has been under a lot of work pressure lately, and his blood pressure has risen too.

血压.zh: 奶奶每天早晚都会测一次血压。
血压.en: My grandma measures her blood pressure every morning and evening.

血压.zh: 因为血压一直不稳定，他决定去医院做个全面检查。
血压.en: Because his blood pressure has been unstable, he decided to go to the hospital for a full check-up.

遗传.zh: 她的眼睛是遗传她妈妈的。
遗传.en: Her eyes are inherited from her mother.

遗传.zh: 这种病有很强的遗传倾向。
遗传.en: This disease has a strong genetic tendency.

遗传.zh: 他爸爸是画家，他好像也遗传了艺术天赋。
遗传.en: His father is a painter, and he seems to have inherited artistic talent.

遗传.zh: 科学家发现身高和遗传有很大关系。
遗传.en: Scientists have found that height is closely related to genetics.

遗传.zh: 虽然父母都很胖，但他并没有遗传到这一点。
遗传.en: Although both parents are overweight, he didn't inherit that trait.

教堂.zh: 他们每个星期天都去教堂做礼拜。
教堂.en: They go to church for service every Sunday.

教堂.zh: 教堂的钟声响了，大家开始安静下来。
教堂.en: The church bell rang, and everyone started to quiet down.

教堂.zh: 我们在小镇上参观了一座古老的教堂。
教堂.en: We visited an old church in the small town.

教堂.zh: 虽然我不信教，但教堂的建筑真的很好看。
教堂.en: Although I'm not religious, the church architecture is really beautiful.

识别.zh: 你能识别出这是谁的字吗？

识别.en: A facial recognition system has been installed at the door.

识别.zh: 这种软件可以自动识别图片中的文字。
识别.en: This software can automatically recognize text in images.

识别.zh: 他靠声音就能识别出每个朋友。
识别.en: He can recognize each friend just by their voice.

识别.zh: 虽然口罩遮住了脸，我还是能识别出他。

纠正.zh: 这个错误需要及时纠正。
纠正.en: This mistake needs to be corrected promptly.

纠正.en: His way of speaking is very rude; I helped him correct it a bit.

纠正.zh: 如果你发现数据错了，一定要马上纠正。
纠正.en: If you find that the data is wrong, you must correct it immediately.

纠正.zh: 她写字的姿势不对，医生建议她纠正。
纠正.en: Her writing posture is incorrect; the doctor advised her to correct it.

期限.en: The registration deadline is next Friday.

期限.zh: 这个项目的期限快到了。
期限.en: The deadline for this project is coming soon.

期限.en: If you exceed the deadline, you'll need to pay a late fee.

期限.en: Although the deadline was tight, we still finished on time.

开启.en: The new gate will be opened next week.

开启.en: With the development of technology, we have ushered in the smart age.

用心.en: She is very attentive in doing things.

用心.en: The teacher carefully prepared every lesson.

用心.zh: 如果你不用心，很难学好这个技能。
用心.en: If you don't put your heart into it, it's hard to learn this skill well.

用心.zh: 他虽然年轻，但工作非常用心。
用心.en: Although he is young, he is very dedicated at work.

流动.en: Due to the pandemic, international personnel movement has been greatly restricted.

如果你不想去，没人会拦着你。

拦.en: There's road construction ahead, so they set up barriers.

外界.zh: 你别太在意外界的看法了。
外界.en: Don't care too much about external opinions.

外界.zh: 外界不太了解我们公司的内部情况。
外界.en: The outside world doesn't understand our company's internal situation.

外界.zh: 虽然外界批评很多，但我们坚持自己的路。
外界.en: Although there is a lot of external criticism, we stick to our own path.

奉献.en: He devoted love to the disaster area.

奉献.zh: 她一生都在为教育事业奉献。
奉献.en: She devoted her whole life to education.

奉献.zh: 志愿者无私地奉献自己的时间。

奉献.zh: 我们不仅要索取，还要懂得奉献。
奉献.en: We should not only take but also know how to contribute.

漫长.zh: 经过漫长的旅行，我们终于到了。
漫长.en: After a long journey, we finally arrived.

漫长.zh: 等待考试结果的过程很漫长。
漫长.en: The process of waiting for exam results is very long.

漫长.zh: 因为路程漫长，所以我们需要休息一下。
漫长.en: Because the road is long, we need to rest a bit.

喜剧.en: Although this is a comedy, I felt a bit like crying.

喜剧.zh: 他演喜剧的时候特别有天赋。
喜剧.en: He has a special talent when performing comedy.

心脏病.zh: 爷爷因为心脏病所以住院了。

视觉.en: Although visually beautiful, the story is too poor.

The perfume smell is too strong.

香水.zh: 我不喜欢那种香水，因为太甜了。
香水.en: I don't like that kind of perfume because it's too sweet.

香水.zh: 他送我的那瓶香水味道很好闻。
香水.en: The perfume he gave me has a very nice scent.

多余.zh: 这些东西都是多余的，可以扔了。
多余.en: These things are all unnecessary, can be thrown away.

多余.en: Since you have already decided, whatever I say is unnecessary.

救助.en: They went to aid the disaster area.

救助.zh: 昨天消防员成功救助了一个被困的小孩。
救助.en: Yesterday firefighters successfully rescued a trapped child.

救助.zh: 虽然很危险，但他们还是坚持救助。
救助.en: Although very dangerous, they still insisted on rescuing.

救助.zh: 这只狗救助了落水的小猫。
救助.en: This dog rescued a drowning kitten.

救助.zh: 地震发生后，很多志愿者主动去参加救助工作。
救助.en: After the earthquake, many volunteers actively participated in rescue work.

测量.en: The engineer is using instruments to measure the length of this bridge.

测量.en: Because we're renovating, so first measure the windows.

测量.en: The doctor needs to measure the patient's temperature.

测量.zh: 我们得准确测量数据，不然结果会有误差。
测量.en: We need to accurately measure the data, otherwise the results will have errors.

走廊.zh: 教室外面的走廊上挂满了学生的画。
走廊.en: The corridor outside the classroom is full of students' paintings.

走廊.zh: 因为走廊太窄，所以大家要排队走。
走廊.en: Because the corridor is too narrow, everyone needs to walk in line.

走廊.zh: 酒店走廊尽头有一个紧急出口。
走廊.en: At the end of the hotel corridor there is an emergency exit.

走廊.en: After school, the children run around in the hallway, very noisy.

汇.en: This rainwater all converges into the small river.

汇.zh: 因为时间紧，所以赶紧把钱汇过去。
汇.en: Because time is tight, so quickly remit the money over.

汇.en: Everyone gathered together and took a group photo.

一同.zh: 既然大家目的相同，不如一同出发。
一同.en: Since everyone has the same goal, why not set off together.

一同.zh: 他们一同分享了这次获奖的喜悦。
一同.en: They shared the joy of winning this award together.

一同.en: On weekends our family goes shopping together at the supermarket, very happy.

珠宝.en: On Mom's birthday, I gave her a set of pearl jewelry.

赖.en: Although I didn't do it, he insists on blaming me.

洋.en: The clothes he wears look very stylish.

洋.en: Because he wanted to learn a foreign language, he went abroad to study.

冲击.en: The athlete goes all out to challenge the world record.

冲击.en: New technology has brought a huge impact to traditional industries.

水泥.en: Workers are mixing cement to build a house.

水泥.zh: 因为下雨，所以水泥干得很慢。
水泥.en: Because it's raining, the cement dries very slowly.

水泥.en: His hands were covered with cement, so he quickly washed them.

水泥.en: After mixing cement and sand and adding water, it can be used to lay bricks.

职务.en: Because of a job transfer, he went to the Shanghai branch.

职务.en: This position requires more than five years of management experience.

职务.en: Although his position is not high, he is very influential in the company.

愁.en: He sat there with a worried frown, not saying a word.

愁.en: What worries me is the matter of the child starting elementary school next year.

都市.en: I like living in the city.
The pace of city life is too fast.

都市.zh: 从乡村搬到都市，她很不习惯。
都市.en: Moving from the countryside to the city, she found it hard to get used to.

都市.zh: 这个都市的夜景特别漂亮。
都市.en: The night view of this city is especially beautiful.

都市.zh: 虽然都市机会多，但压力也很大。
都市.en: Although the city has many opportunities, the pressure is also great.

专用.en: This is the elevator for the general manager only.

专用.en: That lane is reserved for buses only.

专用.en: This software is the enterprise-specific version.

天真.en: Her innocent smile warms people's hearts.

认同.en: I need my family's approval before I can make a decision.

认同.en: Many people don't agree with this educational method.

认同.en: Although I don't fully agree, I can understand your thinking.

思路.en: I lost my train of thought, I can't remember.

思路.en: Try a different way of thinking, maybe there will be a solution.

尺寸.en: The size of this room is much smaller than I imagined.

派出.en: We decided to send out a small team to scout the path first.

影子.en: He walked so fast that I didn't even see his shadow.

影子.en: You seem to have lost weight recently; even your shadow got smaller.

影子.zh: 别回头看，你的影子一直在跟着你。
影子.en: Don't look back, your shadow is always following you.

影子.zh: 虽然他离开了，但他的影子还留在我心里。
影子.en: Although he left, his shadow still remains in my heart.

The coastline here is especially beautiful.

赞同.en: I strongly agree with your idea.

牢.en: He was sentenced to ten years in prison for committing a crime.

延续.en: This rain might continue until tomorrow.

电源.en: This power bank can serve as an emergency power source.

学位.en: She is pursuing a doctoral degree and is very busy every day.

考察.en: The leader is inspecting the new project site.

岁月.zh: 这些老照片记录了那段难忘的岁月。
岁月.en: These old photos record that unforgettable time.

岁月.zh: 虽然岁月流逝，但我们的友谊没变。
岁月.en: Although time passes, our friendship hasn't changed.

岁月.zh: 经过这么多年的岁月，我依然记得你。
岁月.en: After so many years, I still remember you.

伴随.en: Success often comes with hard work.

争议.en: Experts' controversy over this issue lasted a long time.

罪恶.en: This movie exposes the evils of war.

罪恶.zh: 他虽然有钱，但内心充满了罪恶感。
罪恶.en: Although he is rich, his heart is full of guilt.

罪恶.zh: 我们要抵制毒品这种罪恶的东西。
罪恶.en: We must resist drugs, that evil thing.

罪恶.zh: 那个罪犯最后承认了自己的罪恶行为。
罪恶.en: That criminal finally admitted his criminal acts.

金额.zh: 他捐了一笔不小的金额给灾区。
金额.en: He donated a considerable amount to the disaster area.

金额.zh: 因为金额有误，我们需要重新开发票。
金额.en: Because the amount is wrong, we need to reissue the invoice.

金额.en: The loan amount cannot exceed ten times your salary.

舌头.zh: 她说话的时候总是咬到舌头。
舌头.en: She always bites her tongue when she speaks.

舌头.zh: 这道菜太辣了，我的舌头都麻了。
舌头.en: This dish is too spicy, my tongue is numb.

舌头.zh: 虽然他很想说，但还是忍住了，咬紧舌头。
舌头.en: Although he really wanted to say it, he held back and bit his tongue.

舌头.zh: 医生让我伸出舌头检查一下。
舌头.en: The doctor asked me to stick out my tongue for an examination.

工地.en: The construction site is very noisy.

工地.zh: 他每天六点就去工地了。
工地.en: He goes to the construction site at six every day.

工地.zh: 这个工地晚上也在施工。
工地.en: This construction site is also working at night.

工地.en: Because of an accident at the site, all workers stopped work.

工地.zh: 工地上堆满了钢筋和水泥。
工地.en: The construction site is piled with steel bars and cement.

周边.en: The area around the school is very quiet.

周边.zh: 我喜欢逛公园周边的小店。
周边.en: I like to visit the small shops around the park.

周边.zh: 这个小区周边有超市和医院。
周边.en: This neighborhood has supermarkets and hospitals nearby.

周边.zh: 我们考察了一下公司周边的交通情况。
周边.en: We looked into the traffic conditions around the company.

周边.zh: 虽然景点很美，但周边设施还不够完善。
周边.en: Although the scenic spot is beautiful, the surrounding facilities are not yet complete.

专利.zh: 这个公司有很多技术专利。
专利.en: This company has many technology patents.

专利.zh: 你的发明可以申请专利保护。
专利.en: Your invention can apply for patent protection.

专利.zh: 因为专利侵权，他们被告上了法庭。
专利.en: Because of patent infringement, they were taken to court.

专利.zh: 这项专利明年就要过期了。
专利.en: This patent will expire next year.

特意.en: I came specifically to see you.
She made a cake specially for me.

特意.zh: 他特意把礼物放在门口。
特意.en: He deliberately placed the gift at the door.

特意.zh: 虽然路很远，但他特意赶过来帮忙。
特意.en: Although it was a long way, he came specifically to help.

特意.zh: 妈妈特意提醒我带伞，结果真的下雨了。
特意.en: Mom specifically reminded me to bring an umbrella, and it did rain.

捐款.en: This donation campaign was very successful.

捐款.zh: 公司给灾区捐款五十万。
捐款.en: The company donated 500,000 to the disaster area.

捐款.zh: 虽然自己不富裕，但他还是坚持捐款。
捐款.en: Although he is not rich, he still insists on donating.

捐款.zh: 捐款的金额虽然不大，但心意很重。
捐款.en: Although the donation amount is not large, the intention is significant.

主演.en: He has starred in several blockbusters.

主演.zh: 新剧的主演都是年轻演员。
主演.en: The leading actors in the new drama are all young actors.

主演.zh: 因为主演临时有事，首演推迟了。
主演.en: Because the lead actor had something come up, the premiere was postponed.

主演.zh: 她主演的角色是个勇敢的医生。
主演.en: The role she played is a brave doctor.

因为时间不够，我们只能合成一个简单版本。
合成.en: Because time was short, we could only produce a simplified version.

预料.en: I didn't expect it to rain.

预料.zh: 他预料的事情果然全都发生了。
预料.en: The things he predicted all happened.

预料.zh: 因为没准备，结果和我预料的不同。
预料.en: Because I didn't prepare, the result was different from what I expected.

预料.zh: 谁都预料不到明天会发生什么。
预料.en: No one can predict what will happen tomorrow.

约束.zh: 这个规则约束了大家的行为。
我不想被太多规矩约束。
约束.en: I don't want to be constrained by too many rules.

约束.zh: 虽然法律有约束，但自由还是有的。
约束.en: Although there are legal constraints, there is still freedom.

约束.zh: 父母对孩子的约束不能太多。
约束.en: Parents' constraints on children cannot be too much.

胡子.en: He shaved his beard and looks much younger.

胡子.zh: 你有没有剃须刀？我想刮胡子。
胡子.en: Do you have a razor? I want to shave my beard.
His beard is long and thick.

粉色.zh: 粉色的花在阳光下非常漂亮。
粉色.en: Pink flowers are very beautiful in sunlight.

粉色.zh: 他虽然是个男生，但非常喜欢粉色。
粉色.en: Although he is a boy, he really likes pink.

粉色.zh: 我给她买了一个粉色的包包。
粉色.en: I bought her a pink bag.

首要.en: Your primary task is to study.

首要.zh: 目前我们的首要问题是怎么解决资金。
首要.en: Currently our primary issue is how to solve the funding.

首要.zh: 健康是人生的首要财富。
首要.en: Health is the primary wealth in life.

首要.zh: 在紧急情况下，保护自己是最首要的。
首要.en: In an emergency, protecting yourself is the most important.

公告.zh: 公司发了一个新的公告。
公告.en: The company issued a new announcement.

公告.zh: 这个公告的内容确实非常重要。
公告.en: The content of this announcement is indeed very important.

公告.zh: 根据公告，明天全体放假。
公告.en: According to the announcement, everyone is off tomorrow.

公告.zh: 政府刚刚发布了一则重要的公告。
公告.en: The government just released an important announcement.

拿走.zh: 他已经把所有的文件拿走了。
拿走.en: He already took all the documents away.

拿走.zh: 外面风很大，赶紧把衣服拿走。
拿走.en: The wind is strong outside, quickly take the clothes away.

恶劣.en: The environment here is too harsh.

恶劣.zh: 虽然条件非常恶劣，但他们坚持工作。
恶劣.en: Although the conditions are very harsh, they persist in working.

恶劣.zh: 在恶劣的天气中开车很危险。
恶劣.en: Driving in harsh weather is dangerous.

过后.zh: 暴风雨过后，天空非常蓝。
过后.en: After the storm, the sky is very blue.

过后.zh: 吃饭过后我们去散步吧。
过后.en: After eating, let's go for a walk.

过后.zh: 他过后才真正明白我的意思。
过后.en: He only truly understood my meaning afterwards.

过后.zh: 考试过后他终于松了一口气。
过后.en: After the exam, he finally breathed a sigh of relief.

答复.zh: 他还没有答复我的具体问题。
答复.en: He hasn't replied to my specific question yet.

答复.zh: 对于你的要求，我明天给你正式答复。
答复.en: Regarding your request, I will give you a formal reply tomorrow.

答复.zh: 请尽快给我一个明确的答复。
答复.en: Please give me a clear reply as soon as possible.

传输.zh: 因为网络不好，文件传输得很慢。
传输.en: Because the network is bad, the file transfer is very slow.

传输.zh: 我们用了加密传输来保护隐私。
传输.en: We used encrypted transmission to protect privacy.

传输.zh: 虽然手机信号很强，但数据传输还是有问题。
传输.en: Although the phone signal is strong, data transmission still has problems.

传输.zh: 这种病毒可以通过空气传输。
传输.en: This virus can be transmitted through the air.

同行.en: He is my colleague in the same field.

同行.zh: 我们同行之间经常交流经验。
同行.en: We often exchange experiences among peers in the industry.

同行.zh: 虽然我们是同行，但很少见面。
同行.en: Although we are in the same industry, we rarely meet.

同行.zh: 这场会议来了很多同行。
同行.en: Many peers came to this conference.

同行.zh: 作为同行，我理解你的困难。
同行.en: As a colleague, I understand your difficulties.

利息.zh: 这笔贷款利息太高了，我负担不起。
利息.en: The interest on this loan is too high, I can't afford it.

利息.zh: 如果你存定期，利息会高一点。
利息.en: If you deposit fixed-term, the interest will be a bit higher.

利息.zh: 信用卡利息是按天计算的。
利息.en: Credit card interest is calculated daily.

急救.zh: 他受伤后，我们马上做了急救处理。
急救.en: After he got injured, we immediately gave first aid treatment.

急救.zh: 虽然伤势不重，但最好还是去急救中心看看。
急救.en: Although the injury is not serious, it's best to go to the emergency center to check.

急救.zh: 急救知识很重要，每个人都应该学。
急救.en: First aid knowledge is very important, everyone should learn it.
What's in the first aid kit?

主张.zh: 他的主张得到了很多人的支持。
主张.en: His stance gained support from many people.

主张.zh: 虽然你不同意，但我还是坚持自己的主张。
主张.en: Although you disagree, I still insist on my own opinion.
The company advocates innovation and efficiency.

主张.zh: 你有什么主张可以提出来。
主张.en: You can put forward any opinion you have.

辣椒.zh: 这道菜放了很多辣椒，特别辣。
辣椒.en: This dish put a lot of chili peppers, very spicy.

辣椒.zh: 如果你怕辣，可以少放点辣椒。
辣椒.en: If you are afraid of spiciness, you can put less chili.

辣椒.zh: 辣椒可以提味，但不能太多。
辣椒.en: Chili can enhance flavor, but not too much.
The chili peppers at the supermarket are very fresh.

跟随.zh: 这个小狗一直跟随主人到学校。
跟随.en: This puppy followed its owner all the way to school.

跟随.zh: 虽然道路很难走，但他仍然跟随队伍前进。
跟随.en: Although the road was difficult, he still followed the team forward.

跟随.zh: 在职场中，跟随一个优秀的领导很重要。
跟随.en: In the workplace, following an excellent leader is important.

跟随.zh: 他喜欢跟随潮流买新衣服。
跟随.en: He likes to follow trends to buy new clothes.

罕见.en: This kind of bird is very rare.

罕见.zh: 在南方见到雪真是罕见的事情。
罕见.en: Seeing snow in the south is really a rare thing.

罕见.zh: 虽然这种病很罕见，但医生还是诊断出来了。
罕见.en: Although this disease is very rare, the doctor still diagnosed it.

罕见.zh: 他收藏了很多罕见的邮票。
这样的大雨在沙漠地区非常罕见。
罕见.en: Such heavy rain is very rare in desert areas.

潮流.zh: 年轻人喜欢追随最新的潮流。
潮流.en: Young people like to follow the latest trends.

潮流.zh: 虽然潮流变化很快，但经典的东西永远不会过时。
潮流.en: Although trends change quickly, classic things never go out of style.

潮流.zh: 这款手机的设计引领了潮流。
潮流.en: The design of this phone leads the trend.
He doesn't care much about fashion trends.

恰恰.zh: 我赶到车站时，火车恰恰开走了。
恰恰.en: When I arrived at the station, the train had just left.

恰恰.zh: 我以为他会生气，恰恰相反，他笑了。
恰恰.en: I thought he would be angry; on the contrary, he smiled.

恰恰.zh: 恰恰因为太忙，所以我没去。
恰恰.en: Precisely because I was too busy, I didn't go.

村庄.en: This small village is very quiet.

村庄.zh: 每次放假我都想回村庄住几天。
村庄.en: Every holiday I want to go back to the village for a few days.

村庄.zh: 虽然村庄不大，但是风景很美。
村庄.en: Although the village is not big, the scenery is beautiful.

村庄.zh: 村庄里的人们互相都很熟悉。
村庄.en: People in the village know each other well.

村庄.zh: 我们开车穿过了一个小村庄。
村庄.en: We drove through a small village.

打动.zh: 这部电影深深打动了所有观众。
打动.en: This movie deeply moved all the audience.

打动.zh: 因为她的真诚，我被彻底打动了。
打动.en: Because of her sincerity, I was completely moved.

打动.zh: 她的演讲打动了在场的每个人。

争吵.en: If we keep quarreling, the problem will never be solved.

争吵.zh: 邻居的争吵声吵醒了我们。
争吵.en: The neighbors' quarreling woke us up.

争吵.zh: 他们因为钱的问题争吵不休。
争吵.en: They quarreled endlessly over money issues.

推销.en: Although the salesperson was enthusiastic, I didn't buy.

推销.zh: 这个公司靠推销保健品赚钱。
推销.en: This company makes money by promoting health products.

推销.en: She is recently promoting a new cosmetic.

机制.en: This company has a strict evaluation mechanism.

深夜.zh: 虽然已是深夜，他还在工作。
深夜.en: Although it's already late night, he is still working.
They often chat late at night.
I'm used to reading late at night.

透过.zh: 透过这件事，我看清了他的为人。
透过.en: Through this matter, I saw his true character.

透过.zh: 如果透过现象看本质，就会发现原因。
透过.en: If you look at the essence through appearances, you will find the reason.
She looked at herself through the mirror.

透过.zh: 透过他的眼神，我能感受到他的悲伤。
透过.en: Through his eyes, I could feel his sadness.

发育.en: Adolescence is a critical period for physical development.

发育.en: Because nutrition is adequate, her development is normal.

发育.zh: 植物的发育需要阳光和水分。
发育.en: Plant development needs sunlight and water.

发育.zh: 他比同龄人发育得慢一些。
发育.en: He develops a bit slower than peers.

一带.zh: 那一带有很多古老的建筑。
一带.en: That area has many ancient buildings.

一带.zh: 虽然这一带比较偏僻，但环境很好。
一带.en: Although this area is relatively remote, the environment is good.
My home is in the school area.

一带.zh: 沿海一带的经济比较发达。
一带.en: The coastal area's economy is relatively developed.

热门.zh: 现在最热门的电影是哪一部？
热门.en: What is the most popular movie now?

热门.zh: 因为那首歌很热门，到处都在放。
热门.en: Because that song is very popular, it's played everywhere.

终点.zh: 虽然很累，但我们终于快到终点了。
终点.en: Although very tired, we're finally near the finish line.

终点.zh: 坐地铁到终点再换公交。
终点.en: Take the subway to the end and then change to bus.

终点.zh: 如果你坚持跑下去，终点就在前面。
终点.en: If you keep running, the finish line is ahead.

终点.zh: 人生没有真正的终点，只有新的起点。
终点.en: Life has no real end, only new beginnings.

精确.en: This data is not precise enough.

精确.zh: 科学家需要精确的测量结果才能做实验。
精确.en: Scientists need precise measurement results to do experiments.

精确.zh: 他的回答非常精确，没有多余的话。
精确.en: His answer was very precise, with no extra words.

精确.zh: 虽然时间有限，但我们还是尽量做到精确。
精确.en: Although time is limited, we still try to be precise.

精确.zh: 请你把地址写精确一点，免得寄错。
精确.en: Please write the address more precisely to avoid mailing errors.

面部.zh: 现在很多手机都有面部识别功能。
面部.en: Now many phones have facial recognition functions.

面部.zh: 他面部受伤了，需要去医院。
面部.en: His face is injured, need to go to hospital.

面部.zh: 如果你紧张，面部肌肉会僵硬。
面部.en: If you are nervous, facial muscles will stiffen.

面部.zh: 美容师说要经常做面部按摩。
面部.en: The beautician said to do facial massage often.

规范.zh: 公司要求所有员工遵守行为规范。
规范.en: The company requires all employees to follow behavioral norms.

规范.zh: 这个流程还不够规范，需要改进。
规范.en: This process is not standardized enough, needs improvement.

规范.zh: 为了提高质量，我们必须规范每一个步骤。
规范.en: To improve quality, we must standardize every step.

规范.zh: 语法书里的例句都很规范。
规范.en: The example sentences in the grammar book are all standard.

中断.en: Because of rain, the match was forced to interrupt for half an hour.

中断.zh: 请不要中断我们的谈话。

中断.en: Although the internet was interrupted, we still finished the work.

拜访.en: Tomorrow I will visit the teacher.

拜访.zh: 周末我们打算去拜访一位老朋友。
拜访.en: This weekend we plan to visit an old friend.

拜访.zh: 第一次拜访长辈应该带礼物。
拜访.en: First time visiting elders should bring gifts.

拜访.zh: 如果你有空，可以来我家拜访。
拜访.en: If you are free, you can come visit my home.

拜访.zh: 他出差时顺便拜访了客户。
拜访.en: He visited clients while on a business trip.

医药.en: This company specializes in medical research and development.

医药.zh: 医药行业这几年发展很快。
医药.en: The medical industry has developed rapidly in recent years.

医药.zh: 虽然医药进步了，但看病依然不便宜。
医药.en: Although medicine has advanced, seeing a doctor is still not cheap.

医药.zh: 请把这些医药垃圾分类处理。
医药.en: Please sort and dispose of these medical wastes.

原料.en: Where do these raw materials come from?

原料.zh: 做蛋糕需要面粉、鸡蛋等原料。
原料.en: Making cake needs flour, eggs and other ingredients.

原料.zh: 工厂因为原料短缺而停产。
原料.en: The factory stopped production due to shortage of raw materials.

原料.zh: 如果你不检查原料质量，产品会出问题。
原料.en: If you don't check raw material quality, products will have problems.

原料.zh: 环保原料越来越受欢迎。
原料.en: Environmentally friendly raw materials are becoming more popular.

动态.zh: 他的动态经常更新，可以看看他最近在干嘛。
动态.en: His updates are frequent, you can see what he's been up to.

动态.zh: 因为系统动态不稳定，所以需要调整。
动态.en: Because the system dynamics are unstable, adjustments are needed.

动态.zh: 微博上的动态都是他发的。
动态.en: The updates on Weibo are all posted by him.

透明.en: The company requires financial information to be transparent.

透明.zh: 透明的包装可以看到里面的东西。
透明.en: Transparent packaging allows seeing the contents inside.

透明.zh: 虽然过程透明，但结果还是让人意外。
透明.en: Although the process was transparent, the result was still surprising.
He likes to drink clear beverages.

调节.en: The air conditioner can adjust the temperature.

调节.zh: 他每天运动来调节心情。
调节.en: He exercises every day to regulate his mood.

调节.zh: 政府需要调节市场供需。
调节.en: The government needs to regulate market supply and demand.

调节.zh: 她喝了杯茶，想调节一下紧张的情绪。
调节.en: She drank a cup of tea to try to calm her nerves.

调节.zh: 如果压力太大，你可以试试用音乐来调节自己。
调节.en: If the pressure is too high, you can try using music to adjust yourself.

频繁.en: He's been taking frequent leave recently.
Earthquakes have been happening frequently this month.

频繁.zh: 他们频繁地开会讨论方案。
频繁.en: They have frequent meetings to discuss plans.

频繁.zh: 因为工作原因，他需要频繁出差。
频繁.en: Due to work reasons, he needs to travel frequently.

频繁.zh: 她频繁更新社交媒体，但没什么人看。
频繁.en: She frequently updates social media, but hardly anyone watches it.

供给.en: The school provides lunch for students.
Vegetable supply has been very tight recently.

供给.zh: 这个地区的水供给主要来自水库。
供给.en: The water supply in this area mainly comes from the reservoir.

供给.zh: 如果供给不足，价格就会上涨。
供给.en: If supply is insufficient, prices will go up.

突发.en: He had a sudden heart attack.
Sudden situations need to be handled promptly.
A big fire broke out suddenly last night.

突发.zh: 因为突发暴雨，比赛取消了。
突发.en: The game was canceled because of a sudden downpour.

突发.zh: 她突发奇想，决定去旅行。
突发.en: She suddenly had a whim and decided to go traveling.

听取.en: It's important to listen to opinions.

听取.zh: 老板听取了大家的建议。
听取.en: The boss listened to everyone's suggestions.

听取.zh: 开会时，他认真听取了报告。
听取.en: During the meeting, he carefully listened to the report.

听取.zh: 为了更好地改进，我们需要广泛听取意见。
听取.en: In order to improve better, we need to widely listen to opinions.

听取.zh: 她耐心听取孩子们的心里话。
听取.en: She patiently listened to the children's inner thoughts.

数目.en: The amount they donated is very large.

数目.zh: 具体的数目还没有统计出来。
数目.en: The specific number hasn't been counted yet.

数目.zh: 因为数目太多，他记不清了。
数目.en: He couldn't remember clearly because the numbers were too many.

数目.zh: 我们需要核对一下订单的数目。
数目.en: We need to check the quantity on the order.

当选.en: She was elected with a high number of votes.
The new chairman has been elected.

当选.zh: 经过投票，她当选为学生会主席。
当选.en: After voting, she was elected student council president.

当选.zh: 如果当选，他会努力为大家服务。
当选.en: If elected, he will work hard to serve everyone.

散发.en: He handed out a lot of flyers.
The sun emits light and heat.

散发.zh: 这种花在夜晚散发浓香。
散发.en: This kind of flower gives off a strong fragrance at night.

散发.zh: 他在街头散发广告，但没人接。
散发.en: He was handing out ads on the street, but nobody took them.

艺人.zh: 因为工作不稳定，艺人压力很大。
艺人.en: Because work is unstable, artists are under a lot of pressure.

艺人.zh: 她从小梦想成为一名艺人。
艺人.en: She dreamed of becoming an entertainer since childhood.

出名.zh: 这家店因为手工冰淇淋出名。
出名.en: This shop is famous for its handmade ice cream.

出名.zh: 他虽然出名了，但还是那么谦虚。
出名.en: Although he became famous, he is still so humble.

出名.zh: 我没想到他这么快就出名了。
出名.en: I didn't expect him to become famous so quickly.

出名.zh: 她出名不仅仅是因为漂亮，更因为才华。
出名.en: She is famous not just because of her beauty, but more because of her talent.

项链.zh: 她把项链弄丢了，很难过。
项链.en: She lost her necklace and is very sad.

项链.zh: 虽然这条项链不贵，但很有意义。
项链.en: Although this necklace is not expensive, it is very meaningful.

项链.zh: 我送她一条项链作为生日礼物。
项链.en: I gave her a necklace as a birthday gift.

项链.zh: 她戴的那条项链是我妈妈留给她的。
项链.en: That necklace she is wearing was left to her by my mother.

杰出.zh: 这部电影的导演非常杰出。
杰出.en: The director of this movie is very outstanding.

杰出.zh: 他在数学方面有杰出的成就。
杰出.en: He has outstanding achievements in mathematics.

杰出.zh: 虽然她年纪不大，但表现已经很杰出了。
杰出.en: Although she is not old, her performance is already outstanding.

杰出.zh: 我们公司需要更多杰出的人才。
杰出.en: Our company needs more outstanding talents.

鼓舞.zh: 教练的话鼓舞我们继续努力。
鼓舞.en: The coach's words inspired us to keep working hard.

鼓舞.zh: 这个好消息特别鼓舞士气。
鼓舞.en: This good news greatly boosts morale.

鼓舞.zh: 她的事迹一直鼓舞着我去追求梦想。
鼓舞.en: Her story has always inspired me to pursue my dreams.

鼓舞.zh: 虽然失败了，但他的精神仍然鼓舞我们。
鼓舞.en: Although we failed, his spirit still inspires us.

抄.zh: 老师让我们抄课文三遍。
抄.en: The teacher told us to copy the text three times.

抄.zh: 这篇文章是从网上抄的。
抄.en: This article was copied from the internet.

抄.zh: 你如果抄别人的创意，早晚会被发现。
抄.en: If you copy others' ideas, you will be found out sooner or later.

棍.en: He used a stick to chase the dog away.
I picked up a stick to use as a walking stick.

棍.zh: 这根棍虽然短，但很好用。
棍.en: Although this stick is short, it is very handy.

棍.zh: 他手里那根棍好像是铁的。
棍.en: That stick in his hand seems to be made of iron.

佩服.zh: 我很佩服你这么快就学会了。
佩服.en: I really admire that you learned it so quickly.

佩服.zh: 他那种不服输的精神真让人佩服。
佩服.en: His never-give-up spirit is truly admirable.

佩服.zh: 虽然失败了，但我佩服他的努力。
佩服.en: Although he failed, I admire his effort.

树立.zh: 我们要树立正确的价值观。
树立.en: We need to establish correct values.

树立.zh: 她通过努力树立了威信。
树立.en: She built up her authority through hard work.

树立.zh: 不仅要有好目标，还要树立好榜样。
树立.en: Not only must we have good goals, but we must also set good examples.

树立.zh: 从小就该树立远大的理想。
树立.en: One should set lofty ideals from a young age.

妨碍.en: This tree is blocking the way.

妨碍.zh: 如果你坐这里，会妨碍别人走路。
妨碍.en: If you sit here, it will block others from walking.

消耗.en: Running consumes a lot of energy.
Air conditioners consume a lot of electricity.

消耗.zh: 这种活动消耗时间又消耗精力。
消耗.en: This kind of activity consumes both time and energy.

消耗.zh: 长时间开会消耗了我们的耐心。
如果不好好休息，会消耗身体的能量。
消耗.en: If you don't rest well, it will deplete your body's energy.

以免.en: Take an umbrella to avoid rain.

以免.zh: 出门前检查一下，以免忘记带钥匙。
以免.en: Check before leaving so you don't forget your keys.

以免.zh: 咱们早点出发吧，以免路上堵车。
以免.en: Let's leave early to avoid traffic jams on the way.

以免.zh: 他说话很小心，以免得罪别人。
以免.en: He speaks very carefully to avoid offending others.

以免.zh: 你最好把密码记在别处，以免忘了。
以免.en: You'd better write the password somewhere else so you don't forget it.

平凡.zh: 虽然她很平凡，但心地善良。
平凡.en: Although she is very ordinary, she is kind-hearted.

平凡.zh: 我不喜欢太平凡的东西，喜欢有点特别的。
平凡.en: I don't like things that are too ordinary; I prefer something a bit special.

平凡.zh: 这部电影讲的是一个平凡人的故事。
平凡.en: This movie tells the story of an ordinary person.

平凡.zh: 在平凡的工作中，她也能找到乐趣。
平凡.en: Even in ordinary work, she can find joy.

花生.zh: 他花生过敏，不能吃这个。
花生.en: He is allergic to peanuts and can't eat this.

花生.zh: 你帮我买点花生油回来。
花生.en: Buy me some peanut oil on your way back.

花生.zh: 花生和啤酒是很好的搭配。
花生.en: Peanuts and beer are a great combination.

花生.zh: 小时候我常去田里挖花生吃。
花生.en: When I was young, I often went to the fields to dig up peanuts and eat them.

听话.en: You need to be obedient and not run around.

听话.zh: 狗狗很听话，叫它坐下它就坐下。
听话.en: The dog is very obedient; when you tell it to sit, it sits.

听话.zh: 虽然男朋友有时候不听话，但我还是很爱他。
听话.en: Although my boyfriend is sometimes disobedient, I still love him.

听话.zh: 老师说我们班学生都很听话，上课不吵闹。
听话.en: The teacher said students in our class are all very obedient and don't make noise in class.

言语.zh: 有时候言语比行动更重要。
言语.en: Sometimes words are more important than actions.

言语.zh: 她言语间透露出对家乡的思念。
言语.en: Her words revealed her longing for her hometown.

言语.zh: 我们之间不需要太多言语，一个眼神就懂了。
言语.en: We don't need many words between us; a glance is enough to understand.

言语.zh: 他言语伤人，后来道了歉。
言语.en: His words were hurtful, but he apologized later.

前景.zh: 你觉得新能源的前景怎么样？
前景.en: What do you think of the prospects for new energy?

前景.zh: 虽然公司现在困难，但前景很光明。
前景.en: Although the company is having difficulties now, its prospects are bright.

前景.zh: 她对自己的职业前景充满了信心。
前景.en: She is full of confidence in her career prospects.

前景.zh: 投资前要先看好市场的前景再做决定。
前景.en: Before investing, you should first look at the market prospects and then make a decision.

传真.en: Please fax the contract to me.

传真.zh: 我们公司还在用传真机。
传真.en: Our company still uses a fax machine.

传真.zh: 你收到我发的传真了吗？
传真.en: Did you receive the fax I sent?

传真.zh: 现在很少有人用传真了，都用电子邮件。
传真.en: Nowadays few people use fax; everyone uses email.

传真.zh: 麻烦你把确认函传真到这个号码。
传真.en: Please fax the confirmation letter to this number.

片刻.en: He didn't rest for a single moment.

片刻.zh: 让我思考片刻再回答你。
片刻.en: Let me think for a moment before answering you.
She left for a moment and then came back.

片刻.zh: 暴风雨过后，天空恢复了片刻宁静。
片刻.en: After the storm, the sky returned to a moment of calm.

隐私.en: Everyone has the right to privacy.

隐私.zh: 不要随便翻别人的手机，那是隐私。
隐私.en: Don't casually look through other people's phone; that's private.

隐私.zh: 在社交媒体上要注意保护个人隐私。
隐私.en: On social media, you should be careful to protect your personal privacy.

隐私.zh: 她不太喜欢谈论自己的隐私问题。
隐私.en: She doesn't like talking about her private issues.

庞大.zh: 公司有一个庞大的客户群。
庞大.en: The company has a huge customer base.

庞大.zh: 政府需要管理庞大的数据。
庞大.en: The government needs to manage a huge amount of data.

庞大.zh: 虽然团队很庞大，但效率并不高。
庞大.en: Although the team is huge, it is not very efficient.

庞大.zh: 面对庞大的工作压力，他选择了辞职。
庞大.en: Facing enormous work pressure, he chose to resign.

极为.zh: 他对待这件事的态度极为认真，让人佩服。
极为.en: His attitude towards this matter is extremely serious, admirable.

极为.zh: 这次考试极为重要，千万别迟到。
极为.en: This exam is extremely important, don't be late.

极为.zh: 虽然天气极为寒冷，但他还是坚持跑步。
极为.en: Although the weather is extremely cold, he still insists on running.

极为.zh: 她的演讲极为精彩，观众都鼓掌了。
极为.en: Her speech was extremely wonderful, the audience applauded.

糖果.zh: 妈妈给孩子买了一些糖果作为奖励。
糖果.en: Mom bought some candies for the child as a reward.

糖果.zh: 过春节的时候，家里总会准备很多糖果。
糖果.en: During Spring Festival, the family always prepares a lot of candies.

糖果.zh: 医生说他不能吃太多糖果，因为对牙齿不好。
糖果.en: The doctor said he can't eat too much candy because it's bad for teeth.

糖果.zh: 这家店的糖果种类很多，有巧克力和水果糖。
糖果.en: This store has many types of candy, including chocolate and fruit candies.

智力.zh: 他智力很高，但缺乏社交能力。
智力.en: He has high intelligence but lacks social skills.

智力.zh: 多读谜语书可以开发儿童的智力。
智力.en: Reading riddle books can develop children's intelligence.

智力.zh: 虽然他的智力超群，但他从不骄傲。
智力.en: Although his intelligence is outstanding, he is never arrogant.

智力.zh: 智力测试的结果并不代表一个人的全部。
智力.en: The results of intelligence tests do not represent a person's entirety.

液体.zh: 这种液体不能直接接触皮肤，会刺激。
液体.en: This liquid cannot directly contact skin, it will irritate.

液体.zh: 瓶子里的液体是什么颜色？
液体.en: What color is the liquid in the bottle?

液体.zh: 如果你把液体加热到沸点，它就会变成气体。
液体.en: If you heat the liquid to boiling point, it will turn into gas.

液体.zh: 工程师需要测量这种液体的密度。
液体.en: Engineers need to measure the density of this liquid.

资本.zh: 这家公司缺乏足够的资本来扩大生产。
资本.en: This company lacks enough capital to expand production.

资本.zh: 人脉也是一种重要的社会资本。
资本.en: Networking is also an important social capital.

资本.zh: 虽然他们有技术，但没有资本很难发展。
资本.en: Although they have technology, without capital it's hard to develop.

资本.zh: 资本家通过投资获得利润。

券.zh: 你用这个券去吃饭可以打八折。
券.en: You can get 20% off for dining with this coupon.

券.zh: 演唱会入场券已经卖完了。
券.en: The concert admission tickets are sold out.

券.zh: 如果你买电影票，记得带学生券可以便宜。
券.en: If you buy movie tickets, remember to bring student coupons to get cheaper.

券.zh: 超市发的代金券只能在指定商品使用。
券.en: The store's gift vouchers can only be used on specified products.

误解.en: There is a misunderstanding between us.

误解.zh: 他的玩笑话被误解成了批评。
误解.en: His joking words were misunderstood as criticism.

误解.zh: 为了避免误解，最好把话说清楚。
误解.en: To avoid misunderstanding, it's best to speak clearly.

误解.zh: 虽然她道歉了，但那个误解还是影响了关系。
误解.en: Although she apologized, that misunderstanding still affected the relationship.

误解.zh: 文化的差异常常导致沟通中的误解。
误解.en: Cultural differences often lead to misunderstandings in communication.

宴会.zh: 公司举办了一场盛大的宴会来庆祝新项目。
宴会.en: The company held a grand banquet to celebrate the new project.

宴会.zh: 宴会上有很多美味的菜肴。
宴会.en: There were many delicious dishes at the banquet.

宴会.zh: 虽然宴会很热闹，但他觉得有点无聊。
宴会.en: Although the banquet was lively, he felt a bit bored.

书面.zh: 我们需要一份书面的合同才能合作。
书面.en: We need a written contract to cooperate.

书面.zh: 面试之后，他会收到书面的录用通知。
书面.en: After the interview, he will receive a written job offer.

书面.zh: 如果你要请假，必须提供书面的申请和证明。
书面.en: If you want to take leave, you must provide a written application and proof.

书面.zh: 口头的承诺不如书面的协议可靠。
书面.en: Oral promises are not as reliable as written agreements.

岸.en: The boat docked at the shore.

岸.zh: 我们走到河的对面岸上休息了一会儿。
岸.en: We walked to the opposite bank of the river and rested for a while.

岸.zh: 海边的岸上有很多漂亮的贝壳。
岸.en: There are many beautiful shells on the seaside shore.

岸.zh: 虽然河水很急，但他还是游到了对岸。
岸.en: Although the river current was strong, he still swam to the opposite shore.

岸.zh: 钓鱼的人坐在岸边等了很久。
岸.en: The fisherman sat on the riverbank and waited for a long time.

有机.en: I've been only eating organic vegetables recently.

有机.zh: 有机食品虽然贵，但是对健康好。
有机.en: Organic food is expensive, but it's good for health.

有机.zh: 这种有机肥料对土壤很好。
有机.en: This organic fertilizer is good for the soil.

有机.zh: 我们公司专门生产有机护肤品。
有机.en: Our company specializes in producing organic skincare products.

次数.zh: 这个月我去了三次，次数不算多。
次数.en: I went three times this month, that's not a lot.

次数.zh: 做运动要注意次数和动作。
次数.en: When exercising, pay attention to reps and form.

次数.zh: 他犯错的次数越来越少了。
次数.en: The number of times he makes mistakes is decreasing.

次数.zh: 因为次数太多，我已经习惯了。
次数.en: Because it's happened so many times, I'm used to it.

次数.zh: 医生建议减少看手机的次数。
次数.en: The doctor advised reducing the number of times I look at my phone.

素质.en: He has very high personal qualities.

素质.zh: 这个员工的综合素质不错。
素质.en: This employee's overall quality is pretty good.

素质.zh: 提高国民素质是教育的目标。
素质.en: Improving the quality of citizens is the goal of education.

素质.zh: 虽然价格便宜，但是产品质量素质差。
素质.en: Although the price is cheap, the product quality is poor.

素质.zh: 我们公司很看重员工的素质。
素质.en: Our company values employees' qualities highly.

联想.zh: 看到这张照片，我联想到了童年。
联想.en: Seeing this photo, I thought of my childhood.

联想.zh: 这个品牌叫联想，但我没买过。
联想.en: This brand is called Lenovo, but I've never bought it.

联想.zh: 一听到这首歌，我就联想起了过去。
联想.en: As soon as I hear this song, I think of the past.

联想.zh: 你不要把这两件事联想在一起。
联想.en: Don't associate these two things together.

联想.zh: 他的联想能力很强，总能想到新点子。
联想.en: His ability to make associations is strong; he always comes up with new ideas.

纠纷.zh: 他们因为钱的问题发生了纠纷。
纠纷.en: They had a dispute over money.
Neighborhood disputes are hard to resolve.

纠纷.zh: 这个合同纠纷已经拖了半年了。
纠纷.en: This contract dispute has dragged on for half a year.

纠纷.zh: 为了避免纠纷，最好提前说清楚。
纠纷.en: To avoid disputes, it's best to clarify things in advance.

纠纷.zh: 他们两家之间的纠纷终于调解了。
纠纷.en: The dispute between the two families was finally mediated.

浴室.en: The faucet in the bathroom is broken.

浴室.zh: 你洗澡的时候记得把浴室门关好。
浴室.en: Remember to close the bathroom door when you shower.
The bathroom in this hotel is very big.

浴室.zh: 浴室里需要装一个排风扇。
浴室.en: We need to install an exhaust fan in the bathroom.

浴室.zh: 我每天早上都会打扫浴室。
浴室.en: I clean the bathroom every morning.

起点.en: This is the starting point of the marathon.

起点.zh: 不管起点怎么样，努力最重要。
起点.en: No matter what the starting point is, effort is most important.

起点.zh: 他的起点比我们高很多。
起点.en: His starting point is much higher than ours.

起点.zh: 从起点到终点大概有十公里。
起点.en: It's about ten kilometers from start to finish.

起点.zh: 每个人的人生起点都不一样。
起点.en: Everyone's starting point in life is different.

榜样.zh: 父母是孩子最好的榜样。
榜样.en: Parents are the best role models for children.

榜样.zh: 雷锋一直是大家学习的榜样。
榜样.en: Lei Feng has always been a role model for everyone to learn from.

榜样.zh: 你要给孩子树立一个好榜样。
榜样.en: You need to set a good example for your child.

榜样.zh: 他的行为为大家树立了榜样。
榜样.en: His behavior set an example for everyone.

创建.zh: 我们创建了一个新的团队。
这个网站是去年创建的。
创建.en: This website was created last year.

创建.zh: 请先创建一个账号才能登录。
创建.en: Please create an account first before logging in.

创建.zh: 在创建项目之前，我们需要做好计划。
创建.en: Before creating the project, we need to make a good plan.

后者.zh: 我喜欢前者，不喜欢后者。
后者.en: I like the former, not the latter.

后者.zh: 苹果和香蕉，后者更健康。
后者.en: Between apples and bananas, the latter is healthier.

后者.zh: 这两个方案，我选择后者。
后者.en: Between these two plans, I choose the latter.

后者.zh: 前者太贵了，后者比较便宜。
后者.en: The former is too expensive, the latter is cheaper.

后者.zh: 对于工作和学习，后者对我来说更重要。
后者.en: Between work and study, the latter is more important to me.

不顾.en: He jumped into the water regardless of the danger.

不顾.zh: 她不顾妈妈的反对，还是选择了学画画。
不顾.en: She chose to learn painting despite her mother's objection.

不顾.zh: 虽然很累，但他不顾疲惫继续工作。
不顾.en: Although very tired, he continued working despite fatigue.

不顾.zh: 他为了赚钱不顾身体健康。
不顾.en: He disregards his health for money.

不顾.zh: 她不顾一切地跑去追那辆公交车。
不顾.en: She ran to catch that bus regardless of everything.

剩余.en: The remaining money is not much.

剩余.zh: 我们先把剩余的材料用完吧。
剩余.en: Let's use up the remaining materials first.

剩余.zh: 因为时间剩余不多，我们只能加快速度。
剩余.en: Because the remaining time is not much, we can only speed up.

剩余.zh: 这个月剩余几天我要好好休息。
剩余.en: In the remaining days of this month, I want to rest well.

剩余.zh: 他把剩余的食物分给了邻居。
剩余.en: He gave the remaining food to the neighbors.

差异.en: These two sentences have a difference.

差异.zh: 南北方的文化差异很大。
差异.en: The cultural differences between north and south are huge.

差异.zh: 虽然他们长得像，但性格差异却很大。
差异.en: Although they look alike, their personalities are very different.

差异.zh: 价格差异让我选择了便宜的那个。
差异.en: The price difference made me choose the cheaper one.

差异.zh: 我们要尊重不同人之间的差异。
差异.en: We should respect differences between people.

气味.zh: 厨房里有一股烧焦的气味。
气味.en: There is a burnt smell in the kitchen.

气味.zh: 虽然气味很淡，但我还是闻到了。
气味.en: Although the smell is faint, I still smelled it.

气味.zh: 花香的气味让我心情变好。
气味.en: The floral smell makes my mood better.

气味.zh: 新房子有一股油漆的气味，需要通风。
气味.en: The new house has a paint smell; it needs ventilation.

推测.zh: 根据线索，我们可以推测出真相。
推测.en: Based on clues, we can infer the truth.

推测.zh: 因为证据不足，我们只能推测原因。
推测.en: Because evidence is insufficient, we can only speculate the reason.
He speculates it will rain tomorrow.

推测.zh: 专家推测这次地震的强度是6级。
推测.en: Experts estimate the intensity of this earthquake is magnitude 6.

点燃.en: She lit the stove with a match.

点燃.zh: 点燃篝火后，大家开始唱歌跳舞。
点燃.en: After lighting the bonfire, everyone started singing and dancing.

点燃.zh: 这个事件点燃了大家的愤怒。
他在黑暗中点燃了一根烟。
点燃.en: He lit a cigarette in the dark.

思念.en: I miss my hometown very much.

思念.zh: 在国外的时候，他特别思念家人。
思念.en: When abroad, he especially missed his family.

思念.zh: 虽然才分开一天，但我已经开始思念她了。
思念.en: Although we only parted for a day, I already miss her.
This song makes me miss the past.

思念.zh: 每当中秋节，思念亲人的感觉就更强烈。
思念.en: During Mid-Autumn Festival, the feeling of missing loved ones is stronger.

刹车.en: There's a car ahead, brake quickly!

刹车.zh: 他用力踩下刹车，车终于停下了。
刹车.en: He stepped hard on the brake, and the car finally stopped.

刹车.zh: 因为路滑，刹车距离变长了。
刹车.en: Because the road is slippery, the braking distance became longer.

刹车.zh: 这辆车的刹车有点问题。
刹车.en: There's something wrong with this car's brakes.

刹车.zh: 突然刹车让乘客都往前倒。
刹车.en: The sudden braking made all passengers lurch forward.

歇.zh: 走了这么久，该歇歇脚了。
歇.en: Having walked so long, it's time to rest our feet.

歇.zh: 如果你累了，就先歇一下。
歇.en: If you're tired, take a rest first.

歇.zh: 周末我哪儿也不去，就在家歇着。
歇.en: I'm not going anywhere on weekends, just resting at home.

歇.zh: 他干了一天的活，晚上就歇着了。
歇.en: He worked all day and rested in the evening.

粥.en: I had a bowl of congee this morning.

粥.zh: 生病的时候最适合喝清淡的粥。
粥.en: When sick, light congee is most suitable.

粥.zh: 因为胃不舒服，我只喝了一点粥。
粥.en: Because my stomach was uncomfortable, I only drank a little congee.

粥.zh: 这家店的皮蛋瘦肉粥很好吃。
粥.en: The preserved egg and lean meat congee at this shop is delicious.

粥.zh: 冬天喝一碗热粥，全身都暖和了。
粥.en: Drinking a bowl of hot congee in winter warms the whole body.

原理.zh: 他跟我解释了机器工作的原理。
原理.en: He explained to me the principle of how the machine works.

原理.zh: 虽然原理听起来复杂，但实际用起来不难。
原理.en: Although the principle sounds complicated, it's not hard to use in practice.

原理.zh: 我们学物理要先理解基本原理。
原理.en: When learning physics, we need to understand basic principles first.

原理.zh: 这个原理适用于很多不同的情况。
原理.en: This principle applies to many different situations.

账.zh: 老板，我能看看昨天的账吗？
账.en: Boss, can I look at yesterday's accounts?

账.zh: 因为没记账，所以不知道花了多少钱。
账.en: Because I didn't keep accounts, I don't know how much I spent.
The debt he owes me hasn't been repaid.

账.zh: 这笔账我们以后慢慢算。
账.en: We'll settle this account slowly later.

有事.zh: 他看起来好像有事瞒着我。
有事.en: He looks like he's hiding something from me.

层面.zh: 从经济层面看，这个计划是可行的。
层面.en: From an economic perspective, this plan is feasible.

层面.zh: 不光是表面层面，深层原因也要考虑。
层面.en: Not just the surface level, but also the deeper reasons need to be considered.

层面.zh: 我们要从不同层面分析这件事。
层面.en: We need to analyze this from different levels.

层面.zh: 这个决定在社会层面影响很大。
层面.en: This decision has a big influence on the social level.

符号.en: How do you read the @ symbol?

符号.zh: 在数学里，加号是一个常见的符号。
符号.en: In math, the plus sign is a common symbol.

符号.zh: 虽然只是一个小符号，但意思完全不同。
符号.en: Although it's just a small symbol, the meaning is completely different.

符号.zh: 我找不到键盘上的美元符号。
符号.en: I can't find the dollar sign on the keyboard.

盛.en: The flowers in the garden are in full bloom.

盛.zh: 最近这种发型非常盛行。
盛.en: Recently this hairstyle is very popular.

盛.zh: 虽然天气不好，但他们的盛情让我很感动。
盛.en: Although the weather was bad, their great kindness moved me.
Many people came to this grand gathering.

盛.zh: 电视上报道了比赛盛况。
盛.en: The TV reported the grand occasion of the competition.

清晨.en: The air is very good in the early morning.

清晨.zh: 我习惯在清晨去公园跑步。
清晨.en: I am used to running in the park in the early morning.

清晨.zh: 因为明天要早起，所以清晨就得出发。
清晨.en: Because I need to get up early tomorrow, I have to depart in the early morning.
The streets are very quiet in the early morning.

清晨.zh: 他每天清晨都喝一杯咖啡。
清晨.en: He drinks a cup of coffee every early morning.

民间.zh: 民间有很多关于这个节日的习俗。
民间.en: There are many folk customs about this festival.

民间.zh: 虽然官方没说，但民间早就传开了。
民间.en: Although the officials didn't say, it has already spread among the people.
Folk art needs to be protected.

占有.zh: 这个国家占有很多资源。
他在这家公司占有重要地位。
占有.en: He holds an important position in this company.

占有.zh: 虽然只占有一小部分股份，但他有发言权。
占有.en: Although he only holds a small share of stock, he has the right to speak.

占有.zh: 这些数据占有了太多内存。
占有.en: These data take up too much memory.

占有.zh: 她的作品在市场上占有很大份额。
占有.en: Her works have a large share in the market.

外来.zh: 这座城市有很多外来人口。
外来.en: This city has many migrant people.

外来.zh: 由于外来文化的冲击，传统习俗在改变。
外来.en: Due to the impact of foreign cultures, traditional customs are changing.

外来.zh: 外来投资帮助了当地经济发展。
外来.en: Foreign investment helped the local economy develop.

哎哟.en: Oops, I forgot to bring my keys.

哎哟.zh: 哎哟，这么晚了，我得走了。
哎哟.en: Oh dear, it's so late, I have to go.

哎哟.zh: 哎哟，原来是你啊，我还以为是谁呢。
哎哟.en: Oh, it's you! I thought it was someone else.

导师.zh: 导师给我推荐了几本专业书。
导师.en: My advisor recommended a few professional books to me.

导师.zh: 我跟导师讨论了一下论文的方向。
导师.en: I discussed the direction of my thesis with my advisor.

导师.zh: 多亏了导师的指导，我才能顺利毕业。
导师.en: Thanks to my advisor's guidance, I was able to graduate smoothly.

导师.zh: 导师不仅教我们知识，还关心我们的生活。
导师.en: Our advisor not only teaches us knowledge but also cares about our lives.

开头.en: The beginning of the story is very engaging.
The beginning of the movie was a bit boring.

开头.zh: 我们刚开始合作，开头不太顺利。
开头.en: We just started cooperating, and the beginning didn't go smoothly.

开头.zh: 这次演讲的开头，他讲了一个笑话，气氛马上活跃了。
开头.en: At the beginning of this speech, he told a joke, and the atmosphere immediately livened up.

倾听.en: You need to learn to listen.

倾听.zh: 她总是耐心倾听别人的烦恼。
倾听.en: She always patiently listens to others' troubles.

倾听.zh: 作为朋友，最重要的是倾听。
倾听.en: As a friend, the most important thing is to listen.

倾听.zh: 在会议上，经理认真倾听了每个人的意见。
倾听.en: At the meeting, the manager carefully listened to everyone's opinions.

倾听.zh: 有时候，倾听比说话更重要。
倾听.en: Sometimes listening is more important than speaking.

消毒.en: The wound needs to be disinfected.
I disinfect my phone with alcohol.

消毒.zh: 疫情期间，我们每天都要消毒双手。
消毒.en: During the pandemic, we have to disinfect our hands every day.

消毒.zh: 孩子玩完玩具后，记得用湿巾消毒一下。
消毒.en: After the child plays with toys, remember to disinfect them with wipes.

消毒.zh: 新买的餐具最好先消毒再用。
消毒.en: Newly bought tableware is best disinfected before use.

原先.zh: 我原先的计划不是这样的。
原先.en: My original plan wasn't like this.

原先.zh: 原先我们打算去海边，但后来改了主意。
原先.en: Originally we planned to go to the beach, but later changed our minds.

原先.zh: 这个地方原先是一个工厂，现在变成了公园。
原先.en: This place was originally a factory, and now it's become a park.

原先.zh: 他原先是个老师，后来辞职创业了。
原先.en: He was originally a teacher, and later quit to start a business.

枕头.zh: 我习惯用高一点的枕头。
枕头.en: I'm used to using a slightly higher pillow.

枕头.zh: 酒店里的枕头太低了，睡得脖子疼。
枕头.en: The pillows in the hotel are too low, making my neck hurt when I sleep.

枕头.zh: 妈妈给我换了一个新的荞麦枕头。
枕头.en: Mom changed my pillow to a new buckwheat one.

枕头.zh: 出门旅行，我总会带自己的枕头。
枕头.en: When traveling, I always bring my own pillow.

探讨.zh: 我们需要探讨这个问题。
探讨.en: We need to discuss this issue.

探讨.zh: 他们正在探讨合作的可能性。
探讨.en: They are discussing the possibility of cooperation.

探讨.zh: 今天开会主要探讨明年的计划。
探讨.en: Today's meeting mainly discusses next year's plan.

探讨.zh: 专家们就这个议题进行了深入的探讨。
探讨.en: The experts had an in-depth discussion on this topic.

探讨.zh: 课后，我和同学继续探讨那道数学题。
探讨.en: After class, my classmate and I continued discussing that math problem.

主导.zh: 市场上，这家公司占据主导地位。
主导.en: In the market, this company holds a dominant position.

主导.zh: 在团队里，他发挥了主导作用。
主导.en: He played a leading role in the team.

主导.zh: 整个活动的策划都是由她主导完成的。
主导.en: The planning of the entire event was led and completed by her.

主导.zh: 我们要让用户需求主导产品设计。
主导.en: We need to let user needs dominate product design.

论坛.en: He often posts on the forum.

论坛.zh: 这个论坛讨论了很多技术问题。
论坛.en: This forum discusses a lot of technical issues.

论坛.zh: 我在论坛上找到了一个很好的学习资源。
论坛.en: I found a very good learning resource on the forum.

论坛.zh: 昨天参加了一个关于人工智能的论坛。
论坛.en: Yesterday I attended a forum about artificial intelligence.

论坛.zh: 论坛里有很多热心人愿意帮忙解答问题。
论坛.en: There are many热心 people in the forum willing to help answer questions.

力度.zh: 今天的训练力度不够大。
力度.en: Today's training intensity is not enough.

力度.zh: 虽然力度很大，但他还是没成功。
力度.en: Although the force was strong, he still didn't succeed.

力度.zh: 你要控制好按摩的力度。
力度.en: You need to control the pressure of the massage.

力度.zh: 他说话的语气力度很强。
力度.en: His tone of voice is very forceful.

城堡.en: Let's go play at the castle.

城堡.zh: 那座城堡已经有几百年历史了。
城堡.en: That castle is already hundreds of years old.

城堡.zh: 孩子梦想住在童话城堡里。
城堡.en: The child dreams of living in a fairytale castle.

城堡.zh: 城堡外面有很多游客在拍照。
城堡.en: There are many tourists taking photos outside the castle.

城堡.zh: 这个城堡虽然旧，但是很漂亮。
城堡.en: This castle, although old, is very beautiful.

拐.en: Turn the corner ahead and you'll arrive.
The driver suddenly turned to the right.

拐.zh: 别拐错了，我在这里等你。
拐.en: Don't make a wrong turn; I'll wait for you here.
He turned into the alley and disappeared.

拐.zh: 虽然路很窄，但他还是拐进去了。
拐.en: Although the road was narrow, he still turned in.

备用.zh: 手机没电了，用备用电池吧。
备用.en: The phone is dead, use the spare battery.

备用.zh: 出门前记得带备用口罩。
备用.en: Remember to bring spare masks before going out.

备用.zh: 虽然主轮胎没问题，但还是要准备备用胎。
备用.en: Although the main tire is fine, you still need to prepare a spare tire.

型号.zh: 这个型号的手机很受欢迎。
型号.en: This model of phone is very popular.
When buying accessories, they must match the model.

型号.zh: 虽然型号不同，但功能差不多。
型号.en: Although the models are different, the functions are similar.

发放.en: The school has started distributing new textbooks.
The government is distributing supplies to the disaster area.

发放.zh: 这个月的补贴还没发放。
发放.en: This month's subsidy hasn't been issued yet.

发放.zh: 因为系统升级，补贴发放延迟了。
发放.en: Due to system upgrades, the subsidy distribution has been delayed.

排练.zh: 排练的时候要认真一点。

排练.en: The actors are rehearsing a new play.

排练.zh: 这次排练花了三个小时。
虽然排练很累，但大家都坚持下来了。
排练.en: Although rehearsal was tiring, everyone persevered.

弱点.zh: 每个人都有自己的弱点。

弱点.en: His weakness is a lack of self-confidence.

弱点.zh: 不要轻易暴露自己的弱点。
这个计划的最大弱点是资金不足。
弱点.en: The biggest weakness of this plan is insufficient funds.

弱点.zh: 尽管他有很多弱点，但我们还是很喜欢他。
弱点.en: Despite his many weaknesses, we still like him very much.

学员.zh: 这次培训有二十名学员。
所有的学员都要通过考试。
学员.en: All trainees must pass the exam.

学员.zh: 老学员可以帮忙带新学员。
学员.en: Senior trainees can help mentor new trainees.

学员.zh: 这个课程对学员要求很高。
学员.en: This course has high requirements for the students.

学员.zh: 虽然学员水平不同，但老师都很耐心。
学员.en: Although the trainees' levels differ, the teachers are all very patient.

专注.en: You need to focus a bit more.
He is reading a book with concentration.

专注.zh: 工作的时候要特别专注。
专注.en: You need to be especially focused when working.

专注.zh: 专注是成功的关键之一。
专注.en: Focus is one of the keys to success.

专注.zh: 虽然环境很吵，但他依然非常专注。
专注.en: Although the environment was noisy, he remained very focused.

漏洞.zh: 软件漏洞被黑客利用了，公司损失很大。
漏洞.en: The software vulnerability was exploited by hackers, and the company suffered heavy losses.

漏洞.zh: 虽然设计很完美，但其实还是有很多漏洞。
漏洞.en: Although the design is perfect, it actually still has many loopholes.

漏洞.zh: 检查漏洞是安全工作的重要部分。
漏洞.en: Checking vulnerabilities is an important part of security work.

损坏.zh: 运输途中物品损坏了，我们需要赔偿。
损坏.en: Items were damaged during transportation, and we need to compensate.
This material is not easily damaged.

损坏.zh: 如果你不小心使用，机器很快就会损坏。
损坏.en: If you use it carelessly, the machine will break down quickly.

才华.zh: 她的音乐才华在很小的时候就表现出来了。
才华.en: Her musical talent showed at a very young age.

才华.zh: 虽然他有才华，但做事不够努力。
才华.en: Although he is talented, he doesn't work hard enough.

才华.zh: 他的才华得到了大家的认可。
才华.en: His talent was recognized by everyone.

验证.zh: 这个实验结果还需要进一步验证。
验证.en: This experiment result needs further verification.
The verification code was sent to the phone.

验证.zh: 我们验证了所有数据，然后才做决定。
验证.en: We verified all data before making a decision.
Her statement is hard to verify.

水面.zh: 小船在水面上慢慢漂着。
水面.en: The boat is drifting slowly on the water surface.
The water surface reflects the moon.

水面.zh: 风吹过时，水面泛起层层波纹。
水面.en: When the wind blows, ripples appear on the water surface.

水面.zh: 他游泳时把头露出水面。
水面.en: He lifts his head above the water surface when swimming.
