温和.zh: 她用温和的语气安慰我，让我好受多了。
温和.en: She comforted me in a gentle tone, which made me feel much better.

温和.zh: 虽然他是领导，但态度非常温和，大家都喜欢他。
温和.en: Even though he's the boss, his attitude is very gentle, and everyone likes him.

目录.en: There is a table of contents at the front of the book.

目录.zh: 你看了目录就知道内容了。
目录.en: You can know the content by looking at the table of contents.

目录.zh: 这个网站的产品目录很详细。
目录.en: This website's product catalog is very detailed.

目录.zh: 我把课程目录打印出来方便查看。
目录.en: I printed out the course catalog for easy reference.

目录.zh: 目录里没有你要找的那一章。
目录.en: That chapter you're looking for is not in the table of contents.

耽误.en: Don't waste time; let's go quickly.

耽误.zh: 这场雨耽误了我们的行程。
他因为生病耽误了很多功课。
耽误.en: He missed a lot of schoolwork because of illness.

耽误.zh: 要是堵车，就耽误了航班。
耽误.en: If there's a traffic jam, we'll miss the flight.

耽误.zh: 你路上小心，别耽误了开会。
耽误.en: Be careful on the road and don't be late for the meeting.

景象.en: The spring scenery is really beautiful.

景象.zh: 眼前是一片丰收的景象。
景象.en: Before us is a scene of a bountiful harvest.

景象.zh: 城市夜景的繁华景象令人难忘。
景象.en: The bustling scene of the city night is unforgettable.

景象.zh: 看到孩子们玩耍的景象，他笑了。
景象.en: Seeing the scene of children playing, he smiled.

景象.zh: 地震后的景象让人心里很难受。
景象.en: The scene after the earthquake was heartbreaking.

船长.zh: 因为天气不好，船长决定推迟出发。
船长.en: Because the weather is bad, the captain decided to delay departure.

船长.zh: 船长让我们都穿上救生衣。
船长.en: The captain told us all to wear life jackets.

船长.zh: 老船长经验丰富，大家都听他的。
船长.en: The old captain is experienced, everyone listens to him.

彩虹.en: After the rain, a rainbow appeared.

彩虹.zh: 小朋友指着彩虹高兴地跳了起来。
彩虹.en: The kid pointed at the rainbow and jumped happily.

彩虹.zh: 虽然没看到彩虹，但我们都玩得很开心。
彩虹.en: Although we didn't see a rainbow, we all had fun.

彩虹.zh: 那道彩虹特别漂亮，像一座桥。
彩虹.en: That rainbow was very beautiful, like a bridge.

后退.zh: 听到巨响，他本能地后退了两步。
后退.en: Hearing the loud noise, he instinctively stepped back two steps.

后退.zh: 前面没路了，我们只能后退。
后退.en: There's no road ahead, we can only retreat.

后退.zh: 司机看到障碍物，马上后退。
后退.en: The driver saw the obstacle and immediately backed up.

后退.zh: 要是你后退一点，就能看到全貌。
后退.en: If you step back a bit, you can see the whole picture.

枝.en: He picked up a dead branch on the ground.

枝.zh: 虽然枝上没花，但叶子的颜色很美。
枝.en: Although there are no flowers on the branch, the color of the leaves is beautiful.
The little bird stopped on a branch and sang.

车牌.en: His license plate is Jing A12345.

车牌.zh: 警察看到那辆车车牌不对，就拦了下来。
车牌.en: The police saw that the car's license plate was wrong, so they stopped it.
I can't remember your license plate number.

车牌.zh: 买车后第一件事就是上车牌。
车牌.en: The first thing after buying a car is to get the license plate.

物体.zh: 光线照在透明物体上会折射。
物理课上我们学习了物体的运动。
物体.en: In physics class we learned about the motion of objects.

物体.zh: 桌子上的物体都掉下来了。
物体.en: The objects on the table all fell down.

物体.zh: 这个物体很重，一个人搬不动。
物体.en: This object is very heavy; one person can't carry it.

职员.zh: 公司职员都可以享受年假。
职员.en: Company employees can all enjoy annual leave.

职员.zh: 这次会议所有职员都必须参加。
职员.en: All staff must attend this meeting.

职员.zh: 职员的工资下个月会调整。
职员.en: Employee salaries will be adjusted next month.
The staff have gotten off work.

商标.en: When buying clothes, look for the trademark.

商标.zh: 很多大公司都会保护自己的商标。
商标.en: Many big companies protect their own trademarks.

商标.zh: 那个商标看起来像一朵花。
商标.en: That trademark looks like a flower.
You can't use a trademark casually.

旅途.zh: 旅途虽然辛苦，但风景很美。
旅途.en: Although the journey was tiring, the scenery was beautiful.

旅途.zh: 我们准备了充足的零食，方便在旅途中吃。
旅途.en: We prepared plenty of snacks to eat during the journey.

旅途.zh: 他在旅途中认识了很多朋友。
旅途.en: He made many friends during the journey.

旅途.zh: 因为堵车，旅途花了好几个小时。
旅途.en: Because of the traffic jam, the journey took several hours.

本能.zh: 看到危险，他本能地躲开了。
母鸟保护小鸟是动物的本能。
本能.en: Mother birds protecting their young is animal instinct.

本能.zh: 他本能地伸出手接住了球。
本能.en: He instinctively reached out and caught the ball.

本能.zh: 虽然害怕，但他本能地选择了逃跑。
本能.en: Although scared, he instinctively chose to run away.

塑造.en: Exercise can shape a good figure.

塑造.zh: 父母的教育塑造了我的性格。
塑造.en: My parents' upbringing shaped my personality.

塑造.zh: 这个角色塑造得非常成功，观众都很喜欢。
塑造.en: This character was shaped very successfully, and the audience likes it a lot.

塑造.zh: 环境对人的影响很大，可以塑造一个人的价值观。
塑造.en: The environment has a big influence on people and can shape a person's values.

塑造.zh: 他通过努力塑造了全新的自己。
塑造.en: He shaped a brand new self through hard work.

薪水.en: This month's salary hasn't been paid yet.

薪水.zh: 他的薪水比去年涨了不少。
薪水.en: His salary has increased quite a bit compared to last year.

薪水.zh: 除了薪水，公司还提供福利。
薪水.en: Besides salary, the company also provides benefits.

薪水.zh: 我换工作主要是因为薪水更高。
薪水.en: I changed jobs mainly because the salary is higher.

薪水.zh: 为了更高的薪水，他决定跳槽。
薪水.en: He decided to switch jobs for a higher salary.

衡量.en: You can't measure success only by money.

衡量.zh: 她衡量了一下利弊，决定辞职。
衡量.en: She weighed the pros and cons and decided to resign.

衡量.zh: 这件事需要从多个角度来衡量。
衡量.en: This matter needs to be measured from multiple angles.

衡量.zh: 我们衡量一个员工的标准是能力和态度。
衡量.en: Our criteria for measuring an employee are ability and attitude.

衡量.zh: 他衡量了半天，还是没拿定主意。
衡量.en: He weighed it for a long time but still couldn't make up his mind.

师父.en: My master taught me a lot of principles.

师父.zh: 他拜了一位有名的师父学功夫。
师父.en: He apprenticed under a famous master to learn kung fu.

师父.zh: 师父的教导让我受益终身。
师父.en: My master's teachings benefited me for life.

师父.zh: 我跟着师父学了三年，终于出师了。
师父.en: I studied under my master for three years and finally graduated.

师父.zh: 这位师父的手艺是祖传的。
师父.en: This master's skill is passed down from ancestors.

健全.zh: 这个制度还需要进一步健全。
我们要健全法律体系，保护人民。
健全.en: We need to improve the legal system to protect the people.

健全.zh: 孩子的身心健全最重要。
健全.en: A child's physical and mental health is most important.

健全.zh: 公司正在健全管理制度，提高效率。
健全.en: The company is improving its management system to increase efficiency.

先前.en: I didn't know about this before.

先前.zh: 先前的问题已经解决了。
先前.en: The previous problem has already been solved.

先前.zh: 他先前说过要来，但没来。
先前.en: He previously said he would come, but didn't.

先前.zh: 和先前相比，现在的生活好多了。
先前.en: Compared to before, life is much better now.

先前.zh: 先前我们见过一面，你还记得吗？
先前.en: We met once before, do you still remember?

心爱.zh: 她收藏了很多心爱的书。
他失去了最心爱的宠物狗。
心爱.en: He lost his most beloved pet dog.

心爱.zh: 这封信是我心爱的人写的。
心爱.en: This letter was written by my beloved.

心爱.zh: 她把自己心爱的项链送给了朋友。
心爱.en: She gave her beloved necklace to a friend.

好不容易.en: I finally found you after much difficulty.

好不容易.zh: 他好不容易考上了大学。
好不容易.en: He managed to get into college after a lot of effort.

好不容易.zh: 我们好不容易等到公交车，结果坐错了。
好不容易.en: We waited a long time for the bus, and then ended up taking the wrong one.

好不容易.zh: 她好不容易学会了游泳，很开心。
好不容易.en: She finally learned to swim after much effort, and was very happy.

好不容易.zh: 好不容易攒够了钱，他却改变了主意。
好不容易.en: After finally saving enough money, he changed his mind.

调动.en: He was transferred to a branch office.

调动.zh: 公司准备调动他的职位。
调动.en: The company plans to transfer his position.

调动.zh: 领导调动了所有资源来处理这个问题。
调动.en: The leader mobilized all resources to handle this problem.

调动.zh: 他的工作调动还没批下来。
调动.en: His job transfer hasn't been approved yet.

调动.zh: 这次人事调动影响了很多员工。
调动.en: This personnel transfer affected many employees.

绝大多数.en: The vast majority of people like him.

绝大多数.zh: 绝大多数学生通过了考试。
绝大多数.en: The vast majority of students passed the exam.

绝大多数.zh: 在投票中，绝大多数人支持这个方案。
绝大多数.en: In the vote, the vast majority supported this plan.

绝大多数.zh: 绝大多数情况下，他是对的。
绝大多数.en: In the vast majority of cases, he is right.

绝大多数.zh: 这个城市绝大多数居民都使用公共交通。
绝大多数.en: The vast majority of residents in this city use public transportation.

默默.zh: 他默默坐在角落里看书。
默默.en: He silently sat in the corner reading a book.

默默.zh: 我默默支持你的决定，虽然我不太认同。
默默.en: I silently support your decision, although I don't quite agree.

默默.zh: 小狗默默跟在我后面走了一路。
默默.en: The little dog silently followed me the whole way.

默默.zh: 他默默付出了很多，却从不抱怨。
默默.en: He silently contributed a lot, but never complained.

辅导.zh: 今晚老师要给我辅导数学。
辅导.en: The teacher will tutor me in math tonight.

辅导.zh: 她每周都去辅导班教小朋友英语。
辅导.en: She goes to the tutoring class every week to teach kids English.

辅导.zh: 家长应该多花时间辅导孩子做作业。
辅导.en: Parents should spend more time helping their children with homework.

辅导.zh: 这家机构提供免费的在线辅导服务。
辅导.en: This institution provides free online tutoring services.

辅导.zh: 我请了一个学姐来辅导我的毕业论文。
辅导.en: I invited a senior student to tutor me on my graduation thesis.

未必.zh: 你看到的不一定是真的，事实未必如此。
未必.en: What you see may not be true; the facts may not be so.

未必.zh: 贵的东西未必质量就好。
未必.en: Expensive things are not necessarily good quality.

未必.zh: 他表面上很高兴，心里未必开心。
未必.en: He looks happy on the surface, but may not be happy inside.

未必.zh: 早点出发未必就能准时到达，堵车很难说。
未必.en: Leaving early may not guarantee arriving on time; traffic jams are unpredictable.

建筑物.zh: 城市里有不少古老的建筑物。
建筑物.en: There are many ancient buildings in the city.

建筑物.zh: 那栋建筑物的设计非常独特。
建筑物.en: The design of that building is very unique.

建筑物.zh: 地震后，很多建筑物都倒塌了。
建筑物.en: After the earthquake, many buildings collapsed.

建筑物.zh: 为了保护历史建筑物，政府制定了很多政策。
建筑物.en: To protect historical buildings, the government has made many policies.

采购.zh: 公司派我去采购办公用品。
采购.en: The company sent me to purchase office supplies.

采购.zh: 这次采购的预算有限，要省着花。
采购.en: The budget for this purchase is limited, so we need to spend wisely.

采购.zh: 她负责每年春节的礼品采购。
采购.en: She is in charge of the annual Spring Festival gift procurement.

采购.zh: 采购部门正在寻找新的供应商。
采购.en: The purchasing department is looking for new suppliers.

采购.zh: 因为急需物资，采购过程加快了速度。
采购.en: Due to urgent need for supplies, the procurement process was speeded up.

旅程.zh: 我们计划了一场为期两周的旅程。
旅程虽然辛苦，但风景值得。
旅程.en: Although the journey was tiring, the scenery was worth it.

旅程.zh: 出发前，她详细规划了整段旅程。
旅程.en: Before setting off, she planned the entire trip in detail.

旅程.zh: 在旅程中，我遇到了很多有趣的人。
旅程.en: During the journey, I met many interesting people.

本土.zh: 本土文化受到外来文化的冲击。
本土.en: Local culture is being impacted by foreign cultures.

本土.zh: 这家店只卖本土生产的农产品。
本土.en: This shop only sells locally produced agricultural products.

本土.zh: 很多年轻人更喜欢本土的美食。
本土.en: Many young people prefer local cuisine.

本土.zh: 为了保护本土物种，政府设立了自然保护区。
本土.en: To protect native species, the government established nature reserves.

阻挡.zh: 大树倒下来阻挡了道路。
阻挡.en: The fallen tree blocked the road.

阻挡.zh: 谁也阻挡不了我们追求梦想的决心。
阻挡.en: No one can stop our determination to pursue our dreams.

阻挡.zh: 他用身体阻挡了敌人的进攻。
阻挡.en: He used his body to block the enemy's attack.

阻挡.zh: 这面墙太高，完全阻挡了阳光。
阻挡.en: This wall is too high, completely blocking the sunlight.

恰当.en: This word is used very appropriately.

恰当.zh: 现在不是做决定的恰当时候。
恰当.en: Now is not the right time to make a decision.

恰当.zh: 你需要找一个恰当的时机跟她谈谈。
恰当.en: You need to find an appropriate time to talk to her.

恰当.zh: 她的穿衣打扮非常恰当，既正式又不失优雅。
恰当.en: Her dress and style are very appropriate, both formal and elegant.

恰当.zh: 在面试中，回答要简洁恰当，不要跑题。
恰当.en: In an interview, answers should be concise and appropriate, not off topic.

疑惑.en: I have many doubts in my mind.

疑惑.zh: 他对这个结果表示疑惑。
疑惑.en: He expressed doubt about this result.

疑惑.zh: 老师解答了大家的疑惑。
她疑惑地看着我，不知道我在说什么。
疑惑.en: She looked at me doubtfully, not knowing what I was talking about.

疑惑.zh: 尽管听了他的解释，我心中的疑惑依然没有消除。
疑惑.en: Even after hearing his explanation, my doubts still haven't been resolved.

监测.zh: 他们在水库装了监测设备。
监测.en: They installed monitoring equipment at the reservoir.

监测.zh: 空气质量需要持续监测才能保证安全。
监测.en: Air quality needs continuous monitoring to ensure safety.

监测.zh: 医生让我每天监测血压，然后记录下来。
监测.en: The doctor told me to monitor my blood pressure every day and record it.

监测.zh: 虽然装了摄像头，但没人实时监测画面。
监测.en: Although cameras were installed, no one monitors the footage in real time.

监测.zh: 地震局用卫星来监测地壳的微小变化。
监测.en: The earthquake agency uses satellites to monitor tiny changes in the Earth's crust.

称号.zh: 他获得了最佳员工的称号。
称号.en: He received the title of best employee.

称号.zh: 这个城市有‘花园城市’的称号。
称号.en: This city has the title of 'Garden City'.

称号.zh: 她一直想拿冠军，但那个称号很难得到。
称号.en: She always wanted to win the championship, but that title is hard to obtain.

称号.zh: 因为他很乐于助人，大家给了他一个‘活雷锋’的称号。
称号.en: Because he is very helpful, everyone gave him the title of 'Living Lei Feng'.

称号.zh: 虽然他有博士称号，但实际能力并不强。
称号.en: Although he has a doctorate title, his actual ability is not strong.

叉.zh: 吃饭时要用叉子和刀子。
叉.en: Use a fork and knife when eating.

叉.zh: 这条路前面有个三叉路口。
叉.en: There is a three-way intersection ahead on this road.

叉.zh: 他拿叉子叉了一块牛排。
叉.en: He used a fork to spear a piece of steak.

叉.zh: 小心别让叉子刮到手上的皮肤。
叉.en: Be careful not to scratch the skin on your hand with the fork.

叉.zh: 作业里打叉的题目都需要重新做一遍。
叉.en: The questions marked with a cross in the homework all need to be redone.

追究.zh: 这次事故一定要追究责任。
追究.en: We must hold someone accountable for this accident.

追究.zh: 如果犯错，公司会追究到底。
追究.en: If you make a mistake, the company will investigate thoroughly.

追究.zh: 他不想再追究过去的事情了。
追究.en: He doesn't want to look into past matters anymore.

追究.zh: 虽然道歉了，但领导还是要追究他的失误。
追究.en: Although he apologized, the boss still wanted to hold him accountable for his mistake.

追究.zh: 警察正在追究盗窃案的线索，希望能尽快破案。
追究.en: The police are investigating leads on the theft case, hoping to solve it soon.

马车.en: Grandpa rode in a horse-drawn carriage when he was young.

马车.zh: 这条街上还有古老的马车在拉客。
马车.en: There are still old horse-drawn carriages picking up passengers on this street.

马车.zh: 以前没有汽车，人们出门都靠马车。
马车.en: Before there were cars, people relied on horse-drawn carriages to go out.

马车.zh: 他在景区租了一辆马车，带着孩子转了一圈。
马车.en: He rented a horse-drawn carriage in the scenic area and took the kids for a ride.

马车.zh: 虽然马车很慢，但游客特别喜欢这种体验。
马车.en: Although the horse-drawn carriage is slow, tourists really enjoy this experience.

拖延.en: Don't procrastinate, do your homework now.

拖延.zh: 他总是拖延到最后一天才交报告。
拖延.en: He always delays until the last day to submit the report.

拖延.zh: 因为拖延症，我错过了报名截止日期。
拖延.en: Because of procrastination, I missed the registration deadline.

拖延.zh: 她本来可以按时完成，但拖延让事情变糟了。
拖延.en: She could have finished on time, but delay made things worse.

拖延.zh: 经理批评了团队的拖延行为，要求立即改进。
拖延.en: The manager criticized the team's delaying behavior and demanded immediate improvement.

文物.zh: 博物馆里有很多珍贵的文物。
文物.en: There are many precious cultural relics in the museum.

文物.zh: 这些文物是从古墓里挖出来的。
文物.en: These artifacts were excavated from ancient tombs.

文物.zh: 保护文物是每个人的责任。
文物.en: Protecting cultural relics is everyone's responsibility.

文物.zh: 这个花瓶是明代文物，价值连城。
文物.en: This vase is a Ming Dynasty relic, worth a fortune.

文物.zh: 虽然文物看起来很旧，但它的历史价值非常高。
文物.en: Although the artifact looks old, its historical value is very high.

个体.en: He is a self-employed person (individual operator).

个体.zh: 每个个体都有自己的想法。
个体.en: Every individual has their own ideas.

个体.zh: 社会是由无数个体组成的。
个体.en: Society is made up of countless individuals.

个体.zh: 虽然是个体小摊，但生意很红火。
个体.en: Although it's an individual small stall, business is booming.

个体.zh: 我们尊重每一个个体的选择和自由。
个体.en: We respect every individual's choices and freedom.

墙壁.en: There is a painting hanging on the wall.

墙壁.zh: 这栋房子的墙壁很厚，隔音效果很好。
墙壁.en: The walls of this house are very thick, so the soundproofing is good.

墙壁.zh: 小孩在墙壁上乱涂乱画，被妈妈骂了。
墙壁.en: The child scribbled on the wall and got scolded by his mother.

墙壁.zh: 我们需要重新粉刷一下卧室的墙壁。
墙壁.en: We need to repaint the bedroom walls.

墙壁.zh: 因为潮湿，墙壁上长了一些霉菌。
墙壁.en: Because of the dampness, some mold has grown on the walls.

开关.zh: 这个开关控制客厅的吊灯。
开关.en: This switch controls the chandelier in the living room.

开关.zh: 他按下开关，机器立刻启动了。
开关.en: He pressed the switch, and the machine started immediately.

开关.zh: 我家走廊的开关是双控的，两边都能开关灯。
开关.en: The switch in my hallway is two-way, so you can turn the light on or off from both sides.

开关.zh: 空调的开关坏了，得找人修一下。
开关.en: The air conditioner's switch is broken; need to get someone to fix it.

昂贵.zh: 虽然价格昂贵，但质量确实很好。
昂贵.en: Although the price is expensive, the quality is really good.

昂贵.zh: 他送了我一件昂贵的礼物。
昂贵.en: He gave me an expensive gift.

昂贵.zh: 因为太昂贵了，所以我没买。
昂贵.en: Because it was too expensive, I didn't buy it.

昂贵.zh: 这家餐厅的菜特别昂贵，但味道一般。
昂贵.en: The dishes at this restaurant are especially expensive, but the taste is average.

仍旧.zh: 虽然下雨了，她仍旧坚持跑步。
仍旧.en: Although it rained, she still insisted on running.

仍旧.zh: 十年过去了，这座城市仍旧那么美。
仍旧.en: Ten years have passed, this city is still so beautiful.

仍旧.zh: 我劝了他很多次，他仍旧不听。
仍旧.en: I advised him many times, he still doesn't listen.

仍旧.zh: 即使失败了，他仍旧没有放弃努力。
仍旧.en: Even though he failed, he still didn't give up trying.

圆满.zh: 这次会议圆满结束，大家都满意。
圆满.en: This meeting ended successfully, everyone was satisfied.

圆满.zh: 祝愿你们的婚姻圆满幸福。
圆满.en: Wish your marriage perfect and happy.

圆满.zh: 虽然过程有点曲折，但结果很圆满。
圆满.en: Although the process was a bit twisty, the result was perfect.

圆满.zh: 经过大家的努力，项目圆满完成了。
圆满.en: With everyone's efforts, the project was completed successfully.

古典.zh: 这座建筑是古典风格，非常漂亮。
古典.en: This building is classical style, very beautiful.

古典.zh: 她穿着古典的旗袍去参加晚会。
古典.en: She wore a classical cheongsam to the party.

古典.zh: 我不太懂古典文学，但觉得很有趣。
古典.en: I don't really understand classical literature, but I find it interesting.

古典.zh: 古典舞和现代舞有很大的区别。
古典.en: Classical dance and modern dance have big differences.

大方.zh: 他送礼物很大方，从不小气。
大方.en: He gives gifts very generously, never stingy.

大方.zh: 这个女孩举止大方，很受欢迎。
大方.en: This girl has poised manners, very popular.

大方.zh: 虽然她很有钱，但花钱不大方。
大方.en: Although she is rich, she doesn't spend generously.

大方.zh: 我建议你穿得大方一点去面试。
大方.en: I suggest you dress a bit more appropriately for the interview.

启发.zh: 老师的讲话启发了我很多想法。
启发.en: The teacher's speech inspired many ideas in me.

启发.zh: 这个实验启发我们思考新方法。
启发.en: This experiment inspired us to think of new methods.

启发.zh: 通过这次交流，我受到了很大的启发。
启发.en: Through this exchange, I received great inspiration.

启发.zh: 他的故事启发了很多年轻人追求梦想。
启发.en: His story inspired many young people to pursue dreams.

不通.zh: 你的解释根本不通，我不接受。
不通.en: Your explanation doesn't make sense at all, I don't accept it.

不通.zh: 这条路不通，我们换一条吧。
不通.en: This road is blocked, let's take another.

不通.zh: 他写文章总是逻辑不通，让人看不懂。
不通.en: He always writes articles with illogical logic, making them hard to understand.

不通.zh: 因为水管不通，厨房里全是水。
不通.en: Because the water pipe is blocked, the kitchen is full of water.

壶.en: There's no water in the pot.

壶.zh: 请把那个茶壶递给我，谢谢。
壶.en: Please pass me that teapot, thanks.

壶.zh: 这把壶是陶瓷做的，很漂亮。
壶.en: This pot is made of ceramic, very beautiful.

壶.zh: 他烧了一壶水，准备泡茶。
壶.en: He boiled a pot of water, ready to make tea.

壶.zh: 我不小心打碎了一个新买的壶。
壶.en: I accidentally broke a newly bought pot.

步骤.zh: 按照这些步骤操作，就不会出错。
步骤.en: Follow these steps to operate, and you won't make mistakes.

步骤.zh: 做这道菜需要五个步骤。
步骤.en: Making this dish requires five steps.

步骤.zh: 首先你要准备好材料，然后按步骤来做。
步骤.en: First you need to prepare the ingredients, then follow the steps.

步骤.zh: 安装这个软件之前，请先阅读步骤说明。
步骤.en: Before installing this software, please read the step instructions.

订单.en: The order has been sent out.

订单.zh: 我今天收到了三个新订单。
订单.en: I received three new orders today.

订单.zh: 请确认一下你的订单信息。
因为库存不足，这个订单需要延期发货。
订单.en: Because of insufficient stock, this order needs to be delayed.

订单.zh: 他取消了一个订单，因为等太久了。
订单.en: He cancelled an order because he waited too long.

远程.zh: 远程办公越来越流行了。
远程.en: Remote work is getting more popular.

远程.zh: 我们通过远程会议解决了这个问题。
远程.en: We solved this problem through a remote meeting.

远程.zh: 现在很多学校都提供远程教育课程。
远程.en: Now many schools offer remote education courses.

远程.zh: 因为疫情，我们不得不改成远程工作。
远程.en: Because of the pandemic, we had to switch to remote work.

远程.zh: 远程控制无人机需要稳定的信号。
远程.en: Remote control of drones requires a stable signal.

选拔.zh: 公司明天进行选拔考试。
选拔.en: The company is holding a selection exam tomorrow.

选拔.zh: 这次选拔很严格，只有三个人通过了。
选拔.en: This selection is very strict, only three people passed.

选拔.zh: 教练要从这些队员中选拔出主力选手。
选拔.en: The coach will select the main players from these team members.

选拔.zh: 如果你想去参加选拔，就得提前准备。
选拔.en: If you want to participate in the selection, you need to prepare in advance.

选拔.zh: 这次选拔不仅看成绩，还看综合素质。
选拔.en: This selection considers not only grades but also overall quality.

人事.en: The HR department is recruiting new employees.

人事.zh: 他最近在处理一些人事变动。
人事.en: He is handling some personnel changes recently.

人事.zh: 公司的人事制度需要改革一下。
人事.en: The company's personnel system needs some reform.

人事.zh: 你要去人事部办离职手续吗？
人事.en: Are you going to HR to handle the resignation procedures?

人事.zh: 因为人事调整，我的部门换了主管。
人事.en: Because of personnel adjustments, my department got a new supervisor.

当今.zh: 当今很多人都离不开手机。
当今.en: Nowadays many people can't live without their phones.

当今.zh: 他是一位当今很有影响力的作家。
当今.en: He is a very influential writer of today.

当今.zh: 当今的年轻人更注重生活质量。
当今.en: Young people nowadays pay more attention to quality of life.

当今.zh: 如果你想成功，就要了解当今的潮流。
当今.en: If you want to succeed, you need to understand current trends.

可行.zh: 我觉得你说的方案很可行。
可行.en: I think the plan you mentioned is very feasible.

可行.zh: 我们需要找一个可行的解决办法。
可行.en: We need to find a feasible solution.

可行.zh: 理论上可行，但实际操作有难度。
如果这个方案可行，我们就立刻执行。
可行.en: If this plan is feasible, we will implement it immediately.

要不然.zh: 快点走，要不然来不及了。
要不然.en: Hurry up, otherwise we'll be late.

要不然.zh: 你得好好复习，要不然考试会不及格。
要不然.en: You need to study well, otherwise you'll fail the exam.

要不然.zh: 要不然我们先吃饭，再讨论这个问题？
要不然.en: Or else, let's eat first, then discuss this issue?

要不然.zh: 他肯定有事，要不然不会不接电话。
要不然.en: He must have something, otherwise he wouldn't ignore the phone.

要不然.zh: 要不然你就别去了，在家休息吧。
要不然.en: Or else, just don't go and rest at home.

恰好.zh: 你来得恰好，我正要找你。
恰好.en: You came just in time, I was about to look for you.

恰好.zh: 这件衣服大小恰好合适。
我恰好路过那家店，就买了一杯咖啡。
恰好.en: I happened to pass by that shop, so I bought a cup of coffee.

恰好.zh: 我们恰好有相同的爱好，所以成了好朋友。
恰好.en: We happen to have the same hobbies, so we became good friends.

恰好.zh: 他恰好在我需要帮助的时候出现了。
恰好.en: He appeared just when I needed help.

进化.zh: 人类是从猿类进化来的。
生物进化是一个漫长的过程。
进化.en: Biological evolution is a long process.

进化.zh: 随着环境的变化，动物也在进化。
进化.en: As the environment changes, animals also evolve.

进化.zh: 手机的设计一直在进化，越来越轻薄。
进化.en: The design of phones has been evolving, becoming thinner and lighter.

便是.zh: 你所说的那个人便是他。
便是.en: The person you mentioned is him.

便是.zh: 只要你努力，成功便是你的。
便是.en: As long as you work hard, success will be yours.

便是.zh: 这便是我们一直寻找的答案。
便是.en: This is the answer we have been looking for.

便是.zh: 人生最大的幸福便是健康。
便是.en: The greatest happiness in life is health.

出示.en: Entering requires showing a health code.
The police asked him to show his driver's license.

出示.zh: 如果你没带门票，可以出示电子票。
出示.en: If you don't have a paper ticket, you can show an electronic ticket.

出示.zh: 在机场安检时，必须出示登机牌。
出示.en: During airport security, you must show your boarding pass.

洪水.en: The flood submerged the village yesterday.

洪水.zh: 因为洪水，我们不得不搬走。
洪水.en: Because of the flood, we had to move away.

洪水.zh: 这场洪水来得太突然了。
洪水过后，大家都在清理淤泥。
洪水.en: After the flood, everyone is cleaning up the mud.

洪水.zh: 听说洪水已经退了不少。
洪水.en: I heard the flood has receded quite a bit.

风光.en: The scenery here is really beautiful.

风光.zh: 沿途的风光让人心情愉快。
风光.en: The scenery along the way makes people feel happy.

风光.zh: 虽然城市繁华，但我更喜欢乡村的风光。
风光.en: Although the city is bustling, I prefer the rural scenery.

风光.zh: 这次旅行看到了很多好风光。
风光.en: This trip I saw a lot of beautiful scenery.

风光.zh: 山顶上的风光特别壮观。
风光.en: The scenery at the mountaintop is particularly spectacular.

为难.en: This matter puts me in a difficult position.

为难.zh: 你别为难他了，他已经尽力了。
为难.en: Don't make things difficult for him; he has tried his best.

为难.zh: 他提出的要求让我左右为难。
为难.en: His request put me in a dilemma.

为难.zh: 如果觉得为难，就直接拒绝吧。
为难.en: If you feel it's difficult, just refuse directly.

为难.zh: 夹在两个朋友中间真为难。
为难.en: Being caught between two friends is really awkward.

改编.en: This movie is adapted from a novel.

改编.zh: 他们把剧本改编成了电视剧。
改编.en: They adapted the script into a TV series.

改编.zh: 老师让我们把故事改编成话剧。
改编.en: The teacher asked us to adapt the story into a play.

改编.zh: 这个游戏改编得很成功。
改编.en: This game adaptation was very successful.

改编.zh: 原著的改编版本不太受欢迎。
改编.en: The adapted version of the original work is not very popular.

吸取.en: We need to learn from the lesson.

吸取.zh: 从失败中吸取经验很重要。
吸取.en: It's important to gain experience from failure.

吸取.zh: 他吸取了上次的教训，这次做得很小心。
吸取.en: He learned from last time and did it very carefully this time.

吸取.zh: 多读书能吸取很多知识。
吸取.en: Reading more can absorb a lot of knowledge.

吸取.zh: 科学家从大自然中吸取灵感。

心愿.en: My wish is to travel around the world.

心愿.zh: 生日那天，她许了一个心愿。
心愿.en: On her birthday, she made a wish.

心愿.zh: 希望我们的心愿都能实现。
心愿.en: I hope all our wishes can come true.

心愿.zh: 他最大的心愿就是家人健康。
心愿.en: His biggest wish is for his family to be healthy.

心愿.zh: 虽然困难，但我从未放弃心愿。
心愿.en: Although it's difficult, I have never given up on my wish.

股市.en: The stock market has fallen sharply recently.

股市.zh: 他投资股市赚了不少钱。
股市.en: He made a lot of money investing in the stock market.
The stock market is very risky, so be cautious.

股市.zh: 因为经济不好，股市一直低迷。
股市.en: Because the economy is bad, the stock market has been sluggish.

股市.zh: 很多人在股市里赔了钱。
股市.en: Many people lost money in the stock market.

至关重要.zh: 健康对每个人来说都至关重要。
这个决定对我们的未来至关重要。
至关重要.en: This decision is crucial for our future.

至关重要.zh: 细节在谈判中至关重要。
因为他的一句话，整个计划都变了，那一步至关重要。
至关重要.en: Because of his one sentence, the whole plan changed, and that step was crucial.

充实.zh: 假期里我读了很多书，感觉很充实。
充实.en: During the holiday I read a lot of books and felt very fulfilled.
Although work is busy, it's very fulfilling.

充实.zh: 多参加活动能让生活更充实。
充实.en: Participating in more activities can make life more fulfilling.

充实.zh: 退休后他找到了新的爱好，日子变得充实起来。
充实.en: After retirement he found new hobbies, and his days became fulfilling.

识.en: He doesn't know what's good for him at all.
One should know when to yield.
I know the way, don't worry.

识.zh: 这个人很识趣，没再追问。
识.en: This person is sensible and didn't ask further.

往后.zh: 往后我们要多注意安全。
往后.en: From now on, we need to pay more attention to safety.

往后.zh: 往后的日子会越来越好的。
往后.en: Life will get better and better from now on.

往后.zh: 你往后做事要仔细一点，别再出差错了。
往后.en: From now on, be more careful when you do things, and don't make mistakes again.

往后.zh: 他说往后不会再犯同样的错误了。
往后.en: He said he won't make the same mistake again from now on.

往后.zh: 虽然现在很辛苦，但往后一定会好起来的。
往后.en: Although it's tough now, things will definitely get better from now on.

处处.en: He always thinks of others in every way.

处处.zh: 春天来了，处处鸟语花香。
处处.en: Spring is here, and everywhere is full of birdsong and flowers.

处处.zh: 这个城市处处都能看到历史痕迹。
处处.en: In this city, you can see traces of history everywhere.

处处.zh: 他处处跟人作对，结果朋友越来越少。
处处.en: He goes against people everywhere, and as a result, he has fewer and fewer friends.

不至于.zh: 这点小事，不至于生气吧。
不至于.en: It's just a small thing, not worth getting angry over.

不至于.zh: 他再笨也不至于连这个都不会。
不至于.en: Even if he's stupid, he wouldn't be so dumb as to not know this.

不至于.zh: 虽然吵架了，但也不至于分手吧。
不至于.en: Even though we had an argument, it's not to the point of breaking up.

不至于.zh: 你放心，事情还不至于那么糟糕。
不至于.en: Don't worry, things aren't that bad yet.

不至于.zh: 他就算再忙，也不至于不接电话。
不至于.en: Even if he's very busy, he wouldn't be so busy as to not answer the phone.

同类.en: Cats and tigers are of the same kind.

同类.zh: 我不喜欢和这种同类的人打交道。
同类.en: I don't like dealing with people of this kind.

同类.zh: 这两款手机属于同类产品。
同类.en: These two models of phones are the same type of product.

同类.zh: 同类事情发生过很多次了。
同类.en: This kind of thing has happened many times.

同类.zh: 虽然他们是同类，但性格完全不同。
同类.en: Although they are the same kind, their personalities are completely different.

醋.en: I like to eat vinegar (or: I get jealous easily).
Adding a little vinegar when cooking makes it taste better.
He always dips his dumplings in vinegar.

醋.zh: 她看到男朋友和别人聊天，心里有点吃醋。
醋.en: She felt a little jealous when she saw her boyfriend chatting with someone else.

身心.en: You need to pay attention to your physical and mental health.

身心.zh: 工作太累，身心都很疲惫。
身心.en: Work is too tiring; both body and mind are exhausted.
Exercise can relax both body and mind.

身心.zh: 假期好好休息，调整一下身心。
身心.en: Take a good rest during the holiday to adjust your body and mind.

身心.zh: 长期压力对身心都有害处。
身心.en: Long-term stress is harmful to both body and mind.

干燥.en: Skin tends to get dry in winter.
The air in the north is relatively dry.

干燥.zh: 洗完脸记得涂面霜，防止干燥。
干燥.en: Remember to apply face cream after washing your face to prevent dryness.

干燥.zh: 这个季节风大，嘴唇很容易干燥。
干燥.en: It's windy this season, so lips get dry easily.

不禁.en: Seeing this, I couldn't help but laugh.

不禁.zh: 听到这个消息，他不禁流下眼泪。
不禁.en: Hearing this news, he couldn't help but shed tears.

不禁.zh: 想到过去，我不禁感慨万千。
不禁.en: Thinking of the past, I couldn't help but feel a flood of emotions.

不禁.zh: 故事太感人，观众不禁鼓掌。
不禁.en: The story was so touching that the audience couldn't help but applaud.

不禁.zh: 看到老朋友，我不禁想起了大学时光。
不禁.en: Seeing an old friend, I couldn't help but think of our college days.

嗓子.en: He has a good voice and sings well.

嗓子.zh: 今天说话太多，嗓子都哑了。
嗓子.en: I talked too much today, and my voice is hoarse.
Drinking more water is good for your throat.

嗓子.zh: 他清了清嗓子，开始演讲。
嗓子.en: He cleared his throat and began his speech.

使劲.zh: 他使劲跑，终于赶上了公交车。
使劲.en: He ran hard and finally caught the bus.
Don't rush; using force won't help.
If you pull hard, the rope will break.

使劲.zh: 虽然很累，但他还是使劲完成了任务。
使劲.en: Although very tired, he still managed to complete the task with effort.

支出.en: This month's expenses are too much.

支出.zh: 因为收入不高，所以我们要控制支出。
支出.en: Because income is not high, we need to control spending.
Keep track of your daily expenses.

支出.zh: 除了房租，还有好多其他支出。
支出.en: Besides rent, there are many other expenses.

支出.zh: 虽然支出很大，但我觉得值得。
支出.en: Although the expense is large, I think it's worth it.

中奖.zh: 他买彩票中奖了，特别开心。
中奖.en: He won a prize in the lottery and was very happy.

中奖.zh: 要是中奖了，我就去环游世界。
中奖.en: If I win the lottery, I'll travel around the world.

中奖.zh: 昨天我朋友中奖了，请我们吃饭。
中奖.en: Yesterday my friend won a prize and treated us to dinner.

中奖.zh: 虽然中奖概率很低，但还是有人会中。
中奖.en: Although the chance of winning is low, some people still win.

诗歌.zh: 他写了一首关于春天的诗歌。
诗歌.en: He wrote a poem about spring.

诗歌.zh: 虽然我不懂诗歌，但我觉得很美。
诗歌.en: Although I don't understand poetry, I think it's beautiful.

诗歌.zh: 老师在课堂教我们现代诗歌。
诗歌.en: The teacher taught us modern poetry in class.

诗歌.zh: 除了小说，她还喜欢朗诵诗歌。
诗歌.en: Besides novels, she also likes reciting poetry.

征求.zh: 公司正在征求员工的建议。
征求.en: The company is seeking employees' suggestions.

征求.zh: 为了改进服务，我们征求顾客反馈。
征求.en: In order to improve service, we seek customer feedback.

征求.zh: 他征求了我的同意才进去。
征求.en: He asked for my consent before entering.

征求.zh: 如果你有疑问，可以征求导师的意见。
征求.en: If you have questions, you can seek your advisor's opinion.

全程.en: I will accompany you throughout the whole process.

全程.zh: 这次旅行全程大概十个小时。
全程.en: This trip takes about ten hours in total.

全程.zh: 虽然很累，但他坚持跑完全程。
全程.en: Although very tired, he insisted on running the whole distance.

全程.zh: 我们全程录了像，留作纪念。
全程.en: We recorded the entire process as a souvenir.

全程.zh: 除了开幕式，他还参加了全程会议。
全程.en: Besides the opening ceremony, he also attended the entire meeting.

认知.zh: 对这件事的认知每个人都不一样。
认知.en: Everyone's perception of this matter is different.

认知.zh: 随着经验增长，你的认知会提高。
认知.en: As experience grows, your cognition will improve.

认知.zh: 孩子的认知能力在慢慢发展。
除了学习，我们也要提升社会认知。
认知.en: Besides studying, we also need to improve social awareness.

周期.zh: 植物的生长周期和季节有关。
周期.en: The growth cycle of plants is related to seasons.

周期.zh: 因为周期短，所以产品更新很快。
周期.en: Because the cycle is short, product updates are fast.

周期.zh: 每个周期结束时我们都要总结。
周期.en: At the end of each cycle, we need to summarize.

周期.zh: 除了经济周期，还有生命周期。
周期.en: Besides economic cycles, there are also life cycles.

坡.en: This slope is a bit steep.
Cycling uphill takes a lot of effort.

坡.zh: 虽然坡很滑，但他还是上去了。
坡.en: Although the slope was slippery, he still went up.

坡.zh: 村子后面有一个小山坡。
坡.en: There is a small hill behind the village.

坡.zh: 除了上坡，下坡也要注意安全。
坡.en: Besides uphill, downhill also requires safety.

氛围.en: The atmosphere here is very good.

氛围.zh: 节日期间，街上充满了欢乐的氛围。
氛围.en: During the festival, the streets are filled with a joyful atmosphere.

氛围.zh: 因为灯光很暗，所以营造了浪漫氛围。
氛围.en: Because the lights were dim, it created a romantic atmosphere.
The company's atmosphere is very relaxed.

氛围.zh: 除了安静，图书馆的氛围还很专注。
氛围.en: Besides quietness, the library's atmosphere is also focused.

求婚.zh: 他在餐厅里当众求婚，很浪漫。
求婚.en: He proposed publicly in the restaurant, very romantic.

求婚.zh: 如果她答应求婚，我们就结婚。
求婚.en: If she accepts the proposal, we will get married.
The engagement ring is expensive but worth it.

求婚.zh: 除了鲜花，他还准备了惊喜求婚。
求婚.en: Besides flowers, he also prepared a surprise proposal.

面对面.zh: 虽然我们每天都发微信，但面对面聊天感觉更好。
面对面.en: Although we text every day, talking face to face feels better.

面对面.zh: 开会时，领导要求我们面对面交流。
面对面.en: During the meeting, the boss asked us to communicate face to face.

面对面.zh: 他们面对面站了很久，一句话也没说。
面对面.en: They stood face to face for a long time without saying a word.

面对面.zh: 我喜欢面对面谈事情，这样效率更高。
面对面.en: I like to discuss matters face to face because it's more efficient.

信赖.zh: 因为每次他都能做到，所以大家都信赖他。
信赖.en: Because he always delivers, everyone trusts him.

信赖.zh: 我们公司最信赖的就是这位工程师。
信赖.en: Our company trusts this engineer the most.

信赖.zh: 如果你不首先付出信赖，别人也不会信赖你。
信赖.en: If you don't give trust first, others won't trust you either.

信赖.zh: 经过多年合作，我们之间建立了深厚的信赖关系。
信赖.en: After years of cooperation, we have built a deep relationship of trust.

口号.zh: 他们喊的口号是“团结就是力量”。
口号.en: The slogan they shout is 'Unity is strength'.

口号.zh: 公司门口挂着一个大大的红色口号。
口号.en: A big red slogan is hung at the company entrance.

口号.zh: 虽然口号喊得响，但实际行动更重要。
口号.en: Although the slogan is loud, actual action is more important.

口号.zh: 学生们举着牌子，上面写着各种环保口号。
口号.en: The students held signs with various environmental slogans written on them.

拆除.en: They are dismantling the old wall.

拆除.zh: 因为房子太危险了，所以必须拆除。
拆除.en: Because the house is too dangerous, it must be demolished.

拆除.zh: 工人们用大锤慢慢拆除那栋废弃的建筑。
拆除.en: The workers are slowly demolishing that abandoned building with sledgehammers.

拆除.zh: 政府决定拆除所有违规搭建的广告牌。
拆除.en: The government decided to remove all illegally built billboards.

拆除.zh: 虽然大家都不同意，但还是把那个旧亭子拆除了。
拆除.en: Although everyone disagreed, the old pavilion was still demolished.

蜜蜂.zh: 花园里有很多蜜蜂飞来飞去。
蜜蜂.en: There are many bees flying around in the garden.

蜜蜂.zh: 蜜蜂虽然小，但对生态系统非常重要。
蜜蜂.en: Although bees are small, they are very important to the ecosystem.

蜜蜂.zh: 他害怕蜜蜂，所以从来不靠近花丛。
蜜蜂.en: He is afraid of bees, so he never goes near the flowers.

蜜蜂.zh: 这些蜜蜂非常勤劳，每天从早忙到晚。
蜜蜂.en: These bees are very hardworking, busy from morning till night every day.

品尝.zh: 这个红酒需要慢慢品尝。
品尝.en: This red wine needs to be savored slowly.

品尝.zh: 厨师请客人品尝他新做的甜点。
品尝.en: The chef invited the guests to taste his new dessert.

品尝.zh: 我品尝了很多种奶酪，最喜欢的是这种。
品尝.en: I tasted many kinds of cheese, and my favorite is this one.

品尝.zh: 虽然看起来一般，但品尝之后发现味道很棒。
品尝.en: Although it looks ordinary, after tasting it, I found the flavor was great.

一模一样.en: These two pieces of clothing are exactly the same.

一模一样.zh: 他们俩长得一模一样，原来是双胞胎。
一模一样.en: They look exactly the same; it turns out they are twins.

一模一样.zh: 这个包和我在店里看到的那个一模一样。
一模一样.en: This bag is exactly the same as the one I saw in the store.

一模一样.zh: 虽然品牌不同，但这两款手机的功能几乎一模一样。
一模一样.en: Although the brands are different, the functions of these two phones are almost exactly the same.

一模一样.zh: 他复制的画跟原作一模一样，连颜色都没差。
一模一样.en: The painting he copied is exactly the same as the original, with no difference even in color.

残疾人.zh: 我们要尊重残疾人的权利。
残疾人.en: We must respect the rights of disabled people.

残疾人.zh: 这个商场有专门为残疾人设计的通道。
残疾人.en: This mall has a passage specially designed for disabled people.

残疾人.zh: 虽然他是残疾人，但他活得很精彩。
残疾人.en: Although he is disabled, he lives a wonderful life.

残疾人.zh: 社区为残疾人提供了很多免费的康复服务。
残疾人.en: The community provides many free rehabilitation services for disabled people.

煤.en: Do we still use coal now?

煤.zh: 北方很多家庭冬天烧煤取暖。
煤.en: Many families in the north burn coal for heating in winter.

煤.zh: 煤矿工人每天的工作非常辛苦。
煤.en: Coal miners have very hard work every day.

煤.zh: 因为烧煤污染太大，所以很多地方改用天然气了。
煤.en: Because burning coal causes too much pollution, many places have switched to natural gas.

煤.zh: 古代人早就开始用煤来做饭和取暖了。
煤.en: Ancient people had already started using coal for cooking and heating long ago.

收取.zh: 这个停车场每小时收取十块钱。
收取.en: This parking lot charges ten yuan per hour.

收取.zh: 公司每月收取固定的服务费。
收取.en: The company charges a fixed service fee every month.

收取.zh: 虽然服务很好，但他们收取的费用也太高了。
收取.en: Although the service is good, the fees they charge are too high.

收取.zh: 请在入口处扫码支付，我们不另外收取手续费。
收取.en: Please scan to pay at the entrance; we do not charge an additional handling fee.

强化.en: We need to strengthen safety awareness.

强化.zh: 通过每天练习，他强化了自己的口语能力。
强化.en: Through daily practice, he strengthened his oral skills.

强化.zh: 公司打算强化员工培训制度。
强化.en: The company plans to strengthen the employee training system.

强化.zh: 虽然基础不错，但还是需要强化训练。
强化.en: Although the foundation is good, intensive training is still needed.

强化.zh: 为了应对挑战，我们必须强化团队合作。
强化.en: To meet challenges, we must strengthen teamwork.

借助.en: Using a map to find the way.

借助.zh: 他借助朋友的帮助完成了项目。
借助.en: He completed the project with the help of friends.

借助.zh: 如果借助科技，工作效率会更高。
借助.en: If using technology, work efficiency will be higher.

借助.zh: 我们可以借助网络学习新知识。
借助.en: We can learn new knowledge via the internet.

借助.zh: 借助这次机会，他展示了自己的能力。
借助.en: Taking advantage of this opportunity, he showed his ability.

形态.zh: 不同形态的云预示着不同的天气。
形态.en: Different forms of clouds indicate different weather.

形态.zh: 虽然形态各异，但这些昆虫属于同一类。
形态.en: Although shapes differ, these insects belong to the same category.

形态.zh: 这种植物的形态会随季节改变。
形态.en: This plant's form changes with the seasons.

形态.zh: 社会形态在不断发展变化。

夺取.zh: 敌军试图夺取这座重要的城市。
夺取.en: The enemy tried to capture this important city.

夺取.zh: 在比赛中，他们成功夺取了第一名。
夺取.en: In the competition, they successfully took first place.

夺取.zh: 千万不要夺取别人的劳动成果。
夺取.en: Never seize the fruits of others' labor.

不曾.zh: 他从来不曾放弃过梦想。
不曾.en: He has never given up his dream.

不曾.zh: 虽然困难重重，他不曾退缩。
不曾.en: Despite many difficulties, he never backed down.

不曾.zh: 我们不曾预料到会发生这种事。
不曾.en: We never expected this to happen.

不曾.zh: 她不曾说过一句抱怨的话。
不曾.en: She never uttered a single complaint.

摄像.zh: 婚礼那天请了专业摄像师。
摄像.en: A professional cameraman was hired for the wedding.

摄像.zh: 因为手机有摄像功能，所以不用带相机。
摄像.en: Because the phone has video recording, no need to bring a camera.

摄像.zh: 这家公司提供摄像和剪辑服务。
摄像.en: This company provides filming and editing services.
Remember to check the battery before filming.

间接.zh: 他通过朋友间接知道了这个消息。
间接.en: He learned the news indirectly through a friend.

间接.zh: 虽然她没直接说，但间接表达了不满。
间接.en: Although she didn't say directly, she indirectly expressed dissatisfaction.

间接.zh: 吸烟对健康有间接的危害。
间接.en: Smoking has indirect harm to health.

间接.zh: 我们不能只靠间接证据判断。
间接.en: We can't judge based only on indirect evidence.

运送.zh: 这些物资需要尽快运送灾区。
运送.en: These supplies need to be shipped to the disaster area quickly.

运送.zh: 由于道路封锁，运送变得困难。
运送.en: Due to road closures, transport became difficult.

运送.zh: 他们用飞机运送紧急医疗设备。
运送.en: They used planes to transport emergency medical equipment.

运送.zh: 公司负责快递的运送服务。
运送.en: The company is responsible for the delivery service.

打仗.en: Historically, there were frequent battles here.

打仗.zh: 虽然国家不想打仗，但不得不自卫。
打仗.en: Although the country doesn't want war, it has to defend itself.

打仗.zh: 打仗受苦的总是老百姓。
打仗.en: The common people always suffer from war.

打仗.zh: 小时候我们玩打仗游戏。
打仗.en: As kids we played war games.

特地.en: I came specially to see you.

特地.zh: 她特地为你准备了生日礼物。
特地.en: She prepared a birthday gift specially for you.

特地.zh: 因为知道你喜欢，我特地买了这个。
特地.en: Because I know you like it, I bought this specially.

特地.zh: 他不远千里特地赶来参加聚会。
特地.en: He traveled a thousand miles specially to attend the party.

特地.zh: 妈妈特地做了你爱吃的菜。
特地.en: Mom specially made your favorite dish.

强壮.zh: 他每天锻炼，所以身体很强壮。
强壮.en: He exercises every day, so he is very strong.

强壮.zh: 生病以后，他需要多吃营养品才能恢复强壮。
强壮.en: After being sick, he needs to eat more supplements to regain his strength.

强壮.zh: 虽然他不高，但是很结实强壮。
强壮.en: Although he is not tall, he is sturdy and strong.

出入.en: Be careful with vehicles entering and exiting here.

出入.zh: 你的说法和事实有出入。
出入.en: Your statement differs from the facts.

出入.zh: 公司有严格的出入管理制度。
出入.en: The company has strict entry and exit management rules.

出入.zh: 他每天早出晚归，出入都很准时。
出入.en: He leaves early and returns late every day, and his comings and goings are always on time.

出入.zh: 这两份报告的内容没什么出入。
出入.en: There is not much difference between the contents of these two reports.

区分.zh: 你能区分这两种颜色吗？
区分.en: Can you tell these two colors apart?
Distinguishing truth from falsehood is very important.

区分.zh: 我们要学会区分好人和坏人。
区分.en: We need to learn to distinguish good people from bad people.

区分.zh: 虽然它们长得很像，但仔细看还是能区分出来。
区分.en: Although they look very similar, you can still tell them apart if you look closely.

区分.zh: 在这个问题上，我们需要区分不同情况。
区分.en: On this issue, we need to distinguish different situations.

报社.en: He works at a newspaper office.
This newspaper office is very famous.
He resigned from the newspaper office last year.

报社.zh: 为了采访，她每天都要去报社。
报社.en: For interviews, she has to go to the newspaper office every day.

报社.zh: 报社的记者们正在准备明天的新闻。
报社.en: The reporters at the newspaper office are preparing tomorrow's news.

筹备.en: They are preparing for the wedding.

筹备.zh: 这个活动需要筹备很久。
筹备.en: This event needs a long time to prepare.

筹备.zh: 公司正在筹备新产品发布会。
筹备.en: The company is preparing for the new product launch event.

筹备.zh: 筹备这次会议用了整整两个月。
筹备.en: Preparing for this meeting took a full two months.

筹备.zh: 因为资金不够，筹备工作暂时停止了。
筹备.en: Because of insufficient funds, the preparations have been temporarily halted.

结尾.zh: 这个故事的结尾很感人。
结尾.en: The ending of this story is very touching.

结尾.zh: 电影的结尾让我很意外。
结尾.en: The ending of the movie surprised me.

结尾.zh: 演讲的结尾他引用了名言。
结尾.en: At the end of the speech, he quoted a famous saying.

结尾.zh: 虽然开头很无聊，但结尾还不错。
结尾.en: Although the beginning was boring, the ending was not bad.

结尾.zh: 你要注意文章的结尾部分。
结尾.en: You need to pay attention to the ending part of the article.

题材.zh: 这个电影的题材很新颖。
题材.en: The subject matter of this movie is very novel.

题材.zh: 他喜欢写历史题材的小说。
题材.en: He likes to write novels with historical themes.

题材.zh: 这个题材不太适合儿童。
题材.en: This subject matter is not very suitable for children.

题材.zh: 导演选了一个很有争议的题材。
题材.en: The director chose a very controversial subject matter.

题材.zh: 虽然题材相同，但两位作家的风格很不一样。
题材.en: Although the subject matter is the same, the two writers' styles are very different.

通用.en: This type of charger is universal.

通用.zh: 这种方法在国内很通用。
通用.en: This method is very common in China.

通用.zh: 虽然型号不同，但配件是通用的。
通用.en: Although the models are different, the accessories are universal.

通用.zh: 这个软件有很多通用的功能。
通用.en: This software has many common functions.

钓鱼.zh: 周末我们去湖边钓鱼吧。
钓鱼.en: Let's go fishing at the lake this weekend.
His fishing skills are very good.

钓鱼.zh: 虽然天气不好，但他还是坚持去钓鱼。
钓鱼.en: Although the weather was bad, he still insisted on going fishing.

迫切.zh: 他迫切地想要解决问题。
迫切.en: He urgently wants to solve the problem.

迫切.zh: 现在最关键的是找到迫切需要的资金。
迫切.en: The most critical thing now is to find the urgently needed funds.

迫切.zh: 因为时间紧迫，我们迫切需要你的帮助。
迫切.en: Because time is tight, we urgently need your help.

打交道.en: I don't like dealing with him.

打交道.zh: 跟客户打交道的时候要注意礼貌。
打交道.en: When dealing with clients, pay attention to politeness.

打交道.zh: 他经常和外国人打交道，英语很好。
打交道.en: He often deals with foreigners, and his English is good.

打交道.zh: 我们公司跟很多大企业打交道。
打交道.en: Our company deals with many big enterprises.

打交道.zh: 自从换了工作，我就很少跟他打交道了。
打交道.en: Since changing jobs, I rarely deal with him.

富人.zh: 那个富人是做房地产的。
富人.en: That rich person is in real estate.

富人.zh: 很多富人都喜欢买豪宅和名车。
富人.en: Many rich people like to buy luxury homes and cars.

富人.zh: 他虽然是富人，但生活很节俭。
富人.en: Although he is rich, he lives frugally.

富人.zh: 这个地区的富人都住在山上。
富人.en: The rich people in this area live on the mountain.

富人.zh: 富人也有他们的烦恼，比如怕被绑架。
富人.en: Rich people also have their worries, like fear of being kidnapped.

兼职.en: She does a part-time job near school.

兼职.zh: 我上大学的时候做过好几份兼职。
兼职.en: When I was in college, I did several part-time jobs.

兼职.zh: 这份兼职虽然钱不多，但能积累经验。
兼职.en: This part-time job doesn't pay much, but it can accumulate experience.

兼职.zh: 他一边读书一边做兼职，很辛苦。
兼职.en: He studies while doing a part-time job, very hard.

兼职.zh: 很多学生周末都会去找兼职做。
兼职.en: Many students look for part-time jobs on weekends.

大致.en: This matter is roughly like this.

大致.zh: 你大致跟我说一下情况就行。
大致.en: Just tell me the situation roughly.

大致.zh: 从这儿到那儿大致需要二十分钟。
大致.en: From here to there it takes about twenty minutes.

大致.zh: 虽然细节不清楚，但大致方向是对的。
大致.en: Although details are unclear, the general direction is correct.

大致.zh: 我们大致分了三个小组来完成这个任务。
大致.en: We roughly divided into three groups to complete this task.

当代.en: This is a contemporary art exhibition.

当代.zh: 当代年轻人的生活方式跟以前很不一样。
当代.en: The lifestyle of contemporary young people is very different from before.

当代.zh: 在当代社会，手机已经成了必需品。

录制.en: Because time was limited, we only recorded three clips.

录制.zh: 录制过程中出了点小问题，需要重新录。
录制.en: A small problem occurred during recording, so we need to re-record.

鲨鱼.zh: 鲨鱼是海洋里非常凶猛的动物。
鲨鱼.en: Sharks are very fierce animals in the ocean.

鲨鱼.zh: 昨天在电视上看到一群鲨鱼。
鲨鱼.en: I saw a group of sharks on TV yesterday.

鲨鱼.zh: 虽然鲨鱼看起来很可怕，但对生态很重要。
鲨鱼.en: Although sharks look scary, they are important to the ecology.

鲨鱼.zh: 他在潜水时遇到了一条大鲨鱼。
鲨鱼.en: He encountered a large shark while diving.

访谈.zh: 昨天他参加了一个电视访谈节目。
访谈.en: Yesterday he participated in a TV talk show.

访谈.zh: 访谈中他谈到了自己的新书。
访谈.en: In the interview, he talked about his new book.

访谈.zh: 因为时间关系，这个访谈只进行了半小时。
访谈.en: Because of time constraints, this interview only lasted half an hour.

访谈.zh: 虽然事先准备了问题，但访谈还是很紧张。
访谈.en: Although questions were prepared in advance, the interview was still nervous.

土壤.en: The soil here is very fertile.

土壤.zh: 这种植物对土壤的要求很高。
土壤.en: This plant has high requirements for soil.

土壤.zh: 因为长期使用化肥，土壤已经变得贫瘠了。
土壤.en: Because of long-term use of chemical fertilizers, the soil has become barren.

土壤.zh: 不同地区的土壤成分差异很大。
土壤.en: Soil composition varies greatly in different regions.

土壤.zh: 虽然土壤看起来差不多，但实际性质完全不同。
土壤.en: Although the soil looks similar, its actual properties are completely different.

污水.zh: 工厂必须处理污水后才能排放。
污水.en: Factories must treat sewage before discharging.

污水.zh: 这条河里有很多工业污水。
污水.en: There is a lot of industrial wastewater in this river.

污水.zh: 污水处理厂出了问题，附近水源被污染了。
污水.en: The sewage treatment plant had a problem, and the nearby water source was polluted.

污水.zh: 我们要学会如何减少生活污水。
污水.en: We need to learn how to reduce domestic sewage.

眉毛.zh: 他气得眉毛都竖起来了。
眉毛.en: He was so angry that his eyebrows stood up.

眉毛.zh: 她每天都会花时间画眉毛。
眉毛.en: She spends time every day drawing her eyebrows.

眉毛.zh: 虽然她的眉毛很浓密，但她还是喜欢修一下。
眉毛.en: Although her eyebrows are thick, she still likes to trim them.

眉毛.zh: 他皱着眉头，眉毛都快挤到一起了。
眉毛.en: He frowned, his eyebrows almost squeezing together.

扩展.zh: 我们计划扩展业务到海外市场。
扩展.en: We plan to expand our business to overseas markets.

扩展.zh: 这个软件可以扩展你的手机功能。
扩展.en: This software can extend your phone's functions.

扩展.zh: 公司正在扩展新的生产线，所以需要招人。
扩展.en: The company is expanding its new production line, so it needs to hire people.

扩展.zh: 城市扩展得太快，很多农田都没了。
扩展.en: The city expanded too fast, and a lot of farmland disappeared.

扩展.zh: 他建议扩展这个项目，但老板没同意。
扩展.en: He suggested expanding the project, but the boss didn't agree.

痛快.en: We had such a great time today!

痛快.zh: 你有什么就痛快说吧，别藏着。
痛快.en: Just say it straight, don't hold back.

痛快.zh: 这场雨下得真痛快，把暑气全赶走了。
痛快.en: This rain came down really refreshingly, driving away all the summer heat.

痛快.zh: 他答应得特别痛快，我都没想到。
痛快.en: He agreed so readily, I didn't expect that.

痛快.zh: 周末和朋友一起烧烤喝酒，特别痛快。
痛快.en: Barbecuing and drinking with friends on the weekend is really satisfying.

繁殖.en: Mosquitoes breed very quickly in summer.

繁殖.zh: 这种鱼在水温合适时繁殖能力很强。
繁殖.en: This kind of fish has strong breeding ability when the water temperature is right.

繁殖.zh: 为了防止害虫繁殖，农场定期喷洒农药。
繁殖.en: To prevent pests from breeding, the farm sprays pesticides regularly.

繁殖.zh: 熊猫繁殖很困难，所以数量一直不多。
繁殖.en: Pandas are very difficult to breed, so their numbers have always been low.

繁殖.zh: 如果环境被破坏，很多动物就无法正常繁殖了。
繁殖.en: If the environment is destroyed, many animals cannot reproduce normally.

加重.en: His smoking made the cough worse.

加重.zh: 别再说这事了，只会加重她的烦恼。
加重.en: Don't mention this anymore, it will only add to her worries.

加重.zh: 政府决定加重对污染企业的罚款。
加重.en: The government decided to increase fines on polluting companies.

加重.zh: 最近工作压力加重，我晚上都睡不好。
加重.en: Recently work pressure has increased, and I can't sleep well at night.

加重.zh: 如果我们不采取措施，问题会越来越加重。
加重.en: If we don't take measures, the problem will become more and more serious.

被动.zh: 他不喜欢被动接受安排。
被动.en: He doesn't like passively accepting arrangements.

被动.zh: 这次谈判我们处于被动地位。
被动.en: We are in a passive position in this negotiation.

被动.zh: 别老是这么被动，主动一点效果更好。
被动.en: Don't always be so passive; being proactive works better.

被动.zh: 中文里被动句用“被”字来表示。
被动.en: In Chinese, passive sentences use the character '被'.

被动.zh: 因为没提前准备，面试时他一直很被动。
被动.en: Because he didn't prepare in advance, he was very passive during the interview.

当面.en: If you have an opinion, say it to my face.

当面.zh: 他当面一套背后一套，很虚伪。
当面.en: He says one thing to your face and another behind your back; he's very hypocritical.

当面.zh: 我当面跟她道过歉了，她接受了。
当面.en: I apologized to her face, and she accepted it.

当面.zh: 别在背后议论，有什么问题当面沟通。
当面.en: Don't gossip behind people's backs; if there's a problem, communicate face to face.

当面.zh: 他不敢当面拒绝，只好发信息说没空。
当面.en: He didn't dare to refuse in person, so he just sent a message saying he was busy.

眼看.zh: 眼看就要下雨了，快回家吧。
眼看.en: It's about to rain; let's go home quickly.

眼看.zh: 眼看春节到了，票还没买到。
眼看.en: Spring Festival is just around the corner, and I still haven't got a ticket.

眼看.zh: 她眼看就要哭了，你别说她了。
眼看.en: She's on the verge of tears; don't scold her.

眼看.zh: 眼看比赛结束，比分还是平的。
眼看.en: The game is about to end, and the score is still tied.

眼看.zh: 我眼看手机掉进水里，却来不及捞。
眼看.en: I watched helplessly as my phone fell into the water, but I couldn't grab it in time.

课题.en: This research topic is very interesting.

课题.zh: 他选的课题是关于人工智能的。
课题.en: The topic he chose is about artificial intelligence.

课题.zh: 我们小组的课题是研究城市垃圾处理。
课题.en: Our group's project is to study urban waste disposal.

课题.zh: 教授让我们下周汇报课题进展。
课题.en: The professor asked us to report on the progress of our project next week.

课题.zh: 这个课题经费不够，可能需要申请更多资金。
课题.en: This research project doesn't have enough funding; we may need to apply for more money.

犹如.zh: 她的笑容犹如阳光般温暖。
犹如.en: Her smile is as warm as sunshine.

犹如.zh: 时间犹如流水，一去不回。
犹如.en: Time is like flowing water, never returning.

犹如.zh: 这座城市夜晚灯火辉煌，犹如白昼。
犹如.en: This city is brilliantly lit at night, bright as day.

犹如.zh: 他对我的帮助犹如雪中送炭。
犹如.en: His help to me was like charcoal delivered in snowy weather—timely relief.

犹如.zh: 听到这个消息，他犹如五雷轰顶。
犹如.en: Hearing this news, he was thunderstruck.

饥饿.en: I'm so hungry; the hunger is unbearable.

饥饿.zh: 在非洲，很多孩子每天都要忍受饥饿。
饥饿.en: In Africa, many children suffer from hunger every day.

饥饿.zh: 饥饿的时候吃什么都香。
饥饿.en: When you're hungry, everything tastes good.

饥饿.zh: 长期饥饿会导致营养不良。
饥饿.en: Long-term hunger can lead to malnutrition.

饥饿.zh: 他饿得胃疼，饥饿让他非常烦躁。
饥饿.en: He was so hungry that his stomach hurt; the hunger made him very irritable.

实质.zh: 这个问题没有实质意义。
实质.en: This problem has no real meaning.

实质.zh: 虽然表面不同，但实质是一样的。
实质.en: Although superficially different, the essence is the same.
We need to see the essence of the problem.

实质.zh: 他说的那些话，其实根本就没有触及实质。
实质.en: What he said actually didn't touch the essence at all.
What is the essence of this matter?

人为.zh: 很多自然灾害其实都有人为因素。
人为.en: Many natural disasters actually have human factors.

人为.zh: 因为人为干预，这个项目失败了。
人为.en: Because of human intervention, this project failed.

人为.zh: 我觉得这次事故完全是人为的。
人为.en: I think this accident is entirely man-made.

特大.en: Last night there was a torrential rain.
This news is a megabreaking story.

特大.zh: 如果遇到特大洪水，一定要小心。
特大.en: If you encounter a major flood, be careful.

特大.zh: 这次展会吸引了特大人流。
特大.en: This exhibition attracted an extremely large crowd.

描写.zh: 作者对场景的描写让人身临其境。
描写.en: The author's description of the scene makes you feel like you're there.

描写.zh: 虽然描写很详细，但读者还是觉得不够。
描写.en: Although the description is detailed, readers still find it insufficient.

描写.zh: 你能用几句话描写一下你的家乡吗？
描写.en: Can you describe your hometown in a few sentences?

添加.zh: 在文档里添加一个新的表格。
添加.en: Add a new table in the document.

添加.zh: 如果你觉得不够甜，可以再添加一点蜂蜜。
添加.en: If you think it's not sweet enough, you can add a bit more honey.

添加.zh: 这道菜还需要添加一些调料。
添加.en: This dish still needs to add some seasoning.

奏.en: The band played the national anthem.

奏.zh: 因为没奏好，他重新来了一次。
奏.en: Because he didn't play well, he did it again.

奏.zh: 请奏一首你最喜欢的歌。
奏.en: Please play a song you like the most.

要点.en: It's important to grasp the key points.

要点.zh: 演讲的要点我已经记下来了。
要点.en: I've noted down the key points of the speech.

要点.zh: 虽然内容很多，但你要记住几个要点。
要点.en: Although there's a lot of content, you need to remember a few key points.

要点.zh: 这篇文章的要点是什么？
要点.en: What are the key points of this article?

要点.zh: 他总结了一下这次会议的要点。
要点.en: He summarized the key points of this meeting.

笑脸.en: She always greets people with a smiling face.

笑脸.zh: 看到孩子的笑脸，他什么都忘了。
笑脸.en: Seeing the child's smiling face, he forgot everything.

笑脸.zh: 虽然心里难过，但他还是露出了笑脸。
笑脸.en: Although feeling sad, he still showed a smiling face.
Your smiling face is very bright.

笑脸.zh: 服务员一直保持笑脸，让顾客很舒服。
笑脸.en: The waiter kept a smiling face, making customers feel comfortable.

截止.zh: 这个项目的截止日期是下周一。
截止.en: The deadline for this project is next Monday.

截止.zh: 因为人数太多，报名提前截止了。
截止.en: Because there were too many people, registration closed early.

截止.zh: 请在截止之前提交你的作业。
截止.en: Please submit your homework before the deadline.

发病.zh: 这种病在冬季更容易发病。
发病.en: This disease is more likely to occur in winter.

发病.zh: 如果你感到不舒服，可能会发病。
发病.en: If you feel unwell, you might get sick.
When the old man fell ill, no one was taking care of him.

发病.zh: 这种病发病很快，需要马上治疗。
发病.en: This disease has a rapid onset and requires immediate treatment.

匆匆.zh: 早上时间不够，我只能匆匆吃两口。
匆匆.en: I didn't have enough time in the morning, so I just grabbed a quick bite.

匆匆.zh: 她匆匆跑进教室，还是迟到了。
匆匆.en: She rushed into the classroom, but still arrived late.
Don't be in such a hurry; take it slow.

匆匆.zh: 他匆匆写完作业就去看电视了。
匆匆.en: He finished his homework in a hurry and then went to watch TV.

高等.zh: 他考上了一所高等学府。
高等.en: He got into a higher education institution.

高等.zh: 虽然只是专科，但也是高等学历。
高等.en: Although it's just a vocational college, it's still a higher education degree.
The tuition for higher education is expensive.

高等.zh: 这所大学的高等教育质量很好。
高等.en: The quality of higher education at this university is very good.

当下.zh: 他当下最重要的事情是找工作。
当下.en: His most important thing at present is finding a job.

当下.zh: 虽然当下很忙，但也要注意休息。
当下.en: Although busy at the moment, you still need to rest.
Don't worry about that for now.

当下.zh: 很多人当下都在考虑换工作的事情。
当下.en: Many people are currently thinking about changing jobs.

描绘.zh: 你能描绘一下那个场景吗？
文章生动地描绘了当地的风土人情。
描绘.en: The article vividly depicts the local customs.
The picture he depicts is very beautiful.
He uses a paintbrush to depict the scenery.

描绘.zh: 虽然他没有去过，但他描绘得好像亲眼见过一样。
描绘.en: Although he hasn't been there, he describes it as if he had seen it himself.

地下室.zh: 他把旧书都堆在地下室里了。
地下室.en: He piled all the old books in the basement.

地下室.zh: 地下室很潮湿，不适合放食物。
地下室.en: The basement is very damp, not suitable for storing food.

地下室.zh: 他们在地下室开了一个小酒吧。
地下室.en: They opened a small bar in the basement.

法语.zh: 我学了两年法语，但还不太流利。
法语.en: I've studied French for two years but am not yet fluent.

法语.zh: 法语是一门美丽的语言。
他用法语写了一封感谢信。
法语.en: He wrote a thank-you letter in French.

观光.zh: 来北京观光的人越来越多了。
观光.en: More and more people come to Beijing for sightseeing.

观光.zh: 虽然只是路过，但我们还是下车观光了一会儿。
观光.en: Although just passing by, we still got off and did some sightseeing for a while.

观光.zh: 我们这次旅行主要是为了观光，不是购物。
观光.en: This trip is mainly for sightseeing, not shopping.

舅舅.zh: 舅舅每年春节都会给我们发红包。
舅舅.en: Uncle gives us red envelopes every Spring Festival.

舅舅.zh: 我舅舅是个律师，工作特别忙。
舅舅.en: My uncle is a lawyer, very busy with work.

舅舅.zh: 因为舅舅住得远，我们很少见面。
舅舅.en: Because uncle lives far away, we rarely meet.

时速.en: What's the speed per hour now?

时速.zh: 高速公路上最高时速是一百二十公里。
时速.en: The maximum speed on the highway is 120 km/h.

时速.zh: 这辆车的设计时速可以达到三百公里。
时速.en: This car's design speed can reach 300 km/h.

时速.zh: 虽然时速不快，但开得很稳。
时速.en: Although the speed isn't fast, it drives very steadily.

归还.en: Please return the book on time.

归还.zh: 图书馆的书必须按时归还。
归还.en: Library books must be returned on time.

归还.zh: 他昨天就把那本书归还给图书馆了。
归还.en: He returned that book to the library yesterday.

归还.zh: 如果你不能按时归还，记得提前说一声。
归还.en: If you can't return it on time, remember to say something in advance.

相连.en: These two roads connect at the village entrance.

相连.zh: 虽然相隔很远，但我们的心是相连的。
相连.en: Although far apart, our hearts are connected.

相连.zh: 电脑和打印机用一根线相连就行了。
相连.en: Just connect the computer and printer with one cable.

相连.zh: 这个公园和那个广场通过一条小路相连。
相连.en: This park and that square are connected by a small path.

限于.zh: 这个活动限于18岁以上的人参加。
限于.en: This activity is limited to people over 18.

限于.zh: 限于时间，我们只能讲重点。
限于.en: Due to time constraints, we can only cover the key points.

限于.zh: 我的能力有限，限于做简单的工作。
限于.en: My ability is limited, so I'm restricted to simple tasks.

限于.zh: 优惠券的使用限于周末。
限于.en: The use of the coupon is limited to weekends.

限于.zh: 这次招聘不限于本地人，外地人也欢迎。
限于.en: This recruitment is not limited to locals; people from other places are also welcome.

公益.en: He often participates in public welfare activities.

公益.zh: 这个项目是公益性质的，不收费。
公益.en: This project is for public benefit and free of charge.

公益.zh: 我们公司每年都会做公益捐赠。
公益.en: Our company makes charitable donations every year.

公益.zh: 公益广告提醒大家注意环保。
公益.en: Public service ads remind everyone to pay attention to environmental protection.

公益.zh: 虽然他很忙，但还是抽时间做公益。
公益.en: Although he is very busy, he still finds time to do charity work.

乐器.en: He has collected many kinds of musical instruments.

乐器.zh: 学一门乐器需要耐心和练习。
乐器.en: Learning a musical instrument requires patience and practice.

乐器.zh: 在乐队里，他负责弹奏打击乐器。
乐器.en: In the band, he is responsible for playing percussion instruments.

乐器.zh: 这家店的乐器种类很全，价格也合理。
乐器.en: This store has a full range of musical instruments at reasonable prices.

事项.en: Please pay attention to safety matters.

事项.zh: 这里列出了会议需要讨论的事项。
事项.en: Here is a list of items to be discussed at the meeting.

事项.zh: 办理签证前，要了解所有注意事项。
事项.en: Before applying for a visa, you need to know all the precautions.

事项.zh: 合同里有一些重要事项需要双方确认。
事项.en: There are some important matters in the contract that both parties need to confirm.

事项.zh: 除了学习，生活上的事项也要安排好。
事项.en: Apart from studying, life matters also need to be arranged well.

天然气.en: My family uses natural gas for cooking.
Natural gas is safer than coal gas.

天然气.zh: 很多城市已经普及了天然气管道。
天然气.en: Many cities have already popularized natural gas pipelines.

天然气.zh: 冬天用天然气取暖比较方便。
天然气.en: Using natural gas for heating in winter is quite convenient.

天然气.zh: 虽然天然气价格涨了，但还是要用。
天然气.en: Although the price of natural gas has risen, we still have to use it.

赞赏.zh: 老板很赞赏他的工作态度。
赞赏.en: The boss greatly appreciates his work attitude.

赞赏.zh: 观众对表演报以热烈的赞赏。
赞赏.en: The audience responded with warm admiration for the performance.

赞赏.zh: 你应该多赞赏孩子的努力。
赞赏.en: You should praise the child's efforts more.

赞赏.zh: 他得到大家的赞赏后，工作更努力了。
赞赏.en: After receiving everyone's praise, he worked even harder.

赞赏.zh: 虽然结果不好，但我仍然赞赏你的勇气。
赞赏.en: Although the result wasn't good, I still admire your courage.

解读.en: This poem is difficult to interpret.

解读.zh: 专家对数据进行了详细的解读。
解读.en: The expert gave a detailed interpretation of the data.

解读.zh: 每个人对这部电影的解读都不一样。
解读.en: Everyone's interpretation of this film is different.

解读.zh: 不要过度解读他说的话。
在这个语境下，那句话可以有两种解读。
解读.en: In this context, that sentence can be interpreted in two ways.

棕色.en: She is wearing a brown coat.

棕色.zh: 棕色和白色搭配很好看。
棕色.en: Brown and white look great together.

棕色.zh: 我家养了一只棕色的小狗。
