古人.en: The poems left by the ancients still move many people today.

古人.zh: 你以为古人很保守？其实他们也有很开放的时候。
古人.en: Do you think the ancients were conservative? Actually, they had very open-minded moments too.

船只.en: There are many ships docked at the port.

船只.zh: 遇到风暴时，所有船只都回港避风了。
船只.en: When the storm hit, all vessels returned to port for shelter.

船只.zh: 这条河上的船只往来非常频繁，是个重要的水路。
船只.en: The traffic of boats on this river is very frequent; it's an important waterway.

船只.zh: 因为航道堵塞，大量船只只能排队等待通过。
船只.en: Because the channel is blocked, many vessels have to line up and wait to pass.

船只.zh: 古代的船只主要靠风力和人力行驶。
船只.en: Ancient ships mainly relied on wind and manpower to move.

配套.zh: 买这个电器，会送配套的遥控器。
配套.en: Buying this appliance comes with a matching remote control.

配套.zh: 这个小区配套很齐全，有学校、超市和公园。
配套.en: This residential area has complete supporting facilities, including schools, supermarkets, and parks.

配套.zh: 家具是配套的，颜色和风格都统一。
配套.en: The furniture is a matching set; the colors and styles are uniform.

配套.zh: 软件和硬件需要配套使用，才能发挥最大功能。
配套.en: Software and hardware need to be used together to maximize functionality.

前期.zh: 前期的工作做得越好，后期就越顺利。
前期.en: The better the early-stage work is done, the smoother the later stages will be.

前期.zh: 这个项目前期投入了大量资金。
前期.en: This project invested a lot of money in the early phase.

前期.zh: 前期调研很重要，不能马虎。
前期.en: Preliminary research is very important and cannot be taken lightly.

前期.zh: 在前期准备阶段，我们遇到了不少困难。
前期.en: During the preparation stage, we encountered quite a few difficulties.

前期.zh: 如果前期规划不周，后期可能要返工。
前期.en: If the early planning is not thorough, later stages may require rework.

还原.zh: 这个软件可以把老照片还原成原来的颜色。
还原.en: This software can restore old photos to their original colors.

还原.zh: 警察试图还原事故发生的经过。
还原.en: The police tried to reconstruct the sequence of the accident.

还原.zh: 我们用了整整两天才把房间还原成最初的样子。
还原.en: It took us two full days to restore the room to its original state.

还原.zh: 厨师能通过味道还原出这道菜的配方。
还原.en: The chef can reproduce the recipe for this dish just by tasting it.

还原.zh: 数据已经丢失了，无法还原回来。
还原.en: The data has been lost and cannot be recovered.

延期.zh: 考试延期了，大家都很开心。
延期.en: The exam has been postponed; everyone is very happy.

延期.zh: 因为天气不好，航班延期到明天早上。
延期.en: Due to bad weather, the flight has been delayed until tomorrow morning.

延期.zh: 这个项目进度太慢，不得不延期一个月。
延期.en: The project is progressing too slowly; it has to be postponed for a month.

延期.zh: 如果申请延期，需要提前提交书面说明。
延期.en: If you apply for an extension, you need to submit a written explanation in advance.

延期.zh: 演唱会延期了，很多粉丝都在等新的日期。
延期.en: The concert has been rescheduled; many fans are waiting for the new date.

不宜.en: It's not advisable to exercise immediately after meals.

不宜.zh: 这种天气不宜出门，外面太冷了。
不宜.en: This weather is not suitable for going out; it's too cold outside.

不宜.zh: 小孩子不宜看太多电视，对眼睛不好。
不宜.en: Children should not watch too much TV; it's bad for their eyes.

不宜.zh: 这件事不宜公开讨论，我们私下说吧。
不宜.en: It's not appropriate to discuss this publicly; let's talk in private.

不宜.zh: 孕妇不宜吃太辛辣的食物，会影响胎儿。
不宜.en: Pregnant women should avoid eating too spicy food; it may affect the fetus.

垂直.zh: 这面墙不是垂直的，有点歪。
垂直.en: This wall is not vertical; it's a bit tilted.

垂直.zh: 电梯沿着垂直的轨道上下运行。
垂直.en: The elevator moves up and down along a vertical track.

垂直.zh: 画线的时候要尽量保持垂直，不然不好看。
垂直.en: When drawing lines, try to keep them vertical, or it won't look good.

垂直.zh: 这座塔从远处看完全是垂直的，很壮观。
垂直.en: This tower looks perfectly vertical from afar; it's very spectacular.

垂直.zh: 他把木棍垂直插进土里，用来做标记。
垂直.en: He inserted the stick vertically into the ground to use as a marker.

出境.zh: 他出境的时候被海关拦住了。
出境.en: He was stopped by customs when leaving the country.

出境.zh: 因为签证问题，他无法顺利出境。
出境.en: Because of visa issues, he couldn't leave smoothly.

出境.zh: 出境前记得检查护照有效期。
出境.en: Remember to check your passport's validity before leaving the country.

出境.zh: 最近出境政策变严格了。
出境.en: Exit policies have become stricter recently.

半决赛.en: They made it to the semifinals.

半决赛.zh: 这场半决赛打得很精彩，观众都看呆了。
半决赛.en: This semifinal was exciting, the audience was stunned.

半决赛.zh: 如果赢了半决赛，就能去决赛了。
半决赛.en: If they win the semifinal, they can go to the finals.

半决赛.zh: 半决赛的对手实力很强。
半决赛.en: The semifinal opponent is very strong.

半决赛.zh: 虽然输了半决赛，但他们的表现已经很好了。
半决赛.en: Although they lost the semifinal, their performance was already great.

治理.en: The government needs to control air pollution.

治理.zh: 这个城市在治理交通拥堵方面做得不错。
治理.en: This city has done well in managing traffic congestion.

治理.zh: 除了治理环境，还要治理社会问题。
治理.en: Besides environmental governance, social issues also need addressing.

治理.zh: 他们用新技术治理河道。
治理.en: They use new technology to manage rivers.

治理.zh: 治理国家需要智慧和耐心。
治理.en: Governing a country requires wisdom and patience.

姑姑.en: My aunt came to see me yesterday.

姑姑.zh: 姑姑做的红烧肉是我最喜欢的菜。
姑姑.en: My aunt's braised pork is my favorite dish.

姑姑.zh: 你姑姑住在北京还是上海？
姑姑.en: Does your aunt live in Beijing or Shanghai?

姑姑.zh: 我姑姑是老师，她教数学。
姑姑.en: My aunt is a teacher; she teaches math.

姑姑.zh: 因为姑姑很疼我，所以我常去她家玩。
姑姑.en: Because my aunt dotes on me, I often go to her house to play.

幅度.en: The price increase is very large.

幅度.zh: 今年房价的波动幅度比去年小了很多。
幅度.en: This year's housing price fluctuation range is much smaller than last year's.

幅度.zh: 他的成绩提高幅度很明显。
幅度.en: The improvement in his grades is very obvious.
The temperature change range is not large.

幅度.zh: 虽然幅度不大，但股市确实在回升。
幅度.en: Although the magnitude is small, the stock market is indeed recovering.

暖气.en: The heating is broken; it's so cold.

暖气.zh: 北方的冬天没有暖气可不行。
暖气.en: Northern winters without heating are impossible.

暖气.zh: 这个月暖气费涨了不少。
暖气.en: The heating bill increased a lot this month.

暖气.zh: 你摸一下暖气，看热不热。
暖气.en: Touch the radiator and see if it's hot.

暖气.zh: 因为暖气太热了，我只好开窗通风。
暖气.en: Because the heating was too hot, I had to open the window for ventilation.

悲观.zh: 他对未来的前景感到非常悲观。
悲观.en: He feels very pessimistic about future prospects.

悲观.zh: 虽然情况不好，但我们不能悲观。
悲观.en: Although the situation is bad, we cannot be pessimistic.
Pessimistic people always think of the worst.

悲观.zh: 因为上次失败了，他现在有点悲观。
悲观.en: Because he failed last time, he is a bit pessimistic now.

评选.en: We are selecting the best employee.

评选.zh: 今年的年度电影评选结果已经公布了。
评选.en: This year's annual movie selection results have been announced.
The selection process must be fair and just.
Did you participate in this selection?

评选.zh: 经过专家评选，他终于得了奖。
评选.en: After expert evaluation, he finally won an award.

率领.zh: 他率领团队获得了胜利。
率领.en: He led the team to victory.

率领.zh: 总统亲自率领代表团访问中国。
率领.en: The president personally led a delegation to visit China.

率领.zh: 经理率领员工完成了那个项目。
率领.en: The manager led the employees to complete that project.

率领.zh: 将军率领军队向前进攻。
率领.en: The general led the army forward to attack.

率领.zh: 虽然困难很多，但他率领大家坚持了下来。
率领.en: Although there were many difficulties, he led everyone to persist.

创立.zh: 这个学校是由一位慈善家创立的。
创立.en: This school was founded by a philanthropist.

创立.zh: 她在三十岁时创立了自己的品牌。
创立.en: She founded her own brand at age thirty.

创立.zh: 他们创立了一个新的基金会。
因为发现了市场空白，他决定创立这个企业。
创立.en: Because he discovered a market gap, he decided to found this business.

自助.zh: 我们周末去吃自助餐吧。
自助.en: Let's go eat buffet this weekend.

自助.zh: 自助旅行虽然累但很自由。
自助.en: Self-guided travel is tiring but very free.

自助.zh: 因为时间紧，我们选了自助早餐。
自助.en: Because we were short on time, we chose the自助 breakfast.

自助.zh: 第一次吃自助火锅，我拿了好多菜。
自助.en: When I first had self-service hotpot, I took a lot of dishes.

祖先.en: Our ancestors came from the north.
During Qingming Festival we worship our ancestors.

祖先.zh: 祖先留下的传统我们要尊重。
祖先.en: We should respect the traditions left by our ancestors.

祖先.zh: 虽然没见过祖先，但听爷爷讲过他们的故事。
祖先.en: Although I've never met my ancestors, I've heard stories about them from my grandfather.

祖先.zh: 科学家通过DNA研究找到了人类共同的祖先。
祖先.en: Scientists have found the common ancestor of humans through DNA research.

委屈.en: Don't put her in a difficult position; she's not wrong.
If you feel wronged, just cry it out.

委屈.zh: 因为被误会，她委屈得说不出话。
委屈.en: Because she was misunderstood, she was so upset she couldn't speak.

委屈.zh: 虽然工资低了点，但这点委屈我能忍。
委屈.en: Although the salary is a bit low, I can put up with this small grievance.

特长.zh: 他特长是打篮球，特别准。
特长.en: His specialty is playing basketball; he's very accurate.

特长.zh: 公司招聘时很看重个人特长。
特长.en: The company values personal specialties when hiring.

特长.zh: 除了唱歌，我没有什么特别的特长。
特长.en: Besides singing, I don't have any special skills.

薄弱.zh: 英语口语是我的薄弱项。
薄弱.en: English speaking is my weak point.

薄弱.zh: 因为基础薄弱，他需要多练习。
薄弱.en: Because his foundation is weak, he needs more practice.

薄弱.zh: 虽然整体不错，但团队协作能力比较薄弱。
薄弱.en: Although the overall is good, team collaboration ability is relatively weak.

主办.zh: 今年奥运会由巴黎主办。
主办.en: This year's Olympics are hosted by Paris.

主办.zh: 学校主办了一场音乐会。
这个活动是我们公司主办的。
主办.en: This event is hosted by our company.

主办.zh: 因为人手不够，主办方推迟了比赛。
主办.en: Because of insufficient staff, the organizers postponed the match.

主办.zh: 下一届世博会将由这座城市主办，大家都期待。
主办.en: The next World Expo will be hosted by this city, and everyone is looking forward to it.

公认.en: He is widely recognized as a good teacher.
This is a universally acknowledged fact.

公认.zh: 她公认是班里最努力的学生。
公认.en: She is recognized as the hardest working student in the class.

公认.zh: 虽然争议很多，但这件事的结论是公认的。
公认.en: Although there is a lot of controversy, the conclusion of this matter is generally accepted.

公认.zh: 在学术界，他的研究成果已经被公认了。
公认.en: In academia, his research results have been widely recognized.

开设.en: The school has newly opened a German course.
This store has opened an online shop.

开设.zh: 银行最近开设了夜间服务。
开设.en: The bank recently started offering nighttime services.

开设.zh: 因为需求大，公司又开设了两家分店。
开设.en: Because of high demand, the company opened two more branches.

开设.zh: 为了丰富学生的生活，俱乐部开设了各种兴趣班。
开设.en: To enrich students' lives, the club set up various interest classes.

百分点.en: Housing prices rose by five percentage points.

百分点.zh: 失业率下降了零点几个百分点。
百分点.en: The unemployment rate dropped by a few tenths of a percentage point.

百分点.zh: 今年利润比去年提高了三个百分点。
百分点.en: This year's profit increased by three percentage points compared to last year.

百分点.zh: 虽然只差一个百分点，但结果完全不同。
百分点.en: Although it's only a one percentage point difference, the result is completely different.

百分点.zh: 调查显示，支持率上升了十个百分点，令人惊讶。
百分点.en: The survey shows that the approval rating increased by ten percentage points, which is surprising.

专题.en: There is a special topic discussion today.
The newspaper did a special feature on environmental protection.

专题.zh: 因为内容太广，我们只做了两个专题。
专题.en: Because the content was too broad, we only made two special topics.

专题.zh: 电视台推出了一档关于健康的专题节目，很受欢迎。
专题.en: The TV station launched a special program about health, which is very popular.

用餐.zh: 今天中午我在公司用餐。
用餐.en: I had lunch at the office today.

用餐.zh: 这家餐厅用餐环境很好，服务也不错。
用餐.en: This restaurant has a great dining atmosphere, and the service is good too.

用餐.zh: 他习惯在用餐时喝点汤。
用餐.en: He's used to having some soup during meals.

用餐.zh: 如果周末有空，我们通常会出去用餐。
用餐.en: If we have time on weekends, we usually go out to eat.

工夫.en: I don't have time to play with you.

工夫.zh: 他花了很多工夫学中文。
工夫.en: He put a lot of effort into learning Chinese.
As long as you put in the effort, you can learn it well.

工夫.zh: 你还有工夫看电视？快去写作业。
工夫.en: You still have time to watch TV? Go do your homework.

工夫.zh: 她用了三个月的工夫才完成这个项目。
工夫.en: It took her three months of hard work to finish this project.

看似.en: He seems busy, but actually he's not.

看似.zh: 这个问题看似简单，做起来很难。
看似.en: This problem looks simple, but it's hard to do.

看似.zh: 看似平静的海面下暗藏危机。
看似.en: Beneath the seemingly calm sea surface hide dangers.

看似.zh: 她看似不太高兴，但没说原因。
看似.en: She looks a bit unhappy, but she didn't say why.

看似.zh: 这个决定看似合理，实际上有问题。
看似.en: This decision seems reasonable, but actually there's a problem.

生成.zh: 这个软件可以自动生成报告。
生成.en: This software can automatically generate reports.

生成.zh: 输入密码后，系统会生成验证码。
生成.en: After entering the password, the system will generate a verification code.

生成.zh: 这些照片都是自动生成的。
生成.en: These photos were all automatically generated.

生成.zh: 工厂每天生成大量垃圾。
生成.en: The factory generates a large amount of waste every day.

生成.zh: 只要输入关键词，就能快速生成文章。
生成.en: Just enter keywords, and you can quickly generate an article.

繁忙.zh: 上下班时间交通很繁忙。
繁忙.en: Traffic is very busy during rush hour.

繁忙.zh: 机场在节假日非常繁忙，旅客很多。
繁忙.en: The airport is very busy during holidays, with many travelers.

繁忙.zh: 她虽然生活繁忙，但每天坚持锻炼。
繁忙.en: Although she has a busy life, she insists on exercising every day.

繁忙.zh: 因为工作繁忙，我很少出门。
繁忙.en: Because of heavy work, I rarely go out.

繁忙.zh: 繁忙的马路上车水马龙。
繁忙.en: The busy streets are filled with traffic.

勺.zh: 我用勺喝汤，但觉得用筷子更方便。
勺.en: I use a spoon to drink soup, but I think chopsticks are more convenient.
This spoon is made of iron.

勺.zh: 如果汤很烫，请用大勺盛。
勺.en: If the soup is very hot, please use a large ladle.
I used a spoon to scoop a spoonful of sugar.

订婚.zh: 订婚那天她收到一枚戒指。
订婚.en: On the day of the engagement, she received a ring.

订婚.zh: 我和他订婚之后，就开始准备婚礼。
订婚.en: After I got engaged to him, we started preparing the wedding.

订婚.zh: 你听说小张订婚的消息了吗？
订婚.en: Have you heard the news that Xiao Zhang got engaged?

订婚.zh: 他们订婚三年了还没结婚。
订婚.en: They've been engaged for three years and still haven't gotten married.

习俗.zh: 假如你来到这里，就要尊重当地习俗。
习俗.en: If you come here, you should respect the local customs.
There is a custom of giving red envelopes during Spring Festival.

习俗.zh: 这个习俗在当地已经流传几百年了。
习俗.en: This custom has been passed down locally for hundreds of years.

习俗.zh: 虽然习俗不同，但大家都很尊重。
习俗.en: Although customs differ, everyone respects them.

习俗.zh: 按照当地的习俗，客人要带礼物上门。
习俗.en: According to local custom, guests should bring gifts when visiting.

茄子.zh: 因为茄子便宜，所以我经常买。
茄子.en: Because eggplant is cheap, I often buy it.

茄子.zh: 茄子炒肉片是一道家常菜。
茄子.en: Eggplant stir-fried with sliced pork is a home-style dish.

茄子.zh: 我不太爱吃茄子，但偶尔会吃。
茄子.en: I don't really like eggplant, but I eat it occasionally.

茄子.zh: 这个茄子很新鲜，是早上买的。
茄子.en: This eggplant is very fresh; I bought it this morning.

金子.en: This piece of gold is very heavy.

金子.zh: 她戴了一条金子做的项链。
金子.en: She is wearing a necklace made of gold.

金子.zh: 虽然金子很贵，但很多人还是买。
金子.en: Although gold is expensive, many people still buy it.

金子.zh: 在沙漠里找到金子可不容易。
金子.en: Finding gold in the desert is no easy task.

金子.zh: 因为金子保值，所以他存了一些。
金子.en: Because gold holds its value, he saved some.

口腔.zh: 每天刷牙可以保持口腔健康。
口腔.en: Brushing teeth every day can maintain oral health.

口腔.zh: 我最近口腔溃疡，吃东西很疼。
口腔.en: I have mouth ulcers lately, eating hurts a lot.

口腔.zh: 因为不注意口腔卫生，他得了蛀牙。
口腔.en: Because he didn't pay attention to oral hygiene, he got cavities.

口腔.zh: 医生建议我用漱口水清洁口腔。
口腔.en: The doctor suggested I use mouthwash to clean my mouth.

口腔.zh: 口腔的问题可能会影响全身健康。
口腔.en: Oral problems can affect overall health.

寿命.en: A dog's lifespan is generally shorter than a human's.

寿命.zh: 现代人的平均寿命越来越长了。
寿命.en: The average lifespan of modern people is getting longer.

寿命.zh: 良好的生活习惯能延长寿命。
寿命.en: Good living habits can extend lifespan.

寿命.zh: 随着医疗进步，人类的寿命显著提高。
寿命.en: With medical advances, human lifespan has significantly increased.

寿命.zh: 这只乌龟的寿命可能超过一百年。
寿命.en: This turtle's lifespan may exceed one hundred years.

日语.en: I can speak a little Japanese.

日语.zh: 他自学日语已经三年了。
日语.en: He has been self-studying Japanese for three years.

日语.zh: 因为喜欢动漫，她开始学日语。
日语.en: Because she likes anime, she started learning Japanese.

日语.zh: 日语里有不少汉字，但读音不同。
日语.en: Japanese has many Chinese characters, but the pronunciations are different.

划分.zh: 老师把班级划分成几个小组。
划分.en: The teacher divided the class into several groups.

划分.zh: 这个城市按功能划分了不同区域。
划分.en: This city is divided into different zones by function.

划分.zh: 历史学家把这段时期划分为三个阶段。
划分.en: Historians divide this period into three stages.

划分.zh: 我们如何划分这个任务？
划分.en: How do we divide this task?

划分.zh: 国界划分常常引起争议。

体积.zh: 这个箱子的体积太大了。
体积.en: The volume of this box is too big.

体积.zh: 气体体积会随着温度改变。
体积.en: The volume of gas changes with temperature.

体积.zh: 快递费是根据体积和重量计算的。
体积.en: The courier fee is calculated based on volume and weight.

体积.zh: 同样体积的水和油，重量不同。
体积.en: Water and oil of the same volume have different weights.

体积.zh: 缩小包装的体积可以节省运输成本。
体积.en: Reducing the volume of packaging can save transportation costs.

地域.zh: 不同地域的文化差异很大。
地域.en: Cultural differences between different regions are huge.

地域.zh: 这个品牌只在北方地域销售。
地域.en: This brand is only sold in northern regions.

地域.zh: 由于地域广阔，各地气候完全不同。
地域.en: Due to the vast region, the climate varies completely.
Regional discrimination is a kind of prejudice.

地域.zh: 他研究中国各个地域的方言。
地域.en: He studies dialects from various regions of China.

热点.zh: 这个新闻成了社交媒体的热点。
热点.en: This news became a hot topic on social media.

热点.zh: 现在的热点是人工智能。
热点.en: The current hot topic is artificial intelligence.

热点.zh: 旅游热点在节假日总是人山人海。
热点.en: Tourist hotspots are always crowded during holidays.

热点.zh: 针对这个社会热点，大家展开了讨论。
热点.en: Everyone started a discussion about this social hot topic.

热点.zh: 夏天避暑的热点都在海边。
热点.en: Summer heat-escape hotspots are all by the seaside.

人行道.en: It's safer to walk on the sidewalk.

人行道.zh: 不要把自行车停在人行道上。
人行道.en: Don't park your bicycle on the sidewalk.

人行道.zh: 这条人行道很宽，适合散步。
人行道.en: This sidewalk is very wide, suitable for strolling.

人行道.zh: 因为修路，人行道暂时封闭了。
人行道.en: Because of road construction, the sidewalk is temporarily closed.

人行道.zh: 在人行道上跑步要注意避让行人。
人行道.en: When running on the sidewalk, be careful to avoid pedestrians.

周到.zh: 你想得真周到，连雨伞都带了。
周到.en: You are so thoughtful, you even brought an umbrella.

周到.zh: 这家酒店的服务非常周到，让人满意。
周到.en: The service at this hotel is very thoughtful and satisfying.

周到.zh: 作为导游，他安排得很周到。
周到.en: As a tour guide, he made very thoughtful arrangements.

周到.zh: 他做事不够周到，总是丢三落四。
周到.en: He is not thorough enough in his work, always forgetting things.

摆放.zh: 家具摆放的位置要合理。
摆放.en: The placement of furniture should be reasonable.

摆放.zh: 餐厅里餐具摆放得很讲究。
摆放.en: The tableware in the restaurant is arranged very elegantly.

摆放.zh: 她喜欢把鲜花摆放在客厅中央。
摆放.en: She likes to place fresh flowers in the center of the living room.

摆放.zh: 因为空间有限，我们只能摆放一张桌子。
摆放.en: Because space is limited, we can only place one table.

精通.en: He is proficient in three foreign languages.

精通.zh: 她精通电脑编程，所以公司很需要她。
精通.en: She is proficient in computer programming, so the company really needs her.

精通.zh: 虽然他不精通音乐，但他很喜欢唱歌。
精通.en: Although he is not proficient in music, he really likes singing.

精通.zh: 这位老师精通古代历史，讲课特别生动。
精通.en: This teacher is proficient in ancient history, and his lectures are very vivid.

精通.zh: 要想精通一门手艺，得多花时间练习。
精通.en: To become proficient in a craft, you need to spend more time practicing.

看中.en: I have my eye on that coat.

看中.zh: 她看中了一套房子，但价格太贵了。
看中.en: She took a fancy to a house, but the price is too high.

看中.zh: 老板看中了他的能力，马上给他升职了。
看中.en: The boss recognized his ability and promoted him immediately.

看中.zh: 如果你看中了这个职位，就尽快投简历吧。
看中.en: If you are interested in this position, submit your resume as soon as possible.

看中.zh: 我们看中了一家餐厅，环境好而且菜好吃。
看中.en: We picked a restaurant that has a nice atmosphere and delicious food.

自来水.zh: 这里的自来水不能直接喝。
自来水.en: The tap water here is not drinkable directly.

自来水.zh: 我家装了净水器，自来水过滤后才用。
自来水.en: My home has a water purifier, so we use tap water only after filtering.

自来水.zh: 停水的时候，自来水公司会提前通知。
自来水.en: When there is a water outage, the water company will notify in advance.

自来水.zh: 虽然自来水很方便，但我还是喜欢喝烧开的水。
自来水.en: Although tap water is convenient, I still prefer to drink boiled water.

自来水.zh: 他打开水龙头，自来水哗哗地流了出来。
自来水.en: He turned on the tap, and tap water came gushing out.

地形.en: The terrain here is very complex.

地形.zh: 因为地形险峻，登山队花了两天才到山顶。
地形.en: Because the terrain was steep, the climbing team took two days to reach the summit.

地形.zh: 我们得先研究一下地形，再决定路线。
地形.en: We need to study the terrain first before deciding on the route.

地形.zh: 这片区域的地形适合建滑雪场。
地形.en: The terrain in this area is suitable for building a ski resort.

地形.zh: 虽然地图上看不远，但实际地形比想象的平坦。
地形.en: Although it looks far on the map, the actual terrain is flatter than imagined.

蓝天.en: The blue sky today is really beautiful.

蓝天.zh: 我最喜欢夏天的蓝天和白云。
蓝天.en: I love the blue sky and white clouds in summer the most.

蓝天.zh: 虽然下了雨，但没多久又出现了蓝天。
蓝天.en: Although it rained, the blue sky appeared again soon after.

蓝天.zh: 在城市里很难看到这么干净的蓝天。
蓝天.en: It's hard to see such a clear blue sky in the city.

蓝天.zh: 他们躺在草地上，看着蓝天聊天。
蓝天.en: They lay on the grass, chatting while looking at the blue sky.

氢.en: Hydrogen is a very light gas.

氢.zh: 科学家正在研究用氢来发电。
氢.en: Scientists are studying how to use hydrogen to generate electricity.

氢.zh: 因为氢容易爆炸，所以储存时要特别小心。
氢.en: Because hydrogen is explosive, it must be stored with special care.
Water is composed of oxygen and hydrogen.

氢.zh: 如果氢能源能普及，环境会改善很多。
氢.en: If hydrogen energy becomes widespread, the environment will improve a lot.

短片.en: This short film is only ten minutes long.

短片.zh: 他拍了一个关于环保的短片，在网上很火。
短片.en: He made a short film about environmental protection, and it went viral online.

短片.zh: 因为时间有限，我们只看了一部短片。
短片.en: Because time was limited, we only watched one short film.

短片.zh: 很多导演都是从拍短片开始练习的。
短片.en: Many directors start practicing by making short films.

短片.zh: 这个短片虽然很短，但故事非常感人。
短片.en: Although this short film is very short, the story is very touching.

细致.zh: 这份报告写得很细致，连小错误都没有。
细致.en: This report is written very meticulously, without even small mistakes.

细致.zh: 因为工作细致，他得到了客户的信任。
细致.en: Because he works meticulously, he earned the client's trust.

细致.zh: 我们需要对这个问题进行更细致的分析。
细致.en: We need to conduct a more detailed analysis of this issue.

细致.zh: 虽然时间紧，但他还是把每个细节都检查得很细致。
细致.en: Although time was tight, he still checked every detail very carefully.

畅销.zh: 因为质量好，他们的产品一直很畅销。
畅销.en: Because the quality is good, their products have always been bestsellers.

畅销.zh: 这种新款手机上市后非常畅销。
畅销.en: This new model of phone became a bestseller after its launch.

畅销.zh: 虽然价格不便宜，但这款化妆品还是十分畅销。
畅销.en: Although the price is not cheap, this cosmetic is still very popular.

畅销.zh: 畅销书不一定都是好书，但读者喜欢一定有原因。
畅销.en: Bestselling books are not necessarily good books, but there must be a reason readers like them.

基督教.zh: 圣诞节是基督教的重要节日。
基督教.en: Christmas is an important holiday in Christianity.

基督教.zh: 虽然我不信基督教，但我尊重别人的信仰。
基督教.en: Although I don't believe in Christianity, I respect others' faith.

基督教.zh: 基督教在中国也有不少信徒。
基督教.en: Christianity also has quite a few followers in China.

基督教.zh: 他从小在基督教家庭长大，所以每周都去教堂。
基督教.en: He grew up in a Christian family, so he goes to church every week.

名气.zh: 这家店的名气是靠口碑传出来的。
名气.en: This shop's reputation was built through word of mouth.

名气.zh: 虽然她名气不大，但专业能力很强。
名气.en: Although she is not very famous, her professional skills are strong.

名气.zh: 你别看他名气大，其实做事很不靠谱。
名气.en: Don't be fooled by his fame; he's actually very unreliable.

名气.zh: 一个小城市能有这样的名气，已经很了不起了。
名气.en: For a small city to have such fame is already impressive.

适宜.en: This season is suitable for travel.

适宜.zh: 这里的气候非常适宜居住。
适宜.en: The climate here is very suitable for living.

适宜.zh: 如果你觉得累，休息一下更适宜。
适宜.en: If you feel tired, it's more appropriate to rest a bit.

适宜.zh: 这道菜口味清淡，适宜老人和孩子吃。
适宜.en: This dish is light in flavor, suitable for the elderly and children.

适宜.zh: 不适宜的运动方式反而会伤害身体。
适宜.en: Unsuitable exercise methods can actually harm your body.

养老.en: This place is very suitable for retirement.
He plans to go back to the countryside for retirement.

养老.zh: 现在很多年轻人开始考虑养老问题。
养老.en: Many young people now are starting to consider retirement issues.

养老.zh: 这所养老院的设施非常完善。
养老.en: The facilities at this nursing home are very comprehensive.

养老.zh: 如果存够钱，我想去海边城市养老。
养老.en: If I save enough money, I want to retire in a coastal city.

百货.en: I'm going to the department store to shop.

百货.zh: 这家百货店的东西很全。
百货.en: This department store has a wide variety of items.

百货.zh: 周末百货商场人特别多。
百货.en: The department store is especially crowded on weekends.

百货.zh: 她喜欢逛百货商店的化妆品区。
百货.en: She likes to browse the cosmetics section of department stores.

百货.zh: 虽然网上购物方便，但百货店的体验感更好。
百货.en: Although online shopping is convenient, the experience at department stores is better.

花瓶.en: She put fresh flowers in the vase.

花瓶.zh: 在公司里，他被人当成花瓶。
花瓶.en: At the company, he is treated as a figurehead.

花瓶.zh: 这个古董花瓶值不少钱呢。
花瓶.en: This antique vase is worth quite a bit of money.

花瓶.zh: 我不喜欢那种只会当花瓶的演员。
花瓶.en: I don't like actors who are just eye candy.

挨着.en: My home is next to the park.
The two tables are placed next to each other.
His seat is next to mine.

挨着.zh: 超市就挨着地铁站，非常方便。
挨着.en: The supermarket is right next to the subway station, very convenient.

挨着.zh: 我们俩挨着坐，聊天很方便。
挨着.en: We sat next to each other, making it easy to chat.

比方.en: Let me give you an analogy and you'll understand.

比方.zh: 比方说，你每天跑步就能瘦下来。
比方.en: For example, if you run every day, you can lose weight.

比方.zh: 这个道理很简单，不如我打个比方。
比方.en: This principle is simple; let me give an analogy.

比方.zh: 比方说你想学游泳，就得先下水。
比方.en: For instance, if you want to learn to swim, you have to get in the water first.

比方.zh: 很多事情光靠比方是说不清楚的。
比方.en: Many things cannot be explained clearly just by analogies.

路面.en: This section of road is very flat.
The road is especially slippery after rain.

路面.zh: 施工导致路面坑坑洼洼的。
路面.en: Construction has left the road bumpy and uneven.

路面.zh: 开车时要注意路面状况。
路面.en: When driving, pay attention to road conditions.

路面.zh: 因为路面结冰，高速封了。
路面.en: Because the road is icy, the highway is closed.

橙.en: She bought a few pounds of oranges.
The orange sunset is especially beautiful.

橙.zh: 你帮我把那个橙切一下。

局限.zh: 能力有限是最大的局限。
局限.en: Limited ability is the biggest limitation.

局限.zh: 不要被自己的思维局限住。
局限.en: Don't be confined by your own thinking.

局限.zh: 虽然条件有局限，但我们还是完成了。
局限.en: Although conditions were limited, we still finished.

局限.zh: 每个工具都有它的局限和长处。
局限.en: Every tool has its limitations and strengths.

打牌.en: We like to play cards on weekends.

打牌.zh: 他一边喝茶一边和朋友们打牌。
打牌.en: He drinks tea while playing cards with friends.

打牌.zh: 虽然下雨了，我们还是去老张家打牌。
打牌.en: Although it rained, we still went to Lao Zhang's to play cards.
How well do you play cards?

打牌.zh: 过年的时候，全家人聚在一起打牌聊天。
打牌.en: During Chinese New Year, the whole family gathers to play cards and chat.

酱油.zh: 我买了一瓶老抽酱油来做红烧肉。
酱油.en: I bought a bottle of dark soy sauce to make braised pork.

酱油.zh: 他打酱油去了，一会儿就回来。
酱油.en: He went to buy soy sauce, will be back soon.
This soy sauce is a bit salty.

酱油.zh: 超市里的酱油种类很多，有生抽和老抽。
酱油.en: There are many types of soy sauce in the supermarket, like light and dark.

捐助.zh: 很多爱心人士捐助了书籍和文具。
捐助.en: Many caring people donated books and stationery.

捐助.zh: 公司决定捐助一个希望小学。
捐助.en: The company decided to donate to a Hope primary school.

捐助.zh: 他们呼吁大家积极捐助。
捐助.en: They appeal for everyone to actively donate.

捐助.zh: 因为疫情，我们通过线上平台捐助了医疗物资。
捐助.en: Because of the epidemic, we donated medical supplies through an online platform.

青春期.zh: 孩子到了青春期，父母要多花时间沟通。
青春期.en: When children reach adolescence, parents need to spend more time communicating.

青春期.zh: 青春期是身体和心理变化很大的阶段。
青春期.en: Adolescence is a stage of great physical and psychological changes.
She grew a lot during adolescence.

青春期.zh: 我记得自己青春期的时候特别喜欢听流行音乐。
青春期.en: I remember that during my adolescence I really liked listening to pop music.

球星.en: He is a famous soccer star.

球星.zh: 那个球星今天来我们城市参加活动。
球星.en: That sports star came to our city today for an event.

球星.zh: 很多年轻人把球星当作偶像。
球星.en: Many young people regard sports stars as idols.
Which sports star do you like most?

球星.zh: 他小时候的梦想就是成为一名球星。
球星.en: His childhood dream was to become a sports star.

面粉.en: Flour can be used to make bread.

面粉.zh: 今天我买了十斤面粉准备包饺子。
面粉.en: Today I bought ten jin of flour to make dumplings.
Flour spilled all over the floor.

面粉.zh: 他揉面粉的时候加了一点盐和糖。
面粉.en: When he kneaded the flour, he added a little salt and sugar.

快捷.zh: 坐地铁比开车更快捷，还不用找车位。
快捷.en: Taking the subway is faster than driving, and you don't need to find parking.

快捷.zh: 我们需要一个快捷的解决方案。
这家店的出餐速度很快捷。
快捷.en: This restaurant's food serving speed is very fast.

快捷.zh: 用手机支付既方便又快捷，现在大家都习惯了。
快捷.en: Paying by phone is both convenient and fast, everyone is used to it now.

空地.en: There is an open space ahead.

空地.zh: 小区里的空地被改造成了儿童游乐场。
空地.en: The open space in the community was transformed into a children's playground.

空地.zh: 他们在空地上种了很多花。
空地.en: They planted many flowers on the open land.

空地.zh: 那片空地一直空着没用。
空地.en: That open space has been unused.

空地.zh: 周末的时候，很多人去空地放风筝。
空地.en: On weekends, many people go to the open space to fly kites.

压缩.en: This file needs to be compressed.

压缩.zh: 为了节省空间，我把照片压缩了一下。
压缩.en: To save space, I compressed the photos.

压缩.zh: 空气被压缩后体积变小。
压缩.en: After air is compressed, its volume becomes smaller.

压缩.zh: 压缩包已经发送给你了。
压缩.en: The compressed archive has been sent to you.

压缩.zh: 他用了很长时间才把这个视频压缩完。
压缩.en: It took him a long time to finish compressing this video.

外衣.en: It's cold outside, put on your coat.

外衣.zh: 她把外衣脱下来挂在衣架上。
外衣.en: She took off her coat and hung it on the hanger.

外衣.zh: 这件外衣是羊毛的，很暖和。
外衣.en: This coat is made of wool, very warm.

外衣.zh: 你的外衣忘在我车上了。
外衣.en: You left your coat in my car.

外衣.zh: 他穿着一件黑色外衣，看起来很帅。
外衣.en: He is wearing a black coat, looks very handsome.

财物.zh: 出门旅行要保管好自己的财物。
财物.en: When traveling, take care of your belongings.

财物.zh: 他因为偷窃公司的财物，所以被开除了。
财物.en: He was fired because he stole company property.

财物.zh: 火灾中很多居民的财物都被烧光了。
财物.en: Many residents' belongings were burned in the fire.

秘书长.zh: 联合国秘书长今天访问了灾区。
秘书长.en: The UN secretary-general visited the disaster area today.

秘书长.zh: 如果秘书长不同意，这个计划就没办法执行。
秘书长.en: If the secretary-general disagrees, this plan cannot be implemented.

秘书长.zh: 新当选的秘书长来自非洲国家。
秘书长.en: The newly elected secretary-general is from an African country.
The secretary-general is in a meeting.

考古.zh: 考古学家在山上发现了古墓。
考古.en: Archaeologists found an ancient tomb on the mountain.

考古.zh: 因为对历史感兴趣，他大学选择了考古专业。
考古.en: Because he is interested in history, he chose archaeology as his major in college.

考古.zh: 这次的考古发掘需要很长时间。
考古.en: This archaeological excavation will take a long time.

很难说.en: This matter is hard to say.

很难说.zh: 他会不会来，真的很难说。
很难说.en: Whether he will come or not is really hard to say.

很难说.zh: 虽然天气看起来不错，但会不会下雨很难说。
很难说.en: Although the weather looks good, it's hard to say if it will rain.

很难说.zh: 比赛结果很难说，两队实力差不多。
很难说.en: The game result is hard to say; the two teams are similar in strength.
Whether it can succeed is hard to say.

限度.zh: 虽然你可以自由发言，但也要注意限度。
限度.en: Although you can speak freely, you also need to pay attention to limits.

限度.zh: 这种药的使用限度是每天三次。
限度.en: The usage limit for this medicine is three times a day.

姨.en: My aunt came to see me.

姨.zh: 大姨最喜欢给我做好吃的。
姨.en: My eldest aunt loves to cook delicious food for me.

姨.zh: 我妈妈有三个妹妹，其中二姨住得最近。
姨.en: My mother has three younger sisters, and the second aunt lives closest.

姨.en: During Spring Festival, we went to aunt's house to pay New Year's visit.

排放.en: Car exhaust emissions polluted the air.

排放.en: The government requires all factories to reduce wastewater discharge, otherwise they will be fined.

排放.zh: 这个城市的碳排放量一直在增加。
排放.en: This city's carbon emissions have been increasing.

白领.zh: 很多白领每天坐办公室。
白领.en: Many white-collar workers sit in the office every day.

白领.zh: 虽然他是白领，但收入并不比蓝领高多少。
白领.en: Although he is a white-collar worker, his income is not much higher than blue-collar.

白领.en: White-collar jobs have high pressure, often working overtime.

滑冰.en: I plan to go to the ice rink with friends this weekend.

滑冰.zh: 他因为滑冰摔倒了，膝盖受伤了。
滑冰.en: He fell while ice skating and hurt his knee.
Winter is best for ice skating.

密集.zh: 城市里的建筑非常密集。
密集.en: Buildings in the city are very dense.

密集.en: Because the meeting schedule was too intensive, he had almost no rest time.

密集.zh: 密集的枪声从远处传来。

交际.en: When work is busy, I rarely have time for socializing.

交际.zh: 交际能力在工作里很重要。
交际.en: Social skills are very important in the workplace.

交际.zh: 她性格内向，所以不常参加交际活动。
交际.en: She's introverted, so she doesn't often attend social events.

交际.zh: 虽然他不爱交际，但朋友还挺多的。
交际.en: Although he doesn't like socializing, he still has quite a few friends.

Sleeping on your back is bad for your neck.

仰.en: She tilted her face up to keep the tears from falling.

仰.zh: 因为个子矮，他总是仰视别人。
仰.en: Because he's short, he always looks up at others.

字幕.zh: 我看外语片必须开字幕。
字幕.en: I have to turn on subtitles when watching foreign films.

字幕.zh: 字幕有时候会挡到画面。
他一边听歌一边看字幕学中文。
字幕.en: He learns Chinese by listening to songs and reading the subtitles.

字幕.zh: 虽然字幕翻译得不太准确，但还能看懂。
字幕.en: Although the subtitle translations aren't very accurate, I can still understand.

亚军.en: He got second place in the competition.

亚军.zh: 虽然是亚军，但他已经很开心了。
亚军.en: Even though it's second place, he's already very happy.

亚军.zh: 这次马拉松的亚军是一名业余选手。
亚军.en: The runner-up of this marathon was an amateur athlete.

亚军.zh: 她去年拿了冠军，今年却只得了亚军。
亚军.en: She won the championship last year, but this year she only got second place.

亚军.zh: 因为他只差0.1秒，所以遗憾地成了亚军。
亚军.en: Because he was only 0.1 seconds behind, he regrettably became the runner-up.

徒弟.en: The master teaches the apprentice how to cook.

徒弟.zh: 他收了三个徒弟，个个都很厉害。
徒弟.en: He took on three apprentices, and each one is very skilled.

徒弟.zh: 徒弟学了一年，终于能独立干活了。
徒弟.en: After studying for a year, the apprentice can finally work independently.

徒弟.zh: 虽然徒弟犯了不少错，但师父一直很有耐心。
徒弟.en: Although the apprentice made many mistakes, the master was always patient.

前者.zh: 我喜欢前者，不喜欢后者。
前者.en: I like the former, not the latter.

前者.en: Coffee and tea; the former keeps you awake, the latter helps you relax.

前者.en: Xiao Li and Xiao Wang; the former is an engineer, the latter is a designer.

号召.en: In response to the call, I joined volunteer activities.

间隔.en: Take the medicine every two hours, and keep the intervals even.

间隔.en: If the interval is too long, it's easy to forget what you learned before.

感想.en: After hearing his speech, everyone had deep thoughts.

感想.en: Although we lost the game, my feeling is that I learned a lot.

入境.en: He was stopped by the police as soon as he entered the country.

入境.en: Because the documents were incomplete, he could not successfully enter the country.

入境.en: Now many countries require a nucleic acid test report for entry.

账单.en: If you don't pay the bill, the water will be cut off.

短缺.en: This city faces a housing shortage.

短缺.en: Due to the supply shortage, prices have risen a lot.

短缺.zh: 人才短缺影响了公司发展。
短缺.en: The talent shortage has affected the company's development.

菊花.zh: 虽然菊花很漂亮，但有些人会对它过敏。

菊花.zh: 菊花在中国文化中象征高洁。
菊花.en: Chrysanthemums symbolize purity in Chinese culture.

夸奖.en: Mom always praises me for being serious about studying.

盲人.en: Society should care more about the blind community.

起源.en: There are many theories about human origins.

火柴.en: Because the lighter ran out of gas, I used a match to light the candle.

火柴.en: When we were kids, we often played with matches.

耳环.en: She changes earrings every day to match her clothes.

坚固.zh: 因为材料坚固，所以这座建筑能用很久。

海域.en: We discovered oil in that sea area.

海域.zh: 因为海域污染严重，所以鱼类减少。
海域.en: Because the sea area is heavily polluted, fish numbers are decreasing.

输送.en: They use trucks to transport supplies.

输送.zh: 这个系统可以输送大量数据。
输送.en: This system can transmit large amounts of data.

输送.zh: 因为道路不通，所以输送中断了。
输送.en: Because the road was blocked, the transport was interrupted.

功效.en: This face mask has whitening effects.

功效.zh: 这种茶的养生功效不错。
功效.en: This tea has good health benefits.

功效.zh: 这款产品的功效已经被证实。
功效.en: The efficacy of this product has been proven.

功效.zh: 虽然它功效显著，但是价格昂贵。
功效.en: Although it is very effective, it is expensive.

口头.en: This is just a verbal promise.

口头.zh: 他口头答应了，但没行动。
口头.en: He agreed verbally but didn't act.

口头.zh: 口头交流比书面更直接。
口头.en: Oral communication is more direct than written.

口头.zh: 我们口头约定明天见面。
口头.en: We verbally agreed to meet tomorrow.

口头.zh: 口头表达需要多加练习。

就读.zh: 我女儿就读小学一年级。
就读.en: My daughter is in first grade of elementary school.
He is currently a graduate student.

就读.zh: 他曾经就读于这所中学。
就读.en: He once studied at this middle school.

就读.zh: 虽然就读名校，但他很谦虚。
就读.en: Although he attends a prestigious school, he is very modest.

勇于.en: You must have the courage to admit mistakes.
He is brave enough to take responsibility.

勇于.zh: 勇于面对困难才能进步。
勇于.en: Only by facing difficulties courageously can you progress.
He dares to try new things.

勇于.zh: 虽然害怕，但她勇于挑战。
勇于.en: Although scared, she has the courage to challenge.

日夜.zh: 为了考试，她日夜不停地复习。
日夜.en: For the exam, she studied day and night without stopping.

日夜.zh: 妈妈日夜照顾生病的奶奶。
日夜.en: Mom takes care of the sick grandmother day and night.

日夜.zh: 他们日夜赶工，终于完成了项目。
日夜.en: They worked day and night and finally completed the project.
Reversing day and night is bad for your health.

反思.zh: 这次失败让我好好反思了一下。
反思.en: This failure made me reflect carefully.

反思.zh: 我们需要反思为什么会出现这个问题。
反思.en: We need to reflect on why this problem occurred.

反思.zh: 她反思了很久，终于想通了。
反思.en: She reflected for a long time and finally figured it out.
Reflection is the first step to improvement.

麦克风.zh: 歌手拿着麦克风唱了一首歌。
麦克风.en: The singer held the microphone and sang a song.

麦克风.zh: 这个麦克风声音不太清楚。
麦克风.en: This microphone's sound is not very clear.

麦克风.zh: 他试了试麦克风，然后开始演讲。
麦克风.en: He tested the microphone and then started the speech.

麦克风.zh: 演出前别忘了检查麦克风。
麦克风.en: Don't forget to check the microphone before the performance.

公元.zh: 这个建筑建于公元8世纪。
公元.en: This building was built in the 8th century AD.

公元.zh: 公元前的历史也很有趣。
公元.en: The history before the common era is also very interesting.

公元.zh: 公元元年是耶稣出生的那一年。
公元.en: The year 1 AD is the year Jesus was born.
In 1644 AD, the Ming dynasty fell.

流量.en: The mobile data is used up.
This website has a lot of traffic.

流量.zh: 我的手机套餐流量不够用。
流量.en: The data in my phone plan is not enough.

流量.zh: 因为流量太多，网络变慢了。
流量.en: Because there is too much traffic, the network became slow.

流量.zh: 这个月流量已经超了，要加钱。
流量.en: The data this month has already exceeded the limit, and I need to pay extra.

厂商.zh: 不同的厂商质量不一样。
我联系了厂商，他们同意维修。
厂商.en: I contacted the manufacturer, and they agreed to repair it.

厂商.zh: 厂商说下个月会推出新产品。
厂商.en: The manufacturer said they will launch new products next month.

厂商.zh: 我们和几家厂商都谈过合作。
厂商.en: We have discussed cooperation with several manufacturers.

高原.en: The air is thin on the plateau.

高原.zh: 去高原旅游要注意身体。
高原.en: When traveling to the plateau, you need to take care of your health.

高原.zh: 他住在高原，习惯了那里的气候。
高原.en: He lives on the plateau and is used to the climate there.

高原.zh: 高原反应让很多人不舒服。
高原.en: Altitude sickness makes many people uncomfortable.

套餐.en: This meal deal is a good value.

套餐.zh: 手机套餐包括流量和通话。
套餐.en: The phone plan includes data and calls.

套餐.zh: 套餐里有一份沙拉和一杯饮料。
套餐.en: The set meal includes a salad and a drink.

套餐.zh: 如果你选这个套餐，可以省不少钱。
套餐.en: If you choose this plan, you can save a lot of money.

图表.en: Please look at the data in the chart.

图表.zh: 我画了一个图表来展示结果。
图表.en: I drew a chart to show the results.

图表.zh: 根据图表，销售额上升了。
图表.en: According to the chart, sales have increased.

图表.zh: 图表显示，今年的业绩比去年好。
图表.en: The chart shows that this year's performance is better than last year's.

考核.en: The company has assessments every year.
The assessment results will affect the bonus.

考核.zh: 他通过了这次考核，很开心。
考核.en: He passed this assessment and is very happy.

考核.zh: 考核前要好好准备一下。
考核.en: You need to prepare well before the assessment.

考核.zh: 这个考核很难，但我还是及格了。
考核.en: This assessment was hard, but I still passed.

食欲.en: The weather is too hot, my appetite is poor.

食欲.zh: 虽然很累，但看到美食还是有了食欲。
食欲.en: Even though I was tired, seeing the delicious food still gave me an appetite.

食欲.zh: 你吃点开胃菜，食欲就会来了。
食欲.en: Eat some appetizers, and your appetite will come.

食欲.zh: 他生病了，所以一点食欲都没有。
食欲.en: He is sick, so he has no appetite at all.

风雨.en: It's very windy and rainy outside.

风雨.zh: 不管风雨多大，我都会准时到。
风雨.en: No matter how strong the wind and rain, I will arrive on time.

风雨.zh: 经过这么多风雨，他们感情更好了。
风雨.en: After going through so many storms, their relationship has grown stronger.

风雨.zh: 风雨过后，天空出现了彩虹。
风雨.en: After the wind and rain, a rainbow appeared in the sky.

瓷器.en: This set of porcelain is very expensive.
Handle it carefully, don't break the porcelain.

瓷器.zh: 奶奶送我的瓷器，我一直好好收着。
瓷器.en: I've kept the porcelain that Grandma gave me carefully.
Porcelain from Jingdezhen is very famous.

瓷器.zh: 他把瓷器摆在了柜子里，特别好看。
瓷器.en: He placed the porcelain in the cabinet, and it looks especially beautiful.

起义.en: The people launched an armed uprising.

起义.zh: 历史上有很多农民起义的故事。
起义.en: There are many stories of peasant uprisings in history.

起义.zh: 起义军占领了这座城市。
起义.en: The insurgent army occupied this city.

起义.zh: 他们因为不满压迫而起义。
起义.en: They rose up because of their dissatisfaction with oppression.

布满.en: The sky is covered with dark clouds.
His face is covered with wrinkles.

布满.zh: 整个山坡都布满了野花，非常漂亮。
布满.en: The entire hillside is covered with wildflowers, very beautiful.

布满.zh: 墙上布满了涂鸦，没人清理。
布满.en: The wall is covered with graffiti, no one cleans it.

布满.zh: 她眼睛里布满血丝，肯定没睡好。
布满.en: Her eyes are bloodshot; she definitely didn't sleep well.

日后.en: You will understand in the future.

日后.zh: 如果你现在努力，日后一定会成功。
日后.en: If you work hard now, you will surely succeed in the future.

日后.zh: 这件事我们日后慢慢聊。
日后.en: We'll talk about this matter slowly another day.

日后.zh: 他把钱存起来，以备日后使用。
日后.en: He saved the money for future use.

严禁.en: The school strictly forbids students from bringing cell phones.

严禁.zh: 图书馆里严禁大声说话，请保持安静。
严禁.en: Loud talking is strictly prohibited in the library; please keep quiet.

严禁.zh: 工地上严禁不戴安全帽。
严禁.en: Not wearing a hard hat is strictly forbidden on the construction site.

严禁.zh: 这个区域严禁拍照，请大家注意。
严禁.en: Photography is strictly prohibited in this area; please be aware.

劳动力.en: There is a shortage of labor in rural areas.

劳动力.zh: 这家工厂需要很多劳动力。
劳动力.en: This factory needs a lot of labor.

劳动力.zh: 随着经济发展，劳动力成本越来越高。
劳动力.en: With economic development, labor costs are getting higher and higher.

劳动力.zh: 年轻劳动力大量流向城市。
劳动力.en: A large number of young laborers are moving to cities.

劳动力.zh: 我们的项目缺少熟练劳动力。

抽象.en: Abstract paintings are not easy to understand.

抽象.zh: 他讲的东西太抽象，我听不懂。
抽象.en: What he said was too abstract; I couldn't understand it.

抽象.zh: 小孩子很难理解抽象的数字。
抽象.en: Young children have difficulty understanding abstract numbers.

抽象.zh: 我不喜欢抽象艺术，更喜欢写实的。
抽象.en: I don't like abstract art; I prefer realistic art.

采纳.zh: 领导经过讨论，决定采纳这个计划。
采纳.en: After discussion, the leader decided to adopt this plan.

采纳.zh: 如果大家同意，我们就采纳这个意见。
采纳.en: If everyone agrees, we'll adopt this opinion.

采纳.zh: 他的设计没有被采纳，有点失望。
采纳.en: His design was not adopted, so he's a bit disappointed.

分工.en: Let's divide the work and cooperate.
The division of labor in the team is very clear.

分工.zh: 这次任务需要合理分工。
分工.en: This task requires a reasonable division of labor.

分工.zh: 他们分工明确，所以效率很高。
分工.en: They have a clear division of labor, so the efficiency is high.

分工.zh: 如果分工不合理，项目就会拖很久。
分工.en: If the division of labor is unreasonable, the project will drag on for a long time.

率先.en: He was the first to raise his hand and speak.

率先.zh: 公司率先推出了新产品。
率先.en: The company pioneered the launch of the new product.
We should take the lead in action.

率先.zh: 在改革中，他们率先尝试了新方法。
率先.en: During the reform, they were the first to try new methods.

率先.zh: 虽然风险很大，但他还是率先同意了。
率先.en: Although the risk was high, he still agreed first.

影星.en: She is a famous movie star.

影星.zh: 影星们经常参加慈善活动。
影星.en: Movie stars often participate in charity events.

影星.zh: 那个影星的新电影很受欢迎。
影星.en: That movie star's new film is very popular.

影星.zh: 我小时候很崇拜这位影星。
影星.en: When I was young, I really admired this movie star.

影星.zh: 虽然他是影星，但生活很低调。
影星.en: Although he is a movie star, he lives a low-key life.

历经.en: He has gone through many difficulties.

历经.zh: 这座城市历经了百年变迁。
历经.en: This city has experienced a century of changes.

历经.zh: 她历经千辛万苦才成功。
历经.en: She succeeded after going through all kinds of hardships.

历经.zh: 这个家族历经几代人的努力。
历经.en: This family has gone through the efforts of several generations.

历经.zh: 历经风雨之后，他们终于团聚了。
历经.en: After going through storms, they finally reunited.

对立.zh: 这两个党派一直处于对立状态。
对立.en: These two parties have been in opposition.

对立.zh: 我们不应该制造对立情绪。
对立.en: We shouldn't create a confrontational atmosphere.

对立.zh: 在讨论中，双方意见对立得很厉害。
对立.en: In the discussion, the two sides had sharply opposing opinions.

对立.zh: 虽然他们是对立的，但私下关系还不错。
对立.en: Although they are opposed, their private relationship is still good.

阔.en: There is a wide open space in the square.

阔.zh: 他穿着阔腿裤看起来很时尚。
阔.en: He looks stylish wearing wide-leg pants.

阔.zh: 这间客厅很阔，可以放很多家具。
阔.en: This living room is very spacious and can hold a lot of furniture.

科幻.zh: 这本小说是科幻题材的。
科幻.en: This novel is a sci-fi theme.

科幻.zh: 科幻作品常常描写未来世界。
科幻.en: Sci-fi works often depict the future world.

科幻.zh: 他写了一部很受欢迎的科幻小说。
科幻.en: He wrote a very popular sci-fi novel.

科幻.zh: 虽然科幻是想象，但有时会变成现实。
科幻.en: Although sci-fi is imagination, it sometimes becomes reality.

厂家.en: The manufacturer is producing new goods.
We order directly from the manufacturer.
The manufacturer says they can ship next week.

厂家.zh: 因为厂家延迟，交货时间推迟了。
厂家.en: Because the manufacturer delayed, the delivery time was postponed.

跳水.en: He likes diving as a sport.

跳水.zh: 那个选手跳水动作很完美。

跳水.en: The stock market has dived recently.

跳水.zh: 她从十米台跳水，很勇敢。
跳水.en: She dived from the ten-meter platform, very brave.

跳水.zh: 虽然跳水很刺激，但也要注意安全。
跳水.en: Although diving is exciting, you also need to pay attention to safety.

推行.en: The company is implementing a new policy.
This plan is hard to implement.

推行.zh: 政府正在推行垃圾分类。
推行.en: The government is promoting waste sorting.

推行.zh: 学校推行了新的教学方式。
推行.en: The school has introduced a new teaching method.

推行.zh: 虽然有人反对，但他们还是坚持推行。
推行.en: Although some oppose it, they still insist on implementing it.

话筒.zh: 他拿起话筒，开始唱这首歌。
话筒.en: He picked up the microphone and started singing this song.

话筒.zh: 我把话筒递给你，你来发言吧。
话筒.en: I'll pass the microphone to you, you speak.

话筒.zh: 虽然话筒坏了，但演出还是继续了。
话筒.en: Although the microphone broke, the show still continued.

话筒.zh: 主持人拿着话筒，问观众一个问题。
话筒.en: The host held the microphone and asked the audience a question.

钟头.zh: 他每天睡八个钟头，精神很好。
钟头.en: He sleeps eight hours a day and feels great.

钟头.zh: 咱们再聊半个钟头就回家吧。
钟头.en: Let's chat another half hour then go home.

钟头.zh: 因为路上堵车，我迟到了两个钟头。
钟头.en: Because of traffic, I was two hours late.

钟头.zh: 这部电影长达三个钟头，有点累。
钟头.en: This movie is three hours long, a bit tiring.

台球.zh: 他台球打得很好，经常赢比赛。
台球.en: He plays pool very well and often wins competitions.
This pool hall has a nice environment.

台球.zh: 虽然我不太会打台球，但觉得很有趣。
台球.en: Although I'm not good at pool, I find it very interesting.

台球.zh: 周末我们约了几个朋友一起打台球。
台球.en: On weekends we invite a few friends to play pool together.

互助.zh: 这个社区有互助小组，大家一起解决问题。
互助.en: This community has mutual aid groups where everyone solves problems together.

互助.zh: 互助精神让我们的团队更团结。
互助.en: The spirit of mutual aid makes our team more united.

互助.zh: 只有通过互助，我们才能共同进步。
互助.en: Only through mutual aid can we progress together.

互助.zh: 学校鼓励学生之间开展互助学习。
互助.en: The school encourages students to engage in mutual learning.

丰收.en: This year is another harvest year.

丰收.zh: 农民们高兴极了，因为粮食大丰收。
丰收.en: The farmers were overjoyed because of a great grain harvest.

丰收.zh: 秋天到了，果园里一片丰收景象。
丰收.en: Autumn arrived, the orchard is full of harvest scene.

丰收.zh: 虽然天气不太好，但今年的水果还是丰收了。
丰收.en: Although the weather wasn't great, the fruit harvest was still bountiful this year.

丰收.zh: 我们公司今年业绩丰收，大家都很开心。
丰收.en: Our company had a bountiful performance this year, everyone is happy.

田径.en: He likes track and field sports.

田径.zh: 学校运动会包括很多田径项目。
田径.en: The school sports meeting includes many track and field events.

田径.zh: 她是一名田径运动员，跑步很快。
田径.en: She is a track and field athlete, runs very fast.

田径.zh: 因为从小就练田径，所以他身体素质很好。
田径.en: Because he trained in track and field since childhood, his physical fitness is very good.

田径.zh: 田径比赛在下午两点开始。
田径.en: The track and field competition starts at 2 PM.

趣味.zh: 他讲的趣味故事让孩子们笑得前仰后合。
趣味.en: The interesting stories he told made the children laugh uncontrollably.

趣味.zh: 这本书趣味性很强，适合小朋友看。
趣味.en: This book has strong entertainment value, suitable for children.

趣味.zh: 虽然学习很累，但我们要找到其中的趣味。
趣味.en: Although studying is tiring, we need to find the fun in it.

趣味.zh: 这个展览展示了科学的趣味。
趣味.en: This exhibition showcases the fun of science.

枯燥.zh: 每天做同样的工作，感觉有点枯燥。
枯燥.en: Doing the same work every day feels a bit dull.

枯燥.zh: 这本书内容枯燥，我看不进去。
枯燥.en: The content of this book is dry, I can't get into it.

枯燥.zh: 虽然数学课很枯燥，但我还是认真听讲。
枯燥.en: Although math class is boring, I still listen carefully.

枯燥.zh: 他说话方式很枯燥，没人愿意听。
枯燥.en: His way of speaking is very dull, no one wants to listen.

解说.en: He is commentating on this match.

解说.zh: 电视上足球比赛的解说非常专业。
解说.en: The commentary on the football match on TV is very professional.

解说.zh: 导游给我们解说这座古建筑的历史。
解说.en: The tour guide explained the history of this ancient building to us.

解说.zh: 因为她对电影很了解，所以她来解说这部纪录片。
解说.en: Because she knows a lot about movies, she will commentate on this documentary.

解说.zh: 解说员的声音很好听，让比赛更有意思。
解说.en: The commentator's voice is pleasant, making the match more interesting.

一口气.en: He drank it all in one gulp.

一口气.zh: 她一口气把书看完了，非常过瘾。
一口气.en: She finished the book in one sitting, very satisfying.

一口气.zh: 他一口气做了一百个俯卧撑。
一口气.en: He did a hundred push-ups in one go.

一口气.zh: 虽然很累，但他还是一口气爬到了山顶。
一口气.en: Although very tired, he climbed to the top in one breath.

一口气.zh: 别着急，慢慢说，别一口气说完。
一口气.en: Don't rush, speak slowly, don't say it all in one breath.

方言.en: He speaks with a bit of a dialect.

方言.zh: 这个方言的词很有意思。
方言.en: This dialect word is very interesting.

方言.zh: 虽然他在北京住了十年，但方言还是改不了。
方言.en: Although he has lived in Beijing for ten years, he still can't change his dialect.

方言.zh: 我们老家方言和普通话差别很大。
方言.en: There is a big difference between our hometown dialect and Mandarin.

方言.zh: 如果你学方言，最好多跟当地人聊天。
方言.en: If you want to learn a dialect, it's best to chat more with local people.

确立.zh: 新的规则需要尽快确立。
确立.en: New rules need to be established as soon as possible.

确立.zh: 经过多次讨论，他们终于确立了合作方向。
确立.en: After many discussions, they finally established the direction of cooperation.

确立.zh: 公司确立了新的发展目标，大家都很期待。
确立.en: The company has established new development goals, and everyone is looking forward to it.

确立.zh: 他通过努力确立了在行业内的地位。
确立.en: He established his position in the industry through hard work.

单调.zh: 每天吃一样的饭很单调。
单调.en: Eating the same meal every day is very monotonous.

单调.zh: 他觉得生活很单调，想找点新乐趣。
单调.en: He finds life very monotonous and wants to find some new fun.

单调.zh: 虽然颜色单调，但设计很精致。
单调.en: Although the color is monotonous, the design is very delicate.

单调.zh: 这部电影情节单调，看完就想睡觉。
单调.en: The plot of this movie is monotonous, and I want to sleep after watching it.

淹.en: Be careful not to submerge your phone.

淹.zh: 昨天暴雨，很多地方都淹了。
淹.en: Yesterday's heavy rain flooded many places.

淹.zh: 他不会游泳，差点淹在河里。
淹.en: He can't swim and almost drowned in the river.

淹.zh: 如果水位再上涨，这条街就会被淹。
淹.en: If the water level rises further, this street will be flooded.

优异.zh: 她在比赛中取得了优异的成绩。
优异.en: She achieved excellent results in the competition.

优异.zh: 因为工作优异，他得到了晋升机会。
优异.en: Because of his excellent work, he got a promotion opportunity.

优异.zh: 这家公司以优异的产品质量赢得了市场。
优异.en: This company won the market with excellent product quality.

媳妇.zh: 我媳妇今天加班，不回来吃饭。
媳妇.en: My wife is working overtime today and won't come back for dinner.

媳妇.zh: 邻居家的媳妇对婆婆特别孝顺。
媳妇.en: The neighbor's daughter-in-law is very filial to her mother-in-law.

媳妇.zh: 他找了个好媳妇，全家都很满意。
媳妇.en: He found a good wife, and the whole family is very satisfied.

媳妇.zh: 老王的媳妇性格开朗，大家都很喜欢她。
媳妇.en: Old Wang's wife has a cheerful personality, and everyone likes her very much.

北极.en: The North Pole is very cold.
There are polar bears at the North Pole.

北极.zh: 科学家在北极做了很多研究。
北极.en: Scientists have done a lot of research at the North Pole.
He dreams of going to the North Pole to see the aurora.

北极.zh: 由于全球变暖，北极的冰正在融化。
北极.en: Due to global warming, the ice at the North Pole is melting.

博览会.en: This expo is very large in scale.

博览会.zh: 我们公司今年参加了两次博览会。
博览会.en: Our company participated in two expos this year.

博览会.zh: 博览会上展出了很多新技术。
博览会.en: Many new technologies were exhibited at the expo.

博览会.zh: 这次国际博览会吸引了来自全球的参展商。
博览会.en: This international expo attracted exhibitors from all over the world.

儿科.en: My child is seeing a doctor in pediatrics.

儿科.zh: 这家医院的儿科很有名。
儿科.en: The pediatrics department of this hospital is very famous.

儿科.zh: 她毕业后选择了做儿科医生。
儿科.en: After graduation, she chose to become a pediatrician.

儿科.zh: 儿科医生需要很有耐心。
儿科.en: Pediatricians need to be very patient.

儿科.zh: 因为孩子发烧，我们赶紧去了儿科急诊。
儿科.en: Because the child had a fever, we rushed to the pediatric emergency room.

变质.en: This meat has been left too long and gone bad.

变质.zh: 食物变质后千万不要吃。
变质.en: Do not eat food after it has gone bad.

变质.zh: 夏天温度高，食物很容易变质。
变质.en: In summer, the temperature is high, and food easily spoils.

变质.zh: 如果发现食物变质，应该马上扔掉。
变质.en: If you find that food has gone bad, you should throw it away immediately.

贵重.zh: 他把贵重物品都锁在保险箱里了。
贵重.en: He locked all the valuables in the safe.

贵重.zh: 虽然这块表很贵重，但我平时舍不得戴。
贵重.en: Even though this watch is very expensive, I usually can't bear to wear it.

贵重.zh: 出门旅行时，贵重东西最好随身携带。
贵重.en: When traveling, it's best to keep valuables with you.

贵重.zh: 她说这些首饰太贵重了，不肯收下。
贵重.en: She said these jewelry pieces are too precious and refused to accept them.

看得见.zh: 从窗户看得见对面的公园。
看得见.en: You can see the park across from the window.

看得见.zh: 只要天气好，这里看得见远处的山。
看得见.en: As long as the weather is good, you can see the distant mountains from here.

看得见.zh: 他站得高，所以看得见整个操场。
看得见.en: He stood high, so he could see the entire playground.

看得见.zh: 虽然雾很大，但还是看得见那个红色招牌。
看得见.en: Even though the fog is thick, you can still see that red sign.

捆绑.zh: 他们把货物捆绑得很结实。
捆绑.en: They tied the goods up very securely.

捆绑.zh: 这两件事不能捆绑在一起处理。
捆绑.en: These two matters cannot be bundled together for handling.

捆绑.zh: 他用绳子把箱子捆绑好，防止运输途中散开。
捆绑.en: He tied the box with rope to prevent it from coming apart during transport.

捆绑.zh: 很多套餐都是把几个服务捆绑销售的。
捆绑.en: Many packages sell several services bundled together.

捆绑.zh: 如果捆绑太紧，反而容易把东西弄坏。
捆绑.en: If you tie it too tightly, it might actually damage the item.

动听.en: Her singing voice is very melodious.

动听.zh: 这首曲子弹起来非常动听。
动听.en: This piece sounds very beautiful when played.

动听.zh: 他讲的故事既动人又动听，大家都听入迷了。
动听.en: The story he told was both touching and melodious, and everyone was captivated.

动听.zh: 虽然歌词简单，但是旋律特别动听。
动听.en: Although the lyrics are simple, the melody is especially pleasing.

动听.zh: 窗外传来一阵动听的鸟叫声，让人心情变好了。
动听.en: A melodious bird song came from outside the window, lifting everyone's spirits.

二氧化碳.zh: 工厂排放的二氧化碳太多了。
二氧化碳.en: Factories emit too much carbon dioxide.

二氧化碳.zh: 如果空气中二氧化碳浓度太高，人会觉得闷。
二氧化碳.en: If the carbon dioxide concentration in the air is too high, people will feel stuffy.

二氧化碳.zh: 科学家在研究怎样减少二氧化碳的排放。
二氧化碳.en: Scientists are researching how to reduce carbon dioxide emissions.

二氧化碳.zh: 饮料里的气泡就是二氧化碳，喝多了容易打嗝。
二氧化碳.en: The bubbles in drinks are carbon dioxide; drinking too much can make you burp.

歌星.en: She is a famous pop star.

歌星.zh: 我喜欢听这位歌星的老歌。
歌星.en: I like listening to this singer's old songs.

歌星.zh: 那个歌星要来我们城市开演唱会了。
歌星.en: That pop star is coming to our city for a concert.

歌星.zh: 很多年轻人梦想成为歌星，但真正成功的不多。
歌星.en: Many young people dream of becoming pop stars, but not many truly succeed.

歌星.zh: 他虽然不是大歌星，但唱得比很多专业歌手都好。
歌星.en: Although he isn't a big pop star, he sings better than many professional singers.

急切.en: He is eagerly waiting for news.
Don't be so impatient; take it slow.

急切.zh: 她急切地想知道考试结果。
急切.en: She is anxious to know the exam results.

急切.zh: 老板急切地催我们赶紧把方案做完。
急切.en: The boss urgently urged us to finish the proposal quickly.

急切.zh: 看到孩子发烧，她急切地抱着他冲进医院。
急切.en: Seeing the child with a fever, she rushed into the hospital holding him urgently.

网吧.en: He is playing games at an internet cafe.

网吧.zh: 这家网吧的环境还算干净。
网吧.en: This internet cafe has a fairly clean environment.

网吧.zh: 周末网吧里全是学生，很难找到空位。
网吧.en: On weekends, internet cafes are full of students, and it's hard to find an empty seat.

网吧.zh: 以前我常去网吧上网，现在家里都有网了。
网吧.en: I used to go to internet cafes often, but now everyone has internet at home.

网吧.zh: 未成年人晚上不能进网吧，这是规定。
网吧.en: Minors are not allowed to enter internet cafes at night; that's the rule.

游戏机.en: My younger brother wants a game console.

游戏机.zh: 这种老式游戏机现在很少见了。
游戏机.en: This kind of old-style game console is rarely seen now.

游戏机.zh: 他整天抱着游戏机玩，也不出去运动。
游戏机.en: He plays with his game console all day and doesn't go out to exercise.

游戏机.zh: 小时候我攒了很久的钱才买到这台游戏机。
游戏机.en: When I was a child, I saved up for a long time to buy this game console.

游戏机.zh: 虽然游戏机很有趣，但也不能玩太久，对眼睛不好。
游戏机.en: Although game consoles are fun, you shouldn't play for too long; it's bad for your eyes.

长寿.en: Grandpa is in good health and lives a long life.

长寿.zh: 这里的人普遍比较长寿。
保持好心情是长寿的秘诀之一。
长寿.en: Keeping a good mood is one of the secrets to longevity.

长寿.zh: 科学家发现，少吃一点可能有助于长寿。
长寿.en: Scientists have found that eating a little less may contribute to a long life.

长寿.zh: 奶奶今年九十五岁了，算是非常长寿的老人了。
长寿.en: Grandma is ninety-five this year, which is considered a very long-lived elder.

脚印.zh: 雪地上有很多清晰的脚印。
脚印.en: There are many clear footprints in the snow.

脚印.zh: 他沿着脚印走，终于找到了出口。
脚印.en: He followed the footprints and finally found the exit.

脚印.zh: 这些脚印是昨天晚上留下的。
脚印.en: These footprints were left last night.

脚印.zh: 因为下雨，地上的脚印都模糊了。
脚印.en: Because of the rain, the footprints on the ground are blurred.

流入.en: The river flows into the sea.

流入.zh: 很多外国投资都流入了中国市场。
流入.en: A lot of foreign investment has flowed into the Chinese market.

流入.zh: 雨水通过管道然后流入下水道。
流入.en: Rainwater goes through pipes and then flows into the sewer.

流入.zh: 因为河流改道，所以不再流入这个湖了。
流入.en: Because the river changed course, it no longer flows into this lake.

流入.zh: 这条小溪的水最终会流入长江。
流入.en: The water from this stream will eventually flow into the Yangtze River.

小气.zh: 他连一杯咖啡都不请，真是太小气了。
小气.en: He won't even treat us to a cup of coffee—he's so stingy.

小气.zh: 你别那么小气，分一点给大家吧。
小气.en: Don't be so stingy; share some with everyone.

小气.zh: 因为小气，他朋友越来越少了。
小气.en: Because he's stingy, he has fewer and fewer friends.

小气.zh: 她虽然很有钱，但非常小气，从来不捐钱。
小气.en: Although she is very rich, she is extremely stingy and never donates money.

接连.en: It rained continuously for three days.

接连.zh: 他接连收到三封奇怪的信。
接连.en: He received three strange letters in a row.

接连.zh: 最近接连发生了好几起交通事故。
接连.en: Several traffic accidents have happened in a row recently.

接连.zh: 因为接连下雨，河里的水涨了很多。
接连.en: Because it rained continuously, the water in the river rose a lot.

接连.zh: 她接连工作了十几个小时，累坏了。
接连.en: She worked continuously for over ten hours and was exhausted.

进而.zh: 他先解决了小问题，进而处理大问题。
进而.en: He first solved the small problems, and then dealt with the big ones.

进而.zh: 我们先讨论方案，进而决定下一步。
进而.en: We'll discuss the plan first, and then decide the next step.

进而.zh: 了解基本概念后，进而学习更复杂的内容。
进而.en: After understanding the basic concepts, then study more complex content.

进而.zh: 他不仅完成了任务，进而还帮助了别人。
进而.en: He not only completed the task, but also helped others.

简化.en: This process needs to be simplified.

简化.zh: 公司决定简化申请手续，方便用户。
简化.en: The company decided to simplify the application process for user convenience.

简化.zh: 为了简化流程，公司取消了不必要的步骤。
简化.en: To simplify the process, the company eliminated unnecessary steps.

简化.zh: 老师把复杂的公式简化了，学生更容易理解。
简化.en: The teacher simplified the complex formulas, making them easier for students to understand.

简化.zh: 这本书简化了很多难懂的概念。
简化.en: This book simplifies many difficult concepts.

诚信.en: One must be honest and trustworthy.

诚信.zh: 这个商家很有诚信，从不欺骗顾客。
诚信.en: This business has great integrity and never cheats customers.

诚信.zh: 没有诚信的人很难交到真心朋友。
诚信.en: People without integrity find it hard to make true friends.

诚信.zh: 因为诚信问题，那家公司倒闭了。
诚信.en: Due to integrity issues, that company went bankrupt.

诚信.zh: 他向来以诚信闻名，大家都信任他。
诚信.en: He has always been known for his integrity, and everyone trusts him.

可口.zh: 这家餐厅的可乐鸡翅非常可口。
可口.en: The cola chicken wings at this restaurant are very tasty.

可口.zh: 妈妈做的蛋糕总是那么可口。
可口.en: Mom's cakes are always so delicious.

可口.zh: 虽然看起来很普通，但味道很可口。
可口.en: Although it looks ordinary, the taste is delicious.

可口.zh: 这瓶新出的饮料口味很可口，推荐你试试。
可口.en: This newly released drink has a delicious taste—I recommend you try it.

殖民地.en: This place used to be a colony.

殖民地.zh: 很多非洲国家以前是欧洲的殖民地。
殖民地.en: Many African countries were once European colonies.

殖民地.zh: 殖民地的历史对当地文化影响很大。
殖民地.en: The history of colonies has a great impact on local culture.

殖民地.zh: 他们讨论殖民地时期的经济政策。
殖民地.en: They discussed the economic policies of the colonial period.

殖民地.zh: 这个岛曾经是英国的殖民地，现在独立了。
殖民地.en: This island was once a British colony, but now it's independent.

再三.zh: 老师再三强调考试的重要性。
再三.en: The teacher repeatedly emphasized the importance of the exam.

再三.zh: 我跟他再三确认了时间之后，他才放心。
再三.en: After I repeatedly confirmed the time with him, he felt relieved.

再三.zh: 尽管父母再三反对，他还是坚持去了。
再三.en: Even though his parents repeatedly opposed it, he still insisted on going.

再三.zh: 他再三道歉，可是对方并不原谅他。
再三.en: He apologized repeatedly, but the other party did not forgive him.

海面.en: The sea surface is very calm.

海面.zh: 虽然海面看起来很平静，但水下其实有暗流。
海面.en: Although the sea surface looks calm, there are actually undercurrents underwater.

海面.zh: 从飞机上看，海面像一面蓝色的镜子。
海面.en: From the plane, the sea surface looks like a blue mirror.

海面.zh: 太阳慢慢从海面升起来。
海面.en: The sun slowly rose from the sea surface.

海面.zh: 因为风太大，海面掀起了大浪。
海面.en: Because the wind was too strong, big waves rose on the sea surface.

佛教.zh: 佛教在中国有很长的历史，影响了很多文化。
佛教.en: Buddhism has a long history in China and has influenced many cultures.

佛教.zh: 我的朋友每年都去佛教寺庙拜佛。
佛教.en: My friend goes to a Buddhist temple every year to worship Buddha.

佛教.zh: 佛教提倡慈悲和智慧，很多人因此修行。
佛教.en: Buddhism promotes compassion and wisdom, so many people practice it.

佛教.zh: 虽然我不信佛教，但我很尊重他们的信仰。
佛教.en: Although I don't believe in Buddhism, I respect their faith.

不耐烦.zh: 等了一个小时，她开始变得不耐烦。
不耐烦.en: After waiting for an hour, she started to get impatient.

不耐烦.zh: 妈妈对孩子不耐烦地说：“快点儿！”
不耐烦.en: The mother said impatiently to the child, 'Hurry up!'

不耐烦.zh: 因为服务员态度不好，顾客显得很不耐烦。
不耐烦.en: Because the waiter had a bad attitude, the customer looked very impatient.

不耐烦.zh: 如果你总是打断别人，他们就会不耐烦。
不耐烦.en: If you keep interrupting others, they will become impatient.

奖牌.zh: 奥运会上，中国运动员拿到了很多奖牌。
奖牌.en: At the Olympics, Chinese athletes won many medals.

奖牌.zh: 这块奖牌是他训练了十年的结果。
奖牌.en: This medal is the result of his ten years of training.

奖牌.zh: 孩子们在比赛后兴奋地展示自己的奖牌。
奖牌.en: The kids excitedly showed off their medals after the competition.

奖牌.zh: 虽然他没能拿到奖牌，但他已经尽力了。
奖牌.en: Although he didn't get a medal, he did his best.

商城.en: Let's go shopping at the mall.

商城.zh: 这个新开的商城很大，里面什么都有。
商城.en: This newly opened mall is huge and has everything inside.

商城.zh: 周末商城人特别多，不好停车。
商城.en: On weekends, the mall is super crowded and parking is hard.

商城.zh: 我跟朋友在商城吃了一顿饭，然后买了衣服。
商城.en: I had a meal with a friend at the mall and then bought some clothes.

商城.zh: 因为商城打折，所以很多人一大早就在门口排队。
商城.en: Because the mall was having a sale, many people lined up at the door early in the morning.

平方.zh: 我的公寓只有四十平方，但住着很舒服。
平方.en: My apartment is only 40 square meters, but it's very comfortable to live in.

平方.zh: 这个房间的面积是二十平方左右。
平方.en: The area of this room is about 20 square meters.

平方.zh: 他们买了一块地，大概有两百平方。
平方.en: They bought a piece of land, about 200 square meters.

平方.zh: 虽然房子只有五十平方，但是装修得很精致。
平方.en: Although the house is only 50 square meters, it's decorated very elegantly.

噪声.en: The noise outside is too loud.

噪声.zh: 晚上施工的噪声让我睡不着觉。
噪声.en: The noise from construction at night keeps me from sleeping.

噪声.zh: 城市里的噪声污染越来越严重。
噪声.en: Noise pollution in the city is getting worse.

噪声.zh: 为了减少噪声，窗户都换成了隔音的。
噪声.en: To reduce noise, the windows were replaced with soundproof ones.

噪声.zh: 如果你觉得噪声烦，可以戴上耳机听音乐。
噪声.en: If you find the noise annoying, you can put on headphones and listen to music.

余额.zh: 你银行卡里还有多少余额？
余额.en: How much balance is left on your bank card?

余额.zh: 手机话费余额不足，该充值了。
余额.en: The phone credit balance is insufficient; it's time to top up.

余额.zh: 购物前最好看看账户余额够不够。
余额.en: Before shopping, it's best to check if the account balance is enough.

余额.zh: 因为余额不够，所以付款没成功。
余额.en: Because the balance wasn't enough, the payment didn't go through.

海拔.en: The altitude here is very high.

海拔.zh: 西藏的平均海拔超过四千米。
海拔.en: The average altitude of Tibet exceeds 4,000 meters.

海拔.zh: 随着海拔升高，温度也会下降。
海拔.en: As altitude increases, the temperature also drops.

海拔.zh: 这个山的海拔是三千八百米。
海拔.en: The altitude of this mountain is 3,800 meters.

海拔.zh: 如果海拔太高，有些人会有高原反应。
海拔.en: If the altitude is too high, some people may experience altitude sickness.

跟前.zh: 他把车停在了超市跟前。
跟前.en: He parked the car in front of the supermarket.

跟前.zh: 别站在我跟前，挡到我看电视了。
跟前.en: Don't stand in front of me; you're blocking my view of the TV.

跟前.zh: 学校跟前有一家很好吃的面馆。
跟前.en: There's a very good noodle shop near the school.

跟前.zh: 他走到我跟前，轻轻说了一句话。
跟前.en: He walked up to me and softly said a word.

自言自语.en: He likes to talk to himself.

自言自语.zh: 你别自言自语了，跟我说说话吧。
自言自语.en: Stop talking to yourself, talk to me.

自言自语.zh: 一边走路一边自言自语，他不觉得尴尬吗？
自言自语.en: Talking to himself while walking, doesn't he feel embarrassed?

自言自语.zh: 我经常在洗澡的时候自言自语，觉得很放松。
自言自语.en: I often talk to myself in the shower and find it very relaxing.

自言自语.zh: 他自言自语的声音太大，把隔壁的人都吵醒了。
自言自语.en: He was talking to himself so loudly that he woke up the neighbors.

山坡.zh: 我们爬到山坡上放风筝。
山坡.en: We climbed the hillside to fly kites.

山坡.zh: 山坡上开满了五颜六色的花。
山坡.en: The hillside is covered with colorful flowers.

山坡.zh: 从山坡往下看，风景特别美。
山坡.en: Looking down from the hillside, the view is especially beautiful.

山坡.zh: 这个山坡太陡了，爬上去很累。
山坡.en: This hillside is too steep; climbing up is very tiring.

山坡.zh: 因为下了雨，山坡上的泥土变得很滑。
山坡.en: Because it rained, the soil on the hillside became very slippery.

只顾.en: He only cares about playing on his phone and ignores me.

只顾.zh: 你别只顾自己，也要想想别人。
只顾.en: Don't just think about yourself; also consider others.

只顾.zh: 她只顾着看电视，饭都忘了吃。
只顾.en: She was so absorbed in watching TV that she forgot to eat.

只顾.zh: 走路的时候只顾看手机，差点撞到人。
只顾.en: While walking, he was so focused on his phone that he nearly bumped into someone.

只顾.zh: 他虽然只顾赚钱，但心里还是关心家人的。
只顾.en: Although he only cares about making money, he still cares about his family deep down.

灾害.zh: 自然灾害是无法预测的。
这次灾害导致很多人失去家园。
灾害.en: This disaster caused many people to lose their homes.

灾害.zh: 政府派出了救援队去灾区应对灾害。
灾害.en: The government sent rescue teams to the disaster area to respond.

灾害.zh: 地震是一种很可怕的自然灾害。
灾害.en: Earthquakes are a very terrifying natural disaster.

灾害.zh: 如果灾害来了，我们要保持冷静并尽快撤离。
灾害.en: If a disaster comes, we need to stay calm and evacuate as soon as possible.

夏令营.zh: 孩子今年参加了夏令营。
夏令营.en: The child attended summer camp this year.

夏令营.zh: 夏令营的活动非常丰富有趣。
夏令营.en: The summer camp activities are very rich and fun.

夏令营.zh: 她在夏令营里交到了很多新朋友。
夏令营.en: She made many new friends at summer camp.

夏令营.zh: 明年暑假我打算去一个英语夏令营。
夏令营.en: Next summer vacation, I plan to go to an English summer camp.

夏令营.zh: 夏令营结束后，孩子们都舍不得离开。
夏令营.en: After the summer camp ended, the children were reluctant to leave.

干旱.zh: 今年夏天干旱得很厉害。
干旱.en: This summer's drought is very severe.

干旱.zh: 干旱导致庄稼都枯死了。
干旱.en: The drought caused the crops to wither and die.

干旱.zh: 这里已经连续三个月干旱了。
干旱.en: It has been dry here for three consecutive months.

干旱.zh: 干旱的时候，农民最担心水源问题。
干旱.en: During droughts, farmers are most worried about water sources.

干旱.zh: 政府采取措施应对干旱，比如人工降雨。
干旱.en: The government took measures to deal with the drought, such as cloud seeding.

抽空.en: I'll find time to go see you.
He found time to go back to his hometown.

抽空.zh: 你抽空把这份文件处理一下。
抽空.en: Take some time to deal with this document.

抽空.zh: 工作再忙，也要抽空锻炼身体。
抽空.en: No matter how busy work gets, you still need to find time to exercise.

抽空.zh: 周末我抽空把房间彻底打扫了一遍。
抽空.en: Over the weekend, I found time to thoroughly clean the room.

定价.zh: 这个产品的定价太高了。
定价.en: The pricing of this product is too high.

定价.zh: 定价要合理，才能吸引顾客。
定价.en: Pricing must be reasonable to attract customers.

定价.zh: 公司在考虑调整这款手机的定价。
定价.en: The company is considering adjusting the pricing of this phone.

定价.zh: 他们对这件艺术品给出了很高的定价。
定价.en: They gave a very high price for this artwork.

定价.zh: 定价之前，需要先了解市场行情。
定价.en: Before setting a price, you need to understand the market conditions.

坚硬.zh: 钻石是自然界最坚硬的物质。
坚硬.en: Diamond is the hardest natural substance.

坚硬.zh: 冰面太坚硬了，在上面走路很安全。
坚硬.en: The ice surface is very solid; it's safe to walk on.

坚硬.zh: 这种木材很坚硬，适合做家具。
坚硬.en: This type of wood is very hard, suitable for making furniture.

坚硬.zh: 她的心像石头一样坚硬，从不轻易感动。
坚硬.en: Her heart is as hard as stone; she is never easily moved.

内科.en: He registered for an internal medicine appointment.

内科.zh: 内科医生建议他做个全面检查。
内科.en: The internal medicine doctor suggested he get a full check-up.

内科.zh: 我肚子不舒服，应该看内科还是外科？
内科.en: My stomach is uncomfortable; should I see internal medicine or surgery?

内科.zh: 这家医院的内科主任很有经验。
内科.en: The head of the internal medicine department at this hospital is very experienced.

内科.zh: 内科病房在住院部的三楼。
内科.en: The internal medicine ward is on the third floor of the inpatient building.

技艺.zh: 她学了很多年，技艺已经炉火纯青了。
技艺.en: She studied for many years, and her skill has reached perfection.

技艺.zh: 这家店的师傅技艺很好，做出来的菜特别好吃。
技艺.en: The chef at this restaurant has great skills, and the dishes are especially delicious.

技艺.zh: 虽然他很年轻，但他在木工方面的技艺已经超过了老师傅。
技艺.en: Although he is very young, his woodworking skills have already surpassed the old master.

技艺.zh: 我们需要通过不断练习来提升自己的技艺。
技艺.en: We need to continuously practice to improve our skills.

专科.en: He studies at a vocational college.

专科.zh: 我打算报考一所专科院校。
专科.en: I plan to apply for a vocational college.

专科.zh: 专科毕业后，他直接找了一份技术工作。
专科.en: After graduating from vocational school, he directly found a technical job.

专科.zh: 虽然专科和本科不一样，但也能学到很多实用知识。
专科.en: Although vocational school is different from undergraduate, you can still learn a lot of practical knowledge.

专科.zh: 她先在专科读了两年，然后又考上了本科。
专科.en: She first studied at a vocational school for two years and then transferred to a university.

舟.en: A small boat drifts on the water.
Ancient people often used boats to cross rivers.

舟.zh: 我们坐着小舟在湖上划了很久。
舟.en: We rowed a small boat on the lake for a long time.

舟.zh: 风浪很大，舟几乎要翻了。
舟.en: The waves were huge, and the boat nearly capsized.

舟.zh: 如果他没及时登上那艘舟，可能就赶不上比赛了。
舟.en: If he hadn't boarded that boat in time, he might have missed the competition.

三明治.zh: 我早上吃了一个三明治。
三明治.en: I ate a sandwich this morning.

三明治.zh: 他喜欢在午餐时吃鸡肉三明治。
三明治.en: He likes to eat chicken sandwiches for lunch.

三明治.zh: 她做的三明治又好吃又健康。
三明治.en: The sandwiches she makes are both delicious and healthy.

三明治.zh: 如果你饿了，冰箱里还有两个三明治。
三明治.en: If you're hungry, there are two more sandwiches in the fridge.

三明治.zh: 我点了一份金枪鱼三明治，但是店里卖光了。
三明治.en: I ordered a tuna sandwich, but the store had sold out.

文艺.en: She is a literary and artistic youth.

文艺.zh: 这家咖啡馆的装修很文艺。
文艺.en: The decoration of this café is very artistic.

文艺.zh: 他平时喜欢看文艺电影和小说。
文艺.en: He usually likes to watch literary films and read novels.

文艺.zh: 虽然她学的是理工科，但内心特别文艺。
文艺.en: Although she studies science and engineering, she is very artistic at heart.

文艺.zh: 这个展览汇集了许多文艺作品，值得一看。
文艺.en: This exhibition brings together many literary and artistic works, worth a visit.

一律.en: All students must wear uniforms without exception.

一律.zh: 进图书馆一律不能带食物。
一律.en: No food is allowed in the library without exception.

一律.zh: 这些商品一律打折，最低五折。
一律.en: All these products are on sale, at least 50% off.

一律.zh: 不管你是谁，进这个区域一律要登记。
一律.en: No matter who you are, entering this area requires registration without exception.

一律.zh: 考试迟到超过半小时，一律取消资格。
一律.en: If you are more than half an hour late for the exam, you will be disqualified without exception.

对称.zh: 人的身体左右基本对称。
对称.en: The human body is basically symmetrical left and right.

对称.zh: 这座建筑的设计非常讲究对称美。
对称.en: The design of this building emphasizes the beauty of symmetry.

对称.zh: 他不喜欢对称的图案，更喜欢不对称的设计。
对称.en: He doesn't like symmetrical patterns; he prefers asymmetrical designs.

对称.zh: 如果你把纸对折，两边的图案是对称的。
对称.en: If you fold the paper in half, the patterns on both sides are symmetrical.

顿时.zh: 听到这话，他顿时愣住了。
顿时.en: Hearing this, he was instantly stunned.
The whole room immediately fell silent.

顿时.zh: 她看到礼物时，顿时高兴得跳了起来。
顿时.en: When she saw the gift, she immediately jumped with joy.

顿时.zh: 暴雨停了，天空顿时晴朗起来。
顿时.en: The heavy rain stopped, and the sky immediately cleared up.

顿时.zh: 他本来在生气，但听到解释后顿时消了气。
顿时.en: He was angry at first, but after hearing the explanation, he instantly calmed down.

畅通.en: This road is very smooth (no traffic).

畅通.zh: 现在高速公路畅通无阻。
畅通.en: The highway is now clear and unobstructed.

畅通.zh: 只要网络畅通，我就能在家办公。
畅通.en: As long as the internet is smooth, I can work from home.

畅通.zh: 下水道堵塞了，导致水流不畅通。
畅通.en: The drain is clogged, causing the water flow to be not smooth.

畅通.zh: 警方努力维持秩序，确保交通畅通。
畅通.en: The police worked hard to maintain order and ensure smooth traffic.

截至.zh: 截至昨天，已经有三百人报名了。
截至.en: As of yesterday, three hundred people had registered.

截至.zh: 活动截至到本月底，请抓紧时间。
截至.en: The event ends by the end of this month, please hurry.

截至.zh: 截至目前的调查结果显示，情况比预想的好。
截至.en: As of now, the survey results show the situation is better than expected.

截至.zh: 如果你错过了截至日期，就不能参加了。
截至.en: If you miss the deadline, you won't be able to participate.

公安.zh: 我昨天去公安局办了身份证。
公安.en: I went to the public security bureau yesterday to get my ID card.

公安.zh: 公安提醒大家注意防盗。
公安.en: The police remind everyone to be careful about theft.

公安.zh: 因为丢了钱包，我只好报警找公安帮忙。
公安.en: Because I lost my wallet, I had to call the police and ask for help.

公安.zh: 你知不知道公安局在哪儿？
公安.en: Do you know where the public security bureau is?

楼房.zh: 我们小区新建了一栋楼房。
楼房.en: A new building was built in our neighborhood.

楼房.zh: 这栋楼房里住了很多户人家。
楼房.en: Many families live in this building.

楼房.zh: 因为老旧楼房要拆，大家正在搬家。
楼房.en: Because the old buildings are going to be demolished, everyone is moving out.

楼房.zh: 站在楼房的顶层能看到整个城市。
楼房.en: Standing on the top floor of the building, you can see the whole city.

暴风雨.zh: 昨晚的暴风雨把树都刮倒了。
暴风雨.en: Last night's storm blew down all the trees.

暴风雨.zh: 暴风雨来临前，记得关好窗户。
暴风雨.en: Before the storm comes, remember to close the windows.

暴风雨.zh: 虽然天气预报说有暴风雨，但好像没那么严重。
暴风雨.en: Although the weather forecast said there would be a storm, it didn't seem that bad.

暴风雨.zh: 暴风雨过后，街上到处都是积水。
暴风雨.en: After the storm, there was water everywhere on the street.

科目.en: Which subject do you like best?

科目.zh: 我学车的时候科目二考了两次。
科目.en: When I learned to drive, I took Subject 2 twice.

科目.zh: 数学是我最头疼的科目。
科目.en: Math is the subject that gives me the biggest headache.

科目.zh: 这次考试科目太多了，我复习不过来。
科目.en: There are too many subjects for this exam; I can't review them all.

科目.zh: 除了必修科目，我还选了两门选修课。
科目.en: In addition to the required subjects, I also chose two elective courses.

高超.zh: 这位医生的手术水平非常高超。
高超.en: This doctor's surgical skills are extremely superb.

高超.zh: 她的绘画技艺十分高超，得过很多奖。
高超.en: Her painting skills are very superb, and she has won many awards.

高超.zh: 虽然年纪不大，但他的厨艺已经很高超了。
高超.en: Although he is young, his cooking skills are already superb.

高超.zh: 大家都佩服他高超的谈判技巧。
高超.en: Everyone admires his superb negotiation skills.

招生.en: The school has started recruiting students.

招生.zh: 今年的招生政策有变化。
招生.en: The admission policy has changed this year.

招生.zh: 这所大学每年招生人数有限。
招生.en: This university has a limited number of students each year.

招生.zh: 因为招生名额少，竞争特别激烈。
招生.en: Because there are few admission slots, the competition is especially fierce.

招生.zh: 招生简章上说需要提供成绩单。
招生.en: The admission brochure says that transcripts are required.

识字.zh: 现在的小孩三岁就开始识字了。
识字.en: Nowadays, children start learning to read at age three.

识字.zh: 奶奶虽然不识字，但记性特别好。
识字.en: Although my grandmother is illiterate, her memory is very good.

识字.zh: 识字是学习其他知识的基础。
识字.en: Literacy is the foundation for learning other knowledge.

识字.zh: 他通过识字软件学会了五百个字。
识字.en: He learned 500 characters through a literacy app.

送礼.en: Gifts are given during the New Year.
Chinese people like to give gifts during festivals.

送礼.zh: 给领导送礼要注意分寸。
送礼.en: You need to be careful about boundaries when giving gifts to your boss.

送礼.zh: 他因为送礼被单位批评了。
送礼.en: He was criticized by his unit for giving gifts.

送礼.zh: 送礼是门学问，不能太贵重也不能太随意。
送礼.en: Gift-giving is a skill; it can't be too expensive nor too casual.

打官司.zh: 打官司既费钱又费时间。
打官司.en: Going to court is both expensive and time-consuming.

打官司.zh: 如果协商不成，就只能打官司了。
打官司.en: If negotiations fail, the only option is to go to court.

打官司.zh: 他不想打官司，但对方不肯和解。
打官司.en: He didn't want to go to court, but the other side refused to settle.

候选.en: The candidate list has come out.

候选.zh: 他是这次比赛的候选选手。
候选.en: He is a candidate player for this competition.

候选.zh: 公司正在招募候选经理。
候选.en: The company is recruiting candidate managers.

候选.zh: 我们需要确定最终候选方案。
候选.en: We need to determine the final candidate plan.

候选.zh: 候选人的面试安排在明天下午。
候选.en: The candidate interviews are scheduled for tomorrow afternoon.

显出.zh: 虽然她没说话，但脸上显出笑意。
显出.en: Although she didn't speak, a smile showed on her face.

显出.zh: 经检查，问题显出是软件导致的。
显出.en: After inspection, the problem turned out to be caused by software.

显出.zh: 每次说谎时，他的眼睛都会显出不安。
显出.en: Every time he lies, his eyes show uneasiness.

出游.en: Let's go on a trip this weekend.

出游.zh: 今年长假我们计划出游去云南。
出游.en: This long holiday we plan to travel to Yunnan.
Remember to bring your documents before traveling.

出游.zh: 因为天气好，我们决定出游。
出游.en: Because the weather is good, we decided to go out.

出游.zh: 他每次出游都会拍很多照片，回家后整理。
出游.en: Every time he travels, he takes many photos and organizes them after returning home.

心疼.zh: 看到孩子摔倒了，她心疼得哭了。
心疼.en: Seeing the child fall, she cried with concern.
Don't begrudge money, spend when you should.

心疼.zh: 虽然很贵，但他一点都不心疼。
心疼.en: Although it's expensive, he doesn't feel a bit of regret.

心疼.zh: 她心疼男朋友天天加班，就做了夜宵送过去。
心疼.en: She felt sorry for her boyfriend working overtime every day, so she made a late-night snack and brought it to him.

加剧.zh: 工作压力加剧了他的失眠。
如果再不休息，你的头痛会加剧的。
加剧.en: If you don't rest, your headache will get worse.

加剧.zh: 暴雨加剧了城市的交通堵塞。
加剧.en: The heavy rain worsened the city's traffic jam.

加剧.zh: 他们的争吵让矛盾进一步加剧。
加剧.en: Their quarrel further intensified the conflict.

适度.zh: 喝酒适度对身体有好处。
适度.en: Drinking in moderation is good for health.

适度.zh: 虽然爱吃辣，但也要适度，不然胃受不了。
适度.en: Although you love spicy food, you should also be moderate, otherwise your stomach can't handle it.

适度.zh: 适度放松可以提高工作效率。
适度.en: Moderate relaxation can improve work efficiency.
Eat in moderation, don't get too full.

长辈.zh: 在长辈面前，说话要懂礼貌。
长辈.en: In front of elders, you should speak politely.

长辈.zh: 因为他是长辈，所以我们都听他的。
长辈.en: Because he is an elder, we all listen to him.
During the New Year, you should pay respects to elders.

长辈.zh: 她经常给长辈买礼物，很孝顺。
长辈.en: She often buys gifts for elders, very filial.

长假.en: Where to go for the May Day long holiday?

长假.zh: 今年国庆长假我打算回家。
长假.en: This National Day long holiday I plan to go home.

长假.zh: 虽然长假很爽，但结束后总不想上班。
长假.en: Although the long holiday is great, after it ends I always don't want to go to work.

长假.zh: 长假期间高速免费，很多人自驾出游。
长假.en: During the long holiday, highways are free, many people drive to travel.
Having a long holiday is the happiest.

定时.en: You need to take medicine on time.
This oven has a timer function.

定时.zh: 为了健康，我每天定时锻炼一小时。
定时.en: For health, I exercise for an hour at a fixed time every day.

定时.zh: 洗衣机定时半小时就好了。
定时.en: Set the washing machine timer for half an hour.
They agreed to meet at regular times.

减压.en: Listening to music can reduce stress.

减压.zh: 工作太忙的时候，记得给自己减压。
减压.en: When work is too busy, remember to relieve stress for yourself.

减压.zh: 如果你觉得压力大，可以试试运动来减压。
减压.en: If you feel stressed, you can try exercising to relieve pressure.
Taking a bath is very stress-relieving.

减压.zh: 周末去爬山是我的减压方式。
减压.en: Going hiking on weekends is my way to decompress.

附件.zh: 邮件附件里是今天的会议资料。
附件.en: The email attachment contains today's meeting materials.

附件.zh: 如果你没收到附件，我再发一次。
附件.en: If you didn't receive the attachment, I'll send it again.

庄稼.zh: 虽然天气不好，但庄稼依然长得不错。
庄稼.en: Although the weather was bad, the crops still grew well.

庄稼.zh: 这片地的庄稼被洪水淹了。
庄稼.en: The crops in this field were flooded.

清洁工.en: The cleaner is sweeping the floor.

清洁工.zh: 我们感谢清洁工的辛勤劳动。
