清洁工.en: We thank the cleaners for their hard work.

清洁工.zh: 清洁工每天很早来上班。
清洁工.en: The cleaner comes to work very early every day.

清洁工.zh: 因为清洁工打扫得很干净，所以办公室很整洁。
清洁工.en: Because the cleaner cleans very thoroughly, the office is very tidy.

清洁工.zh: 那位清洁工总是面带微笑。
清洁工.en: That cleaner always has a smile on their face.

新颖.zh: 他的想法非常新颖，大家都没想到。
新颖.en: His idea is very novel; no one had thought of it.

新颖.zh: 这部电影的剧情很新颖。
新颖.en: The plot of this movie is very novel.

新颖.zh: 虽然产品新颖，但价格太高了。
新颖.en: Although the product is novel, the price is too high.

新颖.zh: 新颖的创意总能吸引顾客。

传承.zh: 我们要把技艺传承给下一代。
传承.en: We need to pass down the skills to the next generation.

传承.zh: 这种手艺已经传承了三百年。
传承.en: This craft has been passed down for three hundred years.

传承.zh: 不仅学习技术，还要传承精神。
传承.en: Not only learn the technique, but also pass on the spirit.

传承.zh: 家风需要一代代传承下去。
传承.en: Family traditions need to be passed down from generation to generation.

省钱.zh: 自己做饭比叫外卖省钱多了。
省钱.en: Cooking yourself saves much more money than ordering takeout.

省钱.zh: 我们得想个省钱的方案。
省钱.en: We need to think of a money-saving plan.

省钱.zh: 虽然贵一点，但长期来看反而省钱。
省钱.en: Although it's a bit expensive, in the long run it actually saves money.

省钱.zh: 她特别会省钱，每个月都能存不少。
省钱.en: She is really good at saving money; she can save a lot each month.

甭.zh: 这事你甭管，我自己能搞定。
甭.en: You don't need to bother with this; I can handle it myself.
Don't be polite; it's what I should do.

甭.zh: 既然他不想去，那甭勉强他。
甭.en: Since he doesn't want to go, then don't force him.
You don't need to say more; I understand everything.

多媒体.zh: 老师用多媒体设备放了一段视频。
多媒体.en: The teacher used multimedia equipment to play a video.

多媒体.zh: 这个展览运用了多媒体技术。
不但有图片，还有多媒体动画。
多媒体.en: Not only are there pictures, but also multimedia animations.

多媒体.zh: 多媒体教学让课堂更有趣。
多媒体.en: Multimedia teaching makes the class more interesting.

稿子.zh: 编辑让我把稿子修改一下。
稿子.en: The editor asked me to revise the draft.

稿子.zh: 这篇稿子需要再检查一遍。
稿子.en: This draft needs to be checked again.

稿子.zh: 因为时间紧，稿子写得比较匆忙。
稿子.en: Because time was tight, the draft was written in a hurry.
He spent the whole night writing the draft.

王后.zh: 王后今天穿了一件红裙子。
王后.en: The queen wore a red dress today.

王后.zh: 她不仅是王后，还是一位慈善家。
王后.en: She is not only a queen but also a philanthropist.

王后.zh: 小时候我以为王后都很善良。
王后.en: When I was little, I thought all queens were kind.

王后.zh: 这部电影里的王后特别威风。
王后.en: The queen in this movie is very majestic.

王后.zh: 因为王后生病了，所以国王取消了宴会。
王后.en: Because the queen was sick, the king cancelled the banquet.

象棋.en: Do you know how to play Chinese chess?

象棋.zh: 公园里两个老人在下象棋。
象棋.en: Two old men are playing Chinese chess in the park.

象棋.zh: 我爸爸每天吃完晚饭都要下一盘象棋。
象棋.en: My dad plays a game of Chinese chess every day after dinner.

象棋.zh: 象棋虽然好玩，但需要很多耐心。
象棋.en: Although Chinese chess is fun, it requires a lot of patience.

象棋.zh: 他象棋下得很好，连老师都赢不了他。
象棋.en: He plays Chinese chess so well that even the teacher can't beat him.

工商.zh: 他学的专业是工商管理。
工商银行就在前面那条街上。
工商.en: The Industrial and Commercial Bank is on the street ahead.

工商.zh: 这家公司主要做工商注册服务。
工商.en: This company mainly provides business registration services.

工商.zh: 因为工商部门查得严，所以小店都关门了。
工商.en: Because the industry and commerce department is strict, all the small shops have closed.

工商.zh: 工商管理的课程虽然难，但很有用。
工商.en: Business administration courses are difficult but very useful.

奶粉.en: This can of milk powder is about to expire.

奶粉.zh: 给宝宝买奶粉要选大品牌。
奶粉.en: When buying milk powder for a baby, choose a big brand.

奶粉.zh: 奶粉用温水冲，别用开水。
奶粉.en: Mix the milk powder with warm water, not boiling water.

奶粉.zh: 昨天超市打折，我囤了好几罐奶粉。
奶粉.en: Yesterday the supermarket had a sale, so I stocked up on several cans of milk powder.

奶粉.zh: 有些奶粉里加了益生菌，对肠胃好。
奶粉.en: Some milk powders have probiotics added, which are good for digestion.

气概.zh: 军人就要有不怕死的气概。
气概.en: Soldiers must have a fearless spirit.

气概.zh: 面对困难，他表现出了非凡的气概。
气概.en: Facing difficulties, he showed extraordinary spirit.

气概.zh: 虽然个子小，但他做事很有男子气概。
气概.en: Although he is small, he acts with manly spirit.

气概.zh: 这种不服输的气概，值得我们学习。
气概.en: This kind of never-give-up spirit is worth learning from.

修车.en: My car is broken and needs repair.

修车.zh: 修车师傅说变速箱有问题。
修车.en: The mechanic said there's a problem with the transmission.

修车.zh: 昨天修车花了我两千块，真贵。
修车.en: Yesterday, car repair cost me two thousand yuan, really expensive.

修车.zh: 如果修车技术好，生意肯定不错。
修车.en: If you have good car repair skills, business is sure to be good.

晴朗.zh: 一个晴朗的下午，我们在公园散步。
晴朗.en: On a sunny afternoon, we took a walk in the park.

晴朗.zh: 天气预报说周末会变得晴朗。
晴朗.en: The weather forecast says it will become sunny on the weekend.

晴朗.zh: 虽然早上下了雨，但下午就晴朗了。
晴朗.en: Although it rained in the morning, it cleared up in the afternoon.

晴朗.zh: 晴朗的日子最适合出去拍照了。
晴朗.en: Sunny days are the best for going out to take photos.

轮子.zh: 这个行李箱的轮子很灵活。
轮子.en: The wheels on this suitcase are very smooth.

轮子.zh: 玩具车少了一个轮子，不能玩了。
轮子.en: The toy car is missing a wheel, so it can't be played with.

轮子.zh: 轮子坏了没关系，换个新的就行。
轮子.en: It doesn't matter if the wheel is broken, just replace it with a new one.

轮子.zh: 汽车有四个轮子，但备胎只有一个。
轮子.en: A car has four wheels, but only one spare tire.

空闲.zh: 空闲的时候你喜欢做什么？
空闲.en: What do you like to do in your free time?

空闲.zh: 虽然工作很忙，但我尽量抽空闲锻炼。
空闲.en: Although work is busy, I try to find free time to exercise.

空闲.zh: 等你有空闲了，我们一起去看电影吧。
空闲.en: When you have free time, let's go see a movie together.

空闲.zh: 他利用空闲时间学了一门新语言。
空闲.en: He used his free time to learn a new language.

岁数.zh: 他岁数大了，走路不方便。
岁数.en: He is old and has trouble walking.

岁数.zh: 虽然岁数小，但她很懂事。
岁数.en: Although she is young, she is very sensible.

岁数.zh: 到了这个岁数，身体最重要。
岁数.en: At this age, health is the most important.

岁数.zh: 别问女生的岁数，这不礼貌。
岁数.en: Don't ask a woman's age, it's impolite.

郊外.en: Let's go for a picnic in the suburbs.

郊外.zh: 周末我喜欢去郊外呼吸新鲜空气，放松一下。
郊外.en: On weekends I like to go to the outskirts to breathe fresh air and relax.

郊外.zh: 虽然住在市区很方便，但我更喜欢郊外的安静。
郊外.en: Although living in the city is convenient, I prefer the quiet of the suburbs.

郊外.zh: 郊外的空气比城里好多了。
郊外.en: The air in the suburbs is much better than in the city.

郊外.zh: 他们打算在郊外买一套房子。
郊外.en: They plan to buy a house in the suburbs.

湿度.zh: 夏天湿度太大，我觉得很不舒服。
湿度.en: In summer the humidity is too high, I feel very uncomfortable.

湿度.zh: 因为湿度低，皮肤很容易干燥。
湿度.en: Because the humidity is low, skin gets dry easily.

湿度.zh: 北方冬天的湿度比南方低很多。
湿度.en: In winter, the humidity in the north is much lower than in the south.

湿度.zh: 这个加湿器可以调节室内的湿度。
湿度.en: This humidifier can adjust the indoor humidity.

指头.zh: 切菜的时候小心别切到指头。
指头.en: When cutting vegetables, be careful not to cut your fingers.

指头.zh: 虽然伤口不大，但指头流血了。
指头.en: Although the wound is small, the finger is bleeding.
She counts on her fingers to calculate days.

指头.zh: 我的指头冻僵了，连手机都拿不住。
指头.en: My fingers are frozen stiff, I can't even hold my phone.

讲课.en: The teacher is giving a lecture.

讲课.zh: 这位教授讲课特别生动，学生们都很喜欢。
讲课.en: This professor's lectures are very vivid, students all like them.

讲课.zh: 他讲课的时候喜欢用很多例子，这样我们更容易理解。
讲课.en: When he lectures, he likes to use many examples, so we understand more easily.

讲课.zh: 今天下午有个专家来给我们讲课。
讲课.en: This afternoon an expert will come to give us a lecture.

往年.en: In past years, it was very cold at this time.

往年.zh: 往年的这个时候我们都在准备过年。
往年.en: At this time in previous years, we were all preparing for the New Year.

往年.zh: 虽然今年生意不好，但比往年还是要好一些。
往年.en: Although business is bad this year, it's still a bit better than previous years.

往年.zh: 往年的假期我都是在家休息，今年打算出去旅行。
往年.en: In previous years' holidays, I rested at home; this year I plan to travel.

往年.zh: 和往年相比，今年雨水明显多了。
往年.en: Compared to previous years, this year's rainfall is noticeably more.

节能.en: This air conditioner is very energy-saving.

节能.zh: 现在很多电器都标有节能等级。
节能.en: Now many appliances have energy efficiency ratings.

节能.zh: 为了节能，我们应该随手关灯。
节能.en: To save energy, we should turn off lights when leaving.

节能.zh: 节能灯泡比普通灯泡贵一些，但更省电。
节能.en: Energy-saving bulbs are a bit more expensive than ordinary bulbs, but they save more electricity.

节能.zh: 政府鼓励大家使用节能汽车。
节能.en: The government encourages everyone to use energy-saving cars.

便捷.zh: 住在火车站旁边，出行非常便捷。
便捷.en: Living next to the train station, travel is very convenient.

便捷.zh: 虽然贵一点，但坐高铁更便捷。
便捷.en: Although a bit more expensive, taking the high-speed rail is more convenient.

便捷.zh: 手机支付让购物变得更加便捷。
便捷.en: Mobile payment makes shopping more convenient.

便捷.zh: 这个新系统操作起来很便捷，容易上手。
便捷.en: This new system is very convenient to operate, easy to learn.

勤劳.zh: 奶奶一辈子都很勤劳，从不肯闲着。
勤劳.en: Grandma was hardworking all her life, never willing to be idle.

勤劳.zh: 因为勤劳，他很快就升职了。
勤劳.en: Because of hard work, he got promoted quickly.

勤劳.zh: 勤劳的农民每天天不亮就下地干活。
勤劳.en: Hardworking farmers go to the fields before dawn every day.

勤劳.zh: 我们从小就学会要勤劳节俭。
勤劳.en: We learned from childhood to be diligent and frugal.

中旬.en: I will travel on business in the middle of the month.

中旬.zh: 这个项目预计中旬就能完成。
中旬.en: This project is expected to be completed by mid-month.

中旬.zh: 虽然现在是月初，但中旬就要交报告了。
中旬.en: Although it's the beginning of the month, the report is due in mid-month.

中旬.zh: 我们打算中旬去海南旅游。
中旬.en: We plan to travel to Hainan in mid-month.
The rent is paid in the middle of each month.

更是.zh: 他本来就聪明，现在更是努力了。
更是.en: He was already smart, and now he works even harder.

更是.zh: 这种水果不仅好吃，价格更是便宜。
更是.en: This fruit is not only delicious, but the price is even cheaper.

更是.zh: 有了孩子以后，生活更是忙碌了。
更是.en: After having a child, life is even busier.

更是.zh: 对于年轻人来说，时间更是宝贵。
更是.en: For young people, time is even more precious.

用人.zh: 因为要扩大业务，所以今年他们打算多用人。
用人.en: Because they want to expand the business, they plan to hire more people this year.
This restaurant is very strict in hiring.

用人.zh: 用人不当会导致很多麻烦。
用人.en: Improper hiring can cause many problems.

用人.zh: 我们部门最近在招人，用人标准很高。
用人.en: Our department is recruiting recently, and the hiring standards are very high.

多元化.zh: 公司需要多元化发展，不能只靠一个产品。
多元化.en: The company needs diversified development; it can't rely on just one product.

多元化.zh: 中国有很多民族，文化很多元化。
多元化.en: China has many ethnic groups, and its culture is very diverse.

多元化.zh: 因为市场变化，他们开始实行多元化策略。
多元化.en: Due to market changes, they started implementing a diversification strategy.

多元化.zh: 教育应该注重多元化，不能只教课本知识。
多元化.en: Education should focus on diversity, not just teaching textbook knowledge.

口感.en: This fruit has a crispy texture.

口感.zh: 我喜欢这个面包，因为口感松软又不太甜。
口感.en: I like this bread because it's soft and not too sweet.

口感.zh: 这种巧克力口感丝滑，入口即化。
口感.en: This chocolate has a smooth texture and melts in your mouth.

口感.zh: 不同的烹饪方式会让肉的口感完全不同。
口感.en: Different cooking methods can make the texture of meat completely different.

口感.zh: 虽然看起来一样，但这两款面条口感差很多。
口感.en: Although they look the same, these two types of noodles have very different textures.

念书.zh: 因为家里穷，他小时候没机会念书。
念书.en: Because his family was poor, he had no chance to study as a child.

念书.zh: 你念书的声音很大，我在隔壁都听到了。
念书.en: You're reading aloud so loudly that I heard you from next door.

念书.zh: 他现在念书很努力，希望能考上好大学。
念书.en: He studies very hard now, hoping to get into a good university.

念书.zh: 别一直玩手机，去念书吧。
念书.en: Stop playing on your phone all the time; go study.

公鸡.zh: 小时候我奶奶养了一只大公鸡，特别凶。
公鸡.en: When I was young, my grandmother kept a big rooster that was very fierce.

公鸡.zh: 这只公鸡的羽毛颜色很漂亮。
公鸡.en: This rooster's feathers are very beautiful in color.

公鸡.zh: 公鸡和母鸡长得不一样，公鸡冠子更大。
公鸡.en: Roosters look different from hens; roosters have bigger combs.

公鸡.zh: 虽然公鸡很吵，但它能叫我们起床。
公鸡.en: Although roosters are noisy, they can wake us up.

招收.en: The school enrolls new students this year.

招收.zh: 这家公司正在招收有经验的程序员。
招收.en: This company is recruiting experienced programmers.

招收.zh: 因为疫情，很多大学减少了招收名额。
招收.en: Due to the pandemic, many universities reduced enrollment numbers.

招收.zh: 他们招收员工时很看重团队合作能力。
招收.en: When recruiting employees, they place great importance on teamwork ability.

招收.zh: 这个项目只招收年龄在18到25岁之间的人。
招收.en: This program only recruits people between the ages of 18 and 25.

以至.en: He is so busy that he forgot to eat.

以至.zh: 天气太热，以至大家都躲在屋里不敢出门。
以至.en: It was so hot that everyone hid inside and didn't dare to go out.

以至.zh: 他说话太快，以至我一句都没听懂。
以至.en: He spoke so fast that I didn't understand a single sentence.

以至.zh: 这个电影太感人，以至很多人都哭了。
以至.en: This movie was so touching that many people cried.

以至.zh: 因为连续下雨，以至河水上涨了很多。
以至.en: Because it rained continuously, the river rose a lot.

理科.en: My younger brother is good at science subjects.

理科.zh: 很多女生也喜欢学理科，比如物理和化学。
理科.en: Many girls also like studying science subjects, such as physics and chemistry.

理科.zh: 他选科的时候选了理科，因为以后好找工作。
理科.en: When choosing subjects, he chose science because it's easier to find a job later.

理科.zh: 理科和文科的学习方法很不一样。
理科.en: The study methods for science and liberal arts are very different.

理科.zh: 虽然我理科成绩一般，但我很喜欢做实验。
理科.en: Although my science grades are average, I really like doing experiments.

胶带.en: Please give me a roll of tape.

胶带.zh: 我用胶带把礼物盒封好了。
胶带.en: I sealed the gift box with tape.

胶带.zh: 这种胶带粘性很强，适合打包。
胶带.en: This kind of tape has strong adhesion, suitable for packing.

胶带.zh: 胶带用完了，你去便利店买一卷吧。
胶带.en: The tape is used up; go buy a roll at the convenience store.

胶带.zh: 他不小心把胶带粘到头发上了，好难拿下来。
胶带.en: He accidentally stuck the tape to his hair, and it's hard to remove.

平方米.zh: 这个房间有二十平方米。
他们买了一套一百二十平方米的房子。
这个广场面积很大，大概有五千平方米。
平方米.en: This square is very large, about 5,000 square meters.

平方米.zh: 因为租金贵，我们只租了一个三十平方米的小办公室。
平方米.en: Because the rent is expensive, we only rented a small 30-square-meter office.

平方米.zh: 装修公司说每平方米的装修费用大概五百块。
平方米.en: The decoration company said the decoration cost per square meter is about 500 yuan.

类别.zh: 请问这个产品属于哪个类别？
类别.en: Which category does this product belong to?

类别.zh: 电影类别有很多种，比如喜剧、动作片等。
类别.en: There are many movie categories, like comedy, action, etc.

类别.zh: 如果不知道类别，可以先查一下。
类别.en: If you don't know the category, you can check first.

类别.zh: 超市里的商品按类别摆放。
类别.en: Goods in the supermarket are arranged by category.

涌现.zh: 最近涌现出很多优秀的年轻作家。
涌现.en: Recently many excellent young writers have emerged.

涌现.zh: 随着经济发展，新机会也不断涌现。
涌现.en: With economic development, new opportunities keep emerging.

涌现.zh: 问题涌现时，我们要冷静处理。
涌现.en: When problems emerge, we need to handle them calmly.

涌现.zh: 那段时间涌现了许多感人的故事。
涌现.en: During that period, many touching stories emerged.

片断.zh: 他回忆了童年的几个片断。
片断.en: He recalled a few fragments of his childhood.

片断.zh: 虽然只看到片断，但也能猜出大概。
片断.en: Although only saw fragments, can still guess the gist.

片断.zh: 这些片断拼在一起就是完整的故事。
片断.en: Putting these fragments together gives the complete story.

片断.zh: 电影里有一段精彩的打斗片断。
片断.en: There is an exciting fight scene fragment in the movie.

教育部.en: The Ministry of Education issued new regulations.

教育部.zh: 教育部要求学校加强安全教育。
教育部.en: The Ministry of Education requires schools to strengthen safety education.

教育部.zh: 因为疫情，教育部调整了考试时间。
教育部.en: Because of the pandemic, the Ministry of Education adjusted the exam schedule.

教育部.zh: 教育部正在调查这个问题。
教育部.en: The Ministry of Education is investigating this issue.
He once worked in the Ministry of Education.

联网.en: This computer is not connected to the internet.

联网.zh: 现在很多家电都可以联网控制。
联网.en: Now many home appliances can be controlled via internet connection.

联网.zh: 只要联网，就能远程办公。
联网.en: As long as connected to internet, you can work remotely.

联网.zh: 请确认手机已经联网再试。
联网.en: Please confirm your phone is connected to the network before trying again.

联网.zh: 这个游戏需要联网才能玩。
联网.en: This game requires an internet connection to play.

客车.en: This passenger bus is very new.

客车.zh: 客车每小时一班，很方便。
客车.en: The passenger bus runs every hour, very convenient.

客车.zh: 因为客车晚点，我们等了很久。
客车.en: Because the bus was delayed, we waited a long time.
Passenger trains have hard seats and soft seats.

客车.zh: 他们乘坐长途客车去旅行。

为首.en: The team headed by him won.

为首.zh: 那个犯罪团伙以三人为首。
为首.en: That criminal gang is headed by three people.

为首.zh: 这个项目以张教授为首的团队负责。
为首.en: This project is handled by the team led by Professor Zhang.

为首.zh: 以她为首的部门业绩很好。
为首.en: The department led by her has good performance.

为首.zh: 代表团以市长为首访问了多国。
为首.en: The delegation, led by the mayor, visited several countries.

团圆.en: Mid-Autumn Festival is a day for reunion.

团圆.zh: 一家人终于团圆了，大家都哭了。
团圆.en: The family finally reunited, everyone cried.

团圆.zh: 虽然工作忙，但春节一定要回家团圆。
团圆.en: Although work is busy, must go home for reunion during Spring Festival.

团圆.zh: 希望所有家庭都能团圆。
他们分隔多年，今日终于团圆。
团圆.en: They were separated for years, finally reunited today.

待会儿.en: You go ahead, I'll come back later.

待会儿.zh: 如果待会儿下雨，我们就不出去了。
待会儿.en: If it rains later, we won't go out.

待会儿.zh: 待会儿吃饭的时候再聊。
待会儿.en: Let's talk later during the meal.

待会儿.zh: 这个文件待会儿再发给你。
待会儿.en: I'll send this document to you later.

单打.zh: 这场比赛是男子单打决赛。
单打.en: This match is the men's singles final.

单打.zh: 虽然单打难，但更有挑战性。
单打.en: Although singles is hard, it's more challenging.

单打.zh: 单打需要很强的个人能力。
她以前打双打，现在改练单打。
单打.en: She used to play doubles, now switches to singles.

棋子.en: This chess piece is very important.

棋子.zh: 下棋的时候，每一步棋子都要考虑清楚。
棋子.en: When playing chess, you need to think carefully about every move of each piece.

棋子.zh: 他觉得自己只是领导的一颗棋子。
棋子.en: He feels he's just a pawn of the leader.

棋子.zh: 虽然只是个小棋子，但它的位置很关键。
棋子.en: Although just a small chess piece, its position is crucial.

棋子.zh: 在这个计划里，我们都被当作棋子来用。
棋子.en: In this plan, we are all being used as pawns.

处长.en: Section Chief Wang is in a meeting.

处长.zh: 我们处长今天请假了，有事可以明天找他。
处长.en: Our department head is on leave today; you can see him tomorrow if there's something.

处长.zh: 这位处长对我们很照顾。
处长.en: This section chief takes good care of us.

处长.zh: 因为处长不在，所以文件先放我这里。
处长.en: Since the department head is absent, I'll keep the documents here for now.

处长.zh: 他当了三年副处长，终于升为处长了。
处长.en: He was deputy director for three years and finally became director.

反动.en: This kind of thinking is very reactionary.

反动.zh: 他因为发表反动言论被批评了。
反动.en: He was criticized for making reactionary remarks.

反动.zh: 那个年代反动派很猖狂。
反动.en: In that era, the reactionaries were very rampant.

反动.zh: 虽然现在没人提反动这个词了，但历史不能忘。
反动.en: Although no one mentions the word reactionary now, we shouldn't forget history.

反动.zh: 别把正常的批评都说成是反动的。
反动.en: Don't label all normal criticism as reactionary.

外头.zh: 你等一下，我外头有朋友来找我。
外头.en: Wait a moment, I have a friend outside looking for me.
It's too cold outside, come in quickly.

外头.zh: 如果你觉得闷，就去外头走走。
外头.en: If you feel stuffy, go for a walk outside.

外头.zh: 外头的声音太大了，我听不清。
外头.en: The noise outside is too loud, I can't hear clearly.

吉祥.en: Wishing you good luck and happiness.

吉祥.zh: 新年到了，家里贴了很多吉祥的装饰。
吉祥.en: The New Year has arrived, and there are many auspicious decorations at home.

吉祥.zh: 虽然只是个小物件，但大家都觉得它很吉祥。
吉祥.en: Although it's just a small item, everyone thinks it's very lucky.

吉祥.zh: 在中国文化里，红色代表吉祥。
吉祥.en: In Chinese culture, red represents auspiciousness.

求职.zh: 最近我一直在网上投简历求职。
求职.en: Recently I've been submitting resumes online for job hunting.

求职.zh: 求职面试需要提前准备。
求职.en: Job interview requires preparation in advance.

求职.zh: 因为经济不好，求职变得很难。
求职.en: Because the economy is bad, job hunting has become very difficult.

求职.zh: 她毕业后就开始了求职之路。
求职.en: After graduation, she started her job-seeking journey.

不择手段.zh: 为了赢这场比赛，他们不择手段。
不择手段.en: In order to win this match, they used any means.

不择手段.zh: 那个人为了钱不择手段。
不择手段.en: That person will stop at nothing for money.

不择手段.zh: 虽然他想成功，但也不能不择手段啊。
不择手段.en: Although he wants to succeed, he can't be unscrupulous.

不择手段.zh: 这种不择手段的做法让人很反感。
不择手段.en: This kind of unscrupulous behavior is very off-putting.

发愁.zh: 他为了房租的事正在发愁。
考试没考好，妈妈很发愁。
发愁.en: The exam didn't go well, mom is very worried.

发愁.zh: 因为找不到工作，他现在非常发愁。
发愁.en: Because he can't find a job, he's very worried now.

发愁.zh: 你发愁也没用，不如想办法解决。
发愁.en: Worrying won't help, better think of a solution.

散文.zh: 鲁迅的散文写得非常好，值得一读。
散文.en: Lu Xun's prose is very well written, worth reading.

散文.zh: 这篇散文描写了秋天的景色。
散文.en: This prose describes the autumn scenery.

散文.zh: 虽然散文不像小说那么吸引人，但很有韵味。
散文.en: Although prose is not as captivating as novels, it has a lot of charm.

散文.zh: 他最近在尝试写散文，记录生活。
散文.en: He recently tried writing prose to record life.

不值.en: This thing is not worth money.

不值.zh: 花那么多钱买一个包，我觉得不值。
不值.en: Spending so much money on a bag, I think it's not worth it.

不值.zh: 为了这个小事生气不值。
不值.en: Getting angry over this trivial matter is not worth it.

不值.zh: 虽然大家都说好，但我觉得不值这个价。
不值.en: Although everyone says it's good, I think it's not worth the price.
Him doing this is really not worthwhile.

相声.en: I want to go see a crosstalk performance.

相声.zh: 他俩说的相声特别搞笑，观众都笑翻了。
相声.en: Their crosstalk was hilarious; the audience cracked up.

相声.zh: 我小时候最爱听收音机里的相声。
相声.en: When I was little, I loved listening to crosstalk on the radio.

相声.zh: 你听过郭德纲的相声吗？我觉得他讲得很有意思。
相声.en: Have you heard Guo Degang's crosstalk? I think he's very entertaining.

相声.zh: 虽然相声是北方曲艺，但现在南方也有很多人喜欢。
相声.en: Although crosstalk is a northern folk art, now many southerners also like it.

朴素.zh: 我喜欢这种朴素的装修风格，看起来舒服。
朴素.en: I like this simple decoration style; it looks comfortable.

朴素.zh: 他虽然有钱，但生活一直很朴素。
朴素.en: Although he's rich, he has always lived a frugal life.

朴素.zh: 用朴素的文字也能写出动人的故事。
朴素.en: Even with simple words, you can write moving stories.

朴素.zh: 这个村子的人都很朴素，待人特别真诚。
朴素.en: People in this village are very plain and treat others with great sincerity.

国歌.en: Please all stand and play the national anthem.

国歌.zh: 奥运会颁奖时，我听到国歌特别激动。
国歌.en: When the national anthem played at the Olympic awards ceremony, I felt very excited.

国歌.zh: 每个学生都应该会唱自己国家的国歌。
国歌.en: Every student should be able to sing their country's national anthem.

国歌.zh: 我们学校的升旗仪式上，大家都大声唱国歌。
国歌.en: At our school's flag-raising ceremony, everyone sings the national anthem loudly.

国歌.zh: 虽然国歌只有短短几分钟，但每次听都让我很自豪。
国歌.en: Although the national anthem is only a few minutes long, it makes me proud every time I hear it.

倒车.zh: 这个停车场太小了，倒车很难。
倒车.en: This parking lot is too small; it's hard to reverse.

倒车.zh: 他倒车的时候撞到了后面的柱子。
倒车.en: He hit the pillar behind when reversing.

倒车.zh: 我建议你装个倒车影像，安全很多。
倒车.en: I suggest you install a reverse camera; it's much safer.

倒车.zh: 前面堵车了，我们得找个地方先倒车掉头。
倒车.en: There's a traffic jam ahead; we need to find a place to reverse and turn around.

防治.en: In spring, pay attention to flu prevention.

防治.zh: 这个城市正在加强空气污染的防治工作。
防治.en: This city is strengthening its air pollution prevention and control efforts.

防治.zh: 多吃水果蔬菜有助于防治高血压。
防治.en: Eating more fruits and vegetables helps prevent and control high blood pressure.

防治.zh: 政府推出了一系列防治森林火灾的措施。
防治.en: The government has introduced a series of measures to prevent and control forest fires.

防治.zh: 医生说，早发现早治疗是防治癌症的关键。
防治.en: The doctor said that early detection and treatment are key to cancer prevention and control.

两侧.en: Both sides of the road are lined with trees.
Many paintings are hung on both sides of the corridor.

两侧.zh: 运动员入场时，观众在两侧热烈鼓掌。
两侧.en: When the athletes entered, the audience applauded warmly on both sides.

两侧.zh: 这条河的两侧都是农田。
两侧.en: Both sides of this river are farmlands.

两侧.zh: 为了防止摔倒，楼梯两侧都装了扶手。
两侧.en: To prevent falls, handrails are installed on both sides of the stairs.

风力.en: The wind is very strong today.

风力.zh: 这台风力发电机效率很高。
风力.en: This wind turbine is very efficient.

风力.zh: 天气预报说明天风力会减弱。
风力.en: The weather forecast says the wind will weaken tomorrow.

风力.zh: 风力发电是一种清洁能源，越来越受欢迎。
风力.en: Wind power is a clean energy source and is becoming more popular.

风力.zh: 在海上，风力常常能达到七八级。
风力.en: At sea, wind force often reaches force 7 or 8.

乐曲.en: This piece of music is really nice.

乐曲.zh: 他正在创作一首新的乐曲。
乐曲.en: He is composing a new piece of music.

乐曲.zh: 晚会上，乐队演奏了几首古典乐曲。
乐曲.en: At the party, the band played several classical pieces.

乐曲.zh: 听着优美的乐曲，我感觉心情放松了很多。
乐曲.en: Listening to the beautiful music, I felt much more relaxed.

乐曲.zh: 这首乐曲虽然很短，但旋律非常动人。
乐曲.en: Although this piece of music is very short, the melody is very touching.

母鸡.en: My grandmother keeps a few hens.

母鸡.zh: 那只母鸡正在带小鸡找食物。
母鸡.en: That hen is leading the chicks to find food.

母鸡.zh: 母鸡比公鸡安静多了，不会一大早就叫。
母鸡.en: Hens are much quieter than roosters; they don't crow early in the morning.

母鸡.zh: 我小时候最怕母鸡追着我跑。
母鸡.en: When I was a child, I was most afraid of hens chasing me.

片面.zh: 不要只凭一面之词就做判断，那样太片面。
片面.en: Don't judge based on just one side's story; that's too biased.

片面.zh: 我们分析问题时不能只看片面。
片面.en: We shouldn't look at only one aspect when analyzing problems.

片面.zh: 他说的虽然有理，但忽略了其他因素，有点片面。
片面.en: What he said is reasonable, but he ignored other factors, so it's a bit one-sided.

片面.zh: 如果你只从经济角度看这件事，就会得出片面的结论。
片面.en: If you only look at this issue from an economic perspective, you'll draw a one-sided conclusion.

清淡.en: The doctor told me to eat lighter food.

清淡.zh: 最近生意很清淡，没什么客人。
清淡.en: Business has been slow recently, with few customers.

清淡.zh: 我喜欢清淡的汤，不要放太多盐。
清淡.en: I prefer light soup, don't put too much salt.

清淡.zh: 虽然这家火锅店很出名，但我还是选了清淡的锅底。
清淡.en: Although this hotpot restaurant is famous, I still chose a mild broth base.

清淡.zh: 她生病了，所以只能吃些清淡的粥和蔬菜。
清淡.en: She's sick, so she can only eat some plain congee and vegetables.

酒水.en: Drinks are all included in this meal.

酒水.zh: 我们点的酒水什么时候能上来？
酒水.en: When will the drinks we ordered be served?

酒水.zh: 自助餐不包括酒水，需要另外付费。
酒水.en: The buffet does not include beverages; they need to be paid separately.

酒水.zh: 因为开车来的，所以我今晚不点任何酒水。
酒水.en: Since I drove here, I'm not ordering any alcoholic drinks tonight.

酒水.zh: 这家餐厅的酒水价格比超市贵很多。
酒水.en: The drink prices at this restaurant are much higher than at the supermarket.

新兴.zh: 人工智能是当前最热门的新兴技术。
新兴.en: Artificial intelligence is currently the hottest emerging technology.

新兴.zh: 很多年轻人选择去新兴城市找工作。
新兴.en: Many young people choose to go to emerging cities to look for jobs.

新兴.zh: 新兴企业虽然风险大，但发展潜力也很大。
新兴.en: Although emerging enterprises have high risks, their development potential is also great.

新兴.zh: 随着新兴市场的崛起，我们的产品销量增加了。
新兴.en: With the rise of emerging markets, our product sales have increased.

灯笼.zh: 门口挂着两个大红灯笼。
灯笼.en: Two big red lanterns are hung at the entrance.

灯笼.zh: 元宵节的时候，街上全是灯笼。
灯笼.en: During the Lantern Festival, the streets are full of lanterns.

灯笼.zh: 小孩提着一个灯笼，开心地跑来跑去。
灯笼.en: The child is carrying a lantern, running around happily.

灯笼.zh: 这些灯笼是手工做的，每一个都不一样。
灯笼.en: These lanterns are handmade, each one is different.

灯笼.zh: 虽然现在有电灯，但过年时大家还是喜欢挂灯笼。
灯笼.en: Although we have electric lights now, people still like to hang lanterns during the New Year.

发炎.zh: 伤口发炎了，需要及时处理。
发炎.en: The wound is infected and needs to be treated promptly.

发炎.zh: 牙疼是因为牙龈发炎了。
发炎.en: The toothache is because the gums are inflamed.

发炎.zh: 如果你觉得关节发炎，最好去看医生。
发炎.en: If you feel your joints are inflamed, it's best to see a doctor.

发炎.zh: 因为扁桃体经常发炎，他最后做了手术。
发炎.en: Because his tonsils were frequently inflamed, he finally had surgery.

饮用水.en: The drinking water here is very clean.

饮用水.zh: 出门记得带足够的饮用水。
饮用水.en: Remember to bring enough drinking water when you go out.

饮用水.zh: 这个小区安装了新的饮用水过滤系统。
饮用水.en: This residential area has installed a new drinking water filtration system.

饮用水.zh: 山上的泉水可以直接当饮用水喝吗？
饮用水.en: Can the spring water on the mountain be drunk directly as drinking water?

饮用水.zh: 为了保证安全，所有饮用水都要经过消毒处理。
饮用水.en: To ensure safety, all drinking water must go through disinfection treatment.

畔.en: We live on the east bank of the lake.
Many willow trees are planted along the riverbank.

畔.zh: 傍晚沿着河畔散步很舒服。
畔.en: It's very pleasant to take a walk along the riverbank in the evening.

畔.zh: 这座房子建在湖畔，风景特别好。
畔.en: This house is built on the lakeside, the scenery is especially nice.

畔.zh: 他们在江畔搭了个帐篷，打算露营过夜。
畔.en: They set up a tent by the riverside, planning to camp overnight.

年终.en: It's the end of the year, everyone is very busy.

年终.zh: 公司下个月开年终大会。
年终.en: The company will hold the year-end meeting next month.

年终.zh: 今年年终奖比去年少了一些。
年终.en: This year's year-end bonus is a bit less than last year's.

年终.zh: 年终总结不仅要写成绩，还要写不足。
年终.en: The year-end summary should include not only achievements but also shortcomings.

年终.zh: 因为业绩不理想，今年的年终派对取消了。
年终.en: Because the performance was unsatisfactory, this year's year-end party was canceled.

汇款.en: I need to go to the bank to send a remittance.

汇款.zh: 现在用手机就能汇款，很方便。
汇款.en: Now you can send money using your phone, it's very convenient.

汇款.zh: 他在国外工作，每个月都会汇款给家人。
汇款.en: He works abroad and sends remittances to his family every month.

汇款.zh: 因为汇率变动，这次汇款的手续费比上次高。
汇款.en: Due to exchange rate fluctuations, the handling fee for this remittance is higher than last time.

农产品.zh: 这些农产品都是有机的。
农产品.en: These agricultural products are all organic.

农产品.zh: 超市里的农产品价格最近涨了。
农产品.en: The prices of agricultural products in the supermarket have risen recently.

农产品.zh: 农民把农产品直接送到市场去卖。
农产品.en: Farmers deliver agricultural products directly to the market to sell.

农产品.zh: 这个地区的农产品因为品质好而很受欢迎。
农产品.en: The agricultural products from this region are very popular because of their good quality.

农产品.zh: 虽然进口的水果很漂亮，但我还是更喜欢本地的农产品。
农产品.en: Although imported fruits look beautiful, I still prefer local agricultural products.

独裁.zh: 虽然那个国家是民主，但其实是个独裁政府。
独裁.en: Although that country is democratic, it's actually a dictatorial government.

独裁.zh: 独裁者总是压制言论自由。
独裁.en: Dictators always suppress freedom of speech.
A dictatorship will collapse sooner or later.

独裁.zh: 很多人为了反抗独裁而付出了生命。
独裁.en: Many people sacrificed their lives to resist dictatorship.

赶不上.zh: 因为路上堵车，我肯定赶不上开会了。
赶不上.en: Because of a traffic jam, I definitely can't make it to the meeting.

赶不上.zh: 他的成绩太好，我怎么都赶不上。
赶不上.en: His grades are so good, I can never catch up.
Run fast, or we'll miss the movie.

赶不上.zh: 如果你再不快，我们就赶不上最后一班地铁了。
赶不上.en: If you don't hurry up, we'll miss the last subway.

喘气.en: After running, he was panting heavily.

喘气.zh: 爬完这座山，我累得连喘气都困难。
喘气.en: After climbing this mountain, I was so tired that breathing was difficult.

喘气.zh: 他紧张得连喘气都不敢大声。
喘气.en: He was so nervous that he didn't dare to breathe loudly.

西班牙语.zh: 她学了三年西班牙语，现在能流利地对话。
西班牙语.en: She studied Spanish for three years and can now converse fluently.

西班牙语.zh: 西班牙语在世界很多国家都通用。
西班牙语.en: Spanish is widely used in many countries around the world.

西班牙语.zh: 为了去西班牙旅游，我开始自学西班牙语。
西班牙语.en: In order to travel to Spain, I started learning Spanish on my own.

实惠.en: The things in this store are very good value.

实惠.zh: 虽然价格便宜，但质量不错，挺实惠的。
实惠.en: Although the price is cheap, the quality is good, quite practical.

实惠.zh: 买这个套餐比单点更实惠。
实惠.en: Buying this set meal is more cost-effective than ordering individually.
Value for money is the most important.

实惠.zh: 我们找一家实惠的餐厅吃晚饭吧。
实惠.en: Let's find a restaurant with good value for dinner.

梢.en: The bird stopped on the treetop.

梢.zh: 微风轻轻一吹，树梢上的叶子就沙沙响。
梢.en: A gentle breeze blew, and the leaves on the treetops rustled.
A hint of smile showed at the corner of his eyebrow.
The crescent moon hangs on the treetop.

梢.zh: 春天来了，树梢上长出了新芽。
梢.en: Spring has come, new buds have grown on the treetops.

无理取闹.zh: 他只是迟到了一会儿，你就这样无理取闹？
无理取闹.en: He was only a little late, and you're making such an unreasonable fuss?

无理取闹.zh: 顾客无理取闹，服务员很无奈。
无理取闹.en: The customer made an unreasonable scene, the waiter was helpless.

无理取闹.zh: 如果你再无理取闹，我就叫保安了。
无理取闹.en: If you keep making an unreasonable scene, I'll call security.

轮船.en: We take a ship to Shanghai.

轮船.zh: 那艘巨大的轮船缓缓驶离了港口。
轮船.en: That huge ship slowly departed from the port.
Life on the ship is very monotonous.

轮船.zh: 虽然坐轮船慢，但可以欣赏海景。
轮船.en: Although taking a ship is slow, you can enjoy the sea view.

一帆风顺.zh: 他的人生不是一帆风顺的，经历了很多挫折。
一帆风顺.en: His life has not been smooth sailing; he experienced many setbacks.

一帆风顺.zh: 事情没有那么一帆风顺。
虽然开头不太顺利，但后来总算一帆风顺了。
一帆风顺.en: Although the beginning was not smooth, later it went smoothly after all.

经商.zh: 这些年经商不容易，竞争很激烈。
经商.en: Doing business these years is not easy, competition is fierce.

经商.zh: 他父亲一辈子都在经商。
经商.en: His father was in business all his life.
Doing business requires a flexible mind.

经商.zh: 他从大学毕业后就决定经商，不再找工作。
经商.en: After graduating from university, he decided to go into business instead of looking for a job.

浓厚.en: This cup of coffee is very strong.

浓厚.zh: 他对中国文化有浓厚的兴趣。
浓厚.en: He has a strong interest in Chinese culture.

浓厚.zh: 房间里充满了浓厚的烟味。
浓厚.en: The room is filled with a thick smell of smoke.

浓厚.zh: 虽然天气不好，但大家的热情依然浓厚。
浓厚.en: Although the weather wasn't good, everyone's enthusiasm remained strong.

浓厚.zh: 这种酱料味道浓厚，适合拌面吃。
浓厚.en: This sauce has a rich flavor, suitable for mixing with noodles.

钢笔.zh: 他习惯用钢笔写字，觉得更有感觉。
钢笔.en: He is used to writing with a fountain pen, feeling it's more expressive.
This fountain pen was a gift from a friend.

钢笔.zh: 虽然现在都用电脑，但我还是喜欢用钢笔。
钢笔.en: Although everyone uses computers nowadays, I still prefer using a fountain pen.

钢笔.zh: 我的钢笔没墨水了，需要换。
钢笔.en: My fountain pen is out of ink; I need to replace it.

国产.zh: 现在国产车的质量越来越好了。
国产.en: Now the quality of domestically made cars is getting better and better.
Domestically made milk powder is also very famous.

国产.zh: 很多人支持买国产商品，因为性价比高。
国产.en: Many people support buying domestic products because they have good value for money.

国产.zh: 虽然进口货贵，但国产的也不错。
国产.en: Although imported goods are expensive, domestic ones are not bad either.

狠心.zh: 我狠心买下了那个包，虽然很贵。
狠心.en: I made up my mind and bought that bag, even though it was expensive.

狠心.zh: 为了减肥，她狠心戒掉了所有甜食。
狠心.en: To lose weight, she resolutely gave up all sweets.

狠心.zh: 老板狠心辞退了很多员工。
狠心.en: The boss ruthlessly fired many employees.

热水器.zh: 我家的热水器用了十年，该换了。
热水器.en: Our water heater has been used for ten years; it's time to replace it.
This water heater is very energy-efficient.

热水器.zh: 冬天没有热水器洗澡太痛苦了。
热水器.en: Taking a shower in winter without a water heater is too painful.

热水器.zh: 你记得关热水器，不然浪费电。
热水器.en: Remember to turn off the water heater, otherwise it wastes electricity.

匪徒.zh: 警察很快抓住了逃跑的匪徒。
匪徒.en: The police quickly caught the fleeing bandit.
The robbers took the bank's money.

匪徒.zh: 这个电影讲的是匪徒和警察的故事。
匪徒.en: This movie is a story about gangsters and police.

匪徒.zh: 虽然匪徒很凶，但最终还是被制服了。
匪徒.en: Although the gangsters were fierce, they were finally subdued.

常年.en: He works away from home all year round.

常年.zh: 这个地方常年下雨，很少出太阳。
常年.en: This place rains all year round, and the sun rarely comes out.
She exercises persistently throughout the year.

常年.zh: 因为常年熬夜，他的身体越来越差。
常年.en: Because he stays up late all year, his health is getting worse.

常年.zh: 这座山常年积雪，夏天也很冷。
常年.en: This mountain is covered with snow all year round; it's cold even in summer.

快车.en: I take the express train to Shanghai.

快车.zh: 快车比慢车贵一点，但省时间。
快车.en: The express train is a bit more expensive than the local train, but it saves time.
This express train doesn't stop at small stations.

快车.zh: 我们订了明天的快车票，早上出发。
快车.en: We booked tickets for tomorrow's express train, departing in the morning.

快车.zh: 如果赶时间，最好坐快车。
快车.en: If you're in a hurry, it's best to take the express train.

无边.zh: 草原无边，一眼望不到头。
无边.en: The grassland is boundless; you can't see the end at a glance.

无边.zh: 在无边的大沙漠里，很容易迷路。
无边.en: In the boundless desert, it's easy to get lost.

无边.zh: 虽然知识无边，但我们还是要努力学习。
无边.en: Although knowledge is boundless, we still need to study hard.

山峰.en: That mountain peak is very high.

山峰.zh: 我们爬到了山峰，看到了美丽的日出。
山峰.en: We climbed to the mountain peak and saw a beautiful sunrise.
The mountain peak is covered with white snow.

山峰.zh: 这座山峰是登山爱好者的挑战目标。
山峰.en: This mountain peak is a challenge goal for mountaineering enthusiasts.

山峰.zh: 虽然山峰陡峭，但他们还是成功登顶了。
山峰.en: Although the mountain peak was steep, they still successfully reached the summit.

方方面面.zh: 我们要考虑到方方面面。
方方面面.en: We need to consider all aspects.

方方面面.zh: 这个计划需要从方方面面去考虑，不能只看一个方面。
方方面面.en: This plan needs to be considered from all aspects, not just one side.

方方面面.zh: 他的生活方方面面都很顺利。
方方面面.en: Every aspect of his life is going smoothly.

方方面面.zh: 公司的发展涉及方方面面，比如财务、人事和销售。
方方面面.en: The company's development involves all aspects, such as finance, personnel, and sales.

方方面面.zh: 既然你想了解这个问题，就得从方方面面入手。
方方面面.en: Since you want to understand this issue, you have to start from all aspects.

民工.zh: 很多民工在城市里打工。
民工.en: Many migrant workers work in the city.

民工.zh: 那些民工每天都很辛苦地工作。
民工.en: Those migrant workers work very hard every day.

民工.zh: 民工为城市的建设做出了很大贡献。
民工.en: Migrant workers have made great contributions to the city's construction.

民工.zh: 过年的时候，很多民工都回家团圆了。
民工.en: During the Spring Festival, many migrant workers went home to reunite with their families.

民工.zh: 虽然工作很累，但民工们还是坚持着。
民工.en: Although the work is tiring, the migrant workers still persist.

益处.zh: 每天早睡早起对身体有很多益处。
益处.en: Going to bed early and waking up early every day has many benefits for your health.

益处.zh: 这本书讲的是喝茶的益处。
益处.en: This book talks about the benefits of drinking tea.

益处.zh: 多和乐观的人相处，对心情有好处，益处很多。
益处.en: Spending time with optimistic people is good for your mood and has many benefits.

益处.zh: 他告诉我们冥想对减压的益处非常大。
益处.en: He told us that meditation has great benefits for stress relief.

下功夫.zh: 如果你想学好英语，就得在听说读写上都下功夫。
下功夫.en: If you want to learn English well, you have to put effort into listening, speaking, reading, and writing.

下功夫.zh: 只有下功夫，才能取得好成绩。
下功夫.en: Only by putting in effort can you achieve good results.

民歌.en: I like listening to folk songs.

民歌.zh: 奶奶唱了一首她年轻时最喜欢的民歌。
民歌.en: Grandma sang a folk song that she liked most when she was young.

民歌.zh: 这首民歌在云南很流行。
民歌.en: This folk song is very popular in Yunnan.

民歌.zh: 他研究了很多不同地区的民歌。
民歌.en: He has studied many folk songs from different regions.

民歌.zh: 每到节日，他们就会唱起古老的民歌。
民歌.en: Every festival, they sing ancient folk songs.

天文.en: He is very interested in astronomy.

天文.zh: 天文望远镜能看到很远的地方。
天文.en: An astronomical telescope can see very far places.

天文.zh: 昨天我参加了一个天文讲座。
天文.en: Yesterday I attended an astronomy lecture.

天文.zh: 他从小就喜欢看天文书，长大当了科学家。
天文.en: He loved reading astronomy books since he was a child, and grew up to become a scientist.

天文.zh: 天文现象比如日食和月食，总是让人着迷。
天文.en: Astronomical phenomena like solar and lunar eclipses are always fascinating.

科普.en: This popular science book is very interesting.

科普.zh: 电视台经常播放一些科普节目，孩子们很喜欢看。
科普.en: TV stations often broadcast popular science programs, and children love to watch them.

科普.zh: 科普活动能帮助大家了解科学知识。
科普.en: Popular science activities can help people understand scientific knowledge.

科普.zh: 这个网站有很多科普视频，讲得特别清楚。
科普.en: This website has many popular science videos that explain things very clearly.

科普.zh: 为了让更多人了解环保，他们做了很多科普宣传。
科普.en: In order to let more people understand environmental protection, they did a lot of popular science promotion.

这就是说.zh: 他迟到了，这就是说，他可能遇到麻烦了。
这就是说.en: He is late; that is to say, he might be in trouble.

这就是说.zh: 这就是说，我们必须重新开始。
这就是说.en: That is to say, we have to start over.

这就是说.zh: 他同意了，这就是说，我们可以继续了。
这就是说.en: He agreed; that is to say, we can continue.

这就是说.zh: 天气不好，这就是说，今天的活动取消了。
这就是说.en: The weather is bad; that is to say, today's event is cancelled.

这就是说.zh: 她没回消息，这就是说，她可能很忙。
这就是说.en: She hasn't replied; that is to say, she might be busy.

朗读.zh: 每天早上我都朗读英语，这样口语会进步得很快。
朗读.en: Every morning I read English aloud, so my spoken English improves quickly.

朗读.zh: 他在比赛中朗读了一首诗。
朗读.en: He read a poem aloud in the competition.

朗读.zh: 老师让我们轮流朗读课文。
朗读.en: The teacher asked us to take turns reading the text aloud.

朗读.zh: 朗读不仅能提高语言能力，还能增强自信。
朗读.en: Reading aloud not only improves language skills but also boosts confidence.

遍地.zh: 洪水过后，遍地都是垃圾。
遍地.en: After the flood, garbage was everywhere.

遍地.zh: 秋天的时候，遍地金黄的落叶。
遍地.en: In autumn, golden fallen leaves are everywhere.

遍地.zh: 这个城市遍地都是共享单车，很方便。
遍地.en: This city has shared bikes everywhere, which is very convenient.

世界观.zh: 旅行能改变一个人的世界观。
世界观.en: Travel can change a person's worldview.

世界观.zh: 因为从小接触不同文化，她的世界观很开放。
世界观.en: Because she was exposed to different cultures from a young age, her worldview is very open.

世界观.zh: 我觉得这本书对我的世界观影响很大。
世界观.en: I think this book had a big impact on my worldview.

世界观.zh: 每个人都有自己的世界观，我们要尊重差异。
世界观.en: Everyone has their own worldview, and we need to respect differences.

少儿.en: This bookstore has a children's section.

少儿.zh: 少儿时期是培养兴趣的关键阶段。
少儿.en: Childhood is a key stage for cultivating interests.

少儿.zh: 他参加了少儿编程班，学得很开心。
少儿.en: He joined a children's programming class and enjoyed learning.

少儿.zh: 这本杂志专门为少儿设计，内容很有趣。
少儿.en: This magazine is specially designed for children, and the content is very interesting.

少儿.zh: 少儿图书馆周末有很多活动，比如讲故事和手工课。
少儿.en: The children's library has many activities on weekends, like storytelling and craft classes.

路况.en: How are the road conditions today?

路况.zh: 堵车的时候路况特别差。
路况.en: Road conditions are especially bad during traffic jams.

路况.zh: 导航提醒我们前面路况不好，建议绕行。
路况.en: The navigation warned us that the road conditions ahead are bad and suggested a detour.

路况.zh: 因为下雨，路况很滑，开车要小心。
路况.en: Because of the rain, the roads are slippery, so drive carefully.

路况.zh: 你出门前最好查一下实时路况，免得堵在路上。
路况.en: You'd better check the real-time road conditions before going out, to avoid getting stuck in traffic.

机动车.zh: 这条路禁止机动车通行。
机动车.en: Motor vehicles are prohibited on this road.

机动车.zh: 现在很多城市限制机动车数量。
机动车.en: Many cities now restrict the number of motor vehicles.

机动车.zh: 他的驾照是机动车驾驶证，可以开卡车。
机动车.en: His driver's license is for motor vehicles, so he can drive trucks.

机动车.zh: 机动车和非机动车混行容易出事故。
机动车.en: Mixed traffic of motor vehicles and non-motor vehicles easily leads to accidents.

机动车.zh: 为了环保，应该减少机动车的使用。
机动车.en: For environmental protection, we should reduce the use of motor vehicles.

皮球.en: The children are kicking a rubber ball.

皮球.zh: 这个皮球漏气了，打点气吧。
皮球.en: This rubber ball is deflated; pump some air into it.

皮球.zh: 他在院子里拍皮球，玩得很开心。
皮球.en: He is bouncing a rubber ball in the yard and having a lot of fun.

皮球.zh: 我把皮球扔给他，他接住了。
皮球.en: I threw the rubber ball to him, and he caught it.

皮球.zh: 皮球比足球轻，适合小孩子玩。
皮球.en: A rubber ball is lighter than a soccer ball, so it's suitable for young children.

颈椎.zh: 长时间低头对颈椎不好。
颈椎.en: Looking down for a long time is bad for the cervical spine.

颈椎.zh: 她每天做颈椎操来缓解疼痛。
颈椎.en: She does cervical spine exercises every day to relieve pain.

颈椎.zh: 医生建议我用一个颈椎枕来改善睡眠。
颈椎.en: The doctor recommended I use a cervical pillow to improve sleep.

颈椎.zh: 因为经常加班，他的颈椎出了问题，需要理疗。
颈椎.en: Because he often works overtime, his cervical spine has problems and needs physical therapy.

神色.zh: 他神色慌张地跑了进来。
神色.en: He ran in with a panicked expression.

神色.zh: 听到这个消息，她神色突然变了。
神色.en: Upon hearing this news, her expression suddenly changed.

神色.zh: 他神色平静地告诉我他辞职了。
神色.en: He told me calmly that he quit his job, with a composed expression.

神色.zh: 我看他神色不对，就问他怎么了。
神色.en: I saw that his expression was off, so I asked him what was wrong.

神色.zh: 虽然心里很紧张，但他表面上神色自如。
神色.en: Although he was very nervous inside, his expression remained calm on the surface.

原材料.zh: 这家工厂的原材料来自国外。
原材料.en: The raw materials for this factory come from abroad.

原材料.zh: 做蛋糕需要准备各种原材料。
原材料.en: To make a cake, you need to prepare various raw materials.

原材料.zh: 因为原材料涨价，产品也跟着贵了。
原材料.en: Because raw materials have increased in price, the products have also become more expensive.

原材料.zh: 他们正在开发一种环保的原材料替代品。
原材料.en: They are developing an environmentally friendly alternative to raw materials.

原材料.zh: 这个行业对原材料的质量要求很高，不能马虎。
原材料.en: This industry has very high quality requirements for raw materials, and you can't be careless.

斯文.en: He looks very gentle and refined.

斯文.zh: 别看他外表斯文，其实很能吃苦。
斯文.en: Although he looks gentle and refined, he can actually endure hardship.

斯文.zh: 她说话声音很小，动作也很斯文。
斯文.en: She speaks in a very soft voice and moves very gracefully.

斯文.zh: 这个男生戴个眼镜，穿衬衫，显得很斯文。
斯文.en: This guy wears glasses and a shirt, which makes him look very refined.

斯文.zh: 虽然他是个运动员，但平时举止非常斯文。
斯文.en: Although he is an athlete, he behaves very gently and politely in daily life.

胶水.en: When the glue dries, it won't stick anymore.

胶水.zh: 我需要一瓶胶水来修这本书。
胶水.en: I need a bottle of glue to repair this book.

胶水.zh: 这个胶水粘性很强，可以粘木头。
胶水.en: This glue is very strong and can stick wood.

胶水.zh: 你把胶水涂在纸上，然后按紧几分钟。
胶水.en: Apply the glue to the paper, then press firmly for a few minutes.

胶水.zh: 小朋友做手工时要用到胶水、剪刀和彩纸。
胶水.en: When children do crafts, they need glue, scissors, and colorful paper.

并存.zh: 这里传统和现代并存，很有特色。
并存.en: Tradition and modernity coexist here, very distinctive.

并存.zh: 虽然他们意见不同，但可以并存。
并存.en: Although they have different opinions, they can coexist.

并存.zh: 在这个城市，新旧建筑并存，形成独特的风景。
并存.en: In this city, old and new buildings coexist, forming a unique landscape.

并存.zh: 公司里两种管理风格并存，员工需要适应。
并存.en: Two management styles coexist in the company, and employees need to adapt.

从业.en: He has been in the profession for twenty years.

从业.zh: 因为热爱，所以他在这个行业从业至今。
从业.en: Because of passion, he has been working in this industry until now.

从业.zh: 很多人选择从业金融，因为收入高。
从业.en: Many people choose to work in finance because the income is high.

从业.zh: 虽然从业经验不足，但他学习很快。
从业.en: Although he lacks professional experience, he learns quickly.

用功.zh: 考试前他总是特别用功。
用功.en: He always works especially hard before exams.

用功.zh: 因为想考上好大学，所以他现在非常用功。
用功.en: Because he wants to get into a good university, he is studying very hard now.

用功.zh: 她每天用功到深夜，成绩自然好。
用功.en: She studies hard until late every night, so naturally her grades are good.

用功.zh: 虽然天赋一般，但用功可以弥补。
用功.en: Although talent is average, hard work can make up for it.

审美.zh: 每个人审美不同，自己喜欢就好。
审美.en: Everyone has different aesthetic tastes; just like what you like.

审美.zh: 这件衣服的审美很独特，一般人欣赏不了。
审美.en: This piece of clothing has a very unique aesthetic; ordinary people can't appreciate it.

审美.zh: 虽然审美很主观，但经典的东西大家都认可。
审美.en: Although aesthetics are subjective, classic things are recognized by everyone.

审美.zh: 她的审美风格偏向简约，不太喜欢花哨的设计。
审美.en: Her aesthetic style leans towards simplicity; she doesn't like flashy designs much.

总计.zh: 这次活动总计花了三千块。
总计.en: This event cost three thousand yuan in total.

总计.zh: 我们班总计有三十个学生，其中女生占一半。
总计.en: Our class has thirty students in total, half of whom are girls.

总计.zh: 他把所有费用加起来，总计一万两千元。
总计.en: He added up all the expenses, totaling twelve thousand yuan.

总计.zh: 虽然看起来很多，但总计才一百块。
总计.en: Although it looks like a lot, it's only one hundred yuan in total.

宏大.zh: 电影的场景非常宏大，让人震撼。
宏大.en: The movie's scenes are very grand, breathtaking.

宏大.zh: 虽然目标宏大，但只要努力就能实现。
宏大.en: Although the goal is ambitious, it can be achieved with effort.

宏大.zh: 这个项目的规模很宏大，需要很多人合作。
宏大.en: The scale of this project is huge and requires many people to cooperate.

宏大.zh: 他描述的未来蓝图非常宏大，令人向往。
宏大.en: The future blueprint he described is very grand and enticing.

共计.en: Our class has thirty-five people in total.

共计.zh: 这次旅行共计五天，行程很紧凑。
共计.en: This trip is five days in total, with a tight itinerary.

共计.zh: 所有货物共计十个箱子，请清点一下。
共计.en: All goods total ten boxes, please check.

共计.zh: 虽然单价便宜，但数量大，共计不少钱。
共计.en: Although the unit price is cheap, the quantity is large, so the total is quite a lot of money.

长跑.zh: 每天早上他都去公园长跑。
长跑.en: He goes for a long run in the park every morning.

长跑.zh: 长跑需要耐力，不是每个人都坚持得了。
长跑.en: Long-distance running requires endurance; not everyone can keep it up.

长跑.zh: 虽然长跑很累，但跑完很放松。
长跑.en: Although long-distance running is tiring, it feels relaxing after finishing.

长跑.zh: 他坚持长跑五年了，身体比以前好很多。
长跑.en: He has been doing long-distance running for five years, and his health is much better than before.

涂抹.zh: 墙上涂抹了一层新油漆。
涂抹.en: A new coat of paint was applied on the wall.

涂抹.zh: 涂完防晒霜后，她又涂抹了一层粉底。
涂抹.en: After applying sunscreen, she applied a layer of foundation.

涂抹.zh: 不要随意在纸上涂抹，会影响阅读。
涂抹.en: Don't scribble on the paper randomly; it will affect reading.

涂抹.zh: 虽然只是简单涂抹，但效果还不错。
涂抹.en: Although it's just a simple application, the effect is pretty good.

特快.en: Taking the express train is faster.
Choose express delivery when sending the package.

特快.zh: 这趟特快列车直达北京，中间不停。
特快.en: This express train goes directly to Beijing without stops.

特快.zh: 虽然特快比较贵，但省时间。
特快.en: Although express is more expensive, it saves time.

特快.zh: 他每次寄重要文件都用特快，怕延误。
特快.en: He sends important documents by express every time, afraid of delays.

梅花.en: The plum blossoms have bloomed, so beautiful.

梅花.zh: 冬天的时候，梅花在雪地里开得特别好看。
梅花.en: In winter, plum blossoms bloom especially beautifully in the snow.

梅花.zh: 我喜欢梅花，因为它很坚强。
梅花.en: I like plum blossoms because they are very resilient.

梅花.zh: 公园里种了很多梅花，每年春天都有人去看。
梅花.en: There are many plum blossoms planted in the park, and people go to see them every spring.

梅花.zh: 梅花香自苦寒来，这句话很有道理。
梅花.en: The saying 'plum blossom fragrance comes from bitter cold' makes a lot of sense.

园林.zh: 这个园林设计得很雅致。
园林.en: This garden is designed very elegantly.

园林.zh: 苏州的园林很有名，我去年去过一次。
园林.en: Suzhou's gardens are very famous; I went there once last year.

园林.zh: 我家附近有一个小园林，周末常常去散步。
园林.en: There's a small garden near my home, and I often go for walks there on weekends.

园林.zh: 园林里的假山和池塘特别美。
园林.en: The rockeries and ponds in the garden are especially beautiful.

园林.zh: 古代皇帝喜欢建大型园林，比如颐和园。
园林.en: Ancient emperors liked to build large gardens, such as the Summer Palace.

近视.zh: 我有点近视，所以得戴眼镜。
近视.en: I'm a bit nearsighted, so I have to wear glasses.

近视.zh: 他近视很严重，不戴眼镜什么都看不清。
近视.en: He has severe nearsightedness; without glasses he can't see anything clearly.

近视.zh: 现在很多小学生都近视了，因为总看手机。
近视.en: Nowadays many elementary school students are nearsighted because they're always on their phones.

近视.zh: 姐姐做了近视手术，现在视力很好。
近视.en: My sister had nearsightedness surgery, and now her eyesight is great.

近视.zh: 你近视多少度？该去查一查。
近视.en: What's your prescription? You should go get it checked.

美观.en: This vase is very aesthetically pleasing.

美观.zh: 房间的布局很美观，让人看了舒服。
美观.en: The room layout is very beautiful; it makes people feel comfortable when they look at it.

美观.zh: 为了让店面更美观，老板重新装修了一次。
美观.en: To make the storefront more beautiful, the boss renovated it again.

美观.zh: 美观又实用，这种设计最受欢迎。
美观.en: Both beautiful and practical, this kind of design is the most popular.

美观.zh: 新手机的外观非常美观，但价格有点贵。
美观.en: The new phone's appearance is very beautiful, but the price is a bit high.

录音机.en: Can this tape recorder still be used?

录音机.zh: 以前学英语常用录音机，现在都用手机了。
录音机.en: We used to use tape recorders to learn English, but now we all use phones.

录音机.zh: 他把录音机放在桌上，开始录音。
录音机.en: He put the tape recorder on the table and started recording.

录音机.zh: 老式录音机需要磁带，现在都不生产了。
录音机.en: Old-school tape recorders need cassettes, which aren't produced anymore.

录音机.zh: 我奶奶还留着那个旧的录音机，舍不得扔。
录音机.en: My grandmother still keeps that old tape recorder and can't bear to throw it away.

灾区.zh: 灾区人民需要我们的帮助。
灾区.en: The people in the disaster area need our help.

灾区.zh: 地震后，政府立刻向灾区送去了物资。
灾区.en: After the earthquake, the government immediately sent supplies to the disaster area.

灾区.zh: 很多志愿者去了灾区，帮忙重建房屋。
灾区.en: Many volunteers went to the disaster area to help rebuild houses.

灾区.zh: 灾区的情况很严重，大家都很担心。
灾区.en: The situation in the disaster area is very serious, and everyone is very worried.

灾区.zh: 为了支援灾区，学校组织了一次捐款活动。
灾区.en: To support the disaster area, the school organized a donation drive.

启事.zh: 墙上贴了一张寻物启事。
启事.en: A lost-and-found notice is posted on the wall.

启事.zh: 我在小区门口看到了一个招聘启事。
启事.en: I saw a job recruitment notice at the entrance of the neighborhood.

启事.zh: 他写了一个启事，说自己的猫丢了。
启事.en: He wrote a notice saying that his cat is lost.

启事.zh: 启事上写着联系电话和地址，方便联系。
启事.en: The notice has a contact phone number and address for easy contact.

启事.zh: 如果你有线索，请按照启事上的电话打过去。
启事.en: If you have any clues, please call the number on the notice.

摄取.zh: 多摄取维生素对身体好。
摄取.en: Taking in more vitamins is good for your health.

摄取.zh: 人每天需要摄取足够的水分和营养。
摄取.en: People need to take in enough water and nutrients every day.

摄取.zh: 为了健康，我们应该少摄取油腻的食物。
摄取.en: For the sake of health, we should consume less greasy food.

摄取.zh: 摄取过量的糖分会引起肥胖。
摄取.en: Taking in excessive sugar can cause obesity.

摄取.zh: 医生建议多吃水果，以便摄取更多维生素。
摄取.en: Doctors recommend eating more fruits to take in more vitamins.

马虎.en: He is too careless when doing things.

马虎.zh: 这次考试我因为马虎而丢了很多分。
马虎.en: I lost a lot of points on this exam because of carelessness.

马虎.zh: 马虎的习惯很难改，但一定要努力改掉。
马虎.en: The habit of being careless is hard to change, but you must try hard to get rid of it.

马虎.zh: 你别这么马虎，再检查一遍。
马虎.en: Don't be so careless; check it again.

马虎.zh: 老板批评了他，因为他工作马虎出了错。
马虎.en: The boss criticized him because he made mistakes due to carelessness at work.

音节.zh: 中文的每个字通常是一个音节。
音节.en: Each character in Chinese is usually one syllable.

音节.zh: 学习英语时要注意音节的划分。
音节.en: When learning English, pay attention to syllable division.

音节.zh: 唱歌的时候，每个音节都要唱清楚。
音节.en: When singing, every syllable must be pronounced clearly.

音节.zh: “妈妈”这个词有两个相同的音节，读起来很顺口。
音节.en: The word 'mama' has two identical syllables, making it very smooth to say.

合身.en: This piece of clothing fits well.

合身.zh: 你穿这条裤子很合身，显得腿长。
合身.en: These pants fit you well and make your legs look longer.

合身.zh: 我试了好几件，只有这件最合身。
合身.en: I tried on several pieces, and only this one fits best.

合身.zh: 虽然款式不错，但不合身的话我还是不会买。
合身.en: Even though the style is nice, if it doesn't fit well, I still won't buy it.

合身.zh: 这件西装很合身，不过袖口稍微有点紧。
合身.en: This suit fits well, but the cuffs are a little tight.

总量.zh: 这次考试的总量是八十分，我得了七十五。
总量.en: The total score for this exam is 80 points, and I got 75.

总量.zh: 我们需要控制用水总量，避免浪费。
总量.en: We need to control the total water usage to avoid waste.

总量.zh: 虽然总量很大，但人均下来就很少了。
总量.en: Although the total amount is large, it becomes very little per capita.

总量.zh: 超市搞活动，买满一定总量就能打折。
总量.en: The supermarket is having a promotion; if you buy a certain total amount, you get a discount.

荧屏.zh: 这个演员经常出现在荧屏上。
荧屏.en: This actor often appears on the screen.

荧屏.zh: 现在的孩子太依赖荧屏了。
荧屏.en: Children nowadays rely too much on screens.

荧屏.zh: 我喜欢在荧屏上看电影，而不是去影院。
荧屏.en: I like watching movies on screen rather than going to the cinema.

荧屏.zh: 她第一次上荧屏的时候特别紧张。
荧屏.en: She was very nervous the first time she appeared on screen.

荧屏.zh: 虽然手机荧屏很小，但看视频还挺清晰的。
荧屏.en: Although the phone screen is small, watching videos is still quite clear.

有序.en: Please line up and enter in an orderly manner.

有序.zh: 这个城市的交通很有序。
有序.en: The traffic in this city is very orderly.

有序.zh: 只有管理有序，公司才能发展得好。
有序.en: Only with orderly management can a company develop well.

有序.zh: 活动虽然人多，但大家很有序，没有混乱。
有序.en: Although there were many people at the event, everyone was very orderly and there was no chaos.

有序.zh: 我们要让垃圾回收变得更有序一些。
有序.en: We need to make waste recycling more orderly.

相等.zh: 男女应该享有相等的权利。
相等.en: Men and women should have equal rights.

相等.zh: 他付出的努力和得到的回报并不相等。
相等.en: The effort he put in and the reward he got are not equal.

相等.zh: 如果两边长度相等，这个图形就是正方形。
相等.en: If the lengths of the two sides are equal, this shape is a square.

相等.zh: 虽然工资相等，但工作内容差别很大。
相等.en: Although the salaries are equal, the job content is very different.

比重.en: Water has a higher specific gravity than oil.

比重.zh: 这个产业在经济中的比重越来越小。
比重.en: The proportion of this industry in the economy is getting smaller.

比重.zh: 你要注意调整饮食中各种营养的比重。
比重.en: You need to pay attention to adjusting the proportion of various nutrients in your diet.

比重.zh: 虽然人口不多，但他们的消费比重很高。
比重.en: Although the population is not large, their consumption proportion is very high.

比重.zh: 这次考试中，选择题的比重占了一半以上。
比重.en: In this exam, multiple-choice questions account for more than half of the proportion.

受灾.en: This area was severely affected by the disaster.

受灾.zh: 政府正在帮助受灾的群众。
受灾.en: The government is helping the disaster-affected people.

受灾.zh: 去年台风来了，很多地方都受灾了。
受灾.en: Last year, when the typhoon came, many places were hit by the disaster.

受灾.zh: 虽然受灾了，但大家很快恢复了正常生活。
受灾.en: Although affected by the disaster, everyone quickly returned to normal life.

受灾.zh: 这次地震受灾面积很大，需要很多救援物资。
受灾.en: The area affected by this earthquake is very large and requires a lot of relief supplies.

灰心.zh: 他失败了很多次，但从来没灰心过。
灰心.en: He failed many times but never lost heart.

灰心.zh: 听到这个消息，她有点灰心。
灰心.en: After hearing this news, she felt a bit discouraged.

灰心.zh: 虽然成绩不理想，但我不灰心，继续努力。
灰心.en: Although the results are not ideal, I won't lose heart and will keep working hard.

灰心.zh: 你要是灰心了，那就真的输了。
灰心.en: If you lose heart, then you truly lose.

人均.en: The average income here is not high.

人均.zh: 我们公司的人均产值增长了。
人均.en: Our company's per capita output value has increased.

人均.zh: 自助餐是按人均收费的。
虽然GDP很高，但人均下来就一般了。
人均.en: Although the GDP is very high, it's average when divided per capita.

人均.zh: 这家餐厅人均消费大概一百块左右。
人均.en: The per capita spending at this restaurant is about 100 yuan.

凉鞋.en: I like to wear sandals in summer.
These sandals are a bit chafing.

凉鞋.zh: 他买了一双新凉鞋去海边。
凉鞋.en: He bought a new pair of sandals for the beach.

凉鞋.zh: 虽然凉鞋很舒服，但上班不能穿。
凉鞋.en: Although sandals are comfortable, you can't wear them to work.

凉鞋.zh: 今年的凉鞋款式比去年好看多了。
凉鞋.en: This year's sandal styles are much nicer than last year's.

雌雄.en: These two birds are a male-female pair.

雌雄.zh: 科学家通过羽毛分辨雌雄。
雌雄.en: Scientists distinguish male from female by feathers.

雌雄.zh: 因为颜色不同，所以很容易看出雌雄。
雌雄.en: Because the colors are different, it's easy to tell male from female.

雌雄.zh: 这对熊猫的雌雄关系很和谐。
雌雄.en: The male-female relationship of this panda pair is very harmonious.

雌雄.zh: 虽然它们大小差不多，但叫声能区分雌雄。
雌雄.en: Although they are about the same size, their calls can tell male from female.

本期.en: This issue of the magazine has great content.

本期.zh: 本期的题目比上期难一些。
本期.en: The questions in this issue are a bit harder than the last one.

本期.zh: 如果你错过本期，可以等下个月。
本期.en: If you miss this issue, you can wait until next month.

本期.zh: 本期节目邀请了三位明星嘉宾。
本期.en: This episode invited three celebrity guests.

本期.zh: 因为本期的折扣很大，所以我买了好几件。
本期.en: Because the discount in this period is huge, I bought several items.

拐弯.en: You need to turn at the intersection ahead.
He always speaks in a roundabout way.
Remember to slow down when turning.

拐弯.zh: 如果你拐弯太急，容易摔倒。
拐弯.en: If you turn too sharply, you might fall.
Go straight on this road, no turning needed.

霞.en: The sunset glow is so beautiful!

霞.zh: 清晨的霞光照亮了山顶。
霞.en: The morning glow illuminated the mountaintop.

霞.zh: 因为天气好，霞的颜色特别鲜艳。
霞.en: Because the weather is good, the glow's color is especially vivid.

霞.zh: 霞光里的城市像一幅画。
霞.en: The city in the glow looks like a painting.
He likes to take a walk in the glow of the sunset.

银牌.zh: 这次比赛她只差一点就拿银牌了。
银牌.en: She was just a little short of getting a silver medal in this competition.

银牌.zh: 虽然没拿到金牌，但银牌也不错。
银牌.en: Although he didn't get gold, silver medal is not bad either.

银牌.zh: 银牌挂在脖子上闪闪发光。
银牌.en: The silver medal sparkled around the neck.

银牌.zh: 因为对手太强，他只能争取银牌。
银牌.en: Because the opponent was too strong, he could only aim for silver.

乡镇.en: He lives in a small town.

乡镇.zh: 这个乡镇的集市很热闹。
乡镇.en: The market in this township is very bustling.

乡镇.zh: 虽然乡镇不大，但生活很舒服。
乡镇.en: Although the township is not big, life is very comfortable.

乡镇.zh: 乡镇的年轻人很多都去城市打工了。
乡镇.en: Many young people from townships go to cities for work.

乡镇.zh: 因为交通方便，这个乡镇发展很快。
乡镇.en: Because transportation is convenient, this township is developing fast.

装卸.en: The workers are loading and unloading goods.

装卸.zh: 这个码头每天装卸很多集装箱。
装卸.en: This dock loads and unloads many containers every day.

装卸.zh: 因为时间紧，装卸速度要快。
装卸.en: Because time is tight, the loading and unloading speed needs to be fast.

装卸.zh: 他做装卸工已经五年了。
装卸.en: He has been working as a loader for five years.

装卸.zh: 如果装卸不当，货物容易损坏。
装卸.en: If loading and unloading is not done properly, the goods can be easily damaged.

养老院.en: Grandma moved into a nursing home.

养老院.zh: 这家养老院的服务很好。
养老院.en: The service at this nursing home is very good.

养老院.zh: 虽然养老院条件不错，但她还是想家。
养老院.en: Although the nursing home conditions are nice, she still misses home.

养老院.zh: 很多老人喜欢在养老院交朋友。
养老院.en: Many elderly people like to make friends in nursing homes.

养老院.zh: 因为子女太忙，所以把父母送到养老院。
养老院.en: Because the children are too busy, they send their parents to a nursing home.

生锈.zh: 铁门因为淋雨所以生锈了。
生锈.en: The iron gate rusted because it got rained on.

生锈.zh: 如果经常擦油，工具就不容易生锈。
生锈.en: If you oil them regularly, tools won't rust easily.

生锈.zh: 他把生锈的自行车重新刷了漆。

手续费.en: There is a handling fee for transfers.

手续费.zh: 这笔交易的手续费太高了。
手续费.en: The handling fee for this transaction is too high.

手续费.zh: 如果你用信用卡，需要额外付手续费。
手续费.en: If you use a credit card, you need to pay an extra handling fee.

手续费.zh: 因为金额大，所以手续费也相应增加。
手续费.en: Because the amount is large, the handling fee also increases accordingly.

手续费.zh: 有些银行免收跨行手续费。
手续费.en: Some banks waive interbank handling fees.

严寒.en: It's extremely cold today, wear more clothes.

严寒.zh: 虽然外面严寒，但他还是坚持跑步。
严寒.en: Although it's freezing outside, he still insists on running.

严寒.zh: 北方冬天严寒，南方暖和多了。
严寒.en: The winter in the north is severe cold, while the south is much warmer.

严寒.zh: 因为严寒，学校停课了一天。
严寒.en: Because of the severe cold, school was closed for a day.

严寒.zh: 这严寒天气让我不想出门。
严寒.en: This freezing weather makes me not want to go out.

力图.en: He strives to get into college.

力图.zh: 公司力图在年底前完成这个项目。
力图.en: The company is trying hard to complete this project before the end of the year.

力图.zh: 虽然困难，但他们力图解决问题。
力图.en: Although it's difficult, they strive to solve the problem.

力图.zh: 她力图说服父母同意她的选择。
力图.en: She tries hard to convince her parents to agree with her choice.

力图.zh: 我们力图用最少的资源完成最多的事。
力图.en: We strive to accomplish the most with the least resources.

盖章.en: The document needs a stamp to be valid.

盖章.zh: 你去办公室让经理盖章。
盖章.en: Go to the office and have the manager stamp it.

盖章.zh: 合同签好后，别忘了盖章。
盖章.en: After signing the contract, don't forget to stamp it.

盖章.zh: 护照上的盖章代表你入境了。
盖章.en: The stamp on your passport means you've entered the country.

盖章.zh: 这个证明没有盖章，不能用。
盖章.en: This certificate has no stamp, it's not usable.

古迹.en: This historical site is very famous.

古迹.zh: 去西安一定要看那些古迹。
古迹.en: When you go to Xi'an, you must see those historical sites.

古迹.zh: 虽然有些古迹被破坏了，但还是值得看。
古迹.en: Although some historical sites have been damaged, they are still worth seeing.

古迹.zh: 保护古迹是我们每个人的责任。
古迹.en: Protecting historical sites is everyone's responsibility.

古迹.zh: 这些古迹已经有上千年历史了。
古迹.en: These historical sites are over a thousand years old.

托运.en: My luggage needs to be checked in.

托运.zh: 在机场，托运行李前要贴标签。
托运.en: At the airport, you need to attach tags before checking in luggage.

托运.zh: 如果东西多，我建议你托运。
托运.en: If you have a lot of stuff, I suggest you check it in.

托运.zh: 这个箱子太大，只能托运。
托运.en: This box is too big, it can only be checked in.
Remember to get your baggage tag after checking in.

唾沫.zh: 他说话时唾沫横飞，让人不舒服。
唾沫.en: When he talks, saliva flies everywhere, which is uncomfortable.

唾沫.zh: 因为生气，他朝地上吐了一口唾沫。
唾沫.en: Because he was angry, he spat on the ground.

唾沫.zh: 唾沫里也有细菌，要注意卫生。
唾沫.en: Saliva also contains bacteria, so pay attention to hygiene.

唾沫.zh: 他擦掉嘴角的唾沫，继续吃饭。
唾沫.en: He wiped the saliva from the corner of his mouth and continued eating.

难点.en: What is the difficult point of this question?

难点.zh: 学习中的难点需要慢慢解决。
难点.en: Difficulties in learning need to be solved slowly.

难点.zh: 虽然有很多难点，但我们不能放弃。
难点.en: Although there are many difficulties, we cannot give up.

难点.zh: 这个计划的难点是时间不够。
难点.en: The difficulty of this plan is not enough time.

难点.zh: 他的难点是不知道怎么开口。
难点.en: His difficulty is not knowing how to speak up.

产地.zh: 这个苹果的产地是山东。
产地.en: The origin of this apple is Shandong.

产地.zh: 买水果时要注意看产地标签。
产地.en: When buying fruit, pay attention to the origin label.

产地.zh: 因为产地不同，价格也不一样。
产地.en: Because the origin is different, the price is also different.

产地.zh: 这些茶叶的产地是福建武夷山。
产地.en: The origin of these teas is Wuyi Mountain in Fujian.

产地.zh: 产地证明很重要，尤其是进口商品。
产地.en: A certificate of origin is very important, especially for imported goods.

补习.en: The child needs to take extra math classes on weekends.

补习.zh: 为了考试，他每天放学后补习英语。
补习.en: To prepare for the exam, he takes extra English classes after school every day.

补习.zh: 虽然补习很累，但成绩提高了。
补习.en: Although tutoring is tiring, grades have improved.

补习.zh: 暑假我打算给妹妹补习语文。
补习.en: In summer break, I plan to tutor my sister in Chinese.

补习.zh: 补习班的价格越来越贵了。
补习.en: The price of tutoring classes is getting more and more expensive.

舰艇.en: Two naval vessels have gone out to sea.

舰艇.zh: 海军正在建造新的舰艇。
舰艇.en: The navy is building new warships.

舰艇.zh: 虽然舰艇很大，但速度很快。
舰艇.en: Although the warship is large, it is very fast.

舰艇.zh: 参观舰艇让我对海军很感兴趣。
舰艇.en: Visiting the warship made me very interested in the navy.

舰艇.zh: 这些舰艇负责保护国家海域。
舰艇.en: These naval vessels are responsible for protecting the country's waters.

国宝.en: Giant pandas are China's national treasures.

国宝.zh: 这次展览展出了很多珍贵的国宝。
国宝.en: This exhibition displays many precious national treasures.

国宝.zh: 虽然它是国宝，但也不能随便触摸。
国宝.en: Although it is a national treasure, you can't just touch it casually.

国宝.zh: 这些国宝文物需要好好保护，因为它们很脆弱。
国宝.en: These national treasure artifacts need good protection because they are very fragile.

国宝.zh: 国宝不仅是文物，还代表了我们的文化传统。
国宝.en: National treasures are not just artifacts, they also represent our cultural heritage.

多方面.zh: 这个问题需要多方面考虑。
多方面.en: This problem needs to be considered from multiple aspects.

多方面.zh: 我们要从多方面提升自己的能力。
多方面.en: We need to improve our abilities from many aspects.

多方面.zh: 公司的发展涉及多方面因素，比如市场、人才等。
多方面.en: The company's development involves many factors, such as market, talent, etc.

多方面.zh: 他不仅在学业上优秀，在社交方面也很出色，真是多方面发展。
多方面.en: He is not only excellent in academics but also outstanding in social aspects, truly all-round development.

多方面.zh: 为了全面了解情况，我们必须从多方面收集信息。
多方面.en: To fully understand the situation, we must gather information from multiple angles.

研讨.zh: 专家们正在研讨这个方案。
研讨.en: The experts are discussing this plan.

研讨.zh: 除了讨论理论，我们还要研讨实际案例。
研讨.en: Besides discussing theory, we also need to study practical cases.

研讨.zh: 这次学术研讨会上，大家交流了很多新想法。
研讨.en: At this academic seminar, everyone exchanged many new ideas.

研讨.zh: 他们花了整整三天来研讨如何提高产品质量。
研讨.en: They spent a full three days discussing how to improve product quality.

两岸.en: The scenery on both sides of the river is beautiful.
This shop is located on both sides of the river.

两岸.zh: 虽然两岸关系有时紧张，但民间交流一直很多。
两岸.en: Although cross-strait relations are sometimes tense, people-to-people exchanges have always been frequent.

两岸.zh: 他住在河的两岸，每天要坐船过河。
两岸.en: He lives on both sides of the river and has to take a boat across every day.

两岸.zh: 两岸的居民因为这座桥来往方便多了。
两岸.en: Residents on both sides find it much more convenient to travel because of this bridge.

补课.en: I need to make up a lesson tomorrow.

补课.zh: 因为生病，我落下了很多课，需要补课。
补课.en: Because I was sick, I missed many lessons and need to make them up.

补课.zh: 老师建议我周末补课，这样能跟上进度。
补课.en: The teacher suggested I make up lessons on weekends so I can keep up.

补课.zh: 暑假他一直在补课，为了准备升学考试。
补课.en: He has been taking make-up lessons all summer to prepare for the entrance exam.

补课.zh: 补课虽然很累，但为了成绩，我觉得值得。
补课.en: Although make-up lessons are tiring, I think it's worth it for the grades.

保修.en: This phone has a one-year warranty.

保修.zh: 如果坏了，在保修期内可以免费修。
保修.en: If it breaks, it can be repaired for free within the warranty period.

保修.zh: 买电器时一定要注意保修条款。
保修.en: When buying appliances, be sure to pay attention to the warranty terms.

保修.zh: 这台电脑已经过了保修期，维修要花钱。
保修.en: This computer is already out of warranty; repairs will cost money.

保修.zh: 保修服务包括免费更换零件，但不包括人为损坏。
保修.en: The warranty service includes free replacement of parts, but not for human-caused damage.

喜事.en: Their family recently had a happy event.

喜事.zh: 她结婚是件大喜事，我们都去祝贺。
喜事.en: Her wedding is a big happy event; we all went to congratulate her.

喜事.zh: 因为家里有喜事，他请了几天假。
喜事.en: Because there was a happy event at home, he took a few days off.

喜事.zh: 孩子考上大学，对全家来说都是大喜事。
喜事.en: The child getting into college is a big happy event for the whole family.

喜事.zh: 喜事连连，今年真是个好年头。
喜事.en: Happy events keep coming; this is really a good year.

晕车.zh: 坐长途车的时候，我总是晕车。
晕车.en: When taking long bus rides, I always get carsick.

晕车.zh: 虽然吃了晕车药，我还是有点不舒服。
晕车.en: Even though I took motion sickness medicine, I still felt a bit uncomfortable.

晕车.zh: 他晕车很厉害，所以很少出远门。
晕车.en: He gets very carsick, so he rarely travels far.

晕车.zh: 坐车时开窗通风可以缓解晕车的症状。
晕车.en: Opening the window for ventilation while riding can relieve carsickness symptoms.

日前.en: He went on a business trip a few days ago.

日前.zh: 公司日前发布了一款新产品。
日前.en: The company recently launched a new product.

日前.zh: 总统日前访问了邻国，并且签署了协议。
日前.en: The president visited a neighboring country recently and signed an agreement.

日前.zh: 这种新型疫苗日前获得了批准。
日前.en: This new vaccine was approved a few days ago.

日前.zh: 日前，警方破获了一起大型诈骗案。
日前.en: A few days ago, the police cracked a major fraud case.

相传.en: Legend has it that there is treasure here.

相传.zh: 相传在古代，这里住着一位神仙。
相传.en: Legend says that in ancient times, an immortal lived here.

相传.zh: 这座山相传是龙脉所在，非常神奇。
相传.en: This mountain is said to be the location of the dragon vein, very miraculous.

相传.zh: 相传每年这个时候，都会出现一道彩虹。
相传.en: It is said that at this time every year, a rainbow appears.

相传.zh: 虽然只是相传，但很多人仍然相信这个传说。
相传.en: Although it's just a legend, many people still believe in this story.

由来.zh: 这个习俗的由来你知道吗？
由来.en: Do you know the origin of this custom?

由来.zh: 关于这件事的由来，我听说过一个版本。
由来.en: I've heard a version about the origin of this matter.

由来.zh: 他们吵架的由来其实很简单。
由来.en: The cause of their argument is actually very simple.

由来.zh: 这个问题由来已久，不是一天两天能解决的。
由来.en: This problem has a long history and can't be solved in a day or two.

由来.zh: 虽然很多人都在用这个说法，但它的由来已经没人记得了。
由来.en: Although many people use this saying, no one remembers its origin anymore.

不怎么样.zh: 这家餐厅的菜不怎么样。
不怎么样.en: The food at this restaurant is not that good.

不怎么样.zh: 他唱得实在不怎么样，但还是挺自信的。
不怎么样.en: His singing is really not good, but he's still quite confident.

不怎么样.zh: 那部电影我觉得不怎么样，但是朋友很喜欢。
不怎么样.en: I think that movie is just so-so, but my friend really likes it.

不怎么样.zh: 你的新发型看起来不怎么样，要不要换一个？
不怎么样.en: Your new hairstyle doesn't look great; do you want to change it?

不怎么样.zh: 虽然价格很便宜，但质量也不怎么样，所以我不推荐。
不怎么样.en: Although the price is very cheap, the quality is also not good, so I don't recommend it.

母语.zh: 他说英语比母语还流利。
母语.en: He speaks English even more fluently than his native language.

母语.zh: 即使出国很多年，母语也不会忘记。
母语.en: Even after living abroad for many years, you won't forget your mother tongue.

母语.zh: 对孩子来说，母语环境特别重要。
母语.en: For children, the native language environment is especially important.

母语.zh: 如果你的母语不是汉语，学声调可能会有点难。
母语.en: If your mother tongue is not Chinese, learning tones might be a bit difficult.

楼道.en: Don't put clutter in the hallway.

楼道.zh: 我们楼道最近在装修，很吵。
楼道.en: Our hallway is being renovated recently, it's very noisy.

楼道.zh: 你从楼道走过去就能看到电梯。
楼道.en: You can see the elevator after walking through the hallway.

楼道.zh: 晚上楼道灯坏了，上下楼要小心。
楼道.en: The hallway light is broken at night, be careful going up and down the stairs.

楼道.zh: 每次在楼道遇见邻居，我都会打个招呼。
楼道.en: Whenever I meet a neighbor in the hallway, I say hello.

绿化.en: The greenery in this neighborhood is very good.

绿化.zh: 城市绿化对空气质量有好处。
绿化.en: Urban greening is good for air quality.

绿化.zh: 他们公司在屋顶做了绿化，夏天凉快多了。
绿化.en: Their company did rooftop greening, making it much cooler in summer.

绿化.zh: 新的公园绿化面积很大，适合散步。
绿化.en: The new park has a large green area, great for walking.

绿化.zh: 虽然绿化多了，但维护起来也需要不少钱。
绿化.en: Although there is more greenery, maintaining it also requires a lot of money.

长短.en: The length of this skirt is just right.

长短.zh: 两个人在一起，别老说别人的长短。
长短.en: When two people are together, don't always gossip about others.

长短.zh: 我要把头发剪短，但长短还没想好。
长短.en: I want to cut my hair shorter, but I haven't decided the length yet.

长短.zh: 比赛的时间长短由组委会决定。
长短.en: The length of the competition time is decided by the organizing committee.

长短.zh: 买裤子时，长短和腰围都要注意。
长短.en: When buying pants, pay attention to both the length and the waist size.

稿件.zh: 编辑让我把稿件再修改一下。
稿件.en: The editor asked me to revise the manuscript again.

稿件.zh: 这期杂志的稿件已经全部收齐了。
稿件.en: All the submissions for this issue of the magazine have been collected.

稿件.zh: 他投了很多稿件，但只被选中了一篇。
稿件.en: He submitted many manuscripts, but only one was selected.

稿件.zh: 因为字数不够，稿件被退回来了。
稿件.en: The manuscript was returned because it didn't meet the word count.

声调.zh: 你说话的声调可以低一点。
声调.en: You can lower your tone of voice.

声调.zh: 学中文的时候，声调特别重要。
声调.en: When learning Chinese, tones are especially important.

声调.zh: 他生气的时候声调会变高。
声调.en: His tone of voice gets higher when he's angry.

声调.zh: 这个字的声调你读错了，应该是第四声。
声调.en: You mispronounced the tone of this character; it should be the fourth tone.

声调.zh: 虽然她很开心，但说话的声调听起来却很平静。
声调.en: Although she was very happy, her tone of voice sounded calm.

参展.zh: 今年我们公司要去参展。
参展.en: Our company will participate in the exhibition this year.

参展.zh: 这次参展的作品都是年轻艺术家的。
参展.en: The works exhibited this time are all by young artists.

参展.zh: 参展之前，所有的产品都要检查一遍。
参展.en: Before participating in the exhibition, all products need to be checked.

参展.zh: 他们花了很多钱来参展，希望能找到客户。
参展.en: They spent a lot of money to exhibit, hoping to find clients.

参展.zh: 因为疫情，今年的服装展只有少数几家公司参展。
参展.en: Due to the pandemic, only a few companies participated in this year's fashion exhibition.

毫米.zh: 这个螺丝只有五毫米长。
毫米.en: This screw is only five millimeters long.
The error must not exceed one millimeter.

毫米.zh: 每张纸的厚度大约是零点一毫米。
毫米.en: The thickness of each sheet of paper is about 0.1 millimeters.

毫米.zh: 他每天只长高一毫米？那也太慢了。
毫米.en: He only grows one millimeter taller each day? That's too slow.

毫米.zh: 量的时候要精确到毫米，不然零件装不上。
毫米.en: When measuring, be precise to the millimeter, otherwise the part won't fit.

家常.zh: 每次回家，妈妈都会跟我聊家常。
家常.en: Every time I go home, my mom chats with me about family matters.

家常.zh: 虽然工作很忙，但我也喜欢和朋友聊家常。
家常.en: Although work is busy, I also like to chat about family matters with friends.

家常.zh: 这部电影讲的是家常小事。
家常.en: This movie is about small family matters.

家常.zh: 她做的菜很有家常味道。
家常.en: Her cooking has a home-style flavor.

写字楼.en: I work in an office building.

写字楼.zh: 这栋写字楼附近有很多餐厅。
写字楼.en: There are many restaurants near this office building.

写字楼.zh: 因为公司搬家，我们换了一栋新的写字楼。
写字楼.en: Because the company moved, we changed to a new office building.

写字楼.zh: 周末写字楼里没什么人。
写字楼.en: On weekends there are few people in the office building.

写字楼.zh: 这栋写字楼的租金很贵。
写字楼.en: The rent for this office building is very expensive.

人工智能.zh: 现在很多手机都用人工智能技术。
人工智能.en: Now many phones use AI technology.

人工智能.zh: 虽然人工智能很方便，但也让一些人失业。
人工智能.en: Although AI is convenient, it also makes some people lose jobs.

人工智能.zh: 你对人工智能感兴趣吗？
人工智能可以帮助医生诊断疾病。
人工智能.en: AI can help doctors diagnose diseases.

不屑一顾.zh: 他对我的建议不屑一顾。
不屑一顾.en: He dismissed my suggestion with disdain.

不屑一顾.zh: 她总是对那些流行话题不屑一顾。
不屑一顾.en: She always dismisses those popular topics with disdain.

不屑一顾.zh: 虽然别人觉得他很成功，但他对名利不屑一顾。
不屑一顾.en: Although others think he is very successful, he disdains fame and fortune.

不屑一顾.zh: 那个明星对记者的提问不屑一顾。
不屑一顾.en: That star ignored the reporter's questions with disdain.

不屑一顾.zh: 他对这种小把戏不屑一顾。
不屑一顾.en: He has nothing but contempt for this kind of trick.

国情.en: We need to understand our country's conditions.

国情.zh: 每个国家的发展都要根据自身国情。
国情.en: Every country's development must be based on its own national conditions.

国情.zh: 虽然外国经验很好，但也要结合中国国情。
国情.en: Although foreign experience is good, it must also be combined with China's national conditions.

国情.zh: 这个政策非常符合我们的国情。
国情.en: This policy is very much in line with our national conditions.

国情.zh: 他写了一本关于中国国情的书。
国情.en: He wrote a book about China's national conditions.

照应.en: Help me take care of the guests.

照应.zh: 我出差的时候，邻居帮我照应家里的猫。
照应.en: When I was on a business trip, my neighbor took care of my cat.

照应.zh: 如果你不在，我可以照应你的孩子。
照应.en: If you are not here, I can look after your child.
Let's take care of each other.

照应.zh: 他一个人在家，需要有人照应。
照应.en: He is alone at home and needs someone to look after him.

文具.en: I'm going to buy some stationery.

文具.zh: 这家店的文具种类很齐全。
文具.en: This store has a wide variety of stationery.

文具.zh: 因为考试要到了，我准备了很多文具。
文具.en: Because the exam is coming, I prepared a lot of stationery.

文具.zh: 小朋友喜欢买漂亮的文具。
文具.en: Children like to buy beautiful stationery.
The desk is piled with stationery.

铜牌.zh: 这次比赛她只拿到了铜牌。
铜牌.en: In this competition, she only got a bronze medal.

铜牌.zh: 虽然没拿到金牌，但铜牌也很不错。
铜牌.en: Although she didn't get gold, a bronze medal is also pretty good.

铜牌.zh: 我们队在这个项目上获得了铜牌。
铜牌.en: Our team won a bronze medal in this event.

铜牌.zh: 铜牌和银牌的区别很大。
铜牌.en: The difference between bronze and silver medals is big.

民俗.en: I really like studying folk customs.

民俗.zh: 这个村子保留了很多古老的民俗。
民俗.en: This village has preserved many ancient folk customs.

民俗.zh: 虽然现在科技发达，但很多民俗依然存在。
民俗.en: Although technology is advanced now, many folk customs still exist.
The folk customs of Spring Festival are very rich.

民俗.zh: 民俗文化是国家的宝贵财富。
民俗.en: Folk culture is a precious treasure of a country.

吞咽.zh: 吃药的时候要用水帮助吞咽。
吞咽.en: When taking medicine, you need water to help swallow.

吞咽.zh: 因为喉咙痛，他每吞咽一次都很痛苦。
吞咽.en: Because of a sore throat, every swallow was painful.

成语.zh: 我刚刚学了一个新的成语。
成语.en: I just learned a new idiom.

成语.zh: 你写作文的时候，可以用这个成语。
成语.en: You can use this idiom when writing your essay.

成语.zh: 这个成语虽然简单，但是很有道理。
成语.en: This idiom is simple yet very meaningful.

成语.zh: 老师让我们每人找一个成语来讲解。
成语.en: The teacher asked each of us to find an idiom to explain.

用得着.zh: 这些资料你以后肯定用得着。
用得着.en: You'll definitely need these materials later.

用得着.zh: 如果你用得着这本书，就拿去吧。
用得着.en: If you need this book, take it.

用得着.zh: 虽然现在用不着，但以后可能用得着。
用得着.en: I don't need it now, but I might need it later.

用得着.zh: 他带了很多工具，但一个都没用得着。
用得着.en: He brought a lot of tools, but didn't need any of them.

双打.en: Do you prefer doubles or singles?

双打.zh: 我和朋友组队参加双打比赛。
双打.en: My friend and I formed a team to play in the doubles match.

双打.zh: 羽毛球双打配合很重要。
双打.en: Coordination is very important in badminton doubles.

双打.zh: 这次双打我们赢了，非常高兴。
双打.en: We won the doubles this time and were very happy.

双打.zh: 虽然双打很累，但比单打有意思。
双打.en: Although doubles is tiring, it's more fun than singles.

退票.en: I want to get a refund for my ticket, is that okay?

退票.zh: 电影票买了就不能退票了。
退票.en: Movie tickets cannot be refunded after purchase.

退票.zh: 因为临时有事，我只能去退票。
退票.en: Because something came up last minute, I had to go refund the ticket.

退票.zh: 你在网上买的票怎么退票？
退票.en: How do you refund a ticket you bought online?

退票.zh: 这个演出取消的话，可以全额退票。
退票.en: If this show is canceled, you can get a full refund.

一系列.en: He conducted a series of experiments.

一系列.zh: 公司推出了一系列新产品。
一系列.en: The company launched a series of new products.

一系列.zh: 政府采取了一系列措施来保护环境。
一系列.en: The government took a series of measures to protect the environment.

一系列.zh: 这一系列问题都需要解决。
一系列.en: This series of problems all need to be solved.

一系列.zh: 他经历了一系列挫折，但没放弃。
一系列.en: He went through a series of setbacks, but didn't give up.

文科.en: I study liberal arts, and he studies science.

文科.zh: 文科的课程比理科少一些。
文科.en: Liberal arts courses are a bit fewer than science courses.

文科.zh: 他文科成绩很好，但是数学不行。
文科.en: His liberal arts grades are good, but he's bad at math.

文科.zh: 你将来想选文科还是理科？
文科.en: In the future, do you want to choose liberal arts or sciences?

文科.zh: 很多人觉得文科找工作难。
文科.en: Many people think it's hard for liberal arts graduates to find jobs.

果酱.zh: 面包上抹点果酱更好吃。
果酱.en: Putting some jam on bread makes it taste better.

果酱.zh: 这瓶果酱快过期了，快吃掉吧。
果酱.en: This jar of jam is about to expire, eat it quickly.

果酱.zh: 你买果酱的时候，记得看生产日期。
果酱.en: When you buy jam, remember to check the production date.

果酱.zh: 我做了苹果果酱，你要尝尝吗？
果酱.en: I made apple jam, would you like to try some?

不料.zh: 我计划出门，不料下起了大雨。
不料.en: I planned to go out, but unexpectedly it started pouring.

不料.zh: 他本来想赢，不料最后输了。
不料.en: He originally wanted to win, but unexpectedly ended up losing.
I didn't expect things to turn out like this.

不料.zh: 我早上还觉得没事，不料下午发烧了。
不料.en: I felt fine in the morning, but unexpectedly got a fever in the afternoon.

闭塞.en: This place has very poor transportation.

闭塞.zh: 他消息闭塞，不知道这件事。
闭塞.en: He's out of the loop and doesn't know about this.

闭塞.zh: 山区信息闭塞，很难联系外界。
闭塞.en: The mountainous area has limited access to information, making it hard to contact the outside world.

闭塞.zh: 你太闭塞了，要多看看新闻。
闭塞.en: You're too isolated; you should watch more news.

闭塞.zh: 虽然这里比较闭塞，但是风景很美。
闭塞.en: Although it's relatively isolated here, the scenery is beautiful.

救灾.en: They are providing disaster relief in the affected area.

救灾.zh: 救灾物资已经送到前线。
救灾.en: Disaster relief supplies have been sent to the front line.
Many people volunteered to go for disaster relief.

救灾.zh: 政府派出军队参与救灾。
