救灾.en: The government sent the military to participate in disaster relief.

救灾.zh: 地震发生后，救灾工作立刻展开。
救灾.en: After the earthquake, disaster relief work began immediately.

沿海.en: Our family lives in a coastal city.

沿海.zh: 沿海地区的经济发展得很快。
沿海.en: The economy in coastal areas is developing very fast.

沿海.zh: 因为沿海风景很美，所以每年都有很多人去旅游。
沿海.en: Because the coastal scenery is beautiful, many people go traveling there every year.

沿海.zh: 沿海的渔民每天早上都要出海打鱼。
沿海.en: Coastal fishermen go out to sea to fish every morning.

沿海.zh: 这条公路沿着沿海修建，开车的时候能看到大海。
沿海.en: This road is built along the coast, and you can see the sea when driving.

升学.en: He is preparing for the school entrance exam this year.

升学.zh: 升学压力让很多学生感到很累。
升学.en: The pressure of advancing to a higher school makes many students feel very tired.

升学.zh: 如果你成绩好，升学就会容易很多。
升学.en: If you have good grades, advancing to a higher school will be much easier.

升学.zh: 她为了升学放弃了所有的娱乐活动。
升学.en: She gave up all recreational activities in order to advance to a higher school.

升学.zh: 现在很多家长从小学就开始操心孩子的升学问题。
升学.en: Nowadays many parents start worrying about their children's school advancement from elementary school.

合算.zh: 坐地铁比打车合算多了。
合算.en: Taking the subway is much more cost-effective than taking a taxi.

合算.zh: 虽然便宜，但质量不好，其实不合算。
合算.en: Although it's cheap, the quality is bad, so it's actually not worthwhile.

合算.zh: 用积分兑换礼品比直接买更合算。
合算.en: Redeeming gifts with points is more cost-effective than buying them directly.

合算.zh: 花时间学一门新技能，长远来看非常合算。
合算.en: Spending time learning a new skill is very worthwhile in the long run.

球拍.zh: 他买了一个新的羽毛球球拍。
球拍.en: He bought a new badminton racket.

球拍.zh: 打网球的时候，球拍的手感很重要。
球拍.en: When playing tennis, the feel of the racket is very important.

球拍.zh: 你能不能借我一个乒乓球球拍？
球拍.en: Can you lend me a table tennis racket?

球拍.zh: 这个牌子的球拍质量很好，但价格有点贵。
球拍.en: This brand of racket has good quality, but the price is a bit expensive.

民警.zh: 民警帮我们找到了钱包。
民警.en: The police officer helped us find the wallet.

民警.zh: 附近的民警经常来社区巡逻。
民警.en: The local police officers often patrol the community.

民警.zh: 如果你遇到困难，可以找路边的民警帮忙。
民警.en: If you encounter difficulties, you can ask the police officer on the street for help.

民警.zh: 那位民警很耐心地给我们解释了交通规则。
民警.en: That police officer patiently explained the traffic rules to us.

民警.zh: 民警同志，请问这附近有地铁站吗？
民警.en: Comrade police officer, is there a subway station nearby?

下旬.en: I have a business trip at the end of next month.

下旬.zh: 每年的六月下旬都会下很多雨。
下旬.en: Every year in the last ten days of June, there is a lot of rain.

下旬.zh: 这个月下旬的工作安排已经出来了。
下旬.en: The work schedule for the last ten days of this month has been released.

下旬.zh: 你打算在十一月的下旬去旅行吗？
下旬.en: Are you planning to travel in the last ten days of November?

下旬.zh: 因为春节在二月上旬，所以一月下旬大家就开始准备年货了。
下旬.en: Because the Spring Festival is in the first ten days of February, people start preparing New Year goods in the last ten days of January.

兴致勃勃.zh: 他兴致勃勃地讲着故事。
兴致勃勃.en: He told the story with great enthusiasm.

兴致勃勃.zh: 一听说要去爬山，孩子们都兴致勃勃。
兴致勃勃.en: As soon as they heard about going hiking, the children were all very excited.

兴致勃勃.zh: 她兴致勃勃地给我们展示她新买的相机。
兴致勃勃.en: She showed us her new camera with great enthusiasm.

兴致勃勃.zh: 虽然天气很热，大家还是兴致勃勃地参加了运动会。
兴致勃勃.en: Although the weather was very hot, everyone still participated in the sports meet with great enthusiasm.

兴致勃勃.zh: 爷爷兴致勃勃地教我怎么种花，讲了好多技巧。
兴致勃勃.en: Grandpa enthusiastically taught me how to plant flowers and shared many tips.

游人.en: There are many tourists in the park today.

游人.zh: 这些游人在湖旁边拍照。
游人.en: These tourists are taking photos by the lake.

游人.zh: 节假日的时候，景点到处都是游人。
游人.en: During holidays, the scenic spots are full of tourists everywhere.

游人.zh: 为了保护环境，游人不能乱扔垃圾。
游人.en: To protect the environment, tourists must not litter.

游人.zh: 这座古庙每天吸引大量游人前来参观。
游人.en: This ancient temple attracts a large number of tourists to visit every day.

清明节.en: We are going to sweep graves on Qingming Festival.

清明节.zh: 清明节放假三天，你打算做什么？
清明节.en: There is a three-day holiday for Qingming Festival; what are you planning to do?

清明节.zh: 清明节前后，天气经常阴雨绵绵。
清明节.en: Around Qingming Festival, the weather is often overcast and rainy.

清明节.zh: 今年清明节，我和家人一起回老家祭祖。
清明节.en: This Qingming Festival, I went back to my hometown with my family to worship ancestors.

清明节.zh: 除了扫墓，很多人也会在清明节去踏青。
清明节.en: Besides tomb sweeping, many people also go on spring outings during Qingming Festival.

无穷无尽.zh: 他的精力好像无穷无尽。
这个问题的可能性是无穷无尽的。
无穷无尽.en: The possibilities for this problem are endless.

无穷无尽.zh: 面对无穷无尽的作业，他感到很头疼。
无穷无尽.en: Facing endless homework, he felt a headache.

无穷无尽.zh: 大自然给我们提供了无穷无尽的资源，但我们要珍惜使用。
无穷无尽.en: Nature provides us with inexhaustible resources, but we must use them wisely.

补考.en: I have to retake the math exam next week.

补考.zh: 补考没过的话，就只能重修了。
补考.en: If I don't pass the makeup exam, I'll have to retake the course.

补考.zh: 他因为生病错过了考试，所以需要补考。
补考.en: He missed the exam due to illness, so he needs a makeup exam.

补考.zh: 补考的时间定在周五下午两点。
补考.en: The makeup exam is scheduled for Friday at 2 PM.

补考.zh: 这次补考虽然简单，但我还是有点紧张。
补考.en: Although this makeup exam is simple, I'm still a bit nervous.

粘贴.zh: 请把这张纸粘贴在墙上。
粘贴.en: Please paste this paper on the wall.
Just copy and then paste directly.

粘贴.zh: 这个文档里的图片无法粘贴到别的地方。
粘贴.en: The images in this document cannot be pasted elsewhere.

粘贴.zh: 他先用胶水粘贴，再用透明胶固定。
粘贴.en: He first used glue to paste, then used tape to secure it.

粘贴.zh: 我在文件夹里复制了文件，但粘贴时出错了。
粘贴.en: I copied the file in the folder, but an error occurred when pasting.

上班族.en: I am an ordinary office worker.

上班族.zh: 上班族每天挤地铁很辛苦。
上班族.en: Office workers have a hard time squeezing onto the subway every day.

上班族.zh: 作为上班族，我最期待周末了。
上班族.en: As an office worker, I look forward to the weekend the most.

上班族.zh: 现在的上班族压力很大，经常加班到很晚。
上班族.en: Office workers nowadays are under a lot of pressure and often work late.

上班族.zh: 虽然上班族收入稳定，但时间不自由。
上班族.en: Although office workers have a stable income, their time is not flexible.

咬牙切齿.en: He was so angry that he gritted his teeth.

咬牙切齿.zh: 看到那个骗子，她咬牙切齿地骂了一句。
咬牙切齿.en: Seeing that swindler, she gritted her teeth and cursed.

咬牙切齿.zh: 每次想起那次失败，他都恨得咬牙切齿。
咬牙切齿.en: Every time he thinks of that failure, he grinds his teeth in hatred.

咬牙切齿.zh: 他咬牙切齿地说一定要赢回来。
咬牙切齿.en: He said through gritted teeth that he must win it back.

咬牙切齿.zh: 比赛输了以后，他整晚都咬牙切齿地睡不着觉。
咬牙切齿.en: After losing the game, he lay awake all night grinding his teeth in frustration.

炒股.en: My dad has been trading stocks recently.

炒股.zh: 炒股风险很大，容易亏钱。
炒股.en: Stock trading is very risky and you can easily lose money.

炒股.zh: 他炒股赚了一笔钱，但后来又赔了。
炒股.en: He made some money from stock trading, but then lost it again.

炒股.zh: 我建议新手不要盲目跟风炒股。
炒股.en: I suggest beginners not to blindly follow trends in stock trading.

炒股.zh: 炒股需要很多专业知识，不能光靠运气。
炒股.en: Stock trading requires a lot of professional knowledge, you can't just rely on luck.

粽子.en: We eat zongzi during the Dragon Boat Festival.

粽子.zh: 你爱吃甜粽子还是咸粽子？
粽子.en: Do you like sweet zongzi or savory zongzi?

粽子.zh: 妈妈包了好多粽子，送给邻居一些。
粽子.en: Mom made a lot of zongzi and gave some to the neighbors.

粽子.zh: 超市里的粽子种类很多，有肉的有豆沙的。
粽子.en: There are many kinds of zongzi in the supermarket, with meat or red bean paste.

粽子.zh: 虽然粽子好吃，但不能吃太多，不然胃会不舒服。
粽子.en: Although zongzi are delicious, you shouldn't eat too many or your stomach will feel uncomfortable.

选修.en: I took Spanish as an elective course.

选修.zh: 下学期你打算选修什么课？
选修.en: What elective courses do you plan to take next semester?

选修.zh: 选修课比必修课轻松很多。
选修.en: Elective courses are much easier than required courses.

选修.zh: 因为感兴趣，我选修了摄影课。
选修.en: Because I'm interested, I chose photography as an elective.

选修.zh: 我们学校有很多选修课，比如音乐、绘画和编程。
选修.en: Our school offers many elective courses, such as music, painting, and programming.

洗衣粉.en: We've run out of laundry detergent, need to buy some.

洗衣粉.zh: 这个洗衣粉的香味很好闻。
洗衣粉.en: This laundry powder has a nice scent.

洗衣粉.zh: 手洗衣服最好用洗衣液，不要用洗衣粉。
洗衣粉.en: For hand washing clothes, it's best to use liquid detergent, not powder.

洗衣粉.zh: 洗衣粉放太多了，衣服上全是泡沫。
洗衣粉.en: I put too much laundry powder, and now the clothes are full of foam.

洗衣粉.zh: 虽然洗衣粉便宜，但我觉得洗衣液更护手。
洗衣粉.en: Although laundry powder is cheaper, I think liquid detergent is gentler on hands.

毫升.zh: 每天喝2000毫升水对身体好。
毫升.en: Drinking 2000 milliliters of water daily is good for health.

毫升.zh: 这瓶酱油只有500毫升，不够用。
毫升.en: This bottle of soy sauce is only 500 milliliters, not enough.

毫升.zh: 药瓶上写着每次喝15毫升。
毫升.en: The medicine bottle says to take 15 milliliters each time.

毫升.zh: 虽然只有100毫升，但这瓶香水很贵。
毫升.en: Although it's only 100 milliliters, this bottle of perfume is very expensive.

季军.en: He won third place in the competition.

季军.zh: 虽然没拿到冠军，但季军也不错。
季军.en: Although he didn't get the championship, third place is not bad.

季军.zh: 这次马拉松的季军是一位年轻的选手。
季军.en: The third-place finisher in this marathon is a young runner.

季军.zh: 我们队只差一分就能拿到季军了。
季军.en: Our team was only one point away from getting third place.

季军.zh: 他站在领奖台上领取季军奖牌，脸上带着微笑。
季军.en: He stood on the podium to receive the bronze medal, with a smile on his face.

常务.en: He is the executive deputy director.

常务.zh: 常务会议定在下周二下午三点开。
常务.en: The standing meeting is scheduled for next Tuesday at 3pm.

常务.zh: 因为临时有事，常务会议取消了。
常务.en: Because something urgent came up, the standing meeting was canceled.

常务.zh: 公司的常务工作都由他负责。
常务.en: He is responsible for the company's routine affairs.

常务.zh: 虽然他是常务，但很多事情也要汇报。
常务.en: Although he is the executive, he still has to report many things.

场馆.zh: 新建的体育场馆下个月就开放了。
场馆.en: The newly built sports venue will open next month.

场馆.zh: 因为场馆临时维修，比赛改到别处了。
场馆.en: Because the venue is under temporary maintenance, the match was moved elsewhere.

场馆.zh: 演唱会结束后，场馆里一片狼藉。
场馆.en: After the concert, the venue was a mess.

场馆.zh: 这个场馆能容纳两万人。

考场.en: The exam room is very quiet.

考场.zh: 考生在考场外排队等待入场。
考场.en: Candidates are queuing outside the exam hall waiting to enter.

考场.zh: 虽然考场有空调，但他还是紧张得出汗。
考场.en: Although the exam room had air conditioning, he was still sweating from nervousness.
The exam room rules are written very clearly.

考场.zh: 他提前半小时到了考场。
考场.en: He arrived at the exam hall half an hour early.

肥沃.en: The soil here is very fertile.

肥沃.zh: 因为土壤肥沃，农民每年都丰收。
肥沃.en: Because the soil is fertile, farmers have a good harvest every year.

肥沃.zh: 虽然气候干燥，但河谷地带十分肥沃。
肥沃.en: Although the climate is dry, the river valley area is very fertile.

肥沃.zh: 肥沃的田野上长满了金黄的麦子。
肥沃.en: The fertile fields are covered with golden wheat.

肥沃.zh: 这片平原是全省最肥沃的地方。
肥沃.en: This plain is the most fertile area in the province.

打雷.zh: 昨晚打雷打得特别响，孩子被吓醒了。
打雷.en: Last night the thunder was very loud; the child was scared awake.

打雷.zh: 因为打雷，飞机暂时不能起飞。
打雷.en: Because of thunder, the plane cannot take off for now.

打雷.zh: 打雷的时候不要站在树下。
打雷.en: Don't stand under a tree when it's thundering.

打雷.zh: 天气预报说下午会打雷。
打雷.en: The weather forecast says it will thunder in the afternoon.

圆珠笔.en: My ballpoint pen is out of ink.

圆珠笔.zh: 考试时只能用黑色圆珠笔答题。
圆珠笔.en: During the exam, you can only answer with a black ballpoint pen.

圆珠笔.zh: 他找了半天，才发现圆珠笔掉在桌子下面了。
圆珠笔.en: He looked for a long time and finally found that the ballpoint pen had fallen under the desk.

圆珠笔.zh: 这支圆珠笔写起来很顺滑。
圆珠笔.en: This ballpoint pen writes very smoothly.

圆珠笔.zh: 送他一支圆珠笔作为小礼物。
圆珠笔.en: Give him a ballpoint pen as a small gift.

贤惠.zh: 邻居们都夸她贤惠，家里收拾得干干净净。
贤惠.en: Neighbors all praise her for being virtuous; she keeps the house spotless.

贤惠.zh: 虽然她工作很忙，但也很贤惠，把家照顾得很好。
贤惠.en: Although she is very busy with work, she is also virtuous and takes good care of the home.

贤惠.zh: 现在的年轻人不一定喜欢“贤惠”这个标签。
贤惠.en: Young people nowadays don't necessarily like the label 'virtuous'.

贤惠.zh: 她不仅贤惠，而且很有主见。
贤惠.en: She is not only virtuous but also has strong opinions.

好客.en: People from Shandong are very warm and hospitable.

好客.zh: 这家民宿的主人非常好客，给我们准备了丰盛的晚餐。
好客.en: The host of this guesthouse is very hospitable and prepared a sumptuous dinner for us.

好客.zh: 因为当地人好客，我们很快就融入了他们的生活。
好客.en: Because the locals are hospitable, we quickly integrated into their lives.

好客.zh: 她好客的名声早就传开了。
好客.en: Her reputation for hospitality has long spread.

棍棒.en: He is holding a stick in his hand.

棍棒.zh: 传统的教育方法常用棍棒，但现在不提倡了。
棍棒.en: Traditional educational methods often used sticks, but they are not advocated now.

棍棒.zh: 虽然棍棒教育效果快，但对孩子心理有伤害。
棍棒.en: Although corporal punishment has quick effects, it harms children's psychology.

棍棒.zh: 警察用棍棒驱散了闹事的人群。
棍棒.en: The police used batons to disperse the rioters.

棍棒.zh: 棍棒底下出孝子？这句话现在有争议。
棍棒.en: Spare the rod and spoil the child? That saying is controversial now.

赶忙.zh: 听到门铃响，她赶忙跑去开门。
赶忙.en: Hearing the doorbell ring, she hurriedly ran to open the door.

赶忙.zh: 因为快迟到了，他赶忙吃了两口早饭就出门了。
赶忙.en: Because he was almost late, he hastily ate a couple of bites of breakfast and left.

赶忙.zh: 看到妈妈生气了，他赶忙认错。
赶忙.en: Seeing his mother angry, he quickly admitted his mistake.

赶忙.zh: 我赶忙把手机调成了静音。
赶忙.en: I hurriedly switched my phone to silent mode.

踌躇.zh: 因为担心结果，她一直踌躇不决。
踌躇.en: Because she was worried about the result, she kept hesitating.

踌躇.zh: 面对选择，他踌躇了很久。
踌躇.en: Facing the choice, he hesitated for a long time.
Don't hesitate, make a decision quickly.

踌躇.zh: 虽然机会难得，但他在门外踌躇着不敢进去。
踌躇.en: Although the opportunity was rare, he hesitated outside the door, not daring to enter.

城乡.en: The gap between urban and rural areas is large.

城乡.zh: 政府正在努力缩小城乡之间的发展差距。
城乡.en: The government is working hard to narrow the development gap between urban and rural areas.

城乡.zh: 虽然城乡生活不同，但各有各的好处。
城乡.en: Although urban and rural life are different, each has its own advantages.
He comes from an urban-rural fringe.

城乡.zh: 城乡交流促进了文化的融合。

浏览器.zh: 这个浏览器支持很多有用的插件。
浏览器.en: This browser supports many useful plug-ins.

浏览器.zh: 如果你想上网，就打开浏览器吧。
浏览器.en: If you want to go online, just open the browser.

浏览器.zh: 新版浏览器加载网页的速度快了很多。
浏览器.en: The new version of the browser loads web pages much faster.

拜年.en: We'll go to pay New Year visits tomorrow.

拜年.zh: 春节期间，大家互相拜年祝福。
拜年.en: During the Spring Festival, everyone pays New Year visits and exchanges blessings.

拜年.zh: 虽然很忙，但他还是抽空去给长辈拜年。
拜年.en: Although he was busy, he still took time to pay New Year visits to his elders.
Do you bring gifts when paying New Year visits?

拜年.zh: 现在很多人用微信视频拜年，很方便。
拜年.en: Now many people use WeChat video to pay New Year visits, which is very convenient.

水稻.en: Rice is a staple food crop.

水稻.zh: 南方地区适合种植水稻。
水稻.en: Southern regions are suitable for growing rice.

水稻.zh: 因为雨水充足，今年水稻长得很好。
水稻.en: Because of sufficient rainfall, the rice is growing well this year.

水稻.zh: 水稻的种植技术一直在不断改进。
水稻.en: The cultivation techniques of rice have been continuously improving.

安居乐业.en: The people live in peace and work happily.

安居乐业.zh: 社会稳定才能让百姓安居乐业。
安居乐业.en: Social stability allows the people to live and work in peace.

安居乐业.zh: 只要政策好，大家就能安居乐业。
安居乐业.en: As long as the policies are good, everyone can live in peace and work happily.

安居乐业.zh: 他们过上了安居乐业的生活。
安居乐业.en: They have achieved a life of peace and contentment.

安居乐业.zh: 这个小区治安很好，居民都安居乐业。
安居乐业.en: This community has good public security, and residents live peacefully and work happily.

模特儿.zh: 这个模特儿的身材很好。
模特儿.en: This model has a great figure.

模特儿.zh: 虽然当模特儿很辛苦，但她很热爱这份工作。
模特儿.en: Although being a model is tough, she loves this job.
Models need confidence on the runway.

模特儿.zh: 很多模特儿为了保持身材吃得很少。
模特儿.en: Many models eat very little to maintain their figure.

果树.en: There are fruit trees planted in the yard.

果树.zh: 春天果树开花了，非常漂亮。
果树.en: In spring, the fruit trees blossom, which is very beautiful.

果树.zh: 如果照顾好果树，秋天就能收获很多果子。
果树.en: If you take good care of the fruit trees, you can harvest a lot of fruit in autumn.
There are many varieties of fruit trees.

果树.zh: 爷爷在果园里种了各种各样的果树。
果树.en: Grandpa planted various kinds of fruit trees in the orchard.

名胜.en: There are many scenic spots here.

名胜.zh: 北京的名胜古迹吸引了很多游客。
名胜.en: Beijing's famous historical sites attract many tourists.

名胜.zh: 虽然去过很多次，但每次看到名胜还是很激动。
名胜.en: Although I've been there many times, I still get excited seeing the famous sites.
This city is famous for its scenic spots.

名胜.zh: 我们计划去游览当地的名胜。
名胜.en: We plan to visit the local famous sites.

惹祸.zh: 他说话不注意，总是惹祸。
惹祸.en: He doesn't watch his words and always causes trouble.

惹祸.zh: 喝酒后开车最容易惹祸。
惹祸.en: Driving after drinking alcohol most easily causes trouble.

蓝领.zh: 很多蓝领工作现在收入也不错，虽然辛苦一点。
蓝领.en: Many blue-collar jobs now pay well, even though they are a bit hard.

蓝领.zh: 蓝领和白领都是社会需要的。
蓝领.en: Blue-collar and white-collar workers are both needed by society.

蓝领.zh: 我爸爸做了二十年的蓝领，他一直很自豪。
蓝领.en: My dad has been a blue-collar worker for twenty years, and he's always been proud.

蓝领.zh: 现在的蓝领技术活越来越多了。
蓝领.en: Nowadays, there are more and more skilled blue-collar jobs.

好容易.en: I finally found you with great difficulty.

好容易.zh: 这道题好容易才做出来，差点放弃了。
好容易.en: I barely managed to solve this problem; I almost gave up.

好容易.zh: 好容易放假了，我想好好休息。
好容易.en: The holiday finally came after a long wait, and I want to rest well.

好容易.zh: 他好容易才考上大学，全家都很高兴。
好容易.en: He finally got into college with great effort, and the whole family was very happy.

好容易.zh: 我好容易把房间收拾干净，他又弄乱了。
好容易.en: I finally cleaned the room with difficulty, and he messed it up again.

工序.en: This process step is very simple.

工序.zh: 每个工序都要仔细检查，不能出错。
工序.en: Every procedure must be carefully checked; no mistakes are allowed.

工序.zh: 工厂把工序分成了五个步骤。
工序.en: The factory divided the process into five steps.

工序.zh: 这道工序需要两个人配合完成，不然很慢。
工序.en: This step requires two people to work together; otherwise, it's very slow.

工序.zh: 新员工要先熟悉每道工序。
工序.en: New employees need to first get familiar with each process step.

聋哑.zh: 聋哑学校教学生用手语交流。
聋哑.en: Deaf-mute schools teach students to communicate using sign language.

聋哑.zh: 那个聋哑孩子很聪明，学东西很快。
聋哑.en: That deaf-mute child is very smart and learns things quickly.

聋哑.zh: 社会上应该多关注聋哑人群体的需求。
聋哑.en: Society should pay more attention to the needs of the deaf-mute community.

聋哑.zh: 我邻居是聋哑夫妇，他们生活得很幸福。
聋哑.en: My neighbors are a deaf-mute couple, and they live very happily.

道教.en: Taoism is one of the religions in China.

道教.zh: 道教讲究顺其自然，无为而治。
道教.en: Taoism emphasizes going with the flow and governing by non-action.

道教.zh: 我爷爷对道教文化很感兴趣。
道教.en: My grandfather is very interested in Taoist culture.

道教.zh: 道教和佛教在中国都有很长的历史。
道教.en: Both Taoism and Buddhism have long histories in China.

道教.zh: 很多道教思想影响了中医。
道教.en: Many Taoist ideas have influenced traditional Chinese medicine.

司长.en: He is the director of a department in the Ministry of Education.

司长.zh: 司长今天下午要开会讨论新政策。
司长.en: The department director has a meeting this afternoon to discuss the new policy.

司长.zh: 这位司长是从基层一步步升上来的。
司长.en: This department director came up step by step from the grassroots level.

司长.zh: 司长要求各部门配合，尽快落实方案。
司长.en: The director asked all departments to cooperate and implement the plan as soon as possible.

司长.zh: 新来的司长做事很果断。
司长.en: The new department director is very decisive in his actions.

伶俐.zh: 她嘴巴伶俐，很会说话，大家都喜欢。
伶俐.en: She has a quick tongue, is very articulate, and everyone likes her.

伶俐.zh: 那只小狗特别伶俐，会很多把戏。
伶俐.en: That little dog is exceptionally smart and knows many tricks.

伶俐.zh: 他虽然年纪小，但心思伶俐，常常帮大人出主意。
伶俐.en: Although he is young, he is sharp-minded and often helps adults come up with ideas.

伶俐.zh: 伶俐的人学东西就是快。
伶俐.en: Clever people just learn things quickly.

上进心.en: He has a strong drive to improve.

上进心.zh: 一个人如果没有上进心，很难有大的进步。
上进心.en: If a person has no ambition, it's hard for them to make significant progress.

上进心.zh: 老师鼓励我们要有上进心，好好学习。
上进心.en: The teacher encouraged us to have ambition and study hard.

上进心.zh: 她工作特别努力，上进心很强，很快升职了。
上进心.en: She works very hard, has a strong desire to advance, and got promoted quickly.
Ambition is more important than intelligence.

气功.zh: 气功对身体健康有很多好处，比如减压。
气功.en: Qigong has many benefits for physical health, such as reducing stress.

气功.zh: 我奶奶练气功二十年了，身体很好。
气功.en: My grandmother has been practicing qigong for twenty years, and she is in great health.

气功.zh: 公园里每天早上都有人打太极、练气功。
气功.en: Every morning in the park, some people do tai chi and practice qigong.

气功.zh: 气功是一种传统的养生方法。
气功.en: Qigong is a traditional method of health preservation.

园地.zh: 这个小园地种了很多花。
园地.en: This small garden has many flowers planted.

园地.zh: 学校给每个班级分配了一块劳动园地。
园地.en: The school assigned a labor garden plot to each class.

园地.zh: 这个网站是文学爱好者的园地。
园地.en: This website is a field for literature enthusiasts.

园地.zh: 他们在小区里开辟了一片园地，种菜种花。
园地.en: They opened up a garden plot in the neighborhood to grow vegetables and flowers.

园地.zh: 园地里种着各种蔬菜，长得很好。
园地.en: The garden is planted with all kinds of vegetables, and they are growing very well.

公婆.zh: 周末我常常陪公婆去公园散步。
公婆.en: On weekends I often accompany my in-laws to walk in the park.

公婆.zh: 虽然公婆住在乡下，但我们每个月都去看他们。
公婆.en: Although my in-laws live in the countryside, we visit them every month.

公婆.zh: 公婆对我就像亲生女儿一样。
公婆.en: My in-laws treat me like their own daughter.

滋长.zh: 如果不好好沟通，误会会慢慢滋长。
滋长.en: If we don't communicate well, misunderstandings will slowly grow.

滋长.zh: 因为缺乏信任，嫉妒心开始滋长。
滋长.en: Because of lack of trust, jealousy began to grow.

滋长.zh: 这种不良风气不能任其滋长。
滋长.en: This unhealthy trend cannot be allowed to develop.
Anxiety is growing in the heart.

旱灾.en: This year's drought is very severe.

旱灾.zh: 由于持续干旱，很多地方都遭受了旱灾。
旱灾.en: Due to continuous drought, many places have suffered from drought.

旱灾.zh: 虽然政府采取了措施，但旱灾还是影响了收成。
旱灾.en: Although the government took measures, the drought still affected the harvest.

旱灾.zh: 旱灾导致农作物大量减产。
旱灾.en: The drought caused a significant reduction in crop yields.

旱灾.zh: 村里这几年没闹过旱灾。
旱灾.en: The village hasn't had a drought in recent years.

千家万户.zh: 这个政策惠及千家万户。
春节的时候，千家万户都会贴春联。
千家万户.en: During Spring Festival, every household pastes Spring Festival couplets.

千家万户.zh: 随着网络普及，千家万户都能上网了。
千家万户.en: With the spread of the internet, every household can access the internet.

千家万户.zh: 这件事关系到千家万户的利益。
千家万户.en: This matter concerns the interests of countless households.

千家万户.zh: 这个新闻传遍了千家万户。
千家万户.en: The news spread to every household.

让座.en: Please offer your seat to the elderly.

让座.zh: 在公交车上，他主动给孕妇让座。
让座.en: On the bus, he proactively offered his seat to a pregnant woman.

让座.zh: 虽然自己也很累，但她还是选择了让座。
让座.en: Although she was tired too, she still chose to offer her seat.
Offering seats is a traditional virtue.

让座.zh: 你会给抱小孩的人让座吗？
让座.en: Would you offer your seat to someone holding a child?

常温.en: This medicine should be stored at room temperature.

常温.zh: 常温下，牛奶放一天就会变质。
常温.en: At room temperature, milk will spoil in a day.

常温.zh: 虽然标签上写着常温，但我觉得还是放冰箱好。
常温.en: Although the label says room temperature, I think it's better to put it in the fridge.

常温.zh: 夏天常温很高，要注意食物保鲜。
常温.en: In summer, room temperature is high, so pay attention to food preservation.
Can you drink yogurt at room temperature?

朝代.en: The Tang Dynasty is a famous dynasty.

朝代.zh: 每个朝代都有自己独特的文化特色。
朝代.en: Each dynasty had its own unique cultural characteristics.

朝代.zh: 虽然朝代更替了，但很多传统保留了下来。
朝代.en: Although dynasties changed, many traditions were preserved.

朝代.zh: 这个朝代持续了三百年。
朝代.en: This dynasty lasted three hundred years.

短促.zh: 秋天很短暂，假期更是短促。
短促.en: Autumn is short, and the holiday is even shorter.

短促.zh: 因为时间短促，我们只能参观几个景点。
短促.en: Because time was short, we could only visit a few scenic spots.

短促.zh: 他发出了一声短促的尖叫。
短促.en: He let out a short, sharp scream.

稻谷.en: The rice in the fields is ripe.

稻谷.zh: 农民们正在收割金黄色的稻谷。
稻谷.en: The farmers are harvesting the golden rice.

稻谷.zh: 如果天气好，今年的稻谷收成会很不错。
稻谷.en: If the weather is good, this year's rice harvest will be very good.

稻谷.zh: 稻谷脱壳后就变成了大米。
稻谷.en: After husking, rice becomes white rice.
The price of paddy rice this year is good.

家家户户.zh: 过年的时候，家家户户都忙着准备年货。
家家户户.en: During the New Year, every household is busy preparing New Year goods.

家家户户.zh: 因为停电，家家户户都点了蜡烛。
家家户户.en: Because of the power outage, every household lit candles.

家家户户.zh: 这条街上的家家户户都认识我。
家家户户.en: Every household on this street knows me.

家家户户.zh: 村里家家户户通了自来水。
家家户户.en: Every household in the village has running water.

统筹兼顾.zh: 做项目要统筹兼顾各个方面。
统筹兼顾.en: When doing a project, you need to consider all aspects comprehensively.

统筹兼顾.zh: 他统筹兼顾了工作和家庭。
统筹兼顾.en: He balanced work and family harmoniously.

统筹兼顾.zh: 这个方案统筹兼顾了成本和效率。
统筹兼顾.en: This plan takes both cost and efficiency into account.

统筹兼顾.zh: 作为领导，你必须学会统筹兼顾。
统筹兼顾.en: As a leader, you must learn to plan comprehensively.

统筹兼顾.zh: 我们统筹兼顾，既考虑了短期利益也考虑了长期发展。
统筹兼顾.en: We made overall plans, taking into account both short-term interests and long-term development.

文娱.zh: 周末我们有很多文娱活动。
文娱.en: We have lots of recreational activities on weekends.

文娱.zh: 这个小区文娱设施很齐全。
文娱.en: This neighborhood has very complete entertainment facilities.

文娱.zh: 公司组织了一次文娱晚会。
文娱.en: The company organized a cultural evening party.

文娱.zh: 除了学习，也要注意文娱生活。
文娱.en: Besides studying, you should also pay attention to recreational life.

文娱.zh: 他们每周都参加文娱活动，放松心情。
文娱.en: They attend recreational activities every week to relax.

车号.en: His license plate number is Jing A12345.
Write down that car's license plate number.

车号.zh: 停车场里车号太多了，我找不到。
车号.en: There are too many license plates in the parking lot; I can't find mine.

车号.zh: 警察通过车号找到了车主。
车号.en: The police found the owner through the license plate number.

车号.zh: 你把车号告诉我，我去查一下。
车号.en: Tell me the license plate number, and I'll check it.

清真.en: He likes to eat halal beef noodles.
There is a halal cafeteria near the school.

清真.zh: 我们点了清真的羊肉串。
他因为宗教信仰只去清真饭店。
清真.en: He only goes to halal restaurants because of his religious beliefs.

铜矿.zh: 这个地区发现了大铜矿。
铜矿.en: A large copper mine was discovered in this area.

铜矿.zh: 铜矿开采对环境有影响。
铜矿.en: Copper mining has an impact on the environment.

铜矿.zh: 工人们正在铜矿里工作。
铜矿.en: The workers are working in the copper mine.

铜矿.zh: 虽然铜矿开采利润很高，但是对环境破坏很大。
铜矿.en: Although copper mining is very profitable, it causes great damage to the environment.

铜矿.zh: 他们投资开发了一个新铜矿。
铜矿.en: They invested in developing a new copper mine.

宁肯.en: I would rather walk than take the car.

宁肯.zh: 他宁肯自己吃亏也不让别人难受。
宁肯.en: He would rather suffer himself than make others uncomfortable.

宁肯.zh: 宁肯多花点时间，也要把质量做好。
宁肯.en: I would rather spend more time to ensure good quality.

宁肯.zh: 她宁肯辞职也不愿意加班。
宁肯.en: She would rather quit her job than work overtime.

宁肯.zh: 我宁肯饿着也不吃那个东西。
宁肯.en: I would rather go hungry than eat that thing.

螺丝钉.en: There is a screw on the table.

螺丝钉.zh: 这个螺丝钉松了，需要拧紧。
螺丝钉.en: This screw is loose and needs to be tightened.

螺丝钉.zh: 他像一颗螺丝钉一样坚守岗位。
螺丝钉.en: He sticks to his post like a screw.

螺丝钉.zh: 工具箱里有很多螺丝钉。
螺丝钉.en: There are many screws in the toolbox.

螺丝钉.zh: 我用螺丝刀把螺丝钉拧进去了。
螺丝钉.en: I used a screwdriver to screw the screw in.

乌黑.en: Her hair is jet black and shiny.
The sky is pitch black; it's about to rain.
His eyes are jet black and very expressive.

乌黑.zh: 那只猫的毛乌黑乌黑的。
乌黑.en: That cat's fur is completely black.

乌黑.zh: 夜晚乌黑一片，什么都看不见。
乌黑.en: The night is pitch black; nothing can be seen.

终年.en: This mountain is covered with snow all year round.
He works away from home all year.

终年.zh: 这里气候温暖，终年如春。
终年.en: The climate here is warm, like spring all year.

终年.zh: 因为终年积雪，所以这座山游客很少。
终年.en: Because it is snow-covered all year, this mountain has few tourists.
This river never freezes all year.

高新技术.zh: 我们公司专注于高新技术研发。
高新技术.en: Our company focuses on high-tech research and development.

高新技术.zh: 高新技术产业是经济增长点。
高新技术.en: The high-tech industry is a driver of economic growth.

高新技术.zh: 他大学学的是高新技术专业。
高新技术.en: He studied high-tech as his major in college.

高新技术.zh: 国家大力支持高新技术企业。
高新技术.en: The state strongly supports high-tech enterprises.

高新技术.zh: 既然选择了高新技术行业，就要不断学习。
高新技术.en: Since you chose the high-tech industry, you must keep learning.

羽绒服.zh: 这件羽绒服保暖效果特别好，还防水。
羽绒服.en: This down jacket is particularly warm and also waterproof.

羽绒服.zh: 冬天去哈尔滨一定要穿羽绒服。
羽绒服.en: When going to Harbin in winter, you must wear a down jacket.

羽绒服.zh: 虽然羽绒服很厚，但是穿起来并不重。
羽绒服.en: Although the down jacket is thick, it's not heavy to wear.

羽绒服.zh: 我的羽绒服被猫抓破了，需要修补。
羽绒服.en: My down jacket was scratched by the cat and needs repair.

口试.zh: 口试的时候不要太紧张，放松一点。
口试.en: Don't be too nervous during the oral exam, relax a bit.

口试.zh: 这门课的成绩包括笔试和口试两部分。
口试.en: The grade for this course includes both written and oral exams.

口试.zh: 因为我口语不太好，所以对口试特别担心。
口试.en: Because my spoken language is not very good, I'm especially worried about the oral exam.

口试.zh: 口试结束后，老师给了我一些建议。
口试.en: After the oral exam, the teacher gave me some advice.

凹凸.zh: 这个凹凸不平的路面让我开车很不舒服。
凹凸.en: This uneven road surface makes driving very uncomfortable.

凹凸.zh: 墙壁上有一些凹凸的花纹。
凹凸.en: There are some bumpy patterns on the wall.

凹凸.zh: 虽然这块石头表面凹凸不平，但是很有艺术感。
凹凸.en: Although the surface of this stone is uneven, it's very artistic.

凹凸.zh: 轮胎经过凹凸的地方要慢慢开。
凹凸.en: Drive slowly when the tires go over uneven places.

贬义.en: This word has a derogatory meaning.

贬义.zh: 说话的时候要注意，别用了带贬义的词语。
贬义.en: When speaking, be careful not to use words with derogatory meanings.

贬义.zh: "胖子"这个词有时会让人觉得有贬义。
贬义.en: The word 'fatty' sometimes makes people feel it's derogatory.

贬义.zh: 虽然这个词本身是中性，但在某些语境下会变成贬义。
贬义.en: Although this word is neutral itself, in some contexts it becomes derogatory.

贬义.zh: 他用了贬义的称呼，对方很不高兴。
贬义.en: He used a derogatory term, and the other party was very unhappy.

衣食住行.en: Clothing, food, housing, and transportation are all important.

衣食住行.zh: 在大城市里，衣食住行的开销都不小。
衣食住行.en: In big cities, the expenses for clothing, food, housing, and transportation are not small.

衣食住行.zh: 现在人们的衣食住行越来越方便了。
衣食住行.en: Now people's basic necessities are becoming more convenient.

衣食住行.zh: 除了工作以外，衣食住行也是每天要考虑的事情。
衣食住行.en: Besides work, clothing, food, housing, and transportation are also things to consider every day.

衣食住行.zh: 旅行时要注意当地的衣食住行习惯。
衣食住行.en: When traveling, pay attention to local customs regarding basic necessities.

写字台.en: My writing desk is very messy.

写字台.zh: 他坐在写字台前认真地写作业。
写字台.en: He sat at the writing desk and did his homework seriously.

写字台.zh: 这张写字台是实木的，很结实。
写字台.en: This writing desk is solid wood, very sturdy.

写字台.zh: 因为家里空间小，所以写字台只能放在墙角。
写字台.en: Because the home space is small, the writing desk can only be placed in the corner.

写字台.zh: 小时候我总在写字台上画画。
写字台.en: When I was little, I always drew pictures on the writing desk.

必修.zh: 大一的时候我们要上很多必修课。
必修.en: In freshman year, we have to take many required courses.

必修.zh: 英语是我们学校的必修科目。
必修.en: English is a compulsory subject at our school.

必修.zh: 虽然必修课比较枯燥，但还是要好好学习。
必修.en: Although required courses are relatively boring, we still have to study them well.

必修.zh: 除了必修课，我还选了几门选修课。
必修.en: Besides required courses, I also chose a few elective courses.

上旬.en: The event will be held in the first ten days of the month.

上旬.zh: 这个月上旬我有一个重要的面试。
上旬.en: In the first ten days of this month, I have an important interview.

上旬.zh: 房租要在每个月上旬交。
上旬.en: The rent should be paid in the first ten days of each month.

上旬.zh: 因为上旬太忙，所以我把聚会安排到了下旬。
上旬.en: Because I'm too busy in the first ten days, I scheduled the gathering for the latter part of the month.
The weather in the first ten days is relatively cool.

布告.en: There's a notice posted at the door.

布告.zh: 布告栏上的通知需要大家仔细阅读。
布告.en: The notices on the bulletin board need everyone to read carefully.

布告.zh: 学校布告说下周要考试。
布告.en: The school notice says there will be exams next week.

布告.zh: 如果你没看到布告，可以去问管理员。
布告.en: If you didn't see the notice, you can ask the administrator.

布告.zh: 这张布告是用红色纸写的，很显眼。
布告.en: This notice was written on red paper, very eye-catching.

看得起.en: Thank you for thinking highly of me.

看得起.zh: 他很有本事，大家都看得起他。
看得起.en: He is very capable; everyone thinks highly of him.

看得起.zh: 别觉得自己不如别人，要看得起自己。
看得起.en: Don't feel inferior to others; you need to value yourself.

看得起.zh: 虽然他家境不好，但是老师却非常看得起他。
看得起.en: Although his family background is poor, the teacher thinks very highly of him.

看得起.zh: 如果你工作努力，老板就会看得起你。
看得起.en: If you work hard, the boss will think highly of you.

波涛汹涌.en: The sea surface is surging with waves.

波涛汹涌.zh: 我们坐船时遇到波涛汹涌，差点晕船。
波涛汹涌.en: When we were on the boat, we encountered surging waves and almost got seasick.

波涛汹涌.zh: 虽然海面波涛汹涌，但船长很镇定。
波涛汹涌.en: Although the sea was surging with waves, the captain was very calm.

波涛汹涌.zh: 远处的波涛汹涌让人害怕。
波涛汹涌.en: The surging waves in the distance are frightening.

波涛汹涌.zh: 在波涛汹涌的大海上，渔船显得很渺小。
波涛汹涌.en: On the surging sea, the fishing boat looks very tiny.

空前绝后.zh: 他的表演才华可以说空前绝后，没人能比。
空前绝后.en: His performance talent can be said to be unparalleled, no one can compare.

空前绝后.zh: 虽然有很多人尝试，但这一纪录空前绝后。
空前绝后.en: Although many people have tried, this record is unprecedented.

空前绝后.zh: 那场比赛的精彩程度空前绝后。
空前绝后.en: The excitement of that game was unmatched.

空前绝后.zh: 这种艺术品在历史上空前绝后。
空前绝后.en: This kind of artwork is unprecedented in history.

望见.zh: 站在山顶，我可以望见整个城市。
望见.en: Standing on the mountaintop, I can see the entire city.

望见.zh: 因为雾太大，我没能望见那座塔。
望见.en: Because the fog was too thick, I couldn't see that tower.

望见.zh: 他望见朋友在对面招手。
望见.en: He saw his friend waving from across the street.

望见.zh: 从窗户望见公园里有很多人。
望见.en: From the window, I can see many people in the park.

考题.en: This exam question is very difficult.

考题.zh: 这次的考题比上次简单一些。
考题.en: This time's exam questions are a bit simpler than last time.

考题.zh: 虽然复习了很久，但考题还是出乎意料。
考题.en: Although I reviewed for a long time, the exam questions were still unexpected.
The exam questions the teacher set are very flexible.

考题.zh: 我们讨论了一下考题的答案。
考题.en: We discussed the answers to the exam questions a bit.

斑纹.zh: 这种鱼的斑纹很漂亮，像彩虹一样。
斑纹.en: The markings on this fish are very beautiful, like a rainbow.

斑纹.zh: 虽然斑马有黑白斑纹，但每一只都不一样。
斑纹.en: Although zebras have black and white stripes, each one is different.

斑纹.zh: 蝴蝶翅膀上的斑纹很独特。
斑纹.en: The patterns on the butterfly's wings are very unique.

斑纹.zh: 猫咪身上的斑纹有点像老虎。
斑纹.en: The markings on the cat's body look a bit like a tiger's.

正负.en: Positive and negative charges attract each other.

正负.zh: 考试分数有正负之分吗？
正负.en: Do exam scores have positive and negative distinctions?

正负.zh: 因为正负号搞错了，所以答案错了。
正负.en: Because the positive and negative signs were mixed up, the answer was wrong.
The positive or negative nature of this number is very important.

正负.zh: 我们要考虑正负两个方面。
正负.en: We need to consider both the positive and negative aspects.

戏曲.en: I like watching traditional Chinese opera.

戏曲.zh: 奶奶特别喜欢听戏曲，每天都要看。
戏曲.en: Grandma really loves listening to opera and watches it every day.

戏曲.zh: 虽然戏曲很古老，但年轻人也开始喜欢了。
戏曲.en: Although opera is very ancient, young people are starting to like it too.

戏曲.zh: 戏曲表演需要很多功夫。
戏曲.en: Opera performances require a lot of skill.

戏曲.zh: 他学习了京剧等好几种戏曲。
戏曲.en: He studied several types of opera, including Beijing opera.

海内外.en: There are many tourists from home and abroad.

海内外.zh: 这部电影在海内外都获得了好评。
海内外.en: This movie received good reviews both domestically and internationally.

海内外.zh: 因为疫情，海内外的交流变少了。
海内外.en: Because of the pandemic, exchanges between domestic and overseas have decreased.

海内外.zh: 他的音乐在海内外都很流行。
海内外.en: His music is popular both at home and abroad.

海内外.zh: 我们公司业务拓展到海内外。
海内外.en: Our company's business has expanded domestically and overseas.

悬崖峭壁.en: This place is all cliffs and steep precipices.

悬崖峭壁.zh: 爬悬崖峭壁需要很大的勇气。
悬崖峭壁.en: Climbing cliffs and steep precipices requires a lot of courage.

悬崖峭壁.zh: 虽然前面是悬崖峭壁，但他还是坚持往上爬。
悬崖峭壁.en: Although ahead there were cliffs and steep precipices, he still insisted on climbing up.

悬崖峭壁.zh: 悬崖峭壁上的风景非常壮观。
悬崖峭壁.en: The scenery on the cliffs and steep precipices is very spectacular.

悬崖峭壁.zh: 他们沿着悬崖峭壁小心地行走。
悬崖峭壁.en: They walked carefully along the cliffs and steep precipices.

多元.zh: 这个城市的文化非常多元，很有意思。
多元.en: The culture of this city is very diverse and very interesting.

多元.zh: 因为学校有多元课程，我们可以选自己喜欢的。
多元.en: Because the school has diverse courses, we can choose the ones we like.

多元.zh: 多元的观点能帮助我们更好理解问题。
多元.en: Diverse viewpoints can help us better understand issues.

多元.zh: 他的兴趣爱好非常多元，从读书到运动。
多元.en: His hobbies and interests are very diverse, from reading to sports.

好学.en: He is very studious and often asks questions.

好学.zh: 我弟弟是个好学的人，周末也去图书馆。
好学.en: My younger brother is a studious person; he even goes to the library on weekends.

好学.zh: 如果你不好学，就很难进步。
好学.en: If you are not eager to learn, it's hard to make progress.

好学.zh: 她不仅聪明，而且非常好学，大家都喜欢她。
好学.en: She is not only smart but also very studious; everyone likes her.

好学.zh: 小时候我就很好学，现在依然如此。
好学.en: I was very eager to learn as a child, and I still am.

开夜车.zh: 明天考试，今晚我得开夜车。
开夜车.en: I have an exam tomorrow, so I have to burn the midnight oil tonight.

开夜车.zh: 他为了赶项目，连续开夜车好几天。
开夜车.en: He worked late nights for several days in a row to meet the project deadline.

开夜车.zh: 虽然开夜车很累，但有时候不得不这样做。
开夜车.en: Although burning the midnight oil is tiring, sometimes you have to do it.

开夜车.zh: 你最好别总是开夜车，对身体不好。
开夜车.en: You'd better not always stay up late; it's bad for your health.

开夜车.zh: 昨晚开夜车到凌晨三点，今天头很疼。
开夜车.en: I stayed up until three in the morning last night, so my head hurts today.

汤圆.en: We eat tangyuan on the Winter Solstice.

汤圆.zh: 超市里有各种口味的汤圆。
汤圆.en: The supermarket has all kinds of flavored tangyuan.

汤圆.zh: 妈妈做的汤圆又软又甜，很好吃。
汤圆.en: The tangyuan my mom makes are soft and sweet, very tasty.

汤圆.zh: 元宵节的时候，全家人一起煮汤圆。
汤圆.en: During the Lantern Festival, the whole family cooks tangyuan together.

汤圆.zh: 我喜欢芝麻馅的汤圆，你呢？
汤圆.en: I like sesame-filled tangyuan, how about you?

初等.en: This is an elementary math problem.

初等.zh: 他连初等的东西都不懂。
初等.en: He doesn't even understand basic things.

初等.zh: 初等教育是每个孩子的基础。
初等.en: Elementary education is the foundation for every child.

初等.zh: 虽然题目是初等水平，但我还是做错了。
初等.en: Although the problem was at an elementary level, I still got it wrong.

初等.zh: 这本书讲的是初等物理，很容易理解。
初等.en: This book covers elementary physics and is very easy to understand.

经纬.zh: 这张地图的经纬线很清晰。
经纬.en: The latitude and longitude lines on this map are very clear.

经纬.zh: 请告诉我这个位置的经纬坐标。
经纬.en: Please tell me the latitude and longitude coordinates of this location.

经纬.zh: 在古代，人们用经纬来导航。
经纬.en: In ancient times, people used latitude and longitude for navigation.

经纬.zh: 这种布的经纬密度很高，所以很结实。
经纬.en: This fabric has a high warp and weft density, so it's very sturdy.

经纬.zh: 你要学会看经纬度才能用导航仪。
经纬.en: You need to learn how to read latitude and longitude to use the GPS.

慢车.en: This is a slow train; it takes a long time.

慢车.zh: 慢车虽然便宜，但是时间太长。
慢车.en: Although the slow train is cheap, it takes too long.

慢车.zh: 我更喜欢坐慢车，可以看风景。
慢车.en: I prefer taking the slow train because I can enjoy the scenery.
During peak hours, even slow trains can be delayed.

慢车.zh: 从北京到上海，慢车要二十多个小时。
慢车.en: From Beijing to Shanghai, a slow train takes over twenty hours.

继往开来.en: Carrying forward the past and opening up the future is not easy.

继往开来.zh: 我们要继往开来，把事业做得更好。
继往开来.en: We must carry forward the past and open up the future to do better in our endeavors.

继往开来.zh: 这个节日是继往开来的象征。
继往开来.en: This festival is a symbol of carrying forward the past and opening up the future.

继往开来.zh: 他演讲时提到了继往开来的精神。
继往开来.en: He mentioned the spirit of carrying forward the past and opening up the future in his speech.

继往开来.zh: 我们公司一直秉持继往开来的理念。
继往开来.en: Our company has always adhered to the philosophy of carrying forward the past and opening up the future.

勤恳.zh: 虽然他很勤恳，但效率不高。
勤恳.en: Although he is very diligent, he is not very efficient.

勤恳.zh: 老师夸他学习勤恳，从不偷懒。
勤恳.en: The teacher praised him for being diligent in his studies and never slacking off.

勤恳.zh: 小王是个勤恳的员工，老板很满意。
勤恳.en: Xiao Wang is a diligent employee; his boss is very satisfied.

做东.en: Today it's my treat; I'll play the host.

做东.zh: 这次聚会我来做东，大家随便点。
做东.en: I'll be the host for this gathering; everyone order whatever you like.

做东.zh: 如果你们来我的城市，我一定做东。
做东.en: If you come to my city, I'll definitely treat you.

做东.zh: 上次你请了，这次该我做东了吧？
做东.en: You treated last time, so it's my turn to be the host this time, right?

做东.zh: 他每次朋友聚餐都抢着做东，很热情。
做东.en: He always rushes to be the host at every dinner with friends; he's very enthusiastic.

通货.zh: 国家需要控制通货的发行量。
通货.en: The country needs to control the amount of currency issued.

通货.zh: 保持通货稳定对经济很重要。
通货.en: Maintaining currency stability is very important for the economy.

通货.zh: 这个国家的通货购买力下降了。
通货.en: The purchasing power of this country's currency has declined.

通货.zh: 政府采取措施来调节通货。
通货.en: The government is taking measures to regulate the currency.

俯仰.en: In a flash, he ran far away.

俯仰.zh: 他简单地做了个俯仰动作。
俯仰.en: He did a simple up-and-down movement.

俯仰.zh: 人生俯仰几十年，要珍惜当下。
俯仰.en: Life is just a few decades in a blink; cherish the present.

俯仰.zh: 我俯仰了一下脖子，感觉舒服多了。
俯仰.en: I tilted my neck up and down, and it felt much better.

俯仰.zh: 他虽然年纪大了，但俯仰之间还是那么灵活。
俯仰.en: Although he is old, he is still so agile in a split second.

端午节.en: We eat zongzi on Dragon Boat Festival.

端午节.zh: 今年端午节我要去看赛龙舟。
端午节.en: This Dragon Boat Festival I'm going to watch dragon boat races.

端午节.zh: 端午节的时候，家里挂上了艾草。
端午节.en: During Dragon Boat Festival, we hung mugwort at home.

端午节.zh: 虽然工作很忙，但端午节我还是回了老家。
端午节.en: Although work was very busy, I still went back to my hometown for Dragon Boat Festival.

端午节.zh: 妈妈包了好多粽子，端午节我们吃了整整三天。
端午节.en: Mom made a lot of zongzi, and we ate them for three whole days during the Dragon Boat Festival.

拔苗助长.en: You can't force growth in learning.

拔苗助长.zh: 家长别拔苗助长，孩子需要慢慢来。
拔苗助长.en: Parents shouldn't force growth; children need to take it slow.

拔苗助长.zh: 他为了快速成功，结果拔苗助长，反而失败了。
拔苗助长.en: He tried to rush success, but ended up forcing things and failed instead.

拔苗助长.zh: 那种拔苗助长的做法，只会让植物死得更快。
拔苗助长.en: That method of pulling seedlings to help them grow only makes the plants die faster.

拔苗助长.zh: 如果你总是拔苗助长，最后可能会适得其反。
拔苗助长.en: If you always try to force things, it might backfire in the end.

糖葫芦.en: I want to eat a stick of candied hawthorn.
There's someone selling candied hawthorn on the street.

糖葫芦.zh: 糖葫芦酸酸甜甜的，很好吃。
糖葫芦.en: Candied hawthorn is sour and sweet, very tasty.

糖葫芦.zh: 小时候每次看到卖糖葫芦的，我都拉着妈妈买。
糖葫芦.en: When I was a kid, every time I saw a candied hawthorn vendor, I would drag my mom to buy one.

糖葫芦.zh: 除了山楂，现在还有草莓和橘子的糖葫芦。
糖葫芦.en: Besides hawthorn, now there are also candied strawberry and orange versions.

碧玉.en: This piece of green jade is very beautiful.
She wore a green jade bracelet.

碧玉.zh: 她是个小家碧玉型的女孩。
碧玉.en: She is a girl of a gentle and refined type.

碧玉.zh: 那块碧玉雕刻的佛像栩栩如生。
碧玉.en: That Buddha statue carved from green jade is lifelike.

碧玉.zh: 虽然只是块小碧玉，但颜色很正，价值不菲。
碧玉.en: Although it's just a small piece of green jade, the color is very pure and it's quite valuable.

砖瓦.zh: 这些砖瓦是盖房子用的。
砖瓦.en: These bricks and tiles are for building a house.

砖瓦.zh: 老房子拆了，砖瓦堆了一地。
砖瓦.en: The old house was torn down, and bricks and tiles were piled all over.

砖瓦.zh: 他小时候家里穷，住的是砖瓦房。
砖瓦.en: When he was a child, his family was poor and lived in a brick-and-tile house.

砖瓦.zh: 工厂生产各种砖瓦，质量特别好。
砖瓦.en: The factory produces all kinds of bricks and tiles, and the quality is especially good.

锦绣前程.zh: 他努力学习，为了锦绣前程。
锦绣前程.en: He studies hard for a bright future.

锦绣前程.zh: 只要肯努力，你会有锦绣前程的。
锦绣前程.en: As long as you work hard, you will have a bright future.

锦绣前程.zh: 她毕业后找到好工作，真是锦绣前程。
锦绣前程.en: She found a good job after graduation; it's truly a bright future.

锦绣前程.zh: 别担心眼前困难，锦绣前程在前面等着你。
锦绣前程.en: Don't worry about the current difficulties; a bright future is waiting for you ahead.

重阳节.en: On Double Ninth Festival, you climb a hill.

重阳节.zh: 重阳节那天，我们去爬山了。
重阳节.en: On the day of Double Ninth Festival, we went mountain climbing.

重阳节.zh: 每年重阳节，我都会陪爷爷奶奶。
重阳节.en: Every year on Double Ninth Festival, I accompany my grandparents.

重阳节.zh: 虽然重阳节不是法定假日，但很多人还是会回家。
重阳节.en: Although Double Ninth Festival is not a public holiday, many people still go home.

重阳节.zh: 重阳节除了登高，还要赏菊花和吃重阳糕。
重阳节.en: Besides climbing, on Double Ninth Festival you also admire chrysanthemums and eat double-ninth cake.

电饭锅.en: She cooks rice with a new rice cooker.

电饭锅.zh: 我家的电饭锅用了十年了。
电饭锅.en: My family's rice cooker has been used for ten years.

电饭锅.zh: 电饭锅不仅可以煮饭，还能煲汤。
电饭锅.en: A rice cooker can not only cook rice but also make soup.

电饭锅.zh: 你记得拔掉电饭锅的插头吗？
电饭锅.en: Do you remember to unplug the rice cooker?

小偷儿.en: There has been a thief in the neighborhood recently.

小偷儿.zh: 我家昨天进了一个小偷儿。
小偷儿.en: A thief broke into my house yesterday.

小偷儿.zh: 那个小偷儿趁人不注意偷走了手机。
小偷儿.en: The thief stole the phone when no one was paying attention.

小偷儿.zh: 虽然小偷儿跑得快，但最后还是被警察抓住了。
小偷儿.en: Although the thief ran fast, he was finally caught by the police.

表面上.zh: 他表面上很冷静，其实心里特别紧张。
表面上.en: He appears calm on the surface, but he's actually very nervous inside.

表面上.zh: 表面上看起来不错，实际不行。
表面上.en: It looks good on the surface, but actually it's no good.

表面上.zh: 她表面上答应帮忙，背地里却抱怨。
表面上.en: She agreed to help on the surface, but complained behind the scenes.

表面上.zh: 这件事表面上很简单，做起来才发现很难。
表面上.en: This matter seems simple on the surface, but it turns out to be very difficult when you actually do it.

表面上.zh: 别只看表面上，要深入了解。
表面上.en: Don't just look at the surface; you need to understand deeply.

低碳.zh: 现在很多人提倡低碳生活。
低碳.en: Many people now advocate for a low-carbon lifestyle.

低碳.zh: 低碳出行可以减少环境污染。
低碳.en: Low-carbon travel can reduce environmental pollution.

低碳.zh: 我们公司最近在推广低碳办公。
低碳.en: Our company has been promoting low-carbon office practices recently.

低碳.zh: 如果大家都选择低碳方式，地球会更健康。
低碳.en: If everyone chooses low-carbon methods, the Earth will be healthier.

低碳.zh: 吃本地蔬菜也是一种低碳选择。
低碳.en: Eating local vegetables is also a low-carbon choice.

墨水儿.en: My pen is out of ink.

墨水儿.zh: 这个打印机需要加墨水儿。
墨水儿.en: This printer needs to add ink.

墨水儿.zh: 你写字的时候墨水儿弄到手上了。
墨水儿.en: You got ink on your hands while writing.

墨水儿.zh: 这种墨水儿颜色很好看。
墨水儿.en: This type of ink has a very nice color.

墨水儿.zh: 他不小心把墨水儿洒在桌布上了。
墨水儿.en: He accidentally spilled ink on the tablecloth.

纽扣儿.zh: 你衣服上的纽扣儿掉了。
纽扣儿.en: A button on your shirt fell off.

纽扣儿.zh: 帮我缝一下这个纽扣儿。
纽扣儿.en: Help me sew on this button.

纽扣儿.zh: 这件外套的纽扣儿是金属的。
纽扣儿.en: The buttons on this coat are metal.

纽扣儿.zh: 她买了一些漂亮的纽扣儿做手工。
纽扣儿.en: She bought some pretty buttons for crafts.

纽扣儿.zh: 如果纽扣儿丢了，可以去裁缝店配。
纽扣儿.en: If you lose a button, you can get a replacement at a tailor shop.

取款机.zh: 我在取款机取了五百块。
取款机.en: I withdrew five hundred yuan from the ATM.

取款机.zh: 取款机前面排了好长的队。
取款机.en: There was a long queue in front of the ATM.

取款机.zh: 这个取款机坏了，不能取钱。
取款机.en: This ATM is broken, so you can't withdraw money.

取款机.zh: 晚上去取款机要注意安全。
取款机.en: Be careful about safety when using an ATM at night.

却是.zh: 他说他来了，却是骗人的。
却是.en: He said he came, but it was a lie.

却是.zh: 我以为很简单，做起来却是很难。
却是.en: I thought it was simple, but it turned out to be very hard.

却是.zh: 她看起来温柔，性格却是很倔强。
却是.en: She looks gentle, but her personality is very stubborn.

却是.zh: 这件衣服很贵，质量却是不好。
却是.en: This piece of clothing is very expensive, but the quality is not good.

却是.zh: 大家都笑了，他却是面无表情。
却是.en: Everyone laughed, but he had a blank expression.

薯片.en: This bag of chips isn't very crispy anymore.

薯片.zh: 边看电视边吃薯片很享受。
薯片.en: It's very enjoyable to eat chips while watching TV.

薯片.zh: 薯片吃多了对身体不好。
薯片.en: Eating too many chips is bad for your health.

薯片.zh: 她买了一袋薯片和一瓶可乐。
薯片.en: She bought a bag of chips and a bottle of cola.

摊儿.en: There is a fruit stall by the roadside.

摊儿.zh: 早上市场有很多小摊儿卖早餐。
摊儿.en: In the morning, there are many small stalls selling breakfast at the market.

摊儿.zh: 他在学校门口摆了个书摊儿。
摊儿.en: He set up a book stall at the school gate.

摊儿.zh: 城管来了，摊儿都收走了。
摊儿.en: The city management came, and all the stalls were packed up.

性价比.zh: 这个手机的性价比很高。
性价比.en: This phone has great value for money.

性价比.zh: 买性价比高的东西才划算。
性价比.en: It's only worthwhile to buy things with good value for money.

性价比.zh: 我们比较了几款车的性价比。
性价比.en: We compared the value for money of several car models.
Although it's expensive, its value for money is average.

性价比.zh: 选房子不能只看价格，也要看性价比。
性价比.en: When choosing a house, you can't just look at the price; you also need to consider the value for money.

有没有.en: Is there any place selling water here?
Have you ever been to Beijing?

有没有.zh: 他有没有告诉你这件事？
有没有.en: Did he tell you about this matter?

有没有.zh: 不知道他有没有收到我的消息。
有没有.en: I don't know if he received my message.

招投标.en: This bidding process is very competitive.

招投标.zh: 我们公司刚参加了一个招投标项目。
招投标.en: Our company just participated in a bidding project.

招投标.zh: 招投标的结果下周一才会公布，大家都很紧张。
招投标.en: The bidding results won't be announced until next Monday, and everyone is very nervous.

招投标.zh: 他们因为材料没准备好，错过了招投标的截止时间。
招投标.en: They missed the bidding deadline because the materials weren't ready.

招投标.zh: 你要是想中标，就得认真研究招投标的规则和要求。
招投标.en: If you want to win the bid, you need to carefully study the rules and requirements of the bidding.

指着.zh: 他指着地图说：“就是这儿。”
指着.en: He pointed at the map and said, 'Right here.'

指着.zh: 你别老指着别人，想想自己的问题。
指着.en: Don't always point at others; think about your own problems.

指着.zh: 妈妈指着天上的星星，告诉孩子那叫北斗星。
指着.en: Mom pointed at the stars in the sky and told the child that those are called the Big Dipper.

指着.zh: 我们全家就指着他一个人赚钱，压力太大了。
指着.en: Our whole family relies on him alone to make money; the pressure is too great.

指着.zh: 他指着窗外说，那辆红色的车就是他的。
指着.en: He pointed out the window and said that the red car was his.

总监.en: Did the director have a meeting today?

总监.zh: 我们总监说话很有条理。
总监让我把这个方案改一下。
总监.en: The director asked me to revise this plan.

总监.zh: 因为总监出差了，所以会议推迟到下周一。
总监.en: Because the director is on a business trip, the meeting is postponed to next Monday.

总监.zh: 新来的总监对市场很有经验，大家都很佩服他。
总监.en: The new director has a lot of experience in the market, and everyone admires him.
